original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: You've brought her where she wanted to go, despite her criminal past.
translation: 尽管她有犯罪的前科，你仍然把她带到了她想去的地方。

original: She tips her hat as she disembarks and deposits a heavy purse into your hands.  She whistles a jaunty tune as she makes her way through the station.
translation: 下车时，她向你倾帽致意，把一个颇重的钱袋递到了你手中。她吹着欢快的哨子穿过车站。

original: The Political Machine
translation: 政治机器

original:
It is [qvd:133938(Day)]. [qvd:133938(Atmosphere)] 

[qvd:133937(SecretaryComment)]

[Every day you get one action to try to boost your Bill's Political Capital. The higher this is, the better its chances of passing at the end of the week.]
translation:
现在是[qvd:133938(Day)]。[qvd:133938(Atmosphere)] 

[qvd:133937(SecretaryComment)]

[每天你都可以采取一个行动，尝试提高你法案的政治资本。政治资本越高，法案在周末通过的机会就越大。]

original: Deliver a stirring speech in the House
translation: 在议院发表煽动性演讲

original: You will convince them in advance that this bill should be law.
translation: 你会提前说服他们，这个法案应该成为法律。

original: The House rocks with applause
translation: 议院内掌声雷动

original: You appeal to their patriotism. You stir their souls. You paint them a picture of a better world. Where necessary, you even talk about the actual bill.
translation: 你迎合他们的爱国心。你煽动他们的灵魂。你给他们描绘了一个更美好的世界。必要时，你甚至还可以谈一谈实际的法案。

original: A damp squib of an announcement
translation: 如哑炮一般的声明

original: Boo! Boo! You slink away, tail between your legs and notes ready for the fireplace.
translation: 嘘——！嘘——！你夹着尾巴悄悄溜走，你的笔记已经准备好去壁炉里当燃料了。

original: Take the new law before the House
translation: 将新法提交给议院

original: You've done all you can. It's time to put it to the vote.
translation: 你已经做了你能做的一切。是时候将其付诸表决了。

original: A New Law is made!
translation: 新法诞生！

original:
[qvd:133937(HouseResponse)] All that remains is to take it to the Throne of Hours, where the Empress will choose whether or not to grant it her royal stamp. As you file out of the House you see one of the First Secretary's clerks watching. She nods her head approvingly. Your status in Parliament is clearly on the rise.

[Every time you successfully pass a law, the House of Commons becomes wiser to your tricks. Succeeding will get harder each time. Head out and gather another example of the Will of the People to begin passing a new law.]
translation:
[qvd:133937(HouseResponse)]如今只剩最后一步：将法案呈送时间王座，由女皇裁决是否加盖皇家印章。你随人群离开议院时，注意到首席大臣的那位文员仍在注视你。她点了点头，面露赞许。显然，你在议会中的地位正稳步上升。

[每当你通过一项法律，下议院将更容易看透你的伎俩，立法之路也将愈发艰难。离开议院，再次收集民意，以推进新一轮立法。]

original: Voted down
translation: 否决

original:
Despite your efforts, you are unable to convince the House to rubber-stamp your bill. As everyone files out in search of drinks, you see one of the First Secretary's clerks waiting for you in the corridor. She shakes her head, conveying her superior's disappointment.

[Find more examples of the Will of the People to pass a new law.]
translation:
尽管你竭尽所能，众议院仍不肯通过你的法案。议员们鱼贯而出，前往觅酒之时，你看见首席大臣的一名文员在走廊里等你。她轻轻摇头，显然是在传达上司的失望。

[收集更多民意来通过新法律。]

original: Dig up dirt on a rival MP
translation: 挖出对手议员的污点

original: An Ambitious Orator has set his sights on you. He must be dealt with.
translation: 一个野心勃勃的演说家已经把目光投向了你。必须要对付他。

original: A masterful moral assassination
translation: 一次技艺高超的道德暗杀

original: The clerks of your Ministry come through with style. You just have to wait for a quiet moment with the fellow, where as a friend, you persuade him that another, most uncivilised MP, is about to release details of his recent visit to Magdalene's. He leaves in a hurry.
translation: 你所在部门的书记员们风度翩翩地四处走动。你只需等待与这个家伙的一个安静的相处时刻，站在朋友的立场上使他相信，另一位极为下作的国会议员即将公布他最近访问抹大拉之家的细节。他匆匆离开了。

original: A failed attempt at blackmail
translation: 勒索失败

original: What's that, he demands? You think you have what? Oh, please. No, go and tell everyone. See how much they care. He slaps you hard on the back, wishing you better luck next time.
translation: 那究竟是什么？他坚持要你直说出口。你觉得你掌握着什么？哦，拜托。不，去把它告诉所有人吧。看看他们能有多关心。他用力拍你的背，希望你下次的运气会更好一些。

original: Intimidate the backbenchers
translation: 恫吓后座议员

original: They squabble so. Let them put their voices to good use.
translation: 他们这样喋喋不休。逼他们把嘴皮子用在正道上。

original: Laying down the law
translation: 立下规矩

original: A careful series of threats and bribes does your dirty work better than you could have hoped. The yapping hordes eat up your words and agree to support you. Alone they may not be enough to push your agenda through, but it certainly won't hurt.
translation: 一系列谨慎的威胁和贿赂让你的肮脏工作比你想象的更好。那群聒噪的人消化了你的话，并同意支持你。仅靠他们可能不足以推动你的议程，但肯定不会有什么坏处。

original: Arguments from authority
translation: 争辩权威

original: Your relatively junior status in Parliament doesn't go unnoticed. The only backbenchers who don't outright refuse your orders are the ones too busy laughing to respond.
translation: 你在议会中相对较低的地位并没有被忽视。唯一没有直接拒绝你命令的后座议员是那些忙着嘲笑你的人。

original: Conduct a survey of the protestors outside
translation: 对议院外的抗议者进行民意调查

original: Carefully selecting the questions should produce the right answers.
translation: 谨慎选择问题，就能从他们口中得到你要的答案。

original: An effortless sweep
translation: 一次毫不费力的扫荡

original: With the help of your attractive staff, scrubbed up and pushed into suits they will never be able to afford, you put the key questions to the protesters outside. No one wants to disappoint the attractive, smiling people in front of them, and you receive the answers your questions demanded.
translation: 你在那些迷人的工作人员的帮助下把自己打理干净，穿上他们永远买不起的西装，随后把关键问题抛给外面的抗议者。没有人想让面前这位迷人而面带微笑的人失望，而你得到了你的问题所要求的答案。

original: The worst possible outcome
translation: 下下签

original:
You send out a couple of your staff to conduct a survey. They return, proudly announcing that they have gathered the truth. The truth! What political survey ever sought the truth? 

The Loquacious Civil Servant explains the art of asking questions that will get the answers you actually want, but it is too late. Worse, opponents of your bill have already seen the results and know exactly how much support it has amongst the people.
translation:
你派几名员工前去进行民意调查。回来后，他们自豪地宣布已经收集到了真相。真相！哪门子政治调查的目的会是寻求真相？

饶舌的公务员向你介绍该如何通过诱导性提问来获得你想获得的答案，但为时已晚。更糟的是，你法案的反对者们已经看到了结果，并且清楚地知道它在人民中得到了多少支持。

original: Commission a voyage into the Flooded Cellars
translation: 策划一次进入水淹酒窖的航行

original: A few gifts of some pre-Fall wine will turn opinion in a hurry.
translation: 赠送一些前坠落时期的葡萄酒会使人们的意见迅速转变。

original: Into the dark
translation: 进入黑暗

original:
There are small rowboats near the wine cellar entrance, down the stone steps into the freezing water. There is no light down here but whatever torches you bring. 

The rowboat clinks against bottles fallen from the many shelves. Greyfields 1882. Morelways 1872. The Master known as Mr Wines liked to use the cold of the Stolen River to keep its favourites at the right temperature. You emerge with enough to keep the whole House tipsy.
translation:
于酒窖入口附近，几艘小划艇沿石阶涉入冰冷的水中。除了你手中的照明工具外，酒窖内漆黑一片。

划艇与从架子上掉下来的许多酒瓶相碰。1882年格雷菲德蘑菇酒。1872年莫瑞维斯蘑菇酒。被称为“葡萄酒先生”的领主习惯用遭窃之河的寒冷河水来给它的最爱保温。你带着足以灌醉全议会的酒划了出来。

original: A disaster in the cellar
translation: 地窖里的一场灾难

original: There are small rowboats near the wine cellar entrance, down the stone steps into the freezing water. Yours soon capsizes, leaving you half drowning in the dark. Fortunately another boat on a quest for a fabled stock of crackers and cheese shows up before the  hypothermia takes you. You return shivering, soaked and empty handed.
translation: 于酒窖入口附近，几艘小划艇沿石阶涉入冰冷的水中。你的船不久后便倾覆，让你半淹没在黑暗中。幸运的是，在你体温过低之前，另一艘前来寻找传说中大量饼干和奶酪的船出现了。你颤抖着返回，浑身湿透，两手空空。

original: Leak compromising information to the press
translation: 向新闻界泄露危险信息

original: Your 'friend' the Phlegmatic Journalist is usually willing to be a conduit.
translation: 你的“朋友”——淡漠的记者乐意效劳。

original: A satisfying business meeting
translation: 一次令人满意的商务会议

original:
All leaks take place in the Estranged Bar. The Phlegmatic Journalist is happy to spread the word about your bill in exchange for a little 'fresh bacon' on your fellow Ministers. 

True or not, it hardly matters. The squalid little rag he and his colleagues crank out between liquid lunches may be read by everybody in Highminster, but it's taken seriously by nobody. You weave a fanciful tale and are credited as 'a source close to the First Secretary'. It is a scrupulously honest title. Everyone is in close proximity, here.
translation:
泄密事件总是发生在埃斯特朗酒吧。淡漠的记者乐于帮你宣传法案，作为交换，你得向他透露一点其他大臣的“新鲜猛料”。

孰真孰假，并不重要。他与同事们在醉意朦胧中拼凑出来的那份破报，虽说在高敏宫无人不读，却鲜有人当真。你编了个离奇故事，被引用为“据首席秘书身边的消息人士透露”。不过，这也算是实话实说：毕竟，这里的每个人，都在首席秘书身边。

original: Leaking disaster
translation: 信息泄漏的灾难

original: You weave an epic story of corruption and salvation, but the Phlegmatic Journalist is unmoved. The small newspaper he prints already has enough of those, some of them even real. He falls asleep in the corner before you can bore him further.
translation: 你编造了个有关腐败和救赎的史诗故事，但淡漠的记者不为所动。他的小报里早已充斥着此类故事，有些甚至还不是谣言。你还未来得及继续用无聊的爆料折磨他，他便在角落里睡着了。

original: Invent a good sob story to sway opinion
translation: 编造一个上佳的悲情故事来动摇舆论

original: A real one would be preferable, but time is marching on.
translation: 一个真实的故事会更好，但此一时彼一时嘛。

original: Tears in the house
translation: 屋子里的泪水

original: Your tale of a woe that could have been prevented by your law hits its target. While your civil servant is uncomfortable with the lie, she sticks to the script and pockets a most generous bonus at Parliament's expense.
translation: 你那个本可以被你的新法阻止的悲惨故事击中了它的目标。尽管你手下的那位公务员对这个谎言感到不快，她还是照本宣科，并从议会的钱袋子里私吞了极丰厚的油水。

original: Deflated in falsehood
translation: 干瘪的虚伪

original: Your civil servant flubs her script from the start. Nobody buys her story of woe and tragedy. When one of the backbenchers recognises her, the gig is over. You both flee the House to a chorus of boos and a rain of crumpled white papers.
translation: 你的公务员从一开始就搞砸了她的剧本。没有人相信她的苦痛和悲剧。当一个后座议员认出她时，演出就结束了。你们俩在一片嘘声和皱巴巴的白纸雨中逃离了议院。

original: Seek a celebrity backer for your bill
translation: 寻找一位支持你法案的名流

original: There must be someone who will put their famous face next to it.
translation: 一定有人愿意在法案的旁边出现他著名的脸。

original: A little improvisation
translation: 小小的即兴创作

original: There are no celebrities around, but one of your civil servants still has a signed picture of the beloved Kashmiri Princess from the days of Old London. Some careful scissor work, a manufactured quote, and some decorative trimming later your campaign has a figurehead that none can argue with (and who will hopefully never find out).
translation: 你的社交圈子里面没有权贵，但你的一个公务员仍然保有一张旧伦敦时代可爱的克什米尔公主的签名照。在经过一些小心翼翼的剪裁工作，一段编造的语录，以及一些装饰性的修饰后，你的竞选活动就有了一个没有人可以与之争论（也很可能不会被本尊发现的）的傀儡。

original: Making a celebrity
translation: 人造名流

original: Your attempts to put a face on your bill with Walter the Hastily Assembled Democracy Camel go about as well as Walter's construction. The two of you are chased out of the House, with the Speaker announcing that should Walter ever re-appear, it is to be immediately set on fire.
translation: 你试图在法案里加上“仓促组装的民主骆驼沃尔特”头像的过程，和沃尔特的组装过程本身一样磕磕绊绊。你们两个都被赶出了议会，议长宣布如果沃尔特再次出现，必须立即烧掉它。

original: Conduct a bribery campaign
translation: 展开贿赂活动

original: The best part is that it's such accepted corruption, you can put it on expenses.
translation: 对于这种广为人接受的腐败来说。最棒的一点是，你可以把它加到预算里。

original: The oldest convincer
translation: 最古老的说服方式

original:
Every MP you approach sniffs, bristles, and makes it abundantly clear that they cannot be bought, they cannot be influenced, and they cannot be corrupted for a small brown envelope of cash. 

But a large brown envelope? That's different.
translation:
你接触到的每一位国会议员都嗤之以鼻，撇起嘴角，并充分表明在一个小小的棕色现金信封之下，他们绝对不会被收买，绝对不会被动摇，绝对不会被腐化。

但如果是一个大大的棕色信封呢？那就两说了。

original: The art of bribery
translation: 贿赂的艺术

original: Somehow your offer of a bribe sparks your fellow ministers' morals. Much to their own surprise, they bristle at the mere thought of it. The fact that there is so little to buy here probably has something to do with it.
translation: 不知何故，你的贿赂提议激起了你同僚们的道德热忱。令他们自己都感到惊讶的是，他们对贿赂的任何一点苗头都会大发雷霆。会发生这种情况的原因可能是，在这里能用钱买到的东西太少了。

original: Attempt to clear out the competition
translation: 尝试解决掉竞争对手

original: If your opponents don't make the vote, that's hardly your fault.
translation: 如果你的对手没有投票，那不是你的错。

original: A fact-finding mission to Eleutheria
translation: 前往厄琉忒里亚的事实调查团

original: Nothing clears out the House like an all-expenses paid trip. You carefully choose the lucky winners, who are coincidentally the most likely to disapprove of your bill. Most are so excited about the trip, they fail to notice the lack of a return ticket. A fine bonus.
translation: 没有什么比一次全额支付的旅行更能把议院打扫干净。你精心挑选那些恰好是最有可能反对你法案的幸运儿。他们大多对这次旅行感到非常兴奋，没有注意到没有回程票。好上加好。

original: A failed exodus
translation: 失败的外出

original: It is surprisingly difficult to get rid of MPs. Most of them have managed, over the years, to mould the leather seats of the House into perfect receptacles for their buttocks: a comfort they are reluctant to yield. Even the offer of a free introductory scourging at Carillon fails to move them, physically or emotionally.
translation: 摆脱国会议员的计划出乎意料的困难。多年来，他们中大多已设法将众议院的皮革座椅塑造成他们臀部的完美容器：他们不愿意放弃这种舒适。即使是在钟琴区提供免费的试用性鞭打，也无法在身体上或情感上打动他们。

original: Call upon the Chief Whip
translation: 召唤党鞭下场

original: They say the term used to be metaphorical. But these are modern times.
translation: 据说，党鞭的“鞭”过去只是隐喻，但今非昔比了。

original: Sore, but compliant
translation: 疼了，但也乖了

original: There is much shuffling on the back-benches tonight. A few torn bits of clothing. But everyone comes to order on your command. They cheer when called on. They boo loud enough to drown out any opposition. You own the House this evening.
translation: 许多后座议员坐立不安，几人衣衫凌乱，显然刚受过“整顿”。不过你一声令下，全场归于有序。对你的发言，他们欢呼雀跃；对反对党的发言，他们嘘声如雷。今晚，你在众议院说一不二。

original: Rebellious elements
translation: 反叛分子

original:
The Whips go into action. All seems to be going well, until a dispute breaks out in the peanut gallery. An open bag of flour lands hard on the table, coating you and the front benches in a coughing white cloud. 

By the time the culprit has been tracked down and beaten by the Serjeant-at-Arms, there is no getting back on topic. The House is closed for emergency cleaning.
translation:
党鞭开始行动，一切似乎都很顺利，直到议会顶楼座位附近爆发了一场争执。一袋敞口的面粉重重地落下，摔在桌上，升起一朵引人咳嗽的白云，把你和前排长凳裹上一层面粉。

等到下议院警卫找到罪魁祸首被并开始殴打这人，本场会议已无回旋余地。下院由此关闭以进行紧急清理。

original: Scare the House with a Tale of Terror
translation: 讲个恐怖故事，吓唬众人

original: Fear has always been one of the best political motivators.
translation: 恐惧总是最好的政治动机。

original: Stories from afar
translation: 远方异事

original: You paint the fascinated MPs a tale of the wonders and hardships outside of their parliamentary cocoon, taking care to sprinkle in a few embellishments when they seem to be on the verge of dozing off. It may not all sink in, but they won't quickly forget the gory details.
translation: 你向感兴趣的议员们讲述议会茧房之外的各种奇迹和苦难故事，同时在他们快要打瞌睡的时候，细心地加上一些细节点缀。也许他们不能完全理解你的发言，但不会转头就忘记那些血淋淋的细节。

original: Defang your rival with a 'generous' act
translation: 以“慷慨”之名，行敲诈之实

original: There are things you've heard, things you've learned, that could cause them trouble. You'll ensure that they cannot be shared further, without requiring anything in exchange.
translation: 你听说过、了解到的一些事情可能会给他们带来麻烦。你会确保这些黑料无法继续传播，作为交换，什么都不要。

original: A careful word in the right place
translation: 在正确的地点谨慎发言

original: As the embers of former blackmail materials drift away, you shake hands and confirm the support of your biggest rival. They had better remember.
translation: 当过往的黑料化为灰烬之时，你与自己最强的政敌握手言和，换取了他对你的支持。这人最好长点记性，别再来招惹你。

original: Impress the House with your experience
translation: 用冒险经历打动议会

original: While they sit in the crumbling ruins of parliament, you have explored the stars. You've seen things they cannot face, cannot even contemplate. But perhaps they should try.
translation: 当议员们端坐在摇摇欲坠的议会废墟中时，你却已然踏足群星，见过了他们不敢直视，甚至不敢设想之物。但也许他们该试着想象一下。

original: Astonishing horrors
translation: 骇人怖事

original: Few of the MPs have seen any more of the High Wilderness than could be glimpsed through the extra-thick stained glass of their luxury trains. Just hearing about some of the squirming horrors awaiting in the dark has them reaching for their handkerchiefs. If they weren't listening to you before, they certainly are now.
translation: 透过豪华列车的加厚彩窗所能瞥见的丁点风景，便是大多数国会议员仅见的天野。哪怕只是听闻黑暗中潜伏着某种蠕动的怪物，他们就已经吓得赶忙掏出手帕。如果他们以前不听你的话，那现在肯定会听了。

original: The House of Commons
translation: 下议院

original:
The wheels of government continue to turn, but its halls have seen better days. Most are green-tinged from decades submerged in the Stolen River, during that unusual historical interlude when London was stolen by bats.

Water still drips from unseen reservoirs of damp. Even so, the House remains a hive of favour-trading, drinks-promising and constant debate.
translation:
议会继续运作，但其破败的大厅已不见往日的风采。在沦敦陷于蝙蝠的那段长达几十年的非常时期中，议会曾被遭窃的泰晤士河淹没，因而浸染了陈旧的绿色。

目光不可及的阴湿处，仍有水滴落下。但即便破旧，议会的下院仍是一个利益交换、酒水充足、辩论不休的场所。

original: Visit the First Secretary
translation: 拜访首席秘书

original: You don't need an appointment. As a Minister, he technically works for you.
translation: 你不需要预约会见，因为你是大臣。情理上讲，他为你工作。

original: Visit your Ministerial Department
translation: 视察你的部门

original: No doubt the [qvd:132084(Office)] is lost without its leader.
translation: 毫无疑问，[qvd:132084(Office)]已经群龙无首。

original: Take over the Department for Albion Affairs
translation: 接管阿尔比恩事务部

original: A Loquacious Civil Servant strides up to greet you. "Ah, Minister. Right on time."
translation: 饶舌的公务员大步走来迎接，说道：“啊，大臣先生，您来得正是时候。”

original: The Department of Albion Affairs
translation: 阿尔比恩事务部

original:
The Loquacious Civil Servant glides through the labyrinthine house with an ease it took a career to acquire. "This way, Minister. Do step over the drunks in the hall. Journalists, you know. Old habits die hard. Ah, here we go. Your new dominion."

He pushes open the door. Your new department's carpeted floor squishes underfoot. Almost nobody glances up as you enter. You are, after all, just the next Minister in a long chain of distractions to their work.
translation:
这位饶舌的公务员在迷宫般的房子里穿行，仪态里带着从其整个职业生涯中取得的轻松。“这边走，议员。请跨过大厅里的醉汉。记者，你懂的。旧习难改。啊，我们到了。您的新领地。”

他推开了门。你新部门的铺着地毯的地板在你脚下压扁。几乎没有人在你进来时抬头。毕竟，你只是一长串分散他们工作注意力的议员中的下一个。

original: Head back outside
translation: 回到议会外面

original: The damp air quickly gets oppressive. A short walk would be good.
translation: 室内的潮气很快便让人感到压抑，出去走两步就好了。

original: Explore Parliament
translation: 探索议会

original: You have full access to the House of Commons now, and all its amenities.
translation: 你现在可以在下议院内外设施畅行无碍。

original: A faded empire
translation: 帝国残阳

original:
Parliament's green-stained halls are hardly what they used to be. Forty years ago, when the bats dragged London deep beneath the earth, its new cloaked Masters stripped the place of its gold and finery. 

Only the two Houses themselves – the Commons and the Lords – have been properly refurnished. Everyone else makes do. The journalistic lobby has set up a basic printing press in the Estranged Bar, with the New Ministries established in any spare room or corridor. Occasionally, between the drinks and debates, some work gets done.
translation:
昔日绿意盎然的议会大厅，如今黯然失色，不复荣光。四十年前，当蝙蝠把伦敦拖到地底深处后，身披斗篷的新领主们进驻议会，剥去了此处的金漆和装饰。

只有上、下两院得到了像样的修缮，其他地方只能将就着用。游说记者团在埃斯特朗酒吧里架起了简陋的印刷机，新政府部门则挤在各个空闲的房间或走廊里办公。偶尔，在觥筹交错与唇枪舌剑之间，正事也能勉强推进几分。

original: Disrupt proceedings with a perfect pangolin
translation: 用完美无缺的穿山甲扰乱会议

original: The sessions tend to be droning and dull, but you're provisioned with a pangolin of unparalleled perfection.
translation: 会议往往枯燥乏味，但你有一只无比完美的穿山甲。

original: Order!
translation: 肃静！

original:
You slide into a session and seat yourself in the back, your footsteps swallowed by the slow, sloppy rhetoric of the MPs. How boring. You should remedy this. 

Discreetly, you lift your Perfect Pangolin up and whisper to the gleaming nub of her ear. She salutes – beautifully, of course – and races away to interrupt the funerary drivel.

As expected, the Perfect Pangolin performs exquisitely, exciting the session to astonished conversation. The two of you are quickly evicted – although not before you've glutted yourself on gossip.

[You have exhausted this opportunity for now.]
translation:
你溜进一个会议，坐在后面，你的脚步声被议员们缓慢、草率的言辞所吞没。多么无聊。你应该纠正这一点。

你谨慎地把你的完美无缺的穿山甲举起来，对着她闪闪发光的耳廓轻声说话。她敬了个礼——当然是优雅的礼——然后飞快地跑去打断面前这些宛如葬礼上的胡扯。

正如预期的那样，完美无缺的穿山甲的表现非常出色，她让与会者惊讶不已。你们两个很快就被赶走了，但此时你们已经饱餐了一顿流言蜚语。

[你现在已经用尽了这个机会。]

original: Your Ministerial Department
translation: 你的内阁

original: The [qvd:132084(Office)] is a windowless, airless place at the top of many staircases. Outside your tiny office, a small regiment of clerks led by a Loquacious Civil Servant busies itself with reports and paperwork, then carefully files it all away in an elaborate system designed to ensure nobody ever sees any of it again.
translation: [qvd:132084(Office)]是一个既没有窗户，又没有新鲜空气的地方，它位于许多级楼梯的顶端。在你狭小的办公室外，一个由饶舌的公务员领导的文员团正忙着处理报告和文书工作，然后小心翼翼地将它们全部归入一个精心设计的系统，以确保没有人会再次见到它们。

original: Make a new law
translation: 制定新法律

original:
Time to get to the business of government.
[You can learn the Will of the People at ports around Albion and the Reach. Bring it here to be the foundation of a new Bill. You will be working on this Bill for a week, and unable to leave until it is passed or rejected.]
translation:
是时候开始处理政府事务了。
你可以在阿尔比恩和外野的车站中收集民意，将其带至这里，作为新法案的基础。你将花费一整周的时间来起草法案，无论通过与否，结果揭晓前，你都不得离开。]

original: Consult the Loquacious Civil Servant
translation: 向饶舌的公务员咨询

original: What is your role here, exactly?
translation: 你在这里到底扮演什么角色？

original: The short version
translation: 长话“短”说

original:
“Minister, the traditional vocation of both this office and one in your esteemed position is to take upon the duty and indeed burden of establishing and integrating new legislation of a beneficial yet cost-effective nature for the pan-Albion citizenry, with a twin focus on problem-elimination and controversy-avoidance paradigms. (1)

"The greater efficiency we demonstrate at this, on at least a prima facie basis, the greater slice of the budgetary pie will be allocated to our department, and the greater Parliamentary status you personally, Minister, shall enjoy. (2) With ascendancy comes reward. Minor ones, as Ministerial salaries are currently primarily a barter-based economy for beverages of noted alcoholic form due to a most regrettable budget shortfall in non-functionary related positions that are typically compensated through prestige. (3)

"However," he adds, less than enthusiastically, "I do understand that Parliamentary envoys at Her Renewed Majesty’s most celebrated Throne enjoy some budgetary flexibility to reward completed law-related projects, in gratitude for the demonstration of their continued purpose and presence at the moderate-to-highest levels of government. (4)" 

He smiles a thin, tight smile. "I believe that covers the basics. I can give you the longer version if you would prefer?"

[(1) Make Laws.
(2) The more Laws you pass, the higher your status.
(3) We can't afford to pay you.
(4) Exchange Laws for Sovereigns at the Throne of Hours.]
translation:
“议员，此部门与位于您所在的显赫职位上的人的传统使命是承担为泛阿尔比恩公民制定和整合有益且具有成本效益的新立法的责任和负担，同时关注消除问题和避免争议的范式。(1)

“我们在这方面表现出的效率越高，我们的部门——至少在表面上——就会被分配得到更大的预算蛋糕，而部长您个人也将享有更高的议会地位。(2) 随着地位的提高，奖励也随之而来。微薄的奖励。由于极令人遗憾的非职能相关职位的预算短缺及使用声望作为补偿的形式，部长级别的薪资发放当前主要是一种以物易物来换取著名酒精饮品的经济。(3)

“然而，”他不那么有激情地补充道，“据我所知，为了奖励已完成的相关立法计划，议会特使在新生女王陛下之御座前享有部分的预算灵活性，以表彰他们一以贯之的宗旨的示范性作用，以及他们在政府中高层职位的在场。(4)”

他的笑容淡薄，面色紧绷。“我认为以上涵盖了基本的内容。如果您愿意，我可以为您解释得不那么简明扼要一点？”

[(1) 制定法律。
(2) 通过的法律越多，你的地位越高。
(3) 我们付不起你的钱。
(4) 在时间王座前用法律换取金镑。]

original: You have an important message waiting
translation: 你收到一个重磅消息

original: "Minister. The First Secretary asked me to give you this."
translation: “大臣先生，首席秘书让我把这个交给您。”

original: An urgently written note
translation: 草草写就的短笺

original: It comes scribbled in the margin of a document about wheat production, written in sharp red capitals. COME SEE ME. AT ONCE. MOST IMPORTANT. ALBION MUST RISE AGAIN. BRING BLACK INK.
translation: 这则短笺潦草地写在一份涉及小麦生产的文件的页边空白处，以鲜红色墨水书写，每个字母都大写。立刻来见我。这事很重要。阿尔比恩必须再次崛起。顺便带上黑墨水。

original: Present the Dignity of Albion Bill
translation: 呈递《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》

original: The First Secretary has fired up the whips in your absence. It is time to present it to the House.
translation: 你不在议会履职时，首席秘书就已经发动了党鞭。现在该向下议院提交法案了。

original: A house united
translation: 团结一心

original:
The bought MPs wave the Dignity of Albion Bill through before you are halfway through your opening statement. Those who would have opposed it watch the shadows, fearfully. 

The House votes overwhelmingly for Her Renewed Majesty to once again respect the decisions of Parliament and the people it occasionally represents. Just as overwhelming is the relief of every other MP that they aren't the ones with their names on the bill.

The First Secretary meets you afterwards. "Excellent. Very good. Just to cross our 't's, however, I think we should run this through the House of Lords for their approval. I'm sure I have the key somewhere. Ah, here we go. Just a formality, you understand."
translation:
你的开场白刚讲到一半，被收买的议员们便迫不及待地通过了《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》，原本打算反对的议员则惴惴不安。

新生的女王陛下决定再次尊重议会，以及议会偶尔所代表民意，下议院则以压倒性的票数支持这一决定。同样压倒性的是，其他议员纷纷如释重负，暗自庆幸自己无需承担在法案上签字的重任。

散会后，首席秘书前来见你，他称赞道：“太好了，干得不错。只是，为了万无一失，我认为我们还是应该把法案送去上议院再走个流程。我记得钥匙就放在……啊，在这儿。放心，只是走个形式。”

original: Return to the House
translation: 返回下院

original: It gets stuffy in here. Time for some moderately fresh air.
translation: 这里闷起来了，是时候呼吸一下新鲜空气了。

original: Contact the First Secretary about the Dignity of Albion Bill
translation: 就《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》与首席秘书联络

original: What is your next step with this dangerous document?
translation: 对于这份危险的文件，你下一步的计划是什么？

original: Your messenger returns looking nervous
translation: 你的信使回来了，看起来很紧张

original: "Uh. He said, and I quote, Minister, to tell 'that idiot' to show a little decorum and that anyone could be listening. Yes. He also said I should give you this and say— what was it? Yes. The Empress' Tower. Tonight. Come alone. Also, he said I'm fired. Am I fired, Minister? I really need this job."
translation: “呃。他说，我复述下他的原话，议员先生，让‘那个白痴’不要吵闹，隔墙有耳。对的。他还说我应该把这个交给你，还说——什么来着？哦对。皇后塔。今晚。一个人过来。还有，他说我被解雇了。我被解雇了吗，大臣先生？我真的需要这份工作。”

original: Visit the First Secretary
translation: 拜访首席秘书

original: As First-among-equals, he knows more about Parliament than anyone. A useful font of information.
translation: 身为首席秘书，他比任何人都更了解议会，可以说是个“活档案”。

original: Ask about the Will of the People
translation: 询问什么是民意

original: How do you begin making a new law?
translation: 你要如何开始制定新的法律？

original: Democracy in action
translation: 民主进程

original: "A simple matter, Minister," oozes the Loquacious Civil Servant. "Those around Albion territory, which is to say Albion herself and the more... civilised corners of the Reach... will often present themselves upon your arrival with their problems and little requests. Listen, return here, and your humble servants will put the wheels of government into motion."
translation: “很简单，议员，”饶舌的公务员喋喋不休，“那些居住在阿尔比恩周边地区，也就是阿尔比恩本身以及外野中相对……文明一点的地方……的人，在你到访时经常会向你提出他们的问题和小小的要求。仔细倾听，并带着那些话回到这里，之后你卑微的仆人们便会把政府的车轮开动起来。”

original: The First Secretary
translation: 首席秘书

original: He sits at a huge, mahogany desk in prestigious Downing Corridor. Your conversation doesn't distract him from writing notes in the margins of endless pieces of paperwork. He pauses his scribbling only to sip from a large cup of stone-cold tea, or to scratch his head with the pen's long, silver nib.
translation: 他坐在著名的唐宁走廊的一张巨大的桃花心木办公桌前。你的谈话并没有分散他的注意力，他在无尽文件的空白处写着笔记。只有在喝大杯冷茶，或者用钢笔的长长的银色笔尖挠头的时候，他才会停下来。

original: Discuss business
translation: 讨论正事

original: He looks down his nose at you with the grim expression of a headmaster waiting for an excuse to break out his favourite birch rod.
translation: 他俯视着你，表情严峻，就像校长在体罚前等待学生辩解，以便拿出他最爱的桦树条。

original: "Ah, the Captain. A moment. Do take a seat."
translation: “啊，车长。稍等。请坐吧。”

original:
"Tea? Ah, yes. I will call for some tea. The loss of our dear Minister for—" he hesitates, covertly checking a file— "[qvd:133872(CalledIn)], yes, is a tragedy. But we must move on. You seem just the sort I'm looking for. Lucid. Breathing. Have you considered a career in politics?"

He holds up a hand. "No, I do not care about history or affiliations. A bum in the chair will suffice. The Department of Albion Affairs would be a suitable starting point. If you are interested, I will set the wheels in motion."

[Visit the former Minister's port if you wish to stand for election.]
translation:
“喝茶吗？啊，好。那我去叫些茶来。我们敬爱的议员的过世——，”他犹豫了一下，暗中检查了一份文件，“[qvd:133872(CalledIn)]，是的，这是一场悲剧。但我们必须继续前进。你似乎正是我在寻找的那种人。神智清醒。还有呼吸。你有考虑过从政吗？”

他抬起一只手，“不，我不关心既往履历或隶属关系。坐在椅子上的流浪汉都能干这一行。阿尔比恩事务部将是一个合适的起点。如果你感兴趣的话，我就要付诸行动了。”

[如果你想参选，请访问前议员的港口。]

original: Ask about the state of Parliament
translation: 询问议会的现状

original: Where is the Prime Minister? Shouldn't they be running things?
translation: 首相在哪里？难道不是该首相处理政务吗？

original: A sharp intake of breath
translation: 猛吸一口气

original: "Very good question, Minister. Unfortunately, our illustrious leader decided it would be a better use of his time to take a boat into the Flooded Cellars. Where the wine is, you know. I am not sure how many bottles are there, simply awaiting a net, but they say that the deeper you go, the finer the vintages that one might find. I suppose I should send a search party when time permits. Until then, I really must finish this paperwork."
translation: “很好的问题，议员。然而不幸的是，我们杰出的领导人认为乘船驶入水淹酒窖是对他时间更合理的分配方式。你知道，就是那个储藏酒水的地方。我不确定那里有多少瓶酒，仅仅在等待一张把它们捞起来的网，但他们说，你走得越深，可能找到的年份就越好。我想在时间允许的情况下，我应该派出一支搜索队。在那之前，我真的必须完成这项文书工作。”

original: Ask about the political situation
translation: 询问政局

original: Nobody seems to have any party affiliations here.
translation: 这里似乎没有人有任何党派关系。

original: A regretful sigh
translation: 遗憾地叹气

original:
"Ah. You noticed. Yes, these days Parliament is split along rather less productive lines. 

"We have the Committee for Radical Sovereignty, devoted to finding ever more inventive ways to cling to the Empress' mighty skirts. The Subcommittee for Public Restoration would be as happy to see her gone, but has yet to come up with any workable plans. Finally, the Select Committee for the Chiltern Hundreds likes things as they are. With all three pulling in their own directions, it is no surprise that little gets done around here."

He pauses. "You may have wondered why I was so eager to bring some new blood into our little family; to wit, yourself. I trust now you have an inkling."
translation:
“啊，你注意到了。是的，这些天来，议会分裂成了几条没什么创造力的路线。

“我们有激进主权委员会，致力于寻找更具创造性的方式来攀上皇后的强大裙角。公共修复小组委员会怀着相同的热情想要看到皇后离开，但还没有提出任何可行的计划。最后，奇尔特恩百人特别委员会喜欢事情现在的样子。由于这三派都朝着自己的方向努力，这里几乎没有什么进展也就不足为奇了。”

他停了一下。“你可能想知道为什么我这么急于为我们的小家庭带来一些新鲜血液：也就是说，你自己。我相信现在你已经知道了。”

original: Ask about himself
translation: 询问他的情况

original: What is his role in the Parliamentary system?
translation: 他在议会体系中扮演什么角色？

original: Primus inter pares
translation: 同侪之首

original:
"Minister, I am but a humble functionary. It was my proud duty to serve the elected Prime Minister in an administrative capacity, and – as and when we are able to conduct an election – I trust it will be my privilege to continue for his successor. 

"Until then, my focus is on restoring this once august establishment to greatness, even if it means dragging Albion kicking and screaming back to the troublesome necessities of democratic process."
translation:
“议员，我只是个卑微的职员。以管理身份为当选的首相服务是令我自豪的职责，当我们进行选举时，有幸继续为他的继任者服务仍是我的荣幸。

“在那之前，我专注于让这个曾经令人肃然起敬的建制派恢复荣光，即使这意味着把阿尔比恩死拖硬拽回民主进程的必要麻烦中。”

original: Discuss the future of Parliament
translation: 讨论议会的未来

original: "Ah, Minister. I have something I wish to show you."
translation: “啊，议员。我有东西想给你看看。”

original: The Dignity of Albion
translation: 《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》

original:
The First Secretary leads the way to the Prince's Chamber, where a statue of Victoria stands. The face has been chipped off. "A rare survivor from before the Fall of London," he sighs. "When Britain was Great. I had hoped Her Renewed Majesty's restoration of Parliament would mean a return to those days. Alas, as you have seen, it was a token gesture from an increasingly tyrannical monarch."

He turns. "I need you to present a law for me: the Dignity of Albion bill. As a mere civil servant, I cannot do so myself. However, while I prepare the ground, I need your help with another matter. The Empress' Royal Astronomer is currently enjoying a forced vacation in Carillon. He is trustworthy. Take him to the great telescope of the Royal Society and request the Final Testament of the Old Sun. I know, I speak in vagaries. I apologise, but it is necessary for all of our safety. All will be explained when you return."
translation:
首席大臣领你到亲王厅，厅里矗立着一尊维多利亚的雕像，面部已被凿去。“这是伦敦沦陷前的罕见遗物，”他叹道，“那时的不列颠，仍堪称伟大。我曾盼望新生的女王陛下既已复兴议会，也愿带领我们重返伟大。可惜，如你所见，女王越来越专制独裁，复兴议会也只是做做样子罢了。”

他转过身来，对你说道：“我需要您代我提交《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》。身为一介文官，我无权亲自出面。不过，在我为伟业做准备之时，还需要您协助处理另一件事。女皇陛下的皇家天文学家目前正在钟琴区‘被休假’。他值得信赖。请您带他前往皇家学会的巨型天文望远镜处，请求调阅《旧日之终末遗言》。我知道自己说得很含混，很抱歉，但这是出于安全考量。待您归来，一切自会揭晓。”

original: Ask about the Dignity of Albion Bill
translation: 询问什么是《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》

original: You've done your part so far. What's the next step?
translation: 到目前为止，你已经完成了你的任务。下一步是什么？

original: "Not here, you fool!"
translation: “别在这里说，你这个傻瓜！”

original:
The First Secretary gestures down the corridor. "Anybody could be listening," he whispers. He slides something to you from his side of the table. A key. "The Empress' Tower. Tonight. Come alone."

[You can keep this appointment by visiting the Palace of Highminster.]
translation:
首席秘书向走廊里打了个手势，轻声说道，“隔墙有耳。”他把某物放在桌上，推到你面前，原来是一把钥匙。他还嘱咐道：“今晚来女皇塔找我，别带别人。”

[你可以前往高敏宫赴约。]

original: Return to the House of Commons
translation: 返回下议院

original: You both have much to be getting on with.
translation: 你们两个都有很多事要做。

original: Treasonous Talk in the Victoria Tower
translation: 在维多利亚塔内商议叛国

original: The First Secretary stares out at Albion. "We were told that the Empress conquered Albion's sun, and founded our new Enduring Empire on its ashes. A lie. Now, with your help, we have proof. Albion's sun, its Judgement, was extinguished long before we came here."
translation: 首席秘书向外凝视着阿尔比恩，讲道：“据说，是女皇征服了阿尔比恩的太阳，并在其余烬上建立起我们这不朽的新帝国。但这故事是假的。如今，托您的福，我们终于掌握了确凿证据——阿尔比恩的太阳，它的司命，早早便熄灭了。很久之后，我们才来到这里。”

original: Agree to the plan
translation: 同意该计划

original: Perhaps he's right. Perhaps it is simply better he believes you think so.
translation: 也许他是对的。又或许让他认为你这样想比较好。

original: United in treachery
translation: 携手叛国

original:
The First Secretary breathes a sigh of relief. "I knew that I could count on you. Together, we will restore democracy for the next thousand years. Here. I have prepared everything you require. Take it to the Blue Kingdom. I fear I cannot protect you from the Empress' likely wrath. I can only promise that any sacrifice you make will not be in vain."

Is there no alternative? "None." He laughs. "It's not as if you could blackmail Her Majesty." He laughs again. "The thought of it!"
translation:
首席秘书松了一口气。“我就知道您言而有信。未来千年的民主将由你我携手重建。来，我已为您备妥一切。请把它带去蓝色王国吧。我恐怕无法护您周全，若女皇震怒，必非我所能挡。我只能保证，若您遭遇不幸，您的牺牲不会白费。”

难道你没有其他选择吗？他笑着回答，“没有。您还真能勒索女王陛下吗，”然后又笑了一下，“想都不敢想！”

original: Push the traitor from the Tower
translation: 把叛徒推下塔楼

original: His back is turned. It would only take a touch.
translation: 他背对着你。只需轻轻一碰。

original: Downfall
translation: 坠楼

original:
The First Secretary turns to hear your response just in time to see you coming for him. He shields his face, not realising that your aim is lower. You shove, and he falls backwards through the window and away into the void.

You quickly forge a suicide note and pin it to the wall. It isn't long. In his honour, you restrict yourself to scribbling it in the margins of a memo about pork production. But then you are gone. Both the Albion Bill and the Royal Astronomer's notes are safely in your possession, and no one is any the wiser about their contents.
translation:
首席秘书转身等你回应，正好看到你向他冲来。他下意识地用手护住面庞，却未意识到你的目标是他的身体。只是一推，他便向后倒去，穿过窗户，落入虚空。

你迅速伪造了一封遗书，内容不长，钉在墙上。为表“敬意”，你特意将其潦草地写在一份猪肉产量的备忘录边角处，随后你溜之大吉。《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》与皇家天文学家的笔记都已妥善掌握在你手中，而其内容，仍无人知晓。

original: Ask for more details
translation: 询问更多细节

original: Why all the secrecy?
translation: 为何如此保密？

original: Finders keepers
translation: 谁发现归谁

original:
"Don't you see? Without right of conquest, we are no better than squatters in this territory. Albion no more belongs to us than a dog belongs to its fleas! Or so I believe the other suns would see it. The closest sun rules the Blue Kingdom. Were the truth to come out, it would not sit idly by.

"In that truth, there is opportunity. A chance to restore order, to dethrone the Empress and her Clockwork Sun. To restore the will of the people (through their duly appointed representatives and humble functionaries, naturally)."

He turns back to the view. "We would be holding an empire hostage to coerce its monarch into doing the right thing. But it is the price of dignity. It is worth paying."
translation:
“难道您看不出来吗？若无征服之名，我们立足此地，便与强占无异。狗不属于寄居其上的跳蚤，同理，阿尔比恩也不属于我们！我相信，其他太阳定是如此看待我们的。蓝色王国的所属权，归于最近的那颗太阳。倘若真相暴露，那太阳断然不会坐视不理。

“这份真相之中，还蕴藏着契机：一个重建秩序的机会，一次废黜女皇与她的发条太阳的机会，一次将政权还归民意的机会。”（要问如何实现，自然是依靠人民正式委任的代表与勤谨谦和的官员。）

他转身望向窗外的景色，总结道：“我们挟帝国以令君主，‘请’她做出正确的决定。这是尊严的代价，但值得。”

original: Refuse to get involved with this
translation: 拒绝参与此事

original: This is not what you agreed to.
translation: 这不是你同意去做的事。

original: An unsurprising reaction
translation: 意料之中的反应

original: The First Secretary glances back at you and then back out at Albion. "A pity. I had thought your Ministerhood suited you. Perhaps I misjudged. If you will not do what must be done, I will find another who will. Your seat can be refilled."
translation: 首席秘书回头瞥了你一眼，然后又回头凝视着阿尔比恩，说道：“真遗憾。我原以为你很适合担任大臣一职。或许，我看走了眼。如果你不愿履行应尽之责，我会另觅他人。你的职位，自有人替补。”

original: Agree to deliver the Albion Bill
translation: 同意颁布阿尔比恩法案

original: On second thoughts...
translation: 转念一想…

original:
The First Secretary breathes a sigh of relief. "I knew that I could count on you. Together, we will restore democracy for the next thousand years. Here. I have prepared everything you require. Take it to the Blue Kingdom. I fear I cannot protect you from the Empress' likely wrath. I can only promise that any sacrifice you make will not be in vain."

Is there no alternative? "None." He laughs. "It's not as if you could blackmail Her Majesty." He laughs again. "The thought of it!"
translation:
首席秘书松了一口气。“我就知道您言而有信。未来千年的民主将由你我携手重建。来，我已为您备妥一切。请把它带去蓝色王国吧。我恐怕无法护您周全，若女皇震怒，必非我所能挡。我只能保证，您若遭遇不幸，您的牺牲不会白费。”

难道你没有其他选择吗？他笑着回答，“没有。您还真能勒索女王陛下吗，”然后又笑了一下，“想都不敢想！”

original: Push him from the Tower
translation: 把他推下塔楼

original: You will not be spoken to thus.
translation: 他这么和你说话可不行。

original:
The First Secretary turns to hear your response just in time to see you coming for him. He shields his face, not realising that your aim is lower. You shove, and he falls backwards through the window and away into the void.

You quickly forge a suicide note and pin it to the wall. It isn't long. In his honour, you restrict yourself to scribbling it in the margins of a memo about pork production. But then you are gone. Both the Albion Bill and the Royal Astronomer's notes are safely in your possession, and no one is any the wiser about their contents.
translation:
首席秘书转身等你回应，正好看到你向他冲来。他下意识地用手护住面庞，却未意识到你的目标是他的身体。只是一推，他便向后倒去，穿过窗户，落入虚空。

你迅速伪造了一封遗书，内容不长，钉在墙上。为表“敬意”，你特意将其潦草地写在一份猪肉产量的备忘录边角处，随后你溜之大吉。《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》与皇家天文学家的笔记都已妥善掌握在你手中，而其内容，仍无人知晓。

original: Give up your position
translation: 辞职

original: He can keep it.
translation: 让他自己干去吧。

original: You leave the First Secretary staring out at the skies. By the time you return to your office, the word is out. Nobody will meet your eye. The Loquacious Civil Servant is silent as he takes your key. Your parliamentary career is over.
translation: 首席秘书凝视着天空，你转身离开。当你回到办公室的时候，消息早已传开。没人敢和你对视。饶舌的公务员收走你的钥匙，却一言未发。你的议会生涯，结束了。

original: Election Night
translation: 选举之夜

original: The votes are in. [qvd:133872(Contender1)] [qvd:133872(Contender2)] You wait for your name to be called out. Sure enough, the people choose well. To a smattering of applause from the handful of the public who bothered to show up and vote, you rise from your chair to take your destiny.
translation: 投票结果出来了。[qvd:133872(Contender1)] [qvd:133872(Contender2)] 你等待着他们叫出你的名字。果然，人们做了明智的选择。在少数前来投票的民众的热烈掌声中，你从椅子上站起来，接受你的命运。

original: Accept your new role without any grace whatsoever
translation: 毫不客气地接受你的新角色

original: Push past the losers. Bask in the glory that is you.
translation: 挤掉败者。沐浴在属于你的荣耀中。

original: The honourable member
translation: 尊敬的议员

original:
You've done it. Time to prepare for government.

[Begin your career at the Floating Parliament]
translation:
你已经做到了。是时候为政府做准备了。

[在浮空议院开始你的事业。]

original: Accept your new role with grace
translation: 优雅地接受你的新角色

original: Congratulate your defeated opponents. Take on your new role with the dignity that it demands.
translation: 祝贺被你击败的对手。以与之相称的尊严接受你的新角色。

original: Presenting the honourable member!
translation: 尊敬的议员亮相！

original:
You've done it. Time to prepare for government.

[Begin your career at the Floating Parliament.]
translation:
你已经做到了。是时候为政府做准备了。

[在浮空议院开始你的事业。]

translation: 优雅地接受你的新角色

original: Congratulate your defeated opponents. Take on your new role with the dignity that it demands.
translation: 祝贺被你击败的对手。以与之相称的尊严接受你的新角色。

original: Presenting the honourable member!
translation: 尊敬的议员亮相！

original:
You've done it. Time to prepare for government.

[Begin your career at the Floating Parliament]
translation:
你已经做到了。是时候为政府做准备了。

[在浮空议院开始你的事业。]

translation: 毫不客气地接受你的新角色

original: Push past the losers. Bask in the glory that is you.
translation: 挤掉败者。沐浴在属于你的荣耀中。

original: The honourable member
translation: 尊敬的议员

original:
You've done it. Time to prepare for government.

[Begin your career at the Floating Parliament]
translation:
你已经做到了。是时候为政府做准备了。

[在浮空议院开始你的事业。]

original: Courting the Deathless
translation: 追求不死者

original:
The Most Serene Mausoleum houses more than just the Prince Consort. Under its soaring spires, the Empress keeps her most favoured courtiers. 

These lucky few are provided with every luxury they might wish, and a generous stipend of hours. The only condition of this bounty is that they are dead. A legality, only. They cannot possess property nor hold political office as a result. 

They are the Deathless. Occasionally, they deign to appear to visitors.
translation:
在圣宁墓高耸的尖顶下，不仅安葬着亲王，还居住着女皇最宠爱的朝臣。

这些少数幸运儿穷奢极欲，享有丰厚的时间作为津贴。唯一的代价是他们已“死”：仅在法律意义上死亡而已，因此没有财产权，也无法在政府任职。

他们是不死者。偶尔，也会在游客面前屈尊现身。

original: Speak with the Luminous Cardinal
translation: 与光辉红衣主教交谈

original: He is the Papal Legate to the High Wilderness and Her Renewed Majesty's favourite Catholic.
translation: 他是教皇派往天野的使节，也是新生的女王陛下最宠爱的天主教徒。

original: Timor domini
translation: 对神敬畏（Timor domini）

original: The Cardinal is unattended today, as he walks through the sepulchral vaults of the Mausoleum, his bright vestments trailing along the flagstones. He notices your gaze and approaches. A footman hurries over to facilitate conversation. His Eminence is delighted to meet a skyfarer. He has many questions for you: for his new exegesis on the Bible. Genesis will need a considerable gloss in light of recent information. The Reach, verdant as Eden. The celestial gates of the Blue Kingdom. The infernal splendour of Eleutheria, and so on. His curiosity quenched, he thanks you for your time and leaves you with a Pater Noster for your trouble.
translation: 红衣主教今天无人问津，他漫步在陵墓的墓室中，他明亮的法衣在石板上拖曳。他注意到了你的目光，走了过来。一个男仆匆匆赶来，以协助交流。 这位阁下很高兴能见到一个行天客。他有很多问题要问你：为他在圣经上的新撰注释。需要用近来的消息对《创世纪》进行大量的增色。外野，像伊甸园一样青翠。蓝色王国的天国之门。厄琉忒里亚的地狱般的辉光，诸如此类。 他的好奇心熄灭了，他感谢你花费的时间，并给你留下了一段主祷文作为带给你麻烦的补偿。

original: In nomine matris
translation: 以母之名（In nomine matris）

original:
The Cardinal stalks through the sepulchral vaults of the Mausoleum, his bright vestments trailing on the flagstones. He notices your gaze and approaches. 

The Luminous Cardinal ignores your introduction and  launches into a sermon on the new Kingdom of Heaven. "To whom did Christ entrust the kingdom of God but his own mother? Who now reigns on the throne of Heaven, but a woman, a mother, and a queen? This is the third and last Age! We shall have a queendom, whose boundaries are as limitless as the mysteries of the Godhead! Just as soon as she converts."

He turns away, having forgotten you entirely.
translation:
红衣主教漫步在陵墓的墓室中，他明亮的法衣在石板上拖曳。他注意到你的目光，走了过来。

光辉红衣主教不理会你的自我介绍，开始了关于新天国的布道。“除了他自己的母亲，基督把天国托付给了谁？现在除了一个女人，一个母亲，一个女王之外，还有谁在天国的宝座上掌权？这是第三个也是最后一个时代！我们将有一个女王之国，其边界和神性的奥秘一样无边无际！就在她皈依之后。”

他转身离开，完全忘记了你。

original: Speak with the Macabre Counsellor
translation: 与恐怖顾问交谈

original: She is a former Lady of the Bedchamber, and Governess to at least some of Her Renewed Majesty's children. Mortality is a preoccupation of hers.
translation: 她是一位前卧房侍女，而且是新生的女王陛下部分子女的宫廷特工。死亡率是她的一个关注点。

original: Half in love with easeful death
translation: 一半爱着轻松的死亡

original:
The Counsellor advances through the Nave like an old spider trespassing on a rival's web. Her dark eyes dart, and her fingers curl and twitch. She notices your gaze and approaches lazily. 

A footman moves to intercept, but she holds up a hand. He pales and retreats. She begins by quoting Keats at you: Ode to a Nightingale. She surmises you've encountered death in the skies, known its easeful touch on your cheek. She proceeds thusly for some minutes, lingering on each crewman fallen, each cold burial in the dark. And then, she smiles suddenly, and bids you a pleasant day.
translation:
顾问在中殿中前进，就像一只闯入对手的网的老蜘蛛。她的黑眼睛闪闪发光，她的手指蜷缩抽搐。她注意到你的目光，懒洋洋地走过来。

一个男仆打算拦住她，但她举起了一只手。他脸色苍白，退走了。她开始向你引用济慈的诗：《夜莺颂》。她猜测你在天空中已经遇见过死亡，知道它在你的脸颊上放松的触感。她这样说了好几分钟，谈论着每一个倒下的列车员，谈论着每一个在黑暗中的冰冷埋葬。然后，她突然笑了，向你道别，祝你今天愉快。

original: Found wanting
translation: 发现不足

original:
The Counsellor advances through the Nave like an old and cunning spider trespassing on a rival's web. Her dark eyes dart, and her fingers curl and twitch. She notices your gaze and approaches lazily. 

She stands for a moment, surveying you curiously, while footmen watch on nervously. Her fingers grasp your arm, feeling the muscle in your bicep, the elasticity of your shoulders. Her grip is adamantine.

Then, as suddenly as she appeared, she turns away, muttering "Too vital," as she makes her stately departure.
translation:
顾问在中殿中前进，就像一只闯入对手的网的老而狡猾的蜘蛛。她的黑眼睛闪闪发光，她的手指蜷缩抽搐。她注意到你的目光，懒洋洋地走过来。

她站了一会儿，好奇地打量着你，而男仆则紧张地看着你。她的手指猛地抓住你的手臂，感受你二头肌的肌肉，你肩膀的弹性。她坚定地握着。

然后，就像她的突然出现一样，她转身离去，一边嘟囔着“太重要了”，一边庄重地离开。

original: Speak with the Duchess Incarnadine
translation: 与血色公爵夫人交谈

original: A childhood friend of Her Renewed Majesty, the Duchess Incarnadine was instrumental in the conquest of Albion. Her place in the Mausoleum was her reward.
translation: 作为女王陛下的童年好友，血色公爵夫人在征服阿尔比恩的过程中起到了重要作用。她在陵墓中的位置是她的奖励。

original: A second Tamora
translation: 塔摩拉二世

original:
The Duchess would be a small figure, were it not for the mounds of silk and brocade that comprise her dress. She glides along the flagstones, a great train of scarlet cloth following her like the tell-tale trail of blood in a penny dreadful. Today she is menacing the footmen; press-ganging them into her mock-battles in the Tower Carmine. Fatalities are rare in her battles. Maimings are not.

She gives you a red-lipped smile. A footman intervenes and introduces you. She is pleased to encounter a genuine captain, and quizzes you on all the battles you've fought in the Wilderness. The goriest details she demands you linger on. She parts with you only reluctantly.
translation:
若不是裙子由成堆的丝绸和锦缎组成，公爵夫人的身材会看起来十分矮小。她沿着石板滑行，一长串猩红色的布料拖在她身后，就像廉价恐怖小说里的血迹。今天，她在威胁那些男仆，逼着他们参加她在胭脂红塔的模拟战斗。她的战斗中很少致人死亡。致残则不然。

她的红唇对你勾起一个微笑。一位男仆插话来对她介绍了你。她很高兴遇到一个真正的车长，并询问你在外野中经历的所有战斗。她要求你详细描述其中最血腥的细节。她最后不情愿地与你分开了。

original: The brocade incarnadine
translation: 肉色锦缎

original:
She glides along the flagstones, a great train of scarlet cloth following her like the tell-tale trail of blood in a penny dreadful. Today she is menacing the footmen; loudly inquiring after their physiques and their athleticism. She requires only the fittest to survive her mock battles. 

She notices your gaze, but after looking you up and down, merely sighs. "Insufficient," she says, before gliding away. You cannot help but notice the smears of drying blood on her brocade, nor the wash of crimson that trails in her wake like a red tide.
translation:
她沿着石板滑行，一长串猩红色的布料拖在她身后，就像廉价恐怖小说里的血迹。今天，她正在威胁那些男仆：大声质问他们的体格和运动能力。她的模拟战斗中只有最合适的人才能生存。

她注意到你的目光，但在上下打量你之后，只是叹了口气。“不够，”她说，然后滑行着离开了。你不能不注意到她锦缎上干涸的血迹，也不能不注意到她身后像赤潮一样的深红色的水迹。

original: Speak with the Engraved Mourner
translation: 与铭刻送葬者交谈

original: The Mourner is supposed to be a Clay Man, though in appearance he resembles a Greek statue of Hermes more than the lumpy, stolid workers of Old London.
translation: 这个送葬者应该是一个粘土人，尽管从外表上看，他更像希腊的赫尔墨斯雕像，而不是旧伦敦的那些笨手笨脚，性格迟钝的工人。

original: A man all of marble
translation: 从大理石中雕刻出的人

original:
The Mourner is a vision in white. A Clay Man, his skin is alabaster, his curls are spectral, his thin winding sheet pallid. Candlelight dances on the polished marble. Unlike the other courtiers, the footmen pay him no heed. Today he is testing the integrity of the Nave's vaults. 

He notices your gaze and requests you hold a ladder (made of reinforced steel) for him, as he needs to reach the top of the pillar besides you. "If I fell, I'd shatter," he says, before mounting the ladder. It sways with the weight of him, but your grip is steady. He rewards you with a dazzling smile on his descent, some time later.
translation:
一眼看去，送葬者浑身白色。一个粘土人，他的皮肤是雪花石，他的卷发是幽灵般的，他身上单薄地缠绕着的布料是苍白的。烛光在他抛光的大理石皮肤上跳动。与对待其他朝臣不同，男仆们对他不闻不问。今天，他正在测试中殿拱顶的完整性。

他注意到你的目光，并请求你为他拿着梯子（由钢筋制成），因为他需要爬到你身边那根柱子的顶端。他说：“如果我掉下来，我会摔碎的，”然后就登上了梯子。梯子因他的重量而摇晃着，但你的手很稳。一段时间后，他在爬下来时用一个灿烂的微笑来作为回报。

original: Toppled frescoes
translation: 失去平衡的湿壁画

original:
Candlelight dances on the polished marble of the Engraved Mourner as he strides through the Nave. Unlike the other courtiers, the footmen pay him no heed. Today he is testing the integrity of the Nave's vaults. 

He notices your gaze and asks you to hold his (reinforced steel) ladder, while he investigates the integrity of the arches above you. He disappears into the gloom and is gone some time. Suddenly, you hear a groaning as chunks of masonry tumbles from above. You manage to duck just in time, as the Mourner descends, carrying a stone arch of inferior aesthetic quality. He does not acknowledge you as he walks past.
translation:
烛光在铭刻送葬者身上的抛光大理石上舞动，他大步穿过中殿。与其他朝臣不同，男仆们对他不闻不问。今天，他正在测试中殿拱顶的完整性。

他注意到了你的目光，并请你在他检测你头顶拱门完整性的时候扶着他的（钢筋）梯子。他在昏暗处消失了一段时间。突然，你听到一阵呻吟声，大块的砖石从上面滚落下来。在送葬者抬着一个审美低级的石拱门掉下来的时候，你及时躲开了。走过时，他并没有认出你。

original: Entertain a request from the Macabre Counsellor
translation: 接受恐怖顾问的请求

original: The Cheery Registrar gives you a note and a worried smile. The Macabre Counsellor has requested your attendance: an honour rarely granted the legally living.
translation: 愉快的登记员给了你一张纸条和一个担心的微笑。恐怖顾问要求你出席：这是在法律意义上的生者很少获得的荣誉。

original: Into the dark
translation: 进入黑暗

original:
Several footmen are on hand to escort you from the Nave and through the oak-panelled doors that lead down into the Catacombs of Silence, where the Macabre Counsellor resides.

Black candles burn in silver candelabras. Fading tapestries moulder on the walls. In glass cabinets, bones of saints and sinners are displayed with gloomy relish.
translation:
几位男仆护送你离开中殿，穿过橡木板门，进入沉寂之地下墓穴，恐怖顾问就在那里。

黑色蜡烛在银色烛台中燃烧。墙上的挂毯已经褪色、霉变。在玻璃柜子里，圣人和罪人的骨头以一种阴郁的气氛陈列着。

original: An Invitation
translation: 一个邀请

original:
The Cheery Registrar hands you a gold-leaf envelope, penned in black. It seems you have attracted the attentions of one of the Deathless.
[This will allow you to take on unique Bargains for the Deathless, though you will lose Favour. The Bargain is randomised: you may be able to change which is available by replaying the Invitation.]
translation:
愉快的登记员递给你一个金箔信封，上面写着黑字。看来你已经吸引了一位不死者的注意。
[这将允许你和不死者交易独特的特价商品，但你会失去声望。商品种类是随机的：你可以通过重新获得邀请函来改变它。]

original: Hominem te esse memento!
translation: 牢记汝终为人！（Hominem te esse memento!）

original:
[qvd:134430(Dinner)]

[A new bargain may now sometimes be found at the Mausoleum.]
translation:
[qvd:134430(Dinner)]

[现在有一个新的便宜货有时可以在陵墓找到。]

original: Respice post te!
translation: 顾汝身后！（Respice post te!）

original:
[qvd:134430(Dance)]

[A new bargain may now sometimes be found at the Mausoleum.]
translation:
[qvd:134430(Dance)]

[现在有一个新的便宜货有时可以在陵墓找到。]

original: Visit the Macabre Counsellor
translation: 拜访恐怖顾问

original: You have unfinished business with her.
translation: 你在她这里还有事情要办。

original: Enter the De Charney Vault
translation: 进入德·查尼墓室

original: Here lies the weapon that would unmake the stars.
translation: 此处安眠的是能使群星销逝的武器。

original: A servant's tomb
translation: 一个下仆的坟墓

original:
The Cardinal's directions are good. The south tower opens to swallow you like a throat, and you spend an hour traversing the gullet of the Mausoleum. Brief candlelight flickers in the darkness, illuminating the elaborate danse macabre motif that covers the walls with captains, engineers and auditors dancing with corpses.

At the foot of the stair, the darkness opens out into a desolate catacomb. Low iron doors line the walls. The nearest to the stair reads 'De Charney'. Your Aunt advances with the key.
translation:
红衣主教的指示是准确的。南边的塔楼打开，将你吞下，你花了一个小时穿过圣宁墓的咽喉。黑暗中唯有烛火摇曳，照亮了精心设计的死亡之舞主题壁画，墙壁上车长、工程师和审计师们与尸体一同舞蹈。

在楼梯脚下，黑暗中打开了一个荒凉的墓穴。墙上排列着低矮的铁门。离楼梯最近的一扇写着“德·查尼”。你的姨妈拿着钥匙走了过来。

original: Consult the Engraved Mourner
translation: 向铭刻送葬者咨询

original:
A man of alabaster and marble; cold and ancient as an antique statue. Might he have an interest in the Clay Choirs?
[You will require the Favour of the Deathless to facilitate a meeting with the Mourner. Interactions with the Deathless may grant Favour.]
translation:
一个由雪花石和大理石组成的人：像一尊古董雕像一样冰冷而古老。他可能对粘土合唱团感兴趣吗？
[你需要获得在不死者中的声望，以促成与送葬者的会面。与不死者的互动可能会提供声望。]

original: A courtesy
translation: 一种礼节

original:
The Engraved Mourner consents to a meeting in his many-pillared chambers. You sit on couches of blue stone and drink wine in ivory cups. The Conductor hunches; his form far heavier than the furniture can support, while the Mourner reclines elegantly upon his divan.

After polite introductions, the Conductor demands: "Why do you look different?" 

The Mourner smiles. "I was built for a purpose. To guide, to shepherd, to travel. It was deemed I should be pleasing to the eye and ear. Now, you wanted to hear me sing?"

His singing is sombre, and cold and sad. The Clay Conductor shakes his head. "No good. Too much like the sky." You make your excuses.

[Speak to the Clay Conductor on board your engine to continue.]
translation:
铭刻送葬者同意在他多柱式的房间里会面。你们坐在蓝色石头沙发上，用象牙杯喝葡萄酒。列车主管向前屈身：他的身形远比家具能支撑的要重，而送葬者则优雅地躺在他的沙发上。

礼貌介绍之后，列车主管询问道：“为什么你看起来不一样？” 

送葬者笑了。“我是为了一个目的而被创造的。为了引导，为了放牧，为了旅行。人们认为我应该赏心悦目。现在，你们想听我唱歌吗？”

他的歌声阴郁，冰冷而哀伤。粘土人列车主管摇摇头。“不好听。太像天空。”你借故离开了。

[在机车上与粘土人列车主管交谈，继续这个故事。]

original: Speak with the Dismal Chamberlain
translation: 与阴沉的宫廷内侍交谈

original: The Chamberlain presides over the affairs of the Mausoleum. He has seniority of the sepulchre, and rarely meets with visitors.
translation: 宫廷内侍主持圣宁墓的事务。他是这些墓穴间的老资历，而且极少接见访客。

original: The Dismal Chamberlain
translation: 阴沉的宫廷内侍

original:
Your attempts to meet with the Chamberlain are met with relentless obfuscation. His secretary reschedules the meeting eight times, eventually arranging it for six days ago. You even try waiting all day outside the Chamberlain's office, but he does not appear.

His duties include regulation of time in the Mausoleum, where the Deathless wallow in generous pensions of hours. However, the clocks are not keeping the same time. Has something happened?

Finally, you manage to corner the Engraved Mourner and press him for answers. "The Chamberlain is no longer in residence," he replies curtly. "We don't dwell on the matter. We suggest you follow suit."
translation:
你试图与宫廷内侍会面，却遭到了无情的阻挠。他的秘书八次重新安排会面，最终将它安排在六天前。你甚至试过在宫廷内侍的办公室前等上整整一天，但他根本没有出现。

他的职责包括管理整座陵墓的时间，在墓中，不死者沉浸在慷慨的退休时间抚恤里。然而，时钟却没有指向相同的时间。发生什么事了吗？

最终，你设法找到了铭刻送葬者，并向他追问答案。“宫廷内侍已经不在这里了，”他客气地回答道，“我们不会在这个问题上纠缠。我们建议你也这么做。”

original: Make a donation to the upkeep of the Mausoleum
translation: 为陵墓的维护进行捐赠

original:
The Deathless do not lack for time. They do, however, lack for diversion. Fresh reading material is valued high here; a glimpse of a world left far behind.
[This will allow you to speak to the currently available member of the Deathless immediately.]
translation:
不死者并不缺少时间。然而，他们确实缺少消遣。新鲜的阅读材料在这里很受重视：对一个被远远抛在身后的世界的一瞥。
[这将使你可以立即与当前有空的不死者成员交谈。]

original: Expedited
translation: 加急

original: The Cheery Registrar smiles as you make your intent clear. There are forms to be filled out (endless) and interminable questions as to how you wish your donation to be remembered (plaque or bench). But, eventually, the transaction is made. And, wouldn't you know it, but a member of the Deathless has just become available should you wish some of their time.
translation: 愉快的登记员微笑着听你表明你的来意。要填写一些表格（没完没了），还要没完没了地问你希望如何纪念你的捐赠（以牌匾或长凳的形式）。但最终，交易完成了。而且，你大概不知道吧，如果你想占用他们时间的话，不死者的成员现在刚好有空。

original: An Invitation
translation: 一个邀请

original:
The Cheery Registrar hands you a gold-leaf envelope, penned in black. It seems you have attracted the attentions of one of the Deathless.
[This will allow you to take on unique Bargains for the Deathless, though you will lose Favour. The Bargain is randomised: you may be able to change which is available by replaying the Invitation.]
translation:
愉快的登记员递给你一个金箔信封，上面写着黑字。看来你已经吸引了一位不死者的注意。
[这将允许你和不死者交易独特的特价商品，但你会失去声望。商品种类是随机的：你可以通过重新获得邀请函来改变它。]

original: Hominem te esse memento!
translation: 牢记汝终为人！（Hominem te esse memento!）

original:
[qvd:134430(Dinner2)]

[A new bargain may now sometimes be found at the Mausoleum.]
translation:
[qvd:134430(Dinner2)]

[一个新的便宜货可能会在陵墓出现。]

original: Respice post te!
translation: 顾汝身后！（Respice post te!）

original:
[qvd:134430(Dance2)]

[A new bargain may now sometimes be found at the Mausoleum.]
translation:
[qvd:134430(Dance2)]

[一个新的便宜货可能会在陵墓出现。]

original: On the Quiet Sea
translation: 静海之上

original:
The sea all around is shrouded in rolling mist. You can make out boats nearby, bobbing forlornly in the freezing water. Some are roped together, others set apart. Lights speckle the water; cultists still dwell in at least some of the old steamships. 

This platform is deathly silent however. No one is here to greet you.
translation:
周遭海面笼罩在翻涌的浓雾中。依稀可以看到附近的船只在冰冷的水面上孤寂地飘荡着。有些船被绑在一起，有些则没有。水面上闪着光：尚有些狂热教徒居住在几艘旧蒸汽船里。

然而，这个站台一片死寂。没有人迎接你。

original: Approach the Gate
translation: 驶近大门

original: Once, thousands spilled through from the world you left behind. Now it is half-submerged and there have been no newcomers in more than a year. Your crew plead with you to stay.
translation: 曾经，有成千上万的人自你离开的世界涌入天空。如今，这里半被淹没，足足一年有余无人来访。你的列车员恳求你在这里停留一会。

original: On a Sunless Sea
translation: 于无光之海上

original: The air is still and frigid. Your teeth chatter. Ice floes drift by in the mists. The Gate is far from the flotilla. Your breath freezes in the air. A little craft loosely moored to the rest appears serviceable. Oars nest in the berth. You cut the rope and jump in, pushing out into the mist. The Gate rises like a sepulchre. Its statues – twin cowled figures – raise their wings in an arch. The Gate between the statues is gant, the colour that remains when all other colours are devoured. It is sealed, sarcophagus-tight. When you touch it, it sears your fingers with the bitterest cold. It will not open for you. This is the end of the sky. You can go no further.
translation: 空气沉寂而寒冷。你的牙齿在打颤。浮冰漂在迷雾之中。大门离船队很远。你的呼吸在空气中结成了雾。 一艘小船松垮垮地系在一边，看上去尚可一用。泊位上有船桨。你割断绳子，跳进船里，把自己推入雾中。 大门坟冢般耸立着。它两侧的雕像——两个身着兜帽的身影——扬起它们的翅膀，形成了一扇拱门。雕像间大门的颜色乃是枯寂褐，它是当一切颜色被吞噬后剩下的颜色。此门已被封印，缄若石棺。触摸它时，它会用至为严酷的寒气冻伤你的手指。它不会为你打开。 此处便是天空的终点。你不能再往前了。

original: On a Sunless Sea
translation: 于无光之海上

original:
Two vast winged shapes guard a gate of something like resin, smooth but uneven. It is deep gant – the colour that remains when all other colours have been eaten. Ice crusts over the crack between its valves. You approach. Your breath freezes, falls tinkling from the air.

A merciless wind blows from everywhere to everywhere. It passes without effort through your bridge-coat, your flesh, your lungs. There is no way forward. Turn back.
translation:
两尊巨大的有翼雕像伫立门前，把守着一道光滑却凹凸不平的门扉。这门仿佛由树脂浇铸而成，颜色深沉幽暗，乃是当一切颜色被吞噬后，所剩的枯寂褐色。门扉的裂隙里嵌着冰霜，你靠近时，呼出的气息冻结，化作细碎冰晶，叮当坠落。

寒风自四方袭来，无孔不入，透过大衣，穿透血肉，直抵肺腑。前路已绝，折返吧。

original: Leave an offering
translation: 留下祭品

original: The sea is peopled with the forgotten and the abandoned. It is customary to leave an offering at the Flotilla. For help; for hope; for home. Perhaps someone will come to collect it.
translation: 海里居住着被遗忘的人和被抛弃的人。在船队中留下祭品是一种习俗。或是为了提供帮助；或是为了带来希望；或是为了怀念家乡。也许有人会来拿走它。

original: Sit in contemplation
translation: 端坐沉思

original: There is little else to do here.
translation: 这里没有什么别的事情可做。

original: Hic sunt dracones
translation: 此处有龙（Hic sunt dracones）

original:
Why are you here? At the edge of the Horizon, on an all but empty flotilla. Far from the place where you were born, no way back. If you even wanted to return.

How many waited for the Gate to open? How many came through, unable to go further, unable to return. Where are they now? Are there any still there? You would need to fly to the Gate itself to find out.

The water burbles. You see your face emerge in the sea below, visible through the mist.
translation:
你为什么来到这里？来到地平线的边缘，这片罕有人至的船队上。此处离你的出生地很远，归途已断。如果你甚至还想回去的话。

有多少人曾等待着大门的开启？有多少人曾通过它，却无法继续前进，更无法掉头回返。他们现在又在哪里？他们之中还有人健在吗？你得划到大门那里去寻找答案。

水声潺潺。你看到你的脸自下方海水中浮现，透过薄雾依稀可辨。

original: A voice in the mist
translation: 迷雾中的一个声音

original: A figure in a soaked oilskin steps out of the mists. "We noted your sacrifice."
translation: 一个身披浸湿油布的身影从迷雾中走了出来。“我们已然知晓你的牺牲。”

original: A voice in the mists
translation: 迷雾中的一个声音

original: A figure in a hooded cloak steps out of the mists. "Your sacrifice was most perspicant!"
translation: 一个身披连帽斗篷的身影从迷雾中走了出来。“你的牺牲乃明智之举！”

original: A voice in the mists
translation: 迷雾中的一个声音

original: A figure in an antiquated frockcoat steps out of the mist. "A fine evening to you. We were impressed with your offering."
translation: 一个身着古旧连衣裙的身影从迷雾中走了出来。“祝你度过一个美好的夜晚。我们对你的奉献印象深刻。”

original: Return to the Flotilla
translation: 返回船队

original: Lights in the mist suggest the various mystics have returned from their contemplations.
translation: 迷雾中的灯光表明那些神秘主义者已从他们的冥想中回返。

original: Depart
translation: 离开

original: What is there here for you?
translation: 这里有什么在等着你？

original: Search for the 'Displeased'
translation: 寻找“不悦离人”

original: The Parson asked you to meet with them, to encourage them to join him at Worlebury.
translation: 牧师要求你与他们见面，来鼓励他们来到沃伯瑞，加入他的行列。

original: On a Sunless Sea
translation: 于无光之海上

original:
There's nothing here save for the cold and the teethed wind, tracing fingers down your spine. No one is nearby.

If you're going to talk to the Displeased, you'll need to go further. You'll need to find the acolytes here and gain their favour before you'll be able to persuade them to travel.

[If you have not yet encountered the acolytes who reside here, leave an offering to convince them of your piety. You will need to be embraced by the Displeased before you can speak of this subject.]
translation:
这里什么都没有，除了寒冷，以及顺着你脊柱往下刮的噬人狂风。附近渺无人烟。

要与不悦离人交谈，你得走得更远才行。你需要找到这里的信众，并受到他们的喜爱，之后你才能说服他们上路。

[如果还没有遇见居住在这里的信众，你可以留下一份代表你虔诚的献物。你需要先被不悦离人接纳，之后才能讨论这个话题。]

original: Sacrifice hours to appease the Burrower Below
translation: 牺牲时间来安抚下之掘隧神

original: A half-mad skyfarer once told you that the Burrower devours time, and that the door at the Avid Horizon was sacred to her.
translation: 一个半疯的行天客曾告诉你，掘隧神吞噬时间，而渴求之地平线的门是她的圣域。

original: Appeased
translation: 安抚

original:
You pour barrel after barrel of hours into the sea at the statues feet. There is no sign that your offering is accepted. The sea does not tremble. The statues do not stir. You must simply hope that this was enough.

You row away, your little boat much lighter without its lucrative cargo.
translation:
你把一桶又一桶的时间倒进雕像脚下的海里。没有迹象表明神明接受了你的奉献。海水没有颤动。雕像也没有动静。你只能希望这些已经足够了。

你划船离开，你的小船因失去了值钱的货物而变得更轻。

original: Search for your Driver
translation: 寻找你的司机

original: A few cultists point to a crater in the ice, and a long trail leading deeper into the mists. The Driver is somewhere ahead.
translation: 几个教徒指向冰层上面一个撞出来的裂口，以及一条通往迷雾深处的长长小路。司机就在前面某处。

original: A Driver returned
translation: 归来的司机

original:
You scour the wreckage of the Flotilla, and finding nothing, head away from the cults on the habitable ships, and strike out into the frigid reaches of the Quiet Sea. 

Your crew carry lanterns aloft, which sends shadows skittering across the ice floes. Your voices are soon raw with shouting. And then, when you were on the verge of giving up — A familiar voice cries out.

"[qvd:131182(CapitalInformal)]! Over here. Afraid the engine's totalled. But I'm in one piece!" As the lantern light reveals the extent of the damage, you're forced to concede the Driver's assessment. Their grin is unmistakable even in the gloom.
translation:
你搜索了船队的残骸，但一无所获。随后你离开居于船上的教徒，前往寂静海的寒冷海域。

你的列车员把提灯高高举起，让影子在浮冰上飞快移动。你们的嗓子很快就喊得生疼。最后，当你们几乎要放弃希望时，传来了一声熟悉的喊叫。

“[qvd:131182(CapitalInformal)]！在这里。机车怕是没救了。但我没缺胳膊少腿！”当提灯的光照出机车上的损坏时，你不得不承认司机的评估很准确。即使在这般阴暗的环境中，司机的笑容也如此耀眼。

original: An Offering at the Gate
translation: 在拱门处献祭

original:
At the height of its powers, the Home Office processed tens of thousands of petitioners seeking entry to Albion. Some were rejected or left to seek appeals or help from Albion, caught in limbo between the Office and the Gate. 

Here at the edge of the Horizon, in the shadow of the winged statues, detainees leave offerings; prayers and messages to the world left behind; supplications to the cultists that dwell on the Quiet Sea.

What will you leave behind?
translation:
在内政部权力的鼎盛时期，他们处理过数以万计寻求进入阿尔比恩的请愿。一些人被拒绝，或留在此处寻求申诉或来自阿尔比恩的帮助，滞留在内政部和大门之间的边缘地带。

此处，地平线的边缘，有翼雕像的阴影下，滞留者们留下了祭品：既有送往旧世界的祈祷和讯息，也有对居住在寂静海的教徒的祈求。

你要留下些什么？

original: Food
translation: 食物

original: There is a hunger here.
translation: 此处存有饥饿。

original: Your crew do not complain as you order a crate opened and emptied over the side of the flotilla. They stand by your side as cans and flasks splash into the water. You can see the reflected gazes, staring into the depths.
translation: 你命令列车员打开箱子，把里面的东西从船队一侧倒入水中。他们没有抱怨。他们站在你身边，看着瓶瓶罐罐溅起水花。你看到水面倒影中，他们凝视深渊的目光。

original: Fuel
translation: 燃料

original: You will bring warmth to a cold place and light to a dark one.
translation: 你将予寒冷之地以温暖，予黑暗之地以光。

original: Your stokers glare mutiny, but they comply. Coke is brought from your boilers, ground and sprinkled into the water. It sifts through your fingers like grains of falling sand. There is no land here, and no light.
translation: 司炉们带着反意瞪着你，但他们终于还是照做了。你们从锅炉中取出焦炭，磨碎后洒入水里。它从你指间滑过，如流沙般淌下。此处既无陆地，亦无光。

original: A body
translation: 一具尸体

original: The sea does not forgive.
translation: 大海永不原谅。

original: You take a bland stoker out alone, away from the rest. There is pleading, but there have been many pleas in this place. It is swift. Swifter than starvation or madness. The body sinks like a stone. A few brief eddies interrupt the water. You return alone. You can see the eyes of your crew in their reflections in the waves.
translation: 你只带着一个不起眼的司炉前去，远离了其他人。之后是恳求，但这里承载过很多人的恳求。过程很快。比饥饿或疯狂更快。尸体像石头一样沉了下去。几个漩涡打破了水面的平静。你独自返回。你看到你列车员们的眼睛在波浪中的倒影。

original: Gold
translation: 金钱

original: Throw a fistful of coins, bright as mellow suns.
translation: 扔出一把明亮如柔和阳光的硬币。

original: A long silence; a distant splash. Do you feel better?
translation: 漫长的寂静——远方溅起的水声。你感觉好些了吗？

original: A Conversation with a Careful Masquerader
translation: 与谨慎的覆面者对话

original:
A slim woman lowers her mask to gaze upon you. Her expression is stark. "I permitted myself a brief indulgence: hoping that you would join us. I admired your offering. My friends and I would like to extend an invitation. We are the Displeased.  With us you will find hardship, sorrow and the only truth there is."

She hesitates. "There are certain rituals you will need to pass. And there's someone you should meet."
translation:
一位苗条的女人取下她的面具，凝视着你。她的表情凝重。“我允许自己从面具中暂时解脱，并希望你能加入我们。我很欣赏你的奉献。我和我的朋友们想向你发出邀请。我们是不悦离人。与我们同行，你会寻见苦难，悲恸与唯存的真理。”

她略作犹豫，“你需要通过一些仪式，还应该去见一个人。”

original: Accept and be greeted
translation: 接受提议，加入教众

original: The Careful Masquerader is keen for you to meet someone of her acquaintance.
translation: 谨慎的覆面者很想让你与她的熟人见面。

original: The beginnings of torment
translation: 折磨的开始

original:
She shakes your hand, and guides you to a rope ladder descending into the mists. You can make out old ships and boats roped together. Lights dance across the wrecks. "We have been forced to share in order to survive," the Careful Masquerader says as you descend, "It is a precarious situation."

At the bottom, rotting gang-planks make their way out to a flotilla of roped boats. Before them is a single lantern fixed to a pole. Tied to the pole is the decomposing body of your unfortunate crewman. 

"Pleased to be reacquainted? One betrayal demands answer of another." The Careful Masquerader holds up the jaw so you can better see into his eyes. "Come along. There's more to learn."
translation:
她与你握了手，并把你带到一个绳梯边，梯子向下延伸到迷雾中。透过雾气，你能分辨出用绳索绑在一起的旧船和小舟。灯光在残骸上摇曳。“为了生存，我们被迫分享，”在你向下爬时，谨慎的覆面者说，“时景艰难。”

在底部，腐烂的船板一直延伸到一群被绳索捆绑的船队。船板的这一头，有一盏固定在杆子上的提灯。绑在柱子上的是你那不幸列车员的腐尸。

“很高兴能重新认识你。一人的背叛呼唤着另一人的回应。”谨慎的覆面者抬起你的下巴，让你更清楚地看到她的眼睛，“过来。你还有更多东西要学。”

original: Decline
translation: 拒绝

original: She has gotten the wrong idea.
translation: 她找错人了。

original: She shrugs. "We're not for the faint of heart. Should you wish to see us again, drop another body in the water." With that, she's gone, away and into the mists.
translation: 她耸耸肩。“我们不与心存畏惧之人结识。如果你想再见到我们，就再往水里扔一具尸体吧。”说罢，她离开了，走进迷雾之中。

original: Inquire about the Displeased
translation: 打听不悦离人

original: Who exactly are these people and what do they want with you?
translation: 这些人到底是谁，他们想从你身上得到什么？

original: Needful things
translation: 所需之物

original:
The Careful Masquerader shakes her head, as though she dislikes the question. "We are the abandoned, who in turn, shall abandon. We are the betrayed, who in turn, will betray. We are the despised, who in turn, shall despise."

She draws a blade, jagged and rusted. "London left us behind, decided we were unworthy, unwanted. We have spent the intervening years sharpening that rejection. It is who we are. All else is chaff." 

"As for you, I admired the ferocity of your act. It speaks to the essence of our philosophy. You might have the ice in your soul required to learn our mysteries."
translation:
谨慎的覆面者摇摇头，似是对这个问题感到不悦，“我们是被他人抛弃，并抛弃他人的人。我们是被他人背叛，并背叛他人的人。我们是被他人鄙视，并鄙视他人的人。”

她抽出一把锯齿边的锈刀。“伦敦抛弃了我们，认为我们没有价值，不欢迎我们。我们用这些年的时间来磨砺这种拒绝。这就是构成我们的东西，其余的都是杂质。”

“至于你，我很欣赏你的凶猛行为。它道出了我们哲学的本质。你的灵魂中可能有了解我们奥秘所需的坚冰。”

original: A Conversation with a Jolly Anchorite
translation: 与快哉隐士对话

original:
The man lowers his hood to reveal a scarred and ruddy face. His eyes twinkle like falling suns.

"We've been watching from the flotilla. We all agree your offering was worthy. Worthy to seek the names of the saints  with us. If you wanted to learn a truth of the Gate, that is?" 

He produces a battered flask from his cloak. "I've taken the liberty of bringing the unguent. Should you wish to join us."
translation:
男人拉下兜帽，露出一张伤痕累累的、红润的脸。他的眼睛像坠落的太阳一样闪烁。

“我们一直在船队中看着你。我们都同意你的奉献是值得的。你值得与我们一起寻找圣人的名字。你想学习门的真相，对吗？” 

他从斗篷中拿出一个破旧的烧瓶。“我冒昧地带来了药膏。你大概想要加入我们。”

original: Accept and be anointed in the Cult of the Sanctified
translation: 接受并受膏加入圣化结会

original: "First you must learn words, and stuff your mouth full of them. They shall prepare you to know the names."
translation: “首先你须研习词语，并令其充实你的口。它们将使你准备好认识那些名字。”

original: The ritual
translation: 仪式

original:
"I anoint your head with chrism and press my thumb to your lips, for you are hungry for sacral flesh." You briefly taste dead skin and salt.

"In the beginning was the word, and the word was made writing. The Lord said go forth and multiply. Sin flourishes in silence, but is washed away by the multiplication of words. Open. Wider, please." Parchment is stuffed into your mouth. 

The Jolly Anchorite beams. "Not too hard was it? You have learnt the first name and met our Saint of Inks. Our brethren are just this way."
translation:
“我用圣油涂抹你的头，并在你的唇按上拇指，因你渴望骶骨的肉。”你短暂地尝到了死皮和盐的味道。

“太初有言，言成文字。主曰，汝当直行，繁衍无数。罪恶于静默中滋长，唯言语增多方能将其洗净。嘴巴打开。请再张大一点。”你的嘴里被塞进了羊皮纸。 

快哉隐士笑容满面。“不太难吧？你已经学会了第一个名字，也认识了我们墨之圣徒，我们的兄弟就是这样。”

original: Decline
translation: 拒绝

original: He has gotten rather the wrong impression.
translation: 他的判断错了。

original: Crestfallen
translation: 受挫之人

original: The Jolly Anchorite gazes out over the misty waters and sighs, shaking his head. "Not to worry, not to worry! There will be others. Perhaps you shall come to us again." He departs, away and into the night.
translation: 快哉隐士凝视着雾蒙蒙的水面，叹了口气，又摇了摇头。“不用担心，不用担心！还会有别人。也许你会再来找我们。”他离开了，融入了夜色中。

original: Ask about the Cult of the Sanctified
translation: 问及圣化结会

original: Who are these people and what do they want with you?
translation: 这些人是谁，他们想从你身上得到什么？

original: An indulgent laugh
translation: 纵声大笑

original: "We are but humble acolytes of the Saints. They came among us long ago – before we departed for the Skies in our folly. Most abandoned them, but we pray to let them know that not all have forgotten their names." The Jolly Anchorite sighs, gazing out on the mists, "Perhaps they'll even rejoin us, if enough learn their names and recite them here at the Gate."
translation: “我们只是圣徒的卑微信众。他们很久以前就来到我们中间——在我们愚蠢地离开海泽，前往天空之前。大多数人都抛弃了他们，但我们的祈祷让他们知道，并非所有人都忘记了他们的名字。”快哉隐士叹了口气，凝视着远方的迷雾，“也许他们甚至会重新加入我们，如果有足够多的人知道他们的名字，并在门前念诵的话。”

original: A Conversation with an Illuminated Archivist
translation: 与明光档案员的对话

original:
The man lowers his hood. His features are strident, striking, made all the more so by the lattice of tattoos marking his face like a verdant birthmark. 

He extends his hands. "The Word made flesh. And you have fed ours. We would be glad – the Supralapsarians and I – to welcome you to our little enclave in the flotilla." 

He lowers his cloak to expose his tattooed collarbone. "But first you must read."
translation:
男人放下兜帽。他的五官棱角分明，引人注目，脸上像青翠的胎记一样的格子纹身让他更显如此。 

他伸出双手。“言成肉身。而你使我们饱足。我们——先定论者和我——欢迎你来到我们在船队中的小飞地。” 

他放下斗篷，露出他纹过的锁骨。“但首先你必须阅读。”

original: Accept
translation: 接受

original: Read the Illuminated Archivist's flesh.
translation: 阅读明光档案员的肉体。

original: Always coming home
translation: 恒久归途

original:
The tattoos on his collar are a jumble of words and pictures. You make out a crab and a cave, a candle and a roof. You recite the words you find there: "I am home."

He embraces you, bony arms wrapped around your frame like stumbling into a coffin. "Yes, you are home. Follow me. We're all at the flotilla at the moment. I dislike the arrangement, but there are too few of us to survive alone. If you like, I shall teach you to read." He says 'read' with a weighty, portentous inflection.
translation:
他锁骨上的纹身是杂乱无章的文字和图片。你能认出一只螃蟹和一个山洞，一支蜡烛和一个屋顶。你复述出在那里找到的词。“我回来了。”

他拥抱你，瘦骨嶙峋的手臂环绕着你的身躯，就像跌跌撞撞地走进棺材。“是的，你回来了。跟着我。我们此刻都在船队里。我不喜欢这里，但我们的人太少了，无法独自生存。如果你愿意，我会教你阅读。”他说“阅读”这个词的时候，语气凝重，充满了预示性。

original: Decline
translation: 拒绝

original: This is not for you.
translation: 你不会这么做。

original: The Illuminated Archivist raises his cloak with icy dignity. "Very well. May you travel in darkness. Should you wish to find us again, leave us a feast." He walks into the mists.
translation: 明光档案员以冰冷的尊严罩上他的斗篷。“很好。愿你在黑暗中旅行。如果你想再次找到我们，请给我们留下盛宴。”他走进了迷雾中。

original: Ask about the Supralapsarians
translation: 问及先定论者

original: Who are these people and what do they want with you?
translation: 这些人是谁，他们想从你身上得到什么？

original: Preservation
translation: 保存

original: The Archivist smiles blissfully. "We are those who were left behind, so we have decided that we chose to stay. We keep with tradition." He waves airily about him. "Ours is a remarkably liberating lifestyle. You helped us, however indirectly, with your gift. I'd like to return the favour."
translation: 档案员型幸福的笑道：“我们是那些被留下的人，所以我们决定驻足守望。我们记录着传统。”他轻松的挥手：“我们的工作方式十分自由。你的礼物给了我们很大的帮助，尽管是间接的，我仍想以声望作为回报。”

original: Aboard the Flotilla
translation: 登上船队

original:
Here, among abandoned boats on the Quiet Sea, the similarly abandoned and forgotten of Albion have made their homes. The cults share this space; for warmth and for shelter.

Some boats are covered, others converted into makeshift anchorages, refectories and cells. Hopeful acolytes flock to one ecstatic figure or another, raving about this doctrine or that. Your new friends are one cult among three.

The Sanctified, the loose collection of souls who follow the Jolly Anchorite are communal, fraternal, jovial. The Supralapsarians, who follow the Illuminating Archivist, do everything by their Book (when they can agree upon the interpretation). The Displeased treat distrust as a virtue and betrayal as a sacrament.

A woman is lying on a wheel that sits atop a pole that rises over the flotilla. She does not speak, but only watches the Gate.
translation:
那些被阿尔比恩抛弃、遗忘的人们，在此处的无主之船间安身立命。为了寻求温暖与庇护，信仰不同的异教共处一地。

有的船蒙上了帆布，有的船被改造成简陋的码头、食堂或牢房。满怀希望的信众蜂拥而至，奔向各种各样的受启者，激动不已地鼓吹着自家教义。你可以从三种异教中任选一种加入。

圣化结会是个松散社群，听从快哉隐士，教徒秉承着资产共有、情同手足、畅快行乐的精神；先定论者追随明光档案员，只依其教典行事（前提是他们能就其解读达成共识）；不悦离人则视猜忌为美德，奉背叛为圣礼。

在船队上空，一根杆子的顶端，有个女人静静地躺在顶部的舵轮上。她沉默不语，只凝望着远处的那道巨门。

original: Where will you lay your head at night?
translation: 你晚上在哪里睡觉？

original:
Every acolyte has a favoured spot in the flotilla to take their kip. The politics of one's sleeping arrangements are complicated here.
[Your choices here will affect the dispositions of the cults towards you. Favour with a cult can generate rewards or occasionally open options while pursuing other objectives.]
translation:
每个侍从在船队中都有一个他们满意的用来睡觉的场所。显然任何一人的就寝安排都经过了数次复杂的勾心斗角。
[你在这里的选择将影响各教派对你的态度。在进行其他任务时，教派的声望可以带来便利并且在特定条件下解锁新的选项。]

original: Exalted status
translation: 崇高的地位

original:
Because you were selected by one of the leaders of the mystics to uncover their sacred mysteries, you may sleep where you like. 

Everyone is eager to see what you choose. There isn't much to do here.
translation:
因你被密教的一位领袖委托以揭开他们神圣的奥秘，你可以自由选择在何处睡觉。

每个成员都希望看到你的选择，毕竟他们在这里也没什么能做的事。

original: A cozy berth near an open hearth
translation: 靠近壁炉的舒适铺位

original: Wine and candles, shared warmth and traded stories. You are strengthened by community.
translation: 在葡萄酒与烛光下，分享温暖，交换故事。你因群聚而坚定。

original:
A member of the Sanctified invites you to join them. Their berth is small; like a coffin covered in blankets. The evening passes in clouds of smoke, so that all of your clothes reek of the bonfire. You wake a good deal more familiar with some of your fellow acolytes than you had been before.

[You have pleased the Sanctified.]
translation:
一位圣化结会的成员邀请你加入他们。他们的铺位很小，像一口盖着毛毯的棺材。整个夜晚在与他们的烟雾缭绕中度过，你的衣服散发着篝火的烟熏味。相比之前，你对一些信徒更加熟悉了。

[你取悦了圣化结会教徒。]

original: A crow's nest
translation: 鸦巢

original: A lonely eyrie, far above the mists. You are strengthened by solitude.
translation: 一个孤独的鸟巢，远在迷雾之上。你因孤独而坚定。

original:
After a brief moment of awkwardness when one of the Displeased climbs into the nest, sees you, and then immediately descends into the mists again, you spend a chilly and undisturbed evening alone.

[You have not actively upset the Displeased.]
translation:
一位不悦离人爬进巢穴，看到你后立即离开，再度下降到迷雾中。短暂的尴尬过后，你独自度过了一个寒冷而不受打扰的夜晚。

[你没有激起不悦离人的不悦。]

original: Whatever others are doing
translation: 看看别人怎么做

original: Where they sleep, you sleep. You are strengthened by tradition.
translation: 他们睡哪里，你就睡哪里。你因传统而坚定。

original:
"When Londoners sleep, they do so regardless of their surroundings. Noise shall not disturb them nor light rouse them. A Londoner can sleep through damnation. They keep to their regular hours, for they have adapted to the endless darkness beneath the earth." The words wash over you as you lay down to sleep.

[You have pleased the Supralapsarians.]
translation:
“伦敦人睡觉时不顾及周遭的环境。噪音不会打扰他们，灯光也不会将他们唤醒。伦敦人可以在咒骂声中入眠。他们作息规律，因为他们已经适应了地下的无尽黑暗。”当你躺下睡觉时，这些话语冲刷着你。

[你已取悦了先定论者。]

original: Sing
translation: 歌唱

original:
On rising, there is singing. For some, a morning chorus; for others, a lament. Lungs swell.
