original: The New Street Line's Garret
translation: 新巷线的阁楼

original:
This cramped attic space is a world away from New Street proper. The walls are peeling, the floor bare, and the furniture creaks with every uncomfortable movement. It does however offer an excellent view of the docks for agents of the Line to watch for opportunities.

The Stationmaster salutes. [qvd:134520(StationmasterStatus)]
translation:
这个狭小的阁楼空间与正街相去甚远。墙壁剥落，地板裸露，家具在每一次不舒服的移动时都会吱吱作响。然而，它为新巷线的特工们提供了绝佳的视野，让他们得以观察码头。

站长敬了个礼。[qvd:134520(StationmasterStatus)]

original: Speak to the Stationmaster
translation: 和站长交谈

original: What is his part in the New Street Line?
translation: 他在新巷线中的角色是什么？

original: A proud rescuee
translation: 一位自豪的获救者

original:
"Workworlder, boy and man." He scratches his beard. "Fifty years there, I was. Or five, on the outside. Freed by the Line last year. Anyway. Her Ladyship had a use for me, so here I am. Just put me to work; I'll be the most loyal number-two in the Empire, so I shall."

When it comes to the question of funding, he looks sheepish. "Way it usually works, sir or ma'am is we worry 'bout getting our people to safety first. Then once they're settled they chip in a bit of cash as they can. Don't you worry though. The Ladyship handles that and'll make it all fiduc— financ—" He smacks his cheek. "Worth your time."
translation:
“我从少年到成年都在工作世界。”他挠了挠胡子。“待了五十年，或者说五年，按外面的时间算。直到去年被新巷线解救了。总之，女爵有需要我的地方，所以我在这里。只要给我安排工作；我会成为帝国最忠诚的二把手。”

当谈到资金问题时，他显得有些尴尬。“通常的做法是，先生或女士，我们首先担心的是把人安全地救出来。等他们安顿下来后，他们会尽自己所能捐一些钱。不过你不用担心。女爵会处理这些事情，并确保——”他拍了一下自己的脸颊，“值得你的付出。”

original: Agree to smuggle a passenger yourself
translation: 同意自己偷渡一个乘客

original: Where from and where to?
translation: 从哪里来，到哪里去？

original: A poor soul in need of saving
translation: 一个需要拯救的可怜的灵魂

original: "Good on you!" The Stationmaster stands proudly to attention. "Lessee. This one's been waiting their turn long enough, I reckon. Allow me to scribble down the details."
translation: “好样的！” 站长骄傲地站起来，向大家致意，“承租人。我觉得，这个人已经等得够久了。请允许我记下些细节。”

original: Arrange a smuggling operation
translation: 筹备一次偷渡行动

original:
Not many captains can be trusted to carry escapees. Fortunately, they don't always need to know what they're transporting.
[The higher your Affiliation: Bohemia and lower your Unwanted Attention: Albion, the easier this will be.]
translation:
没多少车长被认为有能力载运逃亡者。幸运的是，他们并不总是需要知道自己在运送什么。
[你的人脉：波西米亚派艺术家越高以及不必要的关注：阿尔比恩越低，这就越容易。]

original: The right word in the right ears
translation: 良言入佳耳

original: It never takes long to find disgruntled crewmembers nursing drinks in a pub. A few sovereigns convince a few to adjust their engine's' cargo manifest and not look too carefully for stowaways the next time they stop at a workworld. The Fierce Philanthropist's other agents can take matters from there. You return to the attic to find payment already waiting. The Stationmaster counts it out a coin at a time.
translation: 要在酒馆里找些借酒浇愁的列车员，用不了很久。只用一点金镑就能收买几个人：调整他们机车的货物清单，让他们下次在工作世界停留时，对偷渡者视而不见。接下来的安排，刚毅的慈善家的其他手下自会接手。你返回阁楼，发现报酬已静候多时，站长正一枚枚地清点着硬币。

original: Too many questions
translation: 太多问题

original: Your hunt for bribable crewmembers does not go well. Too many stowaways in recent months have made your fellow captains nervous. Most that you approach mistake your interest for a test and immediately clam up. Your questions, however, do not go unnoticed by the local officials. They reach for their notebooks. [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]
translation: 找寻可贿赂的列车员并不顺利。近几个月来，太多的偷渡者让各位偷渡车长感到紧张。你所接触的大多数人都把你的兴趣误认为考验，并立即闭口不谈。然而，你的提问并没有被当地官员忽视。他们拿起了笔记本。 [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]

original: Ask about potential projects
translation: 询问潜在的项目

original: The Stationmaster looks out of the window. A patrol from the Ministry is passing by.
translation: 站长看向窗外。公德部的一支巡逻队正巧路过。

original: More haste, less speed
translation: 欲速则不达

original:
"Your eagerness is a credit to you, but we can't go making it too easy for the peelers. Give things a bit of time to settle down first, yes?" He pats you on the back. "How about a nice mug of tea?"

[Return in a few days to continue the Great Work.]
translation:
“你的热忱令人钦佩，但我们不能让那些侦探太轻松了。先让事情平静一下，怎么样？他拍了拍你的背，“来杯茶怎么样？”

[几天后再回来继续伟大的事业。]

original: Ship arms to a workworld
translation: 把武器运往工作世界

original: You'll never bring down a workworld, but an uprising there means fewer overseers here. [The higher your Affiliation: Villainy and lower your Unwanted Attention: Albion, the easier this will be.]
translation: “你永远不可能颠覆一个工作世界，但在那里发动起义意味着这里的监管者会减少。” [你的人脉：恶棍越高以及不必要的关注：阿尔比恩越低，这就越容易。]

original: Distant explosions
translation: 远处的爆炸声

original: Smuggling munitions aboard a train bound for a workworld is a riskier proposition than arranging cabins for a few stowaways. It takes time to find a captain who looks trustworthy, but is willing to make the run. Eventually, you manage it, much to the Fierce Philanthropist's quiet approval.
translation: 要在驶向工厂世界的列车上走私军火，远比为偷渡者安排几间舱位冒险得多。找到一个既值得信赖、又敢铤而走险的车长，可不简单。不过，你最终还是办成了。刚毅的慈善家对你工作相当认可，虽未明言，却溢于言表。

original: A dangerous question
translation: 一个危险的问题

original: Even the crew willing to consider your offer shrink at the thought of smuggling explosives aboard their employers' trains. It isn't long before word of your questions spread. This does not go unnoticed by the local officials with their little black notepads. [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]
translation: 即使是愿意考虑你提议的列车员，在想到要在雇主的列车上走私炸药时也会退缩。不久之后，你询问的消息便传开了。当地手持小黑笔记本的官员们注意到了这一点。 [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]

original: Campaign for the Firebrand Conductor's release
translation: 为煽动指挥者的释放进行宣传

original: "He's her Ladyship's nephew," the Stationmaster tells you. The Fierce Philanthropist never mentioned that. Perhaps she would be grateful if you used your current influence to free him.
translation: “他是夫人的侄子，”站长告诉你。刚毅的慈善家从未提过这一点。如果你利用自己当下的影响去解救他，也许慈善家会心怀感激。

original: Freedom!
translation: 自由!

original:
A small crowd gathers to applaud the Firebrand Conductor as he strides from prison. Instead, an elderly man hobbles uncertainly out of the Empress' palace. His mouth is toothless, his little remaining hair matted and grey. Nothing remains of the young student you met on the docks. The Midnight Cells have taken everything, an hour at a time.

The Fierce Philanthropist waits in her carriage to receive him. Her dark fingers grip a cigarette holder almost hard enough to snap it in two. The crowd remains oblivious to her identity, but she takes a moment to nod her gratitude to you before driving off.
translation:
一小群人聚集在皇宫外，等着为煽动指挥者的出狱鼓掌喝彩。可走出皇宫的，却是一位步履蹒跚的老人。他牙齿掉光，仅存的几缕头发斑白杂乱，与你在码头初识的那位热血学子已是判若两人。午夜牢房将他的一点一滴尽数吞噬，只剩下这副空壳。

刚毅的慈善家在马车中静候接应。她深色的手指几乎要把烟嘴捏断。围观人群未认出她的身份，而她也只是向你轻轻点头致谢，随后便驾车离去。

original: Freedom!
translation: 自由!

original:
A small crowd gathers to applaud the Firebrand Conductor as he strides from prison. Instead, an elderly man hobbles uncertainly out of the Empress' palace. His mouth is toothless, his little remaining hair matted and grey. Nothing remains of the young student you met on the docks. The Midnight Cells have taken everything, an hour at a time.

The Fierce Philanthropist waits in her carriage to receive him. Her dark fingers grip a cigarette holder almost hard enough to snap it in two. The crowd remains oblivious to her identity, but she takes a moment to nod her gratitude to you before driving off.
translation:
一小群人聚集在皇宫外，等着为煽动指挥者的出狱鼓掌喝彩。可走出皇宫的，却是一位步履蹒跚的老人。他牙齿掉光，仅存的几缕头发斑白杂乱，与你在码头初识的那位热血学子已是判若两人。午夜牢房将他的一点一滴尽数吞噬，只剩下这副空壳。

刚毅的慈善家在马车中静候接应。她深色的手指几乎要把烟嘴捏断。围观人群未认出她的身份，而她也只是向你轻轻点头致谢，随后便驾车离去。

original: Organise a mass escape from a workworld
translation: 组织一次从工作世界的大规模逃亡

original:
Enough of your rescued workworlders are willing to take part. They only need guidance.
[The higher your Affiliation: Establishment and lower your Unwanted Attention: Albion, the easier this will be.]
translation:
你拯救的工作世界居民中有足够多的人愿意参与。他们只需要纲领。
[你的人脉：权贵越高以及不必要的关注：阿尔比恩越低，这就越容易。]

original: A careful scheme
translation: 一个谨慎的计划

original: It requires the 'loan' of a cargo train and a whole new crew. Fortunately, enough ex-workworlders are willing to handle both the borrowing and the staffing. They depart on their mission, to sneak into dock, and smuggle as many as they can out under the cover of work. Word soon comes back of their success. The Fierce Philanthropist is said to be so happy with the success, she gives her staff an extra half-hour off.
translation: 这需要“借调”一列货运列车，并重新组建一整班车组。所幸，有不少曾逃离工作世界的人愿意协助，既能筹措列车，也能亲自上阵。列车启程，车组成员潜入码头，假借“工作”之名，尽可能将更多人偷运出去。不久，就传来了任务完成的喜讯。据说，刚毅的慈善家对此非常满意，特地让手下多休息了半小时。

original: Biting off too much
translation: 承担的太多了

original: The scheme goes wrong immediately with a failed attempt to 'borrow' an old cargo train from the scrapheap. Most of the former Workworlder crew manages to escape from the police, but not without a couple ending up in irons. The Fierce Philanthropist does her best to free them before they can spill the limited amount they know of the Line. [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]
translation: 计划一开始就出了岔子。本打算从废品站中顺利“借用”一列老旧货运列车，却以失败告终。至于车组成员，他们大多数人成功逃脱了警方的追捕，但还是有几人被抓。虽然这些人对新巷线知之甚少，刚毅的慈善家仍竭尽所能，在他们坦白交代之前将其解救出来。 [qvd:134520(HeatLevel)]

original: Trade Favour to distract the authorities
translation: 使用声望分散当局的注意力

original: This will lower the heat on the New Street Line, but not reduce your personal Suspicion.
translation: 这将降低新巷线的风紧，但不会减少对你个人的怀疑。

original: A trustworthy voice
translation: 一个值得信赖的声音

original: You buy yourself a few minutes whispering into the right ears, sending the authorities off on a wild goose chase. The New Street Line remains under investigation, but you have bought it some more time to carry out the Work.
translation: 你为自己争取到了几分钟的时间，对着上流社会的耳朵窃语，把当局打发到了徒劳的搜索中。新巷线仍处在调查中，但你又为它争取了一些时间来开展工作。

original: Return to the street
translation: 回到街上

original: You've done everything you came here for, for now.
translation: 你现在已经完成了此行的所有目的，至少目前是这样的。

original: Leaving the Line
translation: 离开新巷线

original: The Stationmaster salutes. "I'll watch the shop until you return, Captain. Good travels."
translation: 站长敬了个礼。“我会在这里守着，直到您回来，车长。祝您一路顺风。”

original: Confess to losing your runaway charge
translation: 承认你让你的看管对象跑了

original: Accidents happen. You had better tell him.
translation: 意外总会发生。你最好还是向他坦白。

original: A sad look
translation: 一个悲伤的表情

original: "Oh dear. Oh dear, oh dear." The Stationmaster sucks in his cheeks. "Well. I'm sure you did your best for them."
translation: “天啊。天啊，天啊。”站长吸了吸脸颊。“好吧。我相信你已经尽力了。”

original: A Tribute in your Honour
translation: 一座为你的荣誉而立的纪念物

original: You've saved more people than anyone else in the New Street Line. Your rescuees have decided to celebrate your bravery, charity and commitment to the Cause.
translation: 你比新巷线的其他人救了更多的人。你救援的人员决定赞扬你的勇敢、仁慈和对事业的贡献。

original: Hero of the New Street Line
translation: 新巷线的英雄

original:
There is talk of a statue in your honour, though all agree (and you are not asked) that you are far too humble for something so grandiose. Soon, your whispering followers are at loggerheads over a suitable tribute. A ceremonial plinth, perhaps. A rose garden within sight of the Empress' palace. A university scholarship in your name. A wing of the local hospital. Perhaps an orphanage. The arguments rage long into the night.

Finally, there is agreement. The Stationmaster leads you, carefully blindfolded, to your tribute. After all the fighting and recriminations, it turns out to be a small bronze plaque on the back of a park bench, lovingly engraved 'In Honour Of The Great Catpain'.

It is, you are reminded, the thought that counts.
translation:
有人提议为你树立一座雕像，不过由于所有人（没有被问及你本人）都一致认为你太过谦逊，不适合如此浮夸的纪念。很快，你的追随者们在合适的纪念方式上产生了分歧。或许是仪式性的基座，或许是在女皇宫殿视线范围内的玫瑰花园，或许是设立以你名字命名的大学奖学金，或许是医院的一个新楼翼，或许是孤儿院。争论持续到深夜。

最终，大家达成了共识。站长蒙住你的眼睛，小心翼翼地领你到你的纪念物前。之前所有争执和谩骂，最终结果为一个小小的青铜牌匾，安放在公园长椅的背面，上面深情地刻着“向伟太的车长致敬”。

最重要的是心意，提醒你一下。

original: The Knackered Horse
translation: 累马

original: Little Nice was built without a pub. Whether this was by design or an oversight by its planners is unclear. Establishing a pub was the first change made by the Overseers after the revolution.
translation: 小奈斯在建设之初就没有酒馆。是规划者有意为之还是无心之失？我们不得而知。革命后，监管者做出的第一个改变就是建立了酒馆。

original: Speak to the landlord
translation: 与房东交谈

original: The woman runs the bar part time. Her other role is as one of Little Nice's gardeners.
translation: 经营酒吧只是这位女士的兼职。她的另一个身份是小奈斯的一名园丁。

original:
[qvd:134376(PubChat)]

[You have exhausted these opportunities for now. Return in 15 days to see more.]
translation:
[qvd:134376(PubChat)]

[现在你暂时已经用完了这些机会。15天后再来，看看是否会有新的发现。]

original: Drink with the off-duty Overseers
translation: 与下班的监管者们一起喝酒。

original: Their blazers are carelessly discarded in the corner. They slump around tables, tired but apparently happy.
translation: 他们的夹克随意地丢在角落里。他们懒散地坐在桌旁，虽然疲惫但显然很高兴。

original:
[qvd:134376(PubDrink)]

[You have exhausted these opportunities for now. Return in 15 days to see more.]
translation:
[qvd:134376(PubDrink)]

[现在你暂时已经用完了这些机会。15天后再来，看看是否会有新的发现。]

original: Return to Little Nice
translation: 返回小奈斯

original: Perhaps you've no wish to converse with the drinkers. Perhaps you think this isn't the place for you.
translation: 也许你不想和这些喝酒的人交谈。也许你觉得这里不适合你。

original: Sweet, sweet Dilly
translation: 可爱的，可爱的迪莉

original: She lives in the vents of your cabin. Even for you, she rarely emerges. But if you sing softly, and no one else is around, she can be convinced to climb down onto your bunk.
translation: 她住在你车舱的通风管道里。即使对你，她也很少露面。但如果你轻声唱歌，而且没有别人在场，她就会被说服爬下来到你的床铺上。

original: Play with your mascot
translation: 和你的吉祥物一起玩

original: She chitters, possibly fondly.
translation: 她吵吵闹闹，可能带着几分喜爱。

original: Like magic
translation: 像魔术一样

original:
At the moment, her favourite trick is to try to turn your fingers backwards without you noticing. She takes such innocent delight in drawing your attention to one finger while she shifts the knuckles on another. 

It's best to play along with it – the first time you caught her she sulked for hours. Your left thumb was useless until she cheered up and wanted to play again.
translation:
目前，她最喜欢的小把戏是试图在你不注意的情况下把你的手指反向弯曲。在吸引你的注意到一个手指，同时偷偷地扭转另一个手指的关节时，她从中感受到纯粹无邪的巨大愉悦。

最好哄着她——第一次你抓住她的时候，她生了好几个小时的闷气。你的左拇指一直无法使用，直到她高兴起来并想再玩一次。

original: The Clairvoyant Doctress
translation: 通灵的女医生

original:
She is wearing modish fashions, but without any adherence to society's opinion regarding colour or pattern. Paisleys in magenta layer stripes of emerald and indigo. 

Her hair is a mousy colour; her eyes unremarkable. Her face is pleasing brown, but not particularly distinguished. The overall impression she gives is one of dazzling colour and clashing patterns. A deliberate misdirection?

She draws gruesomely hand-painted cards and lumpen crystals from a clinking, beaded reticule, and constantly smokes cigars.
translation:
她穿着前卫的服饰，但和主流的审美大相径庭。洋红色的涡纹图案层叠着祖母绿和靛蓝的条纹。

她的头发是鼠灰色，她的眼睛平平无奇。她的脸庞是讨人喜欢的棕色，但并不特别出众。总体给人的印象是色彩斑斓且图案冲突。这是一种刻意的误导吗？

她从一个叮当作响的珠饰小手袋中掏出粗糙手绘的卡片和粗糙的水晶，而且不停地抽雪茄。

original: Introduce yourself
translation: 介绍自己

original: "You were promised help? Well, here it is!" The Clairvoyant Doctress tosses the edge of her floral embroidered capelet, and runs a hand down an equally elaborate bodice.
translation: “她保证了你会有帮手？好吧，这就是！”通灵的女医生抖了抖她绣花披肩的边缘，用手沿着同样精致的紧身上衣滑下。

original: The plan
translation: 计划

original:
"I'm to be the Heiress' replacement. We'll swap clothes... and perhaps a few other items. No one will know to look for her, because she'll still be here. Clever, yes?"

Perhaps your scepticism shows. She grins. "Ah, you think we don't look alike? Allow me to reassure you: that is a temporary inconvenience. I'll worry about that – you worry about finding an escape route. I'd recommend gossiping with the debutantes, chaperones, and servants. Every cage, no matter how gilded, has a hatch through which someone can remove the sh_t."

You mention the complication of the surplus sister, and that the Heiress refuses to leave without her.

"Quite. Is our employer forgetful, do you think, or manipulative? It doesn't matter, of course. We were paid for a single sister, and I can't split myself in two. You'll just have to convince the Misses Macabre to separate, won't you?"
translation:
“我将成为继承人的替身。我们会交换衣服……或许还有一些其他物品。没有人会知道她在哪儿，因为她还会留在这里。聪明吧？”

或许你的怀疑表露了出来。她笑了。“啊，你认为我们不像？让我来安慰你：这只是暂时的不便。这个交给我来操心——你来操心逃生路线。我建议你和那些闺秀、监护人和仆人们聊聊。所有笼子，无论多么金碧辉煌，总有一个拉_的口子。”

你提到了多余的姐姐这个难题，以及继承人拒绝在没有她的情况下离开。

“的确。我们的雇主是健忘呢，你觉得，还是控制欲太强？当然，这不重要。我们只被雇来处理一个妹妹，而我也不能分成两半代替她们俩人。你只能说服恐怖小姐妹俩分开，不是吗？”

original: Get to know her
translation: 去了解她

original: You like to know the people you are committing crimes with. Easier to predict the likely moment of betrayal.
translation: 你喜欢了解你一起犯罪的人。这样更容易预测他们可能背叛的时刻。

original: Right and tight
translation: 准备妥当

original:
"Never you mind about that. Just stick to the plan, and it'll all be right and tight." 

The Clairvoyant Doctress yawns elaborately, and dismisses you with the majesty of a dowager duchess. What's that smell on her breath, under the bitterness of the cigars? Candle-wax? That can't be right.
translation:
“你不用管那么多。只要按计划行事，一切都会顺利的。”

通灵的女医生夸张地打了个哈欠，以一位老侯爵夫人的威严将你打发走。她呼吸中那股在雪茄的苦味之下的气味是什么？是蜡烛的蜡味吗？这不对劲。

original: Return to the morning room
translation: 回到晨间

original: She finishes your reading with an elaborate flourish. "You will meet a handsome stranger in a mask this evening. Y'know I think I'm getting the hang of this."
translation: 她以一个夸张的动作结束了你的占卜。“今晚你会遇到一个戴着面具的英俊陌生人。你知道吗，我觉得我开始掌握这门技艺了。”

original: Return to the dining room
translation: 回到餐厅

original: She finishes your reading with an elaborate flourish: "You are about to come into a vast fortune!" She lowers her voice. "We both are, eh?"
translation: 她以一个夸张的动作结束了你的占卜。“你即将获得一笔巨大的财富！”她压低了声音。“我们俩都是，嗯？”

original: Tell her all is ready for your escape
translation: 告诉她一切就绪，你们可以逃走了

original: The sisters are willing to part. An avenue of escape has been identified. Is she prepared to do her part?
translation: 姐妹俩愿意分开。一条逃生的途径已经确定。她是否准备好完成她的部分？

original: Set in motion
translation: 开始行动

original: "Yes, yes. Give me a sign in the evening, and we'll meet in the passages between Evening and the Parlour."
translation: “当然，当然。晚上给我一个信号，我们将在晚间和客厅之间的通道见面。”

original: A Post Unrest Uprising
translation: 骚乱后的起义

original: [qvd:134357(Revolt)]
translation: [qvd:134357(Revolt)]

original: Let the workers board the locomotive nearest them
translation: 让工人们登上离他们最近的机车。

original: Overseers have had enough time to form a barricade in the tunnel. Only one locomotive is unguarded: a wreck of a thing, barely more than salvage.
translation: 监管者们已经有足够的时间在隧道中设置了路障。只有一台机车无人看守：破烂不堪，几乎只是些废铁。

original:
A group of men and women press inside. One elbows her way past a crewman despite her obviously dislocated shoulder. She must be truly desperate. 

The locomotive had only two crew in addition to its captain. All three are thrown out onto the dock. The door is slammed and the engine jerks free, into the Wilderness.
translation:
一群男男女女挤了进来。其中一人尽管肩膀明显脱臼，还是用力挤过了一名列车员。她一定是非常绝望。

这台机车除了车长外只有两名列车员。三人都被扔到了码头上。车门砰的一声关上，机车猛地启动，驶进天野。

original: Speak with the Governor
translation: 与总督交谈

original: He rushed from Little Nice the moment he heard of the disruption.
translation: 他一听到骚乱的消息，就立刻从小奈斯赶了过来。

original: "D__n and blast it!" He follows this with profanities rarely heard in Albion, and never in polite circles. He has a few quiet words with the captain of the stolen ship, before turning to you. "We were due to break it for scrap. I doubt they'll get even half way to another port. It'll be the cold, or the hunger, but one will get them." He looks genuinely devastated. "I'm doing the best I can. But I can't convince them that this is better than the alternative, no matter the truth." He smiles wryly. "This will do more to quiet them than anything I could. It's a useful sacrifice, at least."
translation: “真他*的该*！”他接着说出的一些脏话，在阿尔比恩都很少听到，更不用说在体面场合了。他和那艘被盗机车的车长低声交谈了几句，然后转向你。“我们本来打算把它拆成废铁的。我怀疑他们连一半的路程都到不了。要么是寒冷，要么是饥饿，总有一种会要了他们的命。”他看起来非常沮丧。 “我正在尽我所能。但我无法说服他们这比另一种选择好，无论事实如何。”他苦笑着说道，“这比我能做的任何事情都更能让他们安静下来。至少，这是一个有用的牺牲。”

original: Hold back the workers, reason with them
translation: 拖住工人，与他们讲道理

original: The only locomotive available is in dangerously poor condition. It does not look fit to brave the skies. Their lives may be passing swiftly here, but at least they're alive.
translation: 唯一可用的机车状况极其危险，看起来根本不适合在天空中行驶。他们的生命在这里或许过得很快，但至少他们还活着。

original:
The workers halt, several look uncertain. Most seem to trust your judgement as a captain. Three men dismiss your words and shove their way aboard the engine.

The locomotive had only two crew in addition to its captain. All three are thrown out onto the dock. The door is slammed and the engine jerks free, into the Wilderness.
translation:
工人们停了下来，其中几个人看起来很不确定。但大多数人似乎相信你作为车长的判断力。有三个人并不相信你的话，仍旧登上了机车。

除了车长之外，机车里只有两个列车员。那三个人都被扔到了码头上。车门被关上了，机车猛地跳了起来，进入了荒野。

original: Kensington Station
translation: 肯辛顿站

original:
Kensington Station is festooned with candles. The footman has time on his hands. 

He greets you as you depart your locomotive. "Back are you, captain? One day you'll never have to leave at all." Chuckling, he gestures for you to follow him.
translation:
肯辛顿站挂满了蜡烛。男仆的手上拿着时间。

当你离开机车时，他向你打招呼，“回来了吗，车长？终有一天，你就不需要离开了。”他笑了笑，示意你跟着他。

original: Follow the footman
translation: 跟随侍从

original: Enter the Most Serene Mausoleum.
translation: 进入圣宁墓。

original: The footman guides you through the shadow-steeped hallways and down the spiralling staircases that form the arteries of the Mausoleum, and onward towards the vaulted chambers of its heart.
translation: 侍从领你穿过阴影环绕的门厅，走下构成陵墓要道的螺旋楼梯，继续向陵墓中心的拱形内庭前进。

original: Bully's Acre
translation: 恶霸之田

original: Humble wooden coffins pepper the sky, here. This is a bully's acre – a pauper's graveyard. There is little room for the dead in London.
translation: 简陋的木棺材在这里点缀着天空。这是一个“恶霸之田”，意即穷人的公墓。伦敦几乎没有地方容纳死者。

original: Pay your respects
translation: 致敬

original:
It is all you can do for them. 
[This will reduce Terror.]
translation:
你能为他们所做的仅此而已。
[这将减少恐惧。]

original: Silence as coffins drift past the windows. A stoker removes his hat.
translation: 棺材静静地从窗户前飘过。一名司炉工摘下帽子。

original: A hush falls as coffins pass by the windows. The silence is broken by an insistent scraping against the hull. One of the coffins has floated too close. A few words are necessary to assuage your crew's unease. You remind all present that were it not for the competence and efficiency of all aboard, a cold grave in the sky might have been all your fates.
translation: 棺材从窗户前飘过时，四周一片寂静。沉默被车体外的持续刮擦声打破。其中一个棺材飘得太近了。你需要说几句话来缓解列车员们的不安。 你提醒在场的每一个人，如果不是因为车上所有人的能力和效率，天空中冰冷的坟墓可能就是你们的归宿了。

original: Break open a coffin
translation: 撬开棺材

original: Even the poorest sometimes manage to take a keepsake to the grave.
translation: 即使是穷人有时也会带一件留念物到坟墓里。

original: What the dead don't need
translation: 死者不需要的东西

original:
You enlist your least-scrupled crewman and exit the main hatch. Manoeuvring close, your nominee gets out on the footplate, in the driving wind, and hooks a coffin with a coal-shovel. 

The lid comes off with a groan, before falling away into the sky. Well. It seems this poor soul tried to take it with them, after all.
translation:
你找来最罔顾人伦的列车员，一起从主舱口离开。小心地靠近后，你的这名列车员顶着强风爬到踏板上，用煤铲勾住了一个棺材。

棺材盖伴随着一声呻吟被掀开，然后掉进了天空中。嗯，看来这个可怜的灵魂终究还是想把它带在身边。

original: Graverobbing
translation: 盗墓

original:
Two of your crew keep the coffin from drifting while you get to work with the crowbar. The lid comes off abruptly, unleashing a cloud of noxious vapours. The wind snatches them away, but not before one of your compatriots get a whiff of them through his sky-suit. Inside, you find mouldering bridal lace and a gaudy ring. 

Later that day, your compatriot begins to cough. The next day, the cough has a meaty wetness to it. The crew begin avoiding him.
translation:
两名船员固定住棺材，防止其漂走，而你则用撬棍开始工作。棺材盖突然被掀开，释放出一团有毒气体。风把毒气吹走，但在那之前，你的一个同伴已经隔着他的潜天装闻到了一些。里面，你找到了腐烂的婚纱蕾丝和一枚华丽的戒指。

当天晚些时候，你的同伴开始咳嗽。第二天，咳嗽声中带着湿漉漉的肉质感。列车员们开始避开他。

original: Investigate a mysterious gleaming
translation: 调查一道神秘的闪光

original: Some of the coffins sparkle under a shroud of glass dust. And what's that amongst them? Something larger, winking with starlight.
translation: 一些棺材在玻璃尘埃的覆盖下闪烁着光芒。那它们之间还有什么？一个更大的物体，闪烁着星光。

original: A treasure
translation: 一件财宝

original:
You stand on the footplate, a crewman holding you by the belt of your sky-suit for safety. After a few misses with the coal shovel, you hook the gleaming thing. Clouds of shimmering dust float up like a constellation of fireflies. 

Back aboard, you examine your catch. It is a glass hand, perfect in every detail. Its knuckles are calloused. When you peer at its fingertips, you can distinguish the whorls of fingerprints. A plain silver ring sits on one finger.
translation:
你站在踏板上，一名列车员为了安全抓着你的潜天装腰带。经过几次尝试，你终于用煤铲勾住了那个发光的物体。一团团闪亮的灰尘像萤火虫组成的星座一样飘浮起来。

回到船上，你仔细检查你的收获。那是一只玻璃手，每一个细节都完美无缺。它的关节处有茧。当你仔细观察指尖时，可以看到指纹的旋涡。其中一个手指上戴着一枚普通的银戒。

original: A secret
translation: 一个秘密

original:
You lean precariously from the exterior door, reaching out with your coal shovel. At last, you make contact with the object and slowly – painfully slowly – draw it in. As soon as you see what it is, you bundle it in your coat, but too late. A stoker has already seen.

Later, you examine it in privacy. It is a human head fashioned from bottle-green glass. Glass hair. Glass teeth. Glass gums. A glass mole, distorting the watery light of your lamp that shines through it. A third of the head has been sheared away, as if struck with something heavy. In the exposed cross-section, you can see the glass scalp, the glass skull, the glass brain.
translation:
你从外部舱门危险地探出身子，伸出手中的煤铲。终于，你触碰到了那个物体，并慢慢地——痛苦地缓慢——将它拉了进来。刚一看清是什么，你就把它包在了外套里，但为时已晚。一名司炉工已经看到了。

后来，你私下仔细检查这个物体。那是一个用瓶绿色玻璃制成的人头。玻璃头发，玻璃牙齿，玻璃牙龈。甚至还有一个玻璃痣，扭曲了你灯光透过它时的水波光效。头颅的三分之一已经被削去，仿佛被重物击中。在暴露的横截面上，你可以看到玻璃头皮、玻璃头骨和玻璃大脑。

original: Break open a coffin
translation: 撬开棺材

original: Some coffins bear crests, indicating a significance pauper's graves are rarely afforded. Perhaps you'll spot one.
translation: 一些棺材上刻有徽章，表明这些棺材的主人具有非同寻常的地位，这在贫民墓地中极为罕见。也许你会发现一个这样的棺材。

original: The treasures of heaven
translation: 天穹的宝藏

original:
After several silent minutes stood at the window watching coffins drift by, a keen-eyed signaller cries out. A flash of silver!

You hurry to the footplate, coal shovel in hand to hook the coffin as it passes. You almost stumble over into the sky, but you reach the coffin with its crest of silver, and haul it aboard. 

The crest is the University's. The silver is real; as are the chains that seal the coffin. You fetch the bolt-cutters. Inside, an experimental device for fracturing navaratine: too precious to leave in the hands of academic scholarship, apparently.
translation:
静静地看了几分钟缓缓飘过的棺材后，一个眼尖的信号员大叫起来。一道银光！

你冲到踏板上，手中拿着煤铲，准备在棺材经过时勾住它。你差点失足跌入空中，但还是成功勾住了那个带有银色徽章的棺材，并将其拉上车。

徽章是大学的标志。银色是真的，封住棺材的链子也是真的。你取来剪切钳。里面是一个用于破碎曩缚咤宝石的实验装置：显然，这东西太珍贵，不能留给学术研究。

original: Ashes to ashes
translation: 尘归尘

original: After several silent minutes of watching coffins drift by, a keen-eyed signaller cries out. A flash of silver! You are leaning from your engine, coal shovel in hand to hook the coffin, when your boot slips on the frosty footplate. For a long moment the sky gapes hungrily for you before you find your grip and haul the crested coffin aboard. Unfortunately, the crest is fake. A replica University seal; dignifying the impoverished scholar inside with honours he'd never achieved. Still, he did take something with him.
translation: 静静地看了几分钟缓缓飘过的棺材后，一个眼尖的信号员大叫起来。一道银光！ 你从机车上探出身子，手中拿着煤铲，准备勾住那个棺材。就在这个时候，你的靴子在冰冷的踏板上滑了一下。有一瞬间，天空似乎贪婪地等待着你掉落，但你最终稳住了身体，将带有徽章的棺材拉上了船。 不幸的是，徽章是假的。一个仿制的大学印章，赋予了这位贫穷学者他从未获得的荣誉。不过，他确实带走了些什么。

original: Break open a coffin
translation: 撬开棺材

original: Quietly, mind. Some of your crew have superstitions about the dead.
translation: 轻一点，注意。你的一些列车员对死者有所忌讳。

original: Her Majesty's man in death
translation: 死去的公务员

original:
You take your least scrupulous signaller out onto the footplate. You bring no lanterns, relying on your sight and distant sunlight that scintillates off a few broken fragments of glass nearby. 

Soon enough, a promising coffin of pleasing bulk passes by, close enough to touch. Deft work with the coal shovel brings it aboard. You break it open in your cabin: inside, the waxen face of a newly dead Auditor (who bothers to bury an auditor in state?). Within his stiffening fingers, the favoured poetry of the Empress.
translation:
你带上最罔顾人伦的信号员，一起站在踏板上。你们没有带灯，只能依靠视力，和在附近的几块碎玻璃上闪烁的遥远阳光。

不久，一口看上去不错的棺材出现了，体积适中，离得足够近，几乎可以触及。灵巧地用煤铲将它拉上了车。你回到自己的车舱里，打开棺材：里面是一张蜡黄色的新死审计官的脸（谁会费心将一个审计官隆重安葬呢？）。在他的僵硬的手指间，是帝国女皇最喜欢的诗集。

original: Things best left buried
translation: 最好被埋葬的事情

original:
You take your least scrupulous signaller out onto the footplate. 

Soon enough, a promising coffin of pleasing bulk passes by, close enough to touch. Deft work with the coal shovel brings it aboard. 

You drag it to your cabin as your stoker cuts the lights on the corridor. Breaking open the lid you find: good lord! The mangled remnants of a murder. A triple murder, judging by the assemblage of body parts. 

You send your signaller back out with the coffin.
translation:
你带上最罔顾人伦的信号员，一起站在踏板上。

不久，一口看上去不错的棺材出现了，体积适中，离得足够近，几乎可以触及。你们灵巧地用煤铲将它拉上了车。

你拖着棺材回到车舱，同时让司炉工关闭了走廊的灯光。打开棺材盖后，你发现：天哪！一具被肢解的尸体。这是一起三重谋杀案，从尸体部件的数量来看。

你让信号员把棺材重新送回外面。

original: Break open a coffin
translation: 撬开棺材

original: Quietly, mind. Some of your crew have superstitions about the dead.
translation: 轻一点，注意。你的一些列车员对死者有所忌讳。

original: The unlicensed collection of souls
translation: 未经许可的灵魂收集

original:
You douse your lantern and step out on the footplate. You are alone, facing the lonely sky, bathed in uncaring starlight, watching coffins drift by in the night. You don't have long. 

A slight coffin passes by. You draw it in with the coal shovel. The wood is imitation bronzewood. Something sloshes within.

In the security of your cabin you wrench off the lid. Within, the jaundiced and broken corpse of a middle-aged man, frigid and putrefied. Clutched in his rotting hands, a jar of unlamented souls. A spirifer, and the punishment for his crime.
translation:
你把提灯浇灭，走到踏板上。你独自一人，面对孤独的天空，沐浴在无情的星光下，看着棺材在夜色中飘过。你没有等太久。

一具简朴的棺材飘过。你用煤铲把它拉过来。棺木是仿青铜木的。里面有东西像水一样晃动。

在你的舱室里，你扳开了盖子。里面是一具中年男子的黄疸色的碎尸，冰冷刺骨，腐烂发臭。在他腐手中，攥着一罐未被哀悼的灵魂。这是一个灵贩，以及对他罪行的惩罚。

original: Frozen blood on knuckles, on skin, on teeth
translation: 指节上、皮肤上、牙齿上的冰冻血液

original:
You douse your lantern and step out on the footplate. You are alone, facing the lonely sky, bathed in uncaring starlight, watching coffins drift by in the night. You don't have long. 

A coffin, slim and crooked as a witch's finger floats by in grabbing distance. Your muscles knot and strain, but you're able to haul the thing above. Wheezing, you drag it into your cabin to ply your own form of the resurrectionist's trade.

Inside: oh dear. They were alive when they were shut in here. Thankfully, they are not any longer.
translation:
你把提灯浇灭，走到踏板上。你独自一人，面对孤独的天空，沐浴在无情的星光下，看着棺材在夜色中飘过。你没有等太久。

一口像女巫的手指一样纤细而弯曲的棺材从触手可及的地方飘过。你的肌肉打结、紧张，但你还是把它拽了上来。你喘着粗气，把它拖进你的车舱，开始你自己的掘墓活动。

在里面——天哪。他们被关在这里的时候还活着。幸好，他们不再是了。

original: A plea in the night
translation: 黑夜中的恳求

original:
You creep out in the middle of the night, and proceed along the least well lit corridor to the exterior hatch. You bring no lanterns and rely on your eyesight, as you step out into the yawning dark. Before you a cluster of coffins drift by: death's trophies scattered across the starless waste. 

A promising coffin passes by: you reel it in with the coal shovel, and haul it aboard. You secure it in your cabin and are about to open the lid when a knock sounds at your door. 

A pious stoker, crucifix in hand. "Captain. Please. Don't do this. Let the dead rest."
translation:
你爬入黑夜的中心，沿着光线最微弱的走廊走到外部舱口。你没有带提灯，而是依靠你的视力走进张着血盆大口的黑暗中。在你面前，一排排棺材飘过：死亡的战利品散落在无星的荒漠上。

一口看上去不错的棺材漂过：你用煤铲把它拉过来，拖上车。你把它放在你的车舱里，正准备打开盖子时，门外响起敲门声。

那是一位虔诚的司炉，手里拿着十字架。“车长。求你了。别这么做。让死者安息吧。”

original: Respect your stoker's wishes
translation: 尊重你的司炉的意愿

original: No point stoking resentment.
translation: 没有必要激起怨恨。

original:
Your stoker smiles and nods, and assists you in walking the coffin back through the corridors to the hatch, before tossing it back into the void.

Unfortunately, your stoker is not quiet and scrapes, bumps, and on one occasion drops, the coffin. Between this and their lengthy and morbid prayer over the departing dead, your crew suffer a very disturbed sleep indeed.
translation:
你的司炉微笑着点点头，协助你抬着棺材穿过走廊，返回舱门，然后再把它扔回虚空。

不幸的是，你的司炉行事并不安静，他在这里刮一下，那里碰一下，还有一次把棺材摔到了地上。在这种情况下，再加上这人对即将离去的死者进行冗长而病态的祈祷，你的列车员们的睡眠真的很不安稳。

original: Throw open the lid
translation: 掀开盖子

original: It's your b____y ship!
translation: 这他__的是你的车！

original:
There is no further argument. Your stoker shuts the door behind them. The coffin lid comes off with ease (they weren't made for durability, really). Inside, predictably, a corpse. There are rings on the fingers and a small coinpurse for whatever pyschopomp it might have found barring its passage onward. 

Your stoker departs at the next port.
translation:
没有更多争论。你的司炉摔门而去。棺材的盖子很容易就被掀开了（这东西并不是为了耐用而制造的，真的）。可以想见，里面是一具尸体。手指上戴着戒指，还有一个小钱袋，为了防止它可能遇到的任何阻碍其继续前进的变态行为。

你的司炉在下一个港口离开了。

original: Dispose of a Death in a Jar
translation: 处置罐中的死亡

original: After all, what ghoul would ever think of rummaging through an unmarked coffin?
translation: 毕竟，哪个食尸鬼一样的人会想到去翻找一个没有标记的棺材？

original: A fitting home
translation: 一个合适的去处

original: There: a death hidden with the dead. A solution as apt as poetry.
translation: 那里：藏死于死者。一个像诗歌一样贴切的解决方案。

original: Azimuth
translation: 方位厅

original:
A figure in a yellow-collared protective suit is delivering a sing-song sermon to mostly empty pews. The Dazzled Sequencer looks up, delighted at your approach, and hurriedly wraps up his speech. 

[qvd:135346(sequencer_description)]
translation:
一个身穿黄领防护服的人正在对没几个人的座位进行唱诗般的布道。目眩的新秩序者者抬起头，对你的到来感到愉快，并匆匆结束了他的演讲。

[qvd:135346(sequencer_description)]

original: Request access to the Sun-Shattered Dome
translation: 请求进入破碎的蔽日穹顶

original: Beyond Azimuth lies the maze of abandoned exhibition-halls, crowned by a magnificent broken dome.
translation: 在方位厅之上，是一座由废弃的展览厅组成的迷宫，它以一个宏伟的破碎穹顶为冠。

original: Reluctant assent
translation: 不情愿地放行

original:
The Sequencer obviously takes his role as gatekeeper seriously. He fusses around you, checking you and your crew's gear – tugging on straps, checking for rips, wiping your stained-glass goggles with a silk handkerchief. All the while he spouts an endless stream of warnings – don't enter the Shalimar, never travel in a group of three or fewer, and resist the urge to sing, no matter how fiercely your throat burns.

"And for Sequence's sake, watch the condition of your suit."

With that he pats you on the back, hands you a brochure, and sends you through the heavy iron door to the dome.
translation:
新秩序者显然很重视他的看门人职责。他在你身边忙上忙下，检查你和你的船员的装备，拉扯带子，检查是否有破损，用丝帕擦拭你的染色玻璃护目镜。与此同时，他还不厌其烦地警告你，不要进入夏利玛尔，不要在三人以下的团队中旅行，要抵制唱歌的冲动，不管你的喉咙在多猛烈地燃烧。

“看在新秩序的份上，务必留意你的防护服的状态。”

说罢，他拍拍你的背，递给你一本小册子，然后送你穿过沉重的铁门，直达穹顶。

original: The Sequencer has a request
translation: 新秩序者有一个请求

original: "Together, we can help the less fortunate," he says. "You will be compensated for your time."
translation: “我们一起可以帮助那些不太幸运的人，”他说，“你会为你花的功夫得到补偿。”

original: A charitable mission
translation: 一个慈善的使命

original:
"There are many poor souls out there in need of our help. Beleaguered, ignorant masses. I've never met them, but I am assured they exist." He pauses to wipe his eyes. "When we lift them from their contemptible state, perhaps they will come to appreciate the greatness of the Sequence."

He sends an orderly to fetch a wooden crate. Once it's set down before him, he raps the lid proudly. "Six hundred manuals on how to correctly tie a bow-tie. Deliver these to Brabazon Workworld, and I'm sure they will be immensely benefited by their improved understanding of etiquette."
translation:
“外面有许多需要我们帮助的可怜人。陷入困境的、无知的群众。我从未见过他们，但我确信他们存在。 ”他暂停了一下，擦了擦眼睛，“当我们把他们从可鄙的状态中解救出来时，也许他们就会欣赏到新秩序的伟大。”

他派一个勤务兵去拿一个木箱。箱子摆在他面前时，他得意地拍了拍它的封盖。“六百本关于如何正确打领结的手册。把这些东西送到布拉巴宗，我相信他们会因为对礼仪理解的加深而受益匪浅。”

original: Complete your charitable mission
translation: 完成你的慈善使命

original: You successfully delivered the manuals to Brabazon, no doubt transforming six hundred lives for the better. Now they just need some bow-ties.
translation: 你成功地把手册送到了布拉巴宗，这无疑会改善六百人的生活。现在他们需要的只是一些蝴蝶结。

original: A new charitable assignment
translation: 一个新的慈善任务

original:
The Sequencer clasps his hands together. "I can just imagine their smiles," he says. "And, oh! Their wide, grateful eyes. And their misshapen bow-ties, crying out for correction."

He sends his orderlies to fetch your payment. There's a glint in his eye. "I knew I was right about you – the Sequence brought us together for a reason. We should send another package."
translation:
新秩序者双手紧握。“我都能想象到他们脸上的笑容，”他说，“还有，哦！他们睁大的、感激的眼睛。还有他们错乱的领结，渴望着要被改正。”

他派他的勤务兵去取你的报酬。光芒闪烁在他的眼里。“我就知道没把你看错，秩序让我们相遇是有原因的。我们应该再送一个包裹。”

original: Complete your charitable assignment
translation: 完成你的慈善任务

original: With unrepressed delight, the Sequencer listens to your account of delivering the items to the orphanage.
translation: 新秩序者带着抑制不住的喜悦，听你讲述把物品送到孤儿院的过程。

original: A partnership is forged
translation: 铸就伙伴关系

original:
A hand settles on your shoulder. "From here on out, the coffers of Azimuth are dedicated entirely to the betterment of mankind," says the Sequencer breathlessly. "Together we'll bring light to even the darkest regions of Albion. I hope you'll join me in a hymn?"

Without waiting for your answer, he launches into a breathless hymn. You don't know the words, but do a creditable job of mumbling along.
translation:
一只手落在你的肩上。“从现在开始，方位厅的库房将完全用于改善人类的生活，”新秩序者激动的喘不上气，“我们将共同为阿尔比恩最黑暗的地区带来光明。我希望你能和我一起唱首赞美诗？”

不等你回答，他便上气不接下气地唱起一首赞美诗。你不知道歌词，但还是像模像样地跟着含糊哼唱。

original: Leave Azimuth
translation: 离开方位厅

original: Return to the yelling of engineers and roaring of machinery.
translation: 回到工程师的吆喝和机械的轰鸣中。

original: Another charitable assignment
translation: 另一项慈善任务

original: A crate of food and medicine awaits delivery to some needy folk somewhere far away.
translation: 一箱食品和药品正等待着被送到远方的一些需要它的人手中。

original: "Good luck!"
translation: “祝你好运！”

original:
The Dazzled Sequencer explains you'll be delivering your care package to one of the grottiest slums in Worlebury-juxta-Mare. He informs you you'll need to look beyond the promenade, and hunt down the hidden side of the port, to successfully dispense his charity to the needy.

"Soon enough, the people of Albion will look up at the Sun in the sky and see a giver of warmth and life and kindness. Something they can rely on. Just like the old days." He flashes you his most sincere smile and bids you a good journey.
translation:
目眩的新秩序者解释说，你需要把你的爱心包裹送到滨海沃伯瑞里一个最糟糕的贫民窟中。他告诉你，你需要把目光投向滨海步道以外的地方，寻找港口隐蔽的一面，来把他的慈善品发给有需要的人。

“很快，阿尔比恩的人们就会抬头仰望天空中的太阳，看到一位温暖、生命和仁慈的给予者。它是他们可以依赖的东西。一如往昔。”他向你展示了他最真诚的微笑，并祝你旅途愉快。

original: Another 'charitable' assignment
translation: 另一项“慈善”任务

original: A crate of ingots awaits delivery to your fence.
translation: 一箱金锭正等待着送到你的车上。

original: "Good luck!"
translation: “祝你好运！”

original:
The Dazzled Sequencer explains you'll be delivering your care package to one of the grottiest slums in Worlebury-juxta-Mare. 

"Soon enough, the people of Albion will look up at the Sun in the sky and see a giver of warmth and life and kindness. Something they can rely on. Just like the old days." He flashes you his most sincere smile and bids you a good journey.

He's wrong, of course. You'll be going straight to your friend in London.
translation:
目眩的秩序者解释说，你需要把你的爱心包裹送到滨海沃伯瑞里一个最糟糕的贫民窟中。

“很快，阿尔比恩的人们就会抬头仰望天空中的太阳，看到一位温暖、生命和仁慈的给予者。它是他们可以依赖的东西。一如往昔。”他向你展示了他最真诚的微笑，并祝你旅途愉快。

当然，他错了。你会直接去找你在伦敦的朋友。

original: Another charitable assignment
translation: 另一项慈善任务

original: A crate of spotted cravats and New Sequence hymn-books awaits delivery to some unsuspecting folk somewhere.
translation: 一箱有斑点的领巾和新秩序的圣歌集正等待着被送到某个毫无戒心的民众间。

original: "Good luck!"
translation: “祝你好运！”

original:
The Dazzled Sequencer explains you'll be delivering your care package to one of the grottiest slums in Worlebury-juxta-Mare. It is apparently suffering an extreme deprivation of cravats.

"Soon enough, the people of Albion will look up at the Sun in the sky and see a giver of warmth and life and kindness. Something they can rely on. Just like the old days." He flashes you his most sincere smile and bids you a good journey.
translation:
目眩的秩序者解释说，你需要把你的爱心包裹送到滨海沃伯瑞里一个最糟糕的贫民窟中。它显然正遭受着极度缺乏领巾的痛苦。

“很快，阿尔比恩的人们就会抬头看天上的太阳，看到一个温暖、生命和仁慈的给予者。可以仰赖之物。就像从前一样。”他向你展示出他最真诚的微笑，并祝你旅途愉快。

original: Complete your charitable assignment
translation: 完成你的慈善任务

original: You've delivered the items for the Sequencer, and can collect your reward.
translation: 你已经为新秩序者送去了物品，可以领取你的奖励了。

original: The Sequencer is grateful
translation: 新秩序者很感激

original:
He demands you tell him everything about it – the distribution, the words of gratitude, the "smiles on the faces of the little children." He listens to it all with a beatific, far-away expression. No doubt he is already planning his next act of unprovoked kindness.

When you're finished, he counts out some coins and promises that the Sequence shall arrange you favourably.
translation:
他要求你告诉他一切，关于分发，关于感激之词，关于 “孩子们脸上的笑容”。他听完，露出了幸福的、遥远的表情。毫无疑问，他已经在计划他的下一个无端的善举。

当你完成后，他数了一些硬币，并承诺新秩序会对你有利。

original: Persuade the Sequencer to donate usefully
translation: 说服新秩序者进行有益的捐赠

original:
Maybe send them food or medicine? Or, you know, just some money?
[He is unlikely to change his mind again after this.]
translation:
也许可以送他们食物或药品？或者，呃，给他们捐点钱？
[在此之后，他不太可能再次改变主意。]

original: An intriguing proposition
translation: 一个耐人寻味的提议

original:
A sudden look of horror. "Ah," says the Sequencer. "You mean they don't already have those things? Oh dear. It's worse than I thought."

From now on, the Sequencer promises to supply what the needy actually need.
translation:
突然露出的惊恐表情。“啊，”新秩序者说，“你是说难道他们不是已经有这些东西了吗？哦，天哪。这比我想象的还要糟糕。”

从现在开始，新秩序者承诺会提供贫苦民众他们真正需要的东西。

original: A guileless smile
translation: 一个朴实的微笑

original: "No, no, I won't hear a word of it! Charity is my passion, and I assure you I understand it just as well as you understand your steam engine."
translation: “不，不，我一个字都不会听！慈善是我的激情，我向你保证，我对它的理解就像你对你的机车一样。”

original: Persuade the Sequencer to donate profitably
translation: 劝说新秩序者进行有利可图的捐赠

original:
Something you can sell to a fence, instead of wasting on some misbegotten orphans.
[He is unlikely to change his mind again after this.]
translation:
你可以把东西卖给销赃人，而不是浪费在一些私生孤儿身上。
[在此之后，他不太可能回心转意。]

original: An intriguing proposition
translation: 一个耐人寻味的提议

original:
A sudden light enters the Sequencer's eyes. "I see! I suppose then they can simply purchase whatever they need the most. An excellent idea, my friend – thank you."

From now on, the Sequencer promises to supply gold. For the orphans, of course.
translation:
新秩序者的眼睛突然闪过一道亮光，“我明白了！我想这样他们就可以简单地购买他们最需要的东西。这是一个很好的主意，我的朋友，谢谢你。”

从现在起，新秩序者承诺会提供黄金。当然，是为了孤儿们。

original: A guileless smile
translation: 一个朴实的微笑

original: "No, no, I won't hear a word of it! Charity is my passion, and I assure you I understand it just as well as you understand your steam engine."
translation: “不，不，我一个字都不会听！慈善是我的激情，我向你保证，我对它的理解就像你对你的机车一样。”

original: Ask the Sequencer what's wrong
translation: 询问新秩序者怎么了

original: He lacks his habitual joie de vivre.
translation: 他失去了他惯有的生活乐趣。

original: The Setting of the Sun
translation: 日沉

original:
"Oh, nothing." The Sequencer avoids looking you in the eye. "I just sometimes feel very small, in the great scheme of things."

The rumbling beneath your feet is off-kilter, and you can hear distant machinery coughing like a flooded steam-engine. The Sun's light is dimmer than might be expected. With every unfortunate clank and wracking whine, the Sequencer winces as though struck.
translation:
“哦，没什么。”新秩序者避免与你对视，“我只是有时觉得自己很渺小，身处在伟大的计划中。”

你脚下的隆隆声不正常，你可以听到远处机器的咳嗽声，就像被淹没的蒸汽机一样。太阳的光线比预期的要暗。伴随着每一次不幸的叮当声和令人痛苦的哀鸣，新秩序者畏缩着，仿佛被击中一般。

original: Deliver the Worlebury Ministry's request for aid
translation: 传达滨海沃伯瑞公德部的援助请求

original: Between one of the Dazzled Sequencer's breaths and the next, you find the opportunity to speak.
translation: 在目眩的新秩序者呼吸的空当，你找到了说话的机会。

original: The Sequencer's Aid
translation: 新秩序者的援助

original:
He stammers dizzily to a halt, trailing parables about power lines and stars in ascendance, trains plumed with light.

"Oh. Oh. Hmm. There's no one I can spare. No, no. None of them." His brow furrows thoughtfully. "There's an explosive in the dome. You could take that back with you. It isn't very pretty, but it is quite loud. You can have it if you find it. And if you promise to be very, very careful. It was meant to end the universe and I've honestly forgotten why they gave it to me."

It is hard to tell if the Dazzled Sequencer means that sincerely. Nevertheless, he details the ritual that must be performed to activate the device – if you find it.

[You will need to request access to the Sun-Shattered Dome and locate the bomb there.]
translation:
他结结巴巴地念着电力线，扬升的群星，以及被光镶边的火车的寓言，晕晕乎乎地停了下来。

“哦。哦。嗯。我不能丢下任何人。不，不。一个都不行。” 他深思地皱起眉头，“穹顶里有一个爆炸物。你可以把它带回去。它不是很好看，但它发出的声音相当响亮。如果你能找到它，它就是你的了。而且你得保证对待它要非常，非常小心。它是用来终结宇宙的，而且说实话，我已经忘了他们为什么把它给我了。”

很难说目眩的新秩序者在说这番话时是否还保有理智。尽管如此，他还是详细说明了激活这个装置所必须进行的仪式，如果你找到它的话。

[你需要设法进入破碎的蔽日穹顶，并找到位于那里的炸弹。]

original: Ask the Dazzled Sequencer about his role on the Sun
translation: 询问目眩的新秩序者他在太阳上干什么

original: The only other people up here are disturbed prisoners and exhausted engineers.
translation: 这里只有不安的囚犯和疲惫的工程师。

original: The Sequencer's Function
translation: 新秩序者的职责

original:
"I'm a priest of the New Sequence!" declares the Sequencer. "The brightest truth! The wildfire that has swept Albion!" He points out at the expanse of the Sun. "There burns a beacon, a saviour, an aspect of God. We venerate the Clockwork Sun and its immortal architect, our Empress. I'm here to greet pilgrims and safeguard the souls of our engineers."

"Azimuth is also the only access-route to the Sun-Shattered Dome, an exhibition-hall that was built back when we received more visitors. The Dome is terribly dangerous and I advise you to avoid it, no matter how much you hear about the priceless artifacts inside."
translation:
“我是新秩序的牧师！”新秩序者宣称，“至明之理！横扫阿尔比恩的野火！”他指着广袤的太阳，“那里燃烧着一座灯塔，一位救世主，上帝的一面。我们崇敬发条太阳和它不朽的设计师，我们的女皇。我在这里迎接朝圣者，并保护我们工程师的灵魂。”

“方位厅也是通往破碎的蔽日穹顶的唯一通道，这个展厅是在我们接待更多游客时建造的。穹顶非常危险，我建议你别去那里，不管你听说里面有多少无价的文物。”

original: Enquire after the lost sigils
translation: 问及丢失的符印

original: You're looking for sigils of the Correspondence. Does he know of any in the Clockwork Sun?
translation: 你正在寻找信符的符印。他知道发条太阳这里的任何与之相关的事吗？

original: "Oh yes!"
translation: “哦，是的！”

original: The Dazzled Sequencer is absolutely certain he's seen a sigil in the Sun-Shattered Dome. "You'll need to poke around to find it," he adds. "The place could do with a tidy."
translation: 目眩的新秩序者十分确定他在破碎的蔽日穹顶中看到了一个符印。“你得四处清理一下才能发现它，”他补充说，“这个地方可以变得更整洁一些。”

original: The Sun-Shattered Dome
translation: 破碎的蔽日穹顶

original:
Exhibition-halls, built to accommodate sunspotter tourists and Sequence pilgrims – and abandoned after the dangers of the Sun became impossible to hide. 

Priceless paintings hang in bleached rags. Magnificent relics have been left to accumulate glittering glass-dust. Is anything still intact?

The stained-glass sky has collapsed, and unfiltered sunlight gnaws savagely at your hazard-suit. It is currently [qvd:134817(suit_state)]

[qvd:134808(dome_discovery)]
translation:
展览厅，为接待赏日游客和新秩序朝圣者而建，在太阳的危险变得无法粉饰后便遭遗弃。

无价的画作悬挂着，已变为了漂白的破布。宏伟文物只剩下闪闪发光的玻璃粉末。还有什么东西完好无损？

绘有天空的彩窗天花板已然坍塌，未经过滤的阳光暴烈地啃噬着你的防护服。它现在[qvd:134817(suit_state)]

[qvd:134808(dome_discovery)]

original: Explore the Shalimar
translation: 探索沙利马尔

original: The light has depraved these plants. The Dazzled Sequencer warned you away from here.
translation: 光线已经腐化了这些植物。目炫的新秩序者警告过你要远离这里。

original: The Shalimar
translation: 沙利马尔

original:
Acid roses. Predatory daffodils. Snapping tulips with lamprey mouths. Specimens imported decades ago from Old London, the kind of common flowers that might be found at a street florist's, but bone-white and deadly. Your crew hacks through them all, leaving a swathe of slaughtered jungle in your wake. 

After much sweat and panic, you come upon one of the Shalimar's treasures, hidden in a tangle of pale weeds. An oyster-shell encrusted with diamonds.

The vegetation has already reclaimed the path behind you. Sighing, you order your crew to resume their work.
translation:
酸性玫瑰。食肉的水仙。长着七鳃鳗嘴的破色郁金香。这是几十年前从旧伦敦进口的样本，是那种可以在街头花店找到的普通花卉，但如今它们白得发亮，且能致人于死地。你的列车员们把它们全部砍倒，在你身后留下一大条被屠杀过的丛林。

在经历了大量汗水和恐慌之后，你发现了沙利玛尔的一个宝藏，藏在一丛苍白的杂草中。一个镶嵌着钻石的牡蛎壳。

在身后，植被已经重新覆盖了来时的路。你叹了口气，命令你的列车员继续他们的工作。

original: The Shalimar
translation: 沙利马尔

original:
Acid roses. Predatory daffodils. Snapping tulips with lamprey mouths. Specimens that might be found at a street florist's, but bone-white and deadly. All attempts to hack through the jungle of flowers are rebuffed.

One of your crew is overcome, tethered by a dozen thorn-vines and dragged shrieking into a hungry flowerbed. The rest of your crew retreat, and refuse to go near the Shalimar again.
translation:
酸性玫瑰。食肉的水仙。长着七鳃鳗嘴的破色郁金香。这是几十年前从旧伦敦进口的样本，是那种可以在街头花店找到的普通花卉，但如今它们白得发亮，且能致人于死地。任何闯入花之丛林的尝试都以失败告终。

你的一名列车员被十几根荆棘藤蔓缠住，尖叫着被拖进了一个饥饿的花床。你的其余列车员们向后撤去，拒绝再次接近沙利马尔。

original: The Shalimar
translation: 沙利马尔

original:
Acid roses. Predatory daffodils. Snapping tulips with lamprey mouths. Specimens imported decades ago from Old London, the kind of common flowers that might be found at a street florist's, but bone-white and deadly. Your crew hacks through them all, leaving a swathe of slaughtered jungle in your wake. 

After much sweat and panic, you come upon one of the Shalimar's treasures, hidden in a tangle of pale weeds. An oyster-shell encrusted with diamonds. As you approach it, a thorn-vine lashes out from the undergrowth and entwines your arm.
translation:
酸性玫瑰。食肉的水仙。长着七鳃鳗嘴的破色郁金香。这是几十年前从旧伦敦进口的样本，是那种可以在街头花店找到的普通花卉，但如今它们白得发亮，且能致人于死地。你的列车员们把它们全部砍倒，在你身后留下一大条被屠杀过的丛林。

在经历了大量汗水和恐慌之后，你发现了沙利玛尔的一个宝藏，藏在一丛苍白的杂草中。一个镶嵌着钻石的牡蛎壳。当你走近它时，一根荆棘藤蔓从灌木丛中猛地抽出，缠住了你的手臂。

original: Fight the vine off yourself
translation: 自己动手把藤蔓击退

original: No need to put the rest of your crew at risk.
translation: 没有必要置你的其他列车员于危险之中。

original:
The vine squeezes until your suit's rigging creaks. Thorns puncture, and the suit deflates with a hiss. But eventually you triumph, hacking again and again until the vine snaps.

You retreat with your prize. Your suit is in ruins.
translation:
藤蔓挤压着，直到你的防护服嘎吱作响。荆棘刺穿了防护服，使它开始嘶嘶地漏气。但最终，在一次又一次地挥砍藤蔓，直到它断裂后，你取得了胜利。

你带着你的战利品撤退。你的衣服现在破烂不堪。

original: Call to your crew for help
translation: 向你的列车员求救

original: They are shaken and exhausted. Hopefully they can handle one more battle.
translation: 他们浑身发抖，疲惫不堪。希望他们能再应付一场战斗。

original:
Blades descend on the vine again and again, but only some fibres snap. More vines whip from the bushes. One of your crew is dragged screaming out of sight.

Finally the vine holding you breaks. Your crew retreat, dragging you with them.
translation:
刀片一次又一次地落在藤蔓上，但只砍断一些纤维。更多的藤蔓从灌木丛中抽出。你的一个列车员尖叫着被拖离了视线。

抓住你的藤蔓终于断裂。你的列车员们向后撤退，把你也拖走了。

original: Abandon the treasure
translation: 放弃宝藏

original: Better to lose the money but keep your arm.
translation: 还是破财来保全手臂为好。

original: No reward is worth that risk. You don't look back.
translation: 没有任何回报值得冒这个险。你没有回头。

original: Attempt to navigate the bad patch
translation: 试图从坏区域中走出

original: If you're careful you can avoid the worst of it.
translation: 如果小心的话，你可以避免最坏的情况发生。

original: An onslaught of hours
translation: 时间的冲击

original:
You guide your crew through the patch of lumpy time. Careful – a spot where fallen shards from the ceiling have turned to sand. Here, watch your step – a discarded tourist pamphlet is still frozen mid-fall. There are a few missteps, but your hazard-suit takes the brunt of it.

Once everyone is through, you find yourself in an area of the Dome untouched by previous explorers. A thorough search uncovers an intact exhibit – a shroud of fabric that, even here, ravenously consumes light.

You hear one of your crew gulp. Now for the return journey.
translation:
你引导你的列车员们穿过这一片到处都是时间凝块的区域。小心——在那边天花板上落下的碎片已经化作了沙子。走这里，注意你的脚下——一本被丢弃的旅游小册子仍冻结在坠落中。有过几次失足，但你的防护服代替你承受了冲击。

所有人都通过之后，你们抵达穹顶之中先前探险者未至的一个区域。经过彻底的搜索，你们发现了一个完整的展品——一块罩形陈列的，即使在这里，也贪婪地吞噬光线的布料。

你听到你的一名列车员咽了口唾沫。现在是回程的时候了。

original: An onslaught of hours
translation: 时间的冲击

original:
You attempt to guide your crew through the patch of lumpy time, but the dangerous areas are subtle and difficult to spot. You make a terrible misstep, and your hazard-suit takes the worst of it – leather straps wither, and the iron framework of your rigging rusts to nothing. The suit sags around you like a deflated football.

It's too dangerous. Your crew simply refuse to go any further.
translation:
你试图引导你的列车员们穿过这一片到处都是时间凝块的区域，但这里的危险区的位置微妙，难以被发现。你犯了个可怕的错误，防护服损害严重——皮革带子枯萎了，你的索具的铁制框架生了锈，直至消失。防护服像泄了气的足球一样在垂在你的身边。

这太危险了。你的列车员拒绝继续前进。

original: An onslaught of hours
translation: 时间的冲击

original:
You guide your crew through the patch of lumpy time. Once everyone is through, you find yourself in an area of the Dome seemingly untouched by previous explorers. A quick search uncovers an intact exhibit – a shroud of fabric that, even here, ravenously consumes light.

On the return journey, however, you run into trouble. The stoker carrying the Bombazine makes a misstep, and begins to wail as his leg withers and rots beneath him. Unbalanced, he falls forward, and the Bombazine tumbles from his grip.
translation:
你引导你的列车员们穿过这一片到处都是时间凝块的区域。所有人都通过之后，你们抵达穹顶之中先前探险者未至的一个区域。经过彻底的搜索，你们发现了一个完整的展品——一块罩形陈列的，即使在这里，也贪婪地吞噬光线的布料。

然而，在回程路上，你陷入了麻烦。扛着邦巴辛布的司炉踏错了一步，致使自己的腿在身下枯萎腐烂，随即哀嚎起来。失去平衡的他向前跌倒，邦巴辛布从手中滚落。

original: Catch the Bombazine
translation: 接住邦巴辛布

original: In the split second available to you, your economic instinct triumphs.
translation: 电光石火之间，你的经济本能取得了胜利。

original: You wince at the crewmember's infinitesimally brief scream. In an instant, all that's left of him is dust and bone-fragments. The rest of your crew whisper angrily behind your back.
translation: 你因列车员那无限短促的尖叫声而退缩了一下。在一瞬间，他已只剩灰尘和骨头碎片。你的其他列车员在你背后愤怒地低语着。

original: Catch the crewmember
translation: 接住列车员

original: Life before profit.
translation: 利益面前，生命至上。

original: The crewmember sobs in relief, clutching tightly at your suit; the Bombazine unravels instantly to an ancient, valueless scrap.
translation: 列车员如释重负地抽泣着，紧紧地抓住你的防护服；邦巴辛布瞬间解体，变成了一个古旧的、没有价值的废品。

original: Pick your way through the glass congregation
translation: 找一条穿过玻璃教会的路

original: Years of harsh sunlight have sharpened the statues, turning elbows and fingertips to razors. You'll need to be agile to reach the other side unscathed.
translation: 多年的刺眼阳光使雕像变得锋利，把它们的肘部和指尖变成一把把剃刀。你需要身体足够灵活才能安然无恙地到达另一边。

original: A crowd of glass
translation: 一群玻璃人

original:
The vitrified tourists are arranged in a circle. Whatever lies at the centre, it must be worth a good gawk.

It's a nightmare in the bulky hazard-suit, but you duck and weave through the statues with only a few rips to your rigging. When you reach the middle you find a plinth, upon which rests a pale pink mask. When you frown, the mask's mouth turns up in a smile.
translation:
玻璃化的游客围成一圈。无论圆圈的中心是什么，都一定值得一看。

穿着笨重的防护服简直就是一场噩梦，但你在雕像中闪避、穿梭，只在装备上留下了几处撕裂。当到达中间时，你发现一个基座，上面放着一个淡粉色的面具。你皱起眉头，而那面具的嘴角则露出一丝微笑。

original: A crowd of glass
translation: 一群玻璃人

original:
The mass of vitrified tourists are arranged in a circle. Whatever lies at the centre, it must be worth a good gawk.

In the bulky hazard-suit, it's a nightmare to try to duck and weave your way through the statues. A lady's jaunty elbow leaves a long rent down the side of your hazard-suit. You catch your glove on a child's sharpened nose, and it is torn from your hand. 

You are forced to retreat, your suit much the worse for wear.
translation:
大量玻璃化的游客围成一圈。不管中心是什么，它一定值得好好地看一看。

穿着笨重的防护服，试图在玻璃雕像中躲避和穿行是一场噩梦。一位女士轻快的手肘在你的防护服侧面留下了一道长长的划痕。你的手套被一个孩子尖尖的鼻子卡住了，它从你的手上被撕了下来。

你被迫撤退，你的衣服磨损得更厉害了。

original: A crowd of glass
translation: 一群玻璃人

original:
The vitrified tourists are arranged in a circle. Whatever lies at the centre, it must be worth a good gawk.

It's a nightmare in the bulky hazard-suit, but you duck and weave through the statues. Just as you're about to reach the middle, you realise that a tourist's pointing finger has snagged on your suit's outer rigging. Attempts to extricate yourself seem to succeed only in widening the rip.
translation:
玻璃化的游客围成一圈。无论圆圈的中心是什么，都一定值得一看。

穿着笨重的防护服简直就是一场噩梦，但你在雕像中闪避、穿梭。正当即将到达中心时，你发现一名游客的手指卡住了防护服的外部索具。你试图解救自己的努力似乎只是扩大了裂痕。

original: Tear yourself free
translation: 把自己扯开

original: It'll cause great damage to your suit, but with care you'll be able to work your way free without shattering the tourist entirely.
translation: 这将对你的防护服造成巨大损伤，但只要小心，你就能在不完全粉碎玻璃化游客的情况下挣脱出来。

original:
Your hazard-suit hisses and deflates as you jolt yourself free, leaving a long rip down the side. There's not much time, now.  

When you reach the middle you find a plinth, upon which rests a pale pink mask. When you frown, the mask's mouth turns up in a smile.
translation:
当你挣脱时，你的防护服嘶嘶漏气，在侧面留下一条长长的裂口。现在没有多少时间了。

当到达中间时，你发现一个基座，上面放着一个淡粉色的面具。你皱起眉头，而那面具的嘴角则露出一丝微笑。

original: Shatter the tourist
translation: 把游客打碎

original: The flying glass might be perilous to your crew, but it'll save you from ripping a hole in your suit.
translation: 飞散的玻璃碎片对你的列车员来说可能很危险，但这么做不会使你的防护服上面被撕开一个洞。

original:
The shattering causes an alarming chain-reaction, as tourist after tourist crumbles in a rain of shards, leaving half your crew staggering and bloodied.

When it's over, all that remains is a plinth in a circle of broken glass. A pink mask rests on the marble. When you frown, the mask's mouth turns up in a smile.
translation:
碎裂引起了惊人的连锁反应，一个又一个游客在碎片雨中崩解，使你一半的列车员踉踉跄跄，满身是血。

当一切结束时，只剩下一圈碎玻璃中的一个基座。一个粉红色的面具躺在大理石上。你皱起眉头，而那面具的嘴角则露出一丝微笑。

original: Give up and wriggle back the way you came
translation: 放弃并扭动着原路返回

original: It's the only way to avoid damaging your suit further.
translation: 这是避免进一步损坏你防护服的唯一方法。

original: Investigate the carousel
translation: 调查传送带

original: Perhaps you can deduce its purpose. It might hide something of value.
translation: 也许你可以推断出它的功能。它可能隐藏着一些有价值的东西。

original: The tempest prognosticator
translation: 风暴预言者

original:
Brushing aside glitter-dust, you discover a label on the carousel's base – 'TEMPEST PROGNOSTICATOR.' Each bottle is similarly labelled 'PHILOSOPHER.' Something roils through the glass.

You work out the carousel's controls and set it going. Your assembled crew watch in astonishment as the bottles glide and rotate. Black shapes emerge from the fluid and slither up glass tubes. When they reach the carousel's top, a bronze bell tolls. 

You pull another lever and the carousel winds to a halt. The slimy shapes slide back into confinement. The bell falls silent. You direct your crew to take one of the philosopher-bottles from its moorings.
translation:
拂去发亮的灰尘，你发现传送带的底座上有一个标签：“风 暴 预 言 者”，每个瓶子上都标着 “哲 人”。玻璃管道可以供某种东西通过。

你确定了传送带的控制方式并启动了它。你召集的列车员惊讶地看着瓶子在里面滑动，旋转。黑色的东西从液体中出现并沿着玻璃管滑行。当它们到达传送带的顶端时，铜钟鸣响。

你拉动另一个控制杆，传送带就会停住。黏糊糊的东西滑回封闭的地方。钟声沉寂下来。你指挥你的列车员把其中一个哲人瓶从它的停靠处拿出来。

original: The tempest prognosticator
translation: 风暴预言者

original:
Brushing aside glitter-dust, you discover a label on the carousel's base – 'TEMPEST PROGNOSTICATOR.' Each bottle is similarly labelled 'PHILOSOPHER.' Something roils through the glass.

You study the controls to no avail. You pull some levers at random, and nothing happens. You attempt to pull one of the bottles free, but it's moored far too firmly. Eventually you're forced to give up and move on.
translation:
拂去发亮的灰尘，你发现传送带的底座上有一个标签： “风 暴 预 言 者”，每个瓶子上都标着 “哲 人”。玻璃管道可以供某种东西通过。

你随意地拉动一些杠杆，但什么也没有发生。你试图把其中一个瓶子拉出来，但它被固定得太牢了。最后，你不得不放弃，继续前进。

original: The tempest prognosticator
translation: 风暴预言者

original:
Brushing aside glitter-dust, you discover a label on the carousel's base – 'TEMPEST PROGNOSTICATOR.' Each bottle is similarly labelled 'PHILOSOPHER.' Something roils through the glass.

After studying the carousel's controls, you think you have some idea of how to set it into motion. But not how to stop it.
translation:
拂去发亮的灰尘，你发现传送带的底座上有一个标签： “风 暴 预 言 者”，每个瓶子上都标着 “哲 人”。玻璃管道可以供某种东西通过。

在研究了一阵传送带的控制系统后，你觉得自己大概明白如何开动这个机器了，但你还不知道怎么让它停下来。

original: Leave the carousel stationary, and take one of the philosopher-bottles
translation: 让传送带静止不动，同时拿走其中一个哲人瓶。

original: You have no desire to see the carousel in motion.
translation: 你并不想看到传送带动起来。

original: The release mechanisms prove stubborn, but you figure them out eventually and the huge bottle slides free. It takes the strength of your entire crew to roll it back to Azimuth.
translation: 把瓶子从上面解放出来的机关很顽固，但你最终弄懂了它们，巨大的瓶子滑了出来。你们全体列车员花了很大的力气才把它滚回方位厅。

original: Set the carousel into motion
translation: 开动传送带

original: You wouldn't miss this for the world.
translation: 你绝对不会错过这个机会的。

original:
Bottles rotate. Black shapes emerge from the fluid and slither up glass tubes. Something metallic springs loose; a dark mass is messily expelled.

Thrashing, wheezing, a scything beak. Your crew draw weapons and hack the creature apart, but not before it grabs one of them and snips him in half.
translation:
瓶子旋转起来。黑色的形体从液体中浮现，在玻璃管中滑动。一些金属弹簧弹起：一个邋遢的黑东西被送了出来。

扑腾，喘息，镰刀般的喙。你的列车员们拔出武器，把这个生物劈开，但那是在它抓住其中一个人并把他切成两半之后的事了。

original: Leave the carousel alone
translation: 别管传送带了

original: Curiosities from across the High Wilderness were displayed at this exhibition – best not tamper with one in ignorance.
translation: 来自天野各地的奇珍异宝都在这个展览上展出——最好不要在对它一无所知的情况下擅动其中的东西。

original: Return to safety
translation: 回到安全地带

original: You've spent too long out here already. You don't want to return to your train with glass-frosted toes.
translation: 你已经在这里呆了太长时间了。你不想带着被变成玻璃的僵硬脚趾回到你的火车上。

original: Your suit hangs in rags. Your crew are panicking
translation: 你的防护服破烂不堪。你的列车员们都很惊慌

original: Their suits are in a similarly lamentable state. You pushed them too far.
translation: 他们的防护服也处于类似的悲惨状态。你带他们走太远了。

original: Disaster
translation: 灾难

original:
Light floods you, and a sickening sense of peace that must be fought with every fibre. Something glass cracks inside your head. 

A tumult, a stampede. Your crew run, shoving in their haste. Someone falls.

It's only when you arrive back to Azimuth and conduct a headcount that you realise one of your crew was left behind. In the Dome beyond, you hear a familiar voice raised in rapturous song.
translation:
光如洪水般将你淹没，其中夹带着某种令人作呕的平和感，得用上每一根神经才能与之对抗。有些东西在你的脑袋里如玻璃破碎般爆开。

一场骚乱，一场踩踏事件。你的列车员四散奔逃，匆忙地互相推搡着。有人摔倒了。

当回到方位厅并清点人数时，你才意识到你的一个列车员被抛在了身后。从远处的穹顶上，你听到一个熟悉的声音在唱着狂喜的歌，响声越来越大。

original: Search elsewhere
translation: 在其他地方搜索

original: It will cost valuable time and entail greater risk. But treasure beckons around the next corner, you know it...
translation: 这将花费宝贵的时间，带来更大的风险。但宝藏就在下一个转角处招手，你坚信…

original: Each moment, precious
translation: 每一刻都弥足珍贵

original: In the time you waste, your suit degrades a little further.
translation: 在你浪费的时间里，你的防护服又降解了一点。

original: Collect the Clockwork Bomb
translation: 拿上发条炸弹

original: There it is, on display at the fringe of the crowd! The contraption the Sequencer mentioned: a bulging dark thing of wires and wheels.
translation: 它就在那里，在人群的边缘展出！新秩序者提到的那个装置：一个由电线和轮子组成的鼓胀的黑东西。

original: Heavy as a child
translation: 像孩子一样沉重

original:
The bomb is not exciting to look at; before they were glass, the crowd swept past it and accumulated around some other, less powerful bauble. You gently nudge aside the vitrified body of the lone gentleman who had paused to inspect it.

It is the size of an ornamental globe in a London club. It is the weight of an angry child resisting being lifted. It rattles slightly as you heave it from the plinth. That's probably fine.
translation:
炸弹看起来并不吸引人：在他们被变成玻璃前，人群忽略了它，聚在别的一些不那么强大的小玩意周围。你轻轻地把那个驻足检视它的孤独绅士的玻璃化身体推到一边。

它的大小就像伦敦俱乐部里的一个装饰用地球仪。它的重量就像一个愤怒的孩子在抗拒着被抱起。当你把它从基座上抬起来时，它发出轻微的嘎嘎声。那可能没问题。

original: Search for a lost sigil
translation: 寻找失落的符印

original: Light shifts and scintillates across the field of glass – exhibits and guests. Each glimmer catches the eye, like a fish on a hook.
translation: 玻璃化的展品和客人的区域中，光线变换闪烁。每一束光都吸引着人们的眼球，就像鱼儿上钩一样。

original: A purposeful light
translation: 一道有目的的光

original: Beyond the glass foot, bereft of its owner. Away from the vines, coiling eagerly. Over the carousel and the bottles of unidentifiable liquid. There, glowing remorselessly, a sigil.
translation: 高过和原主分离的玻璃足。远离渴望地盘卷着的藤蔓。越过旋转木马和那些盛着不明液体的瓶子。那里，一个符印正无情地闪耀着。

original: A kindly request
translation: 一个善意的请求

original:
Another crate is dropped at the Sequencer's feet by his shuffling orderlies. 

"Here we have a collection of antique, but very much functional, pistols," he says brightly. "I was thinking we could send them to the London Refuge for the Lamentably Parentless. I'm sure the little mites will enjoy the thrill of the hunt!"
translation:
又一个箱子被新秩序者的勤务兵扔到了他的脚下。

“我们这里有一批古董，但非常实用的手枪，”他春风满面地说道，“我想，我们可以把它们送到‘伦敦的可怜孤儿庇护所’。我相信这些小家伙们会享受狩猎的刺激！”

original: Suggest an alternative gift
translation: 提出一个替代的送礼方案

original:
Maybe send them food or medicine? Or, you know, just some money?
[He is unlikely to change his mind again after this.]
translation:
也许可以送他们食物或药品？或者，呃，给他们捐点钱？
[在此之后，他不太可能再次改变主意。]

original: An intriguing proposition
translation: 一个耐人寻味的提议

original:
A sudden look of horror. "Ah," says the Sequencer. "You mean they don't already have those things? Oh dear. It's worse than I thought." He snaps his fingers and calls for his orderlies to return.

A few hours later, your crew are carrying a package of tinned food and medicine back to your train, bound for delivery to the orphanage in London.

[Deliver your package to an orphanage in London.]
translation:
突然露出的惊恐表情。“啊，”新秩序者说，“你是说难道他们不是已经有这些东西了吗？哦，天哪。这比我想象的还要糟糕。”他打了个响指，叫他的勤务兵回来。

几个小时后，你的列车员正把一个装满了罐头食品和药品的包裹运回你的火车，准备送到伦敦的孤儿院。

[把你的包裹送到伦敦的一个孤儿院。]

original: An instant dismissal
translation: 眨眼间不见踪影

original:
A guileless smile. "Oh, I'm sure they can get those sorts of things from elsewhere." He raps his knuckles on the box of pistols. "This is what they're lacking!"

[Deliver your package to an orphanage in London.]
translation:
一个纯真的微笑。“哦，我相信他们可以从其他地方得到这些东西。”他用指节敲打着那盒手枪，“这就是他们缺少的东西！”

[把你的包裹送到伦敦的一个孤儿院。]

original: Prioritise your own personal gain
translation: 把你自己的私利放在首位

original:
What orphans really want is untraceable gold ingots.
[He is unlikely to change his mind again after this.]
translation:
孤儿们真正想要的是无法追踪的金锭。
[在此之后，他不太可能再次改变主意。]

original: An intriguing proposition
translation: 一个耐人寻味的提议

original:
A sudden light enters the Sequencer's eyes. "I see! I suppose then they can simply purchase whatever they need the most. An excellent idea, my friend – thank you."

A few hours later, your crew are carrying a package of solid gold ingots back to your train, theoretically bound for delivery to the orphanage. You will, of course, funnel it directly to a fence instead.
[Deliver your package to a fence in London.]
translation:
新秩序者的眼睛突然闪过一道亮光，“我明白了！我想这样他们就可以简单地购买他们最需要的东西。这是一个很好的主意，我的朋友，谢谢你。”

几个小时后，你的列车员正把一包纯金锭运回你的火车，理论上那是要送到孤儿院去的。当然，你会把它直接送到一个销赃人的手上。
[把你的包裹送到伦敦的一个销赃人手上。]

original: An instant dismissal
translation: 眨眼间不见踪影

original:
A guileless smile. "Gold won't help them when they're hunting their dinner or preparing for a duel, captain!" He raps his knuckles on the box of pistols. "This is what they're lacking!"
[Deliver your package to an orphanage in London.]
translation:
一个纯真的微笑。“当他们在猎取他们的晚餐或准备决斗时，黄金对他们来说没用，车长！”他用指节敲打着那盒手枪，“这就是他们缺少的东西！”
[把你的包裹送到伦敦的一个孤儿院。]

original: Accept the mission without comment
translation: 接下任务，不加评论

original: If the Sequencer wants to waste your time and his, it's his prerogative. As long as he's paying.
translation: 如果新秩序者想浪费你和他的时间，这是他的特权。只要他付钱就行。

original:
The Sequencer beams. "Quiet, eh? No matter, no matter. Overawed by the sun, I expect."
[Deliver your package to an orphanage in London.]
translation:
新秩序者笑了，“不说话，嗯？没关系，没关系。我猜是被太阳吓坏了。”
[把你的包裹送到伦敦的一个孤儿院。]

original: Decline the mission
translation: 拒绝任务

original: You're growing tired of ferrying ineffectual parcels at the Sequencer's behest.
translation: 你越来越厌倦按新秩序者的要求递送毫无用处的包裹。

original: The end of a lamentable affair
translation: 悲事告终

original: The Dazzled Sequencer coughs and turns away from you, quickly re-donning the helmet of his protective suit. "I'm grateful for your help up until now, at least. Please do pop by if you're in the mood for a good sermon or a cup of tea."
translation: 目炫的新秩序者咳嗽了一声，背过身去，又抓紧戴上了防护服的头盔。他说：“至少迄今为止，我很感激你的帮助。如果你有兴致听场好的布道会，或想喝杯茶，请一定再来。”

original: The Glasshouse
translation: 军事监狱

original:
Some of the prisoners are shining at the seams, some have eyes of curdled glass. A fractured face turns to watch you.

A few are singing in praise of the Sun, mouths bloody and throats tattered. You should perhaps be horrified, but the song wraps tender cords around your mind and numbs you.

Glass crunches underfoot. When you lift your boot, you discover a cracked ear beneath.
translation:
某些囚犯在牢笼的缝隙间闪闪发光，某些囚犯的眼睛已成了凝结的玻璃。一张破碎的面庞转过头来望着你。

有少数人在唱着赞颂太阳的歌，他们的嘴血迹斑斑，喉咙则沙哑不堪。你或许感到了些惊恐，但这首歌以温柔的绳索包裹你的脑海，麻木你的神智。

脚下破碎的玻璃嘎吱作响。而当你抬起你的靴子时，你发现了下面那只裂开的耳朵。

original: Speak with the prisoners
translation: 与囚犯交谈

original: They either scream or sing. You may not get anything halfway lucid from them.
translation: 他们要么在尖叫，要么在歌唱。你也许无法从他们那里得到半点清醒的言语。

original: A hideous story
translation: 恐怖故事

original:
You root out one of the newer prisoners, a woman whose mind isn't entirely fractured. Her eyes are shining gold, her fingertips pearlescent. With a calm manner and firm words, you momentarily manage to stop her singing.

With a newly-focused gaze, she tells you what she's seen. Men shattered. Men unmade.

"It hates us," she says, staring at her glass-tipped fingers.
translation:
你费力地找到了一名较新的囚犯，这是一个心智还没有完全破碎的女人。她的眼睛闪着金光，指尖则泛着珠光。用平静的态度和坚定的话语，你暂时设法阻止了她的歌唱。

她用重新聚焦的目光，告诉你她所看到的一切。人被打碎了。人被毁灭了。

“它讨厌我们，”她说，盯着她指尖已成玻璃的手指。

original: Scream and song
translation: 尖叫与歌声交织

original:
You sit beside a wild-bearded prisoner whose entire lower body has turned to glass, fixing him forever in a cross-legged pose. One crystalline hand, vitrified at the wrist, has been fused to his knee.

He mumbles a half-coherent account of what he's seen happen to his fellow prisoners, and what he fears will happen to him. Before he can conclude his story he breaks into a song, the high notes coinciding with pulses of sudden-bright sunlight.
translation:
你在一个胡须乱七八糟的囚犯身旁坐下，他的整个下半身都变成了玻璃，将他永远固定成一个盘腿的姿势。而其中一只手已经变得晶莹剔透，从手腕处玻璃化，融化到了他的膝盖上。

他喃喃自语地讲述着他所看到的在他同伴身上发生的事，以及他所担心的会发生在他身上的事，他的手腕已经被玻璃化了。就在他结束故事前，他突然唱起了歌，而那高音与突然明亮的阳光之脉冲正相吻合。

original: Approach the Half-Glass Empty
translation: 靠近半玻璃化的空壳人

original: Only one cell is locked, and the man within is neither singing nor screaming. The left half of his body is shimmering, translucent.
translation: 只有一间牢房上了锁，里面的人既不歌唱也不尖叫。他的左半身闪着微光，是半透明的。

original: Hurry away from this place
translation: 赶紧离开这个地方

original: You've left the prisoners behind, so why do you still hear their songs?
translation: 你既将囚犯们抛于身后，为何仍能听见他们的歌声？

original: The Terpsichore Vault
translation: 特耳西科瑞储藏室

original: [qvd:135336(steward_description)]
translation: [qvd:135336(steward_description)]

original: Speak with the Broken Steward
translation: 与心力交瘁的总管交谈

original: She smiles. Her teeth glint oddly.
translation: 她笑了，牙齿闪着怪异的光芒。

original: The Broken Steward
translation: 心力交瘁的总管

original:
She catches you glancing at her mouth and smiles even wider. Her teeth are shards of cracked glass, protruding at odd angles from her gums.

"It's not just the teeth," she says, with a brusque air that brooks no sympathy. "D__ned Sun turned my bones as well. Terrible nuisance really. It gets in the way of work."

You notice her fixed neck, her stiff limbs, her careful movements. "It's not too bad," she says. "Good thing I like soup."
translation:
她发现你瞥了一眼她的嘴，笑得更灿烂了。她的牙齿是裂开的玻璃碎片，以奇怪的角度从她的牙床上伸出来。

“不仅仅是牙齿，”她说，带着一种不需要同情的粗犷神情，“该__的太阳把我的骨头也变成了玻璃。真是可怕的烦人精。它会妨碍工作。”

你注意到她固定的脖子，她僵硬的四肢，她谨慎的动作。“这不算太糟糕，”她说，“好在我喜欢喝汤。”

original: Bring three Permits to the Broken Steward
translation: 带着三张许可证去见心力交瘁的总管

original: One to authorise the release of the Half-Glass Empty. One to authorise the authorisation. A third to confirm that the authorisation has been authorised.
translation: 第一张用来授权释放那位半玻璃化的空壳人。第二张用来授权第一张的授权。第三张用来确认：第一张的授权，确实已经被第二张所授权。

original: Approved
translation: 同意释放

original:
The Steward takes the permits, shuffles through them, then drops them straight into a wastepaper bin.

"Seems to be in order," she says. "I don't know why we were tasked with keeping prisoners here anyway. As far as I'm concerned, my job is to keep the bally lights on, not mess around in politics. Come on. I need to supervise releases personally, not that it's ever come up before."

Her mouth is a grim line as she re-dons her helmet. With the occasional hiss of pain, she makes her way up to the surface.
translation:
总管接过许可证，随意翻了一下，然后把它们直接扔进了一个废纸篓。

“看上去该有的都有了，”她说，“不知道为什么我们的任务是在这里看管囚犯。据我所知，我的工作是维持正常的照明，而不是掺和政治。来吧。释放过程需要我亲自监督，以前没有过这种情况。”

重新戴上头盔时，她的嘴角带着一丝阴郁。伴随着偶尔吃痛的嘶声，她走上了地面。

original: Speak to the Similarly-Dazzled Steward
translation: 与同样目眩的总管交谈

original: She spends her days singing and smiling.
translation: 她整天都在唱歌，一直微笑。

original: The Similarly-Dazzled Steward
translation: 同样目眩的总管

original:
She's tiny and elderly and good-natured, and absolutely nothing like the person you once knew. She makes you tea and chats about her ailments and the glory of the Sun.

"Oh, and one more thing. No more literature for the engineers. They need to focus on their sermons with the Sequencer."
translation:
她身材娇小，年长，心地善良，完全不像你曾经认识的那个人。她给你泡茶，谈论她的疾病和太阳的荣光。

“哦，还有一件事。不会再有提供给工程师们的文学作品了。他们需要专注于新秩序者的布道。”

original: Return
translation: 返回

original: Back out into the poison light.
translation: 回到有毒的日光中去。

original: The Half-Glass Empty
translation: 半玻璃化的空壳人

original:
Only the flesh and muscle of his left half has vitrified, not the bones and blood within. The glass is suffused with a thousand fine frozen capillaries, like delicate red cracks running through ice.

He fixes you with an anguished stare. "Get me out of here."
translation:
他身上只有左半边的肉体被变成了玻璃，不包括里面的骨头和血液。玻璃上排布着密密麻麻的冻结的毛细血管，就像冰上的细小裂缝。

他用痛苦的目光注视着你。“让我离开这里。”

original: Agree to help the Empty escape
translation: 同意帮助空壳人脱逃

original: A barely perceptible nod. The glass in his neck creaks.
translation: 空壳人微微点头，幅度几乎无法察觉，他脖子上的玻璃嘎吱作响。

original: Half a smile
translation: 半缕笑容

original:
"Thank you." His voice is hoarse and he speaks in barely a whisper. "You will need to find a permit for my release and present it to the Steward. Forged, legitimate, I don't care."

[You will need to acquire 3 Ministry-Stamped Permits and present them to the Broken Steward to secure the Half-Glass Empty's release.]
translation:
“谢谢你，” 他喉咙嘶哑，声音小得几乎像是耳语，“你得找到释放我的许可证，并把它交给总管。伪造的、合法的，我都不在乎。”

[你需要获取3份公德部盖章的许可证并将其出示给心力交瘁的总管，来释放半玻璃化的空壳人。]

original: You can't help him
translation: 你爱莫能助

original: He slumps, and doesn't say another word.
translation: 他耷拉着脑袋，没再说话。

original: Assure him he'll soon be free
translation: 向他保证，他将很快获得自由

original: He musters a half-smile in response.
translation: 他勉强挤出半缕笑容作为回应。

original: Why is his cell locked, and his alone?
translation: 为什么他的牢房是锁着的，而且里面只有他一人？

original: This was an exhibition-hall once, never a prison. An engineer must have had to install those bars especially for him.
translation: 这里本就不是监狱，而是一个展厅。这些铁栏杆肯定是工程师专门为他安装的。

original: The Empty's Conviction
translation: 空壳人的信念

original:
"The others would not leave even if they could. Their minds are lost." 

The Empty attempts a one-sided shrug. "And, well, the Empire sent me here because I was smuggling sunlight from the Neath, back before the Horizon closed. When I sold it, I told my customers that the light from the Clockwork Sun was toxic and true sunlight was the only cure. Ended up causing a minor panic in London. I think one of the engineers locked me in because he took offence at my criticism, though..." He gestures at his vitrified body. "I stand by it."
translation:
“其他人即使可以也不会离开。他们的心智已经迷失了。”

空壳人试图耸起一边的肩，“还有，帝国把我送到这里，是因为我在地平线关闭之前，从尼斯走私阳光。出售时，我告诉我的客户，发条太阳的日光是有毒的，真正的阳光是唯一的治疗方法。结果在伦敦引起了一场小小的恐慌。我猜其中一个工程师把我锁起来，因为他对我的批评感到不满，不过……”他比划了一下他玻璃化的身体，“我觉得自己没错。”

original: Releasing the Half-Glass
translation: 释放空壳人

original:
Entering the Glasshouse, the Steward can only stare in horror at the state of the prisoners. Has she really been so isolated until now?

"The Sun," she mutters. "Broken, hateful thing. D__n it."

Silently she unlocks the Empty's cell. Then she quickly turns to leave. You hear something shatter. She limps away, knee crunching, leaning heavily on her cane.
translation:
总管一进军事监狱，便被囚犯们的惨状吓住了。她当真到现在都一直被蒙在鼓里吗？

“太阳，”她喃喃道，“那破碎的、可憎的东西。该*的。”

她默默地打开了空壳人的牢房门，然后迅速转身离开。你听到碎裂声，发现：她一瘸一拐地离去，紧倚在手杖上，膝盖嘎吱作响。

original: The Empty steps carefully from his cell
translation: 空壳人小心翼翼地从他的牢房里走出来

original: Half his face is contorted with rage and grief and relief. The other half is impassive.
translation: 他半张脸因愤怒、悲伤和解脱而扭曲。另一半则是没有表情。

original: Freedom
translation: 自由

original:
"Thank you," says the freed prisoner. He pauses, struggling with himself, and then simply repeats: "Thank you."

Shuffling awkwardly, partly assisted by your crew, the Half-Glass Empty boards your train. He doesn't know where he wants to go yet, he says. Just away.
translation:
“谢谢你，”被释放的囚犯说。他停顿了一下，作了一番心理斗争，然后只是重复了一遍：“谢谢你。”

在你的列车员的部分协助下，半玻璃化的空壳人尴尬地被拖上了你的火车。他说，他还不知道自己想去哪里。他只想离开。

original: The Steward's Sanctum
translation: 总管的圣地

original:
You demand explanation. She removes her helmet, flashes you a tired broken-glass smile.

"I'm not trying to destroy the Sun. I'm trying to fix it," she says. "For too long we've settled for just keeping it running while it deteriorates, a little more each time. Something had to change.

"If I had more time, I'd be careful. But I don't. I was taking risks. Shortcuts. Putting the Sun under stress, pushing its limits, finding where it's weakest."
translation:
你要求得到解释。她摘下头盔，对你露出一个疲惫的破玻璃微笑。

“我不是要摧毁太阳。而是要修复它，”她说，“长久以来，我们只满足于维持它的运行，而它却在不断地恶化，它每时每刻都会恶化一点。有些东西必须改变。”

“如果有更多的时间的话，我会小心行事。但我没有。我在冒险。走捷径。把太阳置于压力之下，挑战它的极限，找到它最弱的地方。”

original: Persuade her to stop this madness
translation: 劝说她停止这种疯狂的行径

original: The Sun can't be fixed. For London's sake, she should focus on keeping it functional in its twilight years.
translation: 太阳无法修复。为了伦敦着想，在太阳迟暮之时，她应该尽心于维持现有功能。

original: Reluctantly, she listens
translation: 她不情不愿地听着

original:
The light in her eyes goes out. Her mouth takes on a grim cast.

"You're right," she says. "But I'd have appreciated being allowed that shred of hope."
translation:
她眼中的光芒熄灭了，嘴角带着一丝阴郁。

“你说得对，”她说，“但我还渴望着保有那一丝希望。”

original: She won't listen
translation: 她充耳不闻

original: There must be a way, she insists. Defiantly, ludicrously, there's always hope.
translation: 一定有办法，她坚持道。语气间带着不甘，带着固执，带着荒唐。总是有希望的。

original: Offer to bring her Hours
translation: 提议为她带来时间

original: Time can be supplied.
translation: 时间是可以被供给的。

original: The Steward's sanctum
translation: 总管的圣所

original:
You can help her compress months into weeks and years into months. If she needs time, she can have it.

"Thank you," she says, sagging with palpable relief. "Honestly, I don't think the Sun is fixable. But I have to try. After I've slept for about a week."

[You can now bring Hours to the Broken Steward. She will require 3 Barrels at a time.]
translation:
你可以帮助她把月压缩成周，把年压缩成月。如果她需要时间，她可以拥有它。

“谢谢你，”她说，心有余悸地松了口气，“说实话，我不认为太阳是可以修复的。但我必须试试。在我睡个一个星期左右时间之后。”

[你现在可以把时间带给心力交瘁的总管。她每次需要3桶。]

original: Refuse to help her
translation: 拒绝帮助她

original: You're not concerned with the wellbeing of the Sun. She can do this on her own.
translation: 你并不关心太阳的安危。她可以自己做这件事。

original: A diffident shrug
translation: 漫不经心地耸下肩

original:
"I never asked for your help," she says. "The stress-testing is complete, in any case. The day-to-day operation of the Sun can go back to normal for a while."

She picks a tool from the floor and returns to her work. "Why are you still here?"
translation:
“我从未求过你帮忙，”她说，“无论如何，压力测试已经完成。太阳的日常运作可以暂时恢复正常。”

她从地上拾起一个工具，回到工作中，“你为什么还在这里？”
