original: Escape at precisely the moment you entered
translation: 恰好在你进入的那一刻逃离

original: Wait. This exact instant is known to you. You feel a thud of deja vu. Looking at the clock on the bridge, you watch its hands tick over to a familiar angle. This is the very moment before you encountered the Weft. If you act now, you could escape. [You will lose nothing and gain only a Sky-Story.]
translation: 等等。你感到这一刻无比熟悉。你猛然间意识到，眼前的情形似曾相识。你看着车桥上的时钟，指针一点点指向一个熟悉的角度。这正是你遭遇纬线之前的那一刻。如果现在采取行动，你也许能逃脱。 [你不会失去任何东西，只获得一个高天轶事。]

original: A stitch in time
translation: 时间的缝隙

original: You spur your engine forward and emerge from the Weft at exactly the moment you entered. You have lost nothing and gained nothing. Except for a story.
translation: 你鞭策着你的机车前进，并精确地在你进入的那一刻冲出纬线。你没有失去任何东西，也没有得到什么。除了一个故事。

original: Attempt to repair the Weft
translation: 试图修复纬线

original: The Ravelling Jack has caught the edges of the weft. Its wheels spin. Its arms dance. But its hold is tenuous. It will take a delicate hand to affect the repair.
translation: 杰克纺时机抓住了纬线的边缘。它的轮子在自旋。它的手臂在跳舞。但它的支撑非常脆弱。它需要一只巧妙的手来将它复原。

original: Repaired
translation: 修复了

original: Ignoring the intrusive events you have been plunged into, you concentrate on the rattling machine. The work is painstaking and meticulous. Slowly, the Jack teases together the ragged edges of time. The intruding moment is banished. The present resumes. The Weft is repaired.
translation: 无视你陷入的侵扰事件，你专注于嘎嘎作响的机器。这项工作是艰苦卓绝的，一丝不苟的。慢慢地，千斤顶将时间的破损边缘吻合起来。闯入的时刻被驱逐了。此刻恢复如初。纬线被修复了。

original: Unravelling
translation: 解开

original: The Jack's arms flail wildly, sending you ducking for cover. It loses its grip on the threads of time, and before it can regain them, everything shifts...
translation: 杰克的手臂疯狂地挥舞着，让你躲开。它失去了对时间纬线的控制，在它重新掌控时间纬线之前，一切都发生了变化...

original: An unfortunate grinding noise
translation: 令人遗憾的磨擦噪音

original:
You work quickly as time ebbs around you. The Jack has begun to make a distressing grinding noise, and smoke is issuing from its innards. It finishes knitting time back together scant moments before something breaks inside, its wheels spin their last and its arms fall still.

But the Weft is repaired. Your present, or at least something approximating it, has been restored. You will, unfortunately, need a new Jack.
translation:
随着时间的流逝，你工作得很快。杰克开始发出令人痛苦的研磨声，烟雾从它的内部散发出来。它完成了时间的编织，在里面有东西断裂之前，它的轮子最后一次旋转，手臂静止不动。

但是纬线已经修好了。你的机车，或者至少是一些近似的东西，已经恢复了。不幸的是，你需要一个新杰克。

original: Attempt to repair the Weft
translation: 试图修复纬线

original: The Ravelling Jack is stuck! It has caught the torn time of the Weft, but some part of its mechanism has failed. Can you find the problem in time?
translation: 杰克纺时机被卡住了！它抓住了纬线的撕裂时间，但其机制的某些部分已经失效。你能及时发现问题吗？

original: Repaired
translation: 修复了

original: Crawling into the casing of the machine, you identify the fault, free the machinery and scramble out before you get Ravelled. The steel arms dart forwards and back. The gears whirr. The rent in time is woven back together, and you are returned to your present. The Horological Office will be pleased.
translation: 你爬到机器的机壳里，找到故障所在，然后释放机器，在你被困住之前赶紧爬出来。钢铁的手臂来回穿梭。齿轮发出嗡嗡声。时间的裂痕被重新编织在一起，你回到了你的现在。时计部会很高兴的。

original: Unravelling
translation: 解开

original: The instruction manual is atrociously written and disastrously indexed. By the time you find the fault, the Jack has lost its grip on time. Time shifts around you...
translation: 说明书写得很糟糕，索引也很糟糕。当你找到故障的时候，杰克已经失去了对时间的控制。时间在你身边转移...

original: Giving up the ghost
translation: 放弃鬼魂

original:
The damage is worse than you thought. The best you can do is to affect a makeshift repair which is enough – barely – for the Jack to finish its current task. 

Its arms weave, sluggishly. Its gears clatter. Gradually, the snarl in time is untangled. The intruding moments fall away and you are returned to the present you left behind. Or close to it, at least. The Jack, alas, will ravel no more.
translation:
损害比你想象的还要严重。你所能做的就是进行一次临时的修理，这足以让千斤顶勉强完成它目前的任务。

它的手臂挥挥交错，迟缓地编织。它的齿轮咔咔作响。渐渐地，时间的涡流被解开了。侵入的时刻消失了，你回到了你离开的现在。或者说，至少是接近它。至于杰克，唉，不会再有什么变化了。

original: Inspect your Ravelling Jack
translation: 检查你的“杰克纺时机”

original: Its spindly, manifold arms grope wildly, seeking the snarl of the Weft.
translation: 它那骨节分明的手臂疯狂地摸索着，寻找纬线的咆哮。

original: Time and tide
translation: 时间和潮汐

original: The device needs more time to catch the strands of the Weft. You must endure the surging tides of time a little longer, first.
translation: 这个装置需要更多的时间来捕捉纬线的细丝。你必须先多忍受一下汹涌的时间涡流。

original: Inspect your Ravelling Jack
translation: 检查你的“杰克纺时机”

original: Its spidery arms are tangled. Its gears gnash. It is as caught in the snarl of time as the rest of you.
translation: 它蜘蛛网般的手臂被缠住了。齿轮吱吱交合。它和你们一样陷入了时间涡流中。

original: Too late
translation: 为时已晚

original: Its no good. You've been in the Weft too long, and the snarl has grown too dense to untangle. There is no repairing this Weft – you will just have to escape as best you can.
translation: 它不好。你在纬线里呆得太久了，咆哮已经变得太密集了，无法解开。这条纬线是无法修复的，你只能尽你所能地逃离。

original: Dispose of a Death in a Jar
translation: 处置罐中的死亡

original: Why settle for hiding it somewhere when you could hide it somewhen?
translation: 既然能藏在某时，为何满足于藏在某处呢？

original: Cast adrift
translation: 漂流

original: Racing to your exterior hatch, you cast the clay jar out into the surging eddies of the Weft. It is plucked away, lost in one of the feuding futures or pasts.
translation: 奔向你的外部舱门，你把粘土罐扔到了纬线的汹涌漩涡中。它被拉走了，迷失在无休的未来亦或往昔之中。

original: 'Bury' the Navigator's Friend
translation: “埋葬”航海家的朋友

original:
You must be quick! Slide the body out of the exterior hatch into the snarling collisions of time.
[This will transform the Fortunate Navigator into the Stalwart Navigator, a First Officer who increases your Iron by 10, your Affiliation: Establishment by 1 and your Affiliation: Boheme by 1.]
translation:
你一定要快！将身体从外部舱口滑出，进入轰鸣的时间涡流。
[这会让走运的领航员变成忠实的领航员，一位可使你的钢铁+10，人脉：权贵和人脉：波西米亚派艺术家+1的大副。]

original: Cast adrift
translation: 漂流

original:
The Navigator insists on doing the deed himself. Altan's body hangs for a moment just outside the hatch. Then his left shoulder is caught by flailing time, and the corpse is drawn away from the engine. The Navigator watches his friend be snatched away – whenever he is, he is not now. 

He turns to you. "Thank you, Captain. Now, let's find our way out of this tumult." His promise is discharged. He is changed.

[You can appoint the Stalwart Navigator to be your First Officer when you are docked in port.]
translation:
领航员坚持要亲自执行这个行动。阿尔坦的身体在舱口外悬挂了一会儿。随后他的左肩被挥舞着的时间抓住，尸体被拖离了机车。领航员目睹了他的朋友被夺走——无论他以前在哪里，现在都不在了。

他转向你。“谢谢你，车长。现在，让我们找到离开这片混乱的出路吧。”他的承诺已经兑现。他变了。

[停靠在港口时，你可以任命忠实的领航员作为您的大副。]

original: Search the past for a lost Correspondence sigil
translation: 在过往中搜寻一个遗失的信符符印

original: Perhaps, in this long ago, the lost sigils are still remembered. You look out of the window, into the fires of the sun.
translation: 也许，在这久远的年代里，失落的符印仍被铭记着。你看向窗外，望进那太阳的火焰。

original: Seen in negative
translation: 见于负片

original: A sigil flickers across the surface of the sun. Its light is darker, more bearable, than that of the sun glaring behind it. Your eyes water and blur with tears – but you have seen enough.
translation: 一个符印在太阳的表面上闪烁着。它的光更暗，且相比它背后的太阳更容易忍受。你的眼流泪，且因泪水而模糊不清——但你已经看到足够的了。

original: Mr Menagerie's Stall for Delicious Scouts
translation: 百兽先生的美味斥候摊

original:
The cloaked figure looks up as you approach. Its garnet-hued eyes gleam from the darkness of its hood.

"Scouts?" It rasps hopefully, its voice like a cleaver on a whetstone. "We trade scouts. For things and stories." It leans closer to you. "We're leaving soon."
translation:
你走近那身披斗篷的身影，它随之抬头。兜帽阴影中，两抹石榴红幽幽闪动，那是它的眼睛。

“要侦察兽吗？”它满怀期待地低语，嗓音沙哑，犹如菜刀刮过磨刀石上。“我们拿侦察兽换东西，换故事。”它向你靠得更近，催促道：“要就抓紧，我们快走了。”

original: Purchase a Star-Smitten Bat
translation: 购买星痴蝠

original:
It nestles in the crook of Mr Menagerie's neck, burbling happily. Its eyes gleam with pale fire, like one who has looked too long at a star.
[The Star-Smitten Bat has good range, returns after finding one discovery, and conveys little information about what it finds. It requires Mirrors of 25 or more to use.]
translation:
它依偎在百兽先生的颈弯处，快乐地打着饱嗝。它的眼中闪烁着苍白的火星，像是直视星星太久的后果。
[星痴蝠的活动范围很广，在找到一个发现后就会返回，只传达很少有关它发现之物的信息。需要25及以上的镜子值才能使用它。]

original: A bedazzled compatriot
translation: 眼神迷茫的同胞

original:
Mr Menagerie runs its gloved hand along its shoulder, attempting to encourage the bat to climb on. Eventually, Mr Menagerie is forced to perform an undignified shimmy to roll the bat onto its hand. 

As the bat is passed to you, it looks into your face and squeaks. Its pupils shine like cut tourmaline. You are forced to break your gaze after a moment or two: its eyes are uncomfortably bright. 

Mr Menagerie begins to gather up its things, in preparation for the next leg of its journey.
translation:
百兽先生抬起戴着手套的手，在肩头轻轻一划，想引得蝙蝠爬上来。但它畏畏缩缩。最后，百兽先生不得不扭起身子，略显狼狈地让蝙蝠滚落到掌心。

蝙蝠递交于你时，那双小眼直直望来，小嘴还尖声吱叫。它的瞳孔闪亮，有如切割后的碧玺，目光炯炯，难以直视。才对视了几眼，你便只得移开视线。

百兽先生随后开始打点行囊，准备下一段旅途。

original: Purchase a Diffident Bat
translation: 购买自卑蝠

original:
It hides beneath the cloak on Mr Menagerie's shoulder. It occasionally peeks out at you when it thinks you're not looking.
[The Diffident Bat has limited range, returns after finding one discovery, and conveys little information about what it finds.]
translation:
它窝在百兽先生肩膀上，又躲在斗篷下。当猜你没有看它时，偶尔会偷偷探出小脑袋，悄悄打量你。
[自卑蝠的探索范围小，一次只能遭遇一个发现，且不传达发现的具体种类。]

original: A recalcitrant friend
translation: 顽固的朋友

original:
Mr Menagerie jostles the bat out of his cloak, and encourages it forwards. It pulls up a fold of cloth and digs back underneath it. Flicking the cloth, Mr Menagerie flips the bat out; it hides its face under a wing. Mr Menagerie gathers the bat up and deposits it in your arms with an apologetic shrug. 

Mr Menagerie begins to gather up its own things, whistling as it does. A chain around its neck rattles as it works.
translation:
百兽先生把蝙蝠从斗篷里抖出来，想让它往前走。可蝙蝠却一头钻回衣褶里，还死死扒着不放。百兽先生轻轻一甩，又把它抖了出来；蝙蝠立刻用翅膀蒙住脸。他只好把蝙蝠捧起来，塞到你怀里，带着歉意耸了耸肩。

百兽先生随后开始打点行囊，还一边吹着口哨，引得颈上链条咔咔作响。

original: Purchase an Intrepid Cavy
translation: 购买勇敢豚鼠

original:
A large guinea pig wearing a plumed helmet is dozing in a hutch. It is sleeping next to an intricate mechanical bat.
[The Intrepid Cavy has good range, returns after finding one discovery, but conveys more information about what it finds. It requires Mirrors of 45 or more to use.]
translation:
一只豚鼠，头戴羽盔，笼中瞌睡，傍着一架结构精巧的机械蝙蝠。
[勇敢豚鼠探索范围大，一次只能遭遇一个发现，但传达发现的具体种类。需要至少45点镜子值才能装备。]

original: To adventure!
translation: 开始冒险！

original:
Mr Menagerie extends a long finger to prod the dozing guinea pig. 

"Oh!" says the cavy, rubbing sleep from its eyes with a front paw. "I do beg your pardon." It sits upright to address you. "Sir Lionel at your service. Am I to understand you are in need of a valiant Scout? If so, I am the very pig! Just point me in a direction and I will sally forth on my trusty bat!"

Mr Menagerie seems somewhat relieved to pass Sir Lionel on, and begins to gather up its things.
translation:
百兽先生伸出一根修长的手指，戳了戳正在打盹的豚鼠。

“噢！”豚鼠用前爪揉了揉眼睛，赶走睡意，说道：“实在抱歉。”它坐直身子，向你致意。“莱昂诺爵士，乐意为您效劳。您是在寻找勇敢的侦察兽吗？那我就是最合适的鼠选！只需指个方向，我便可骑上忠诚的蝙蝠，马上出发！”

百兽先生把莱昂诺爵士交到你手上后，似乎松了口气，随后开始打点行囊。

original: Purchase a Ratronaut
translation: 购买宇航鼠

original:
The rat in the cage at the top of the pile is wearing a miniature sky-suit and a very determined expression.
[The Ratronaut has good range, can find up to three discoveries before returning, but conveys little information about what it finds. It requires Mirrors of 65 or more to use.]
translation:
一只老鼠待在最高处的笼中，身着迷你潜天装，表情坚定斗志强。
[宇航鼠的探索范围大，一次能遭遇最多三个发现，但不传达发现的具体种类。需要至少65点镜子值才能装备。]

original: An eager companion
translation: 热心的伙伴

original:
The Ratronaut glowers as Mr Menagerie scoops it from its cage. "Are we moving again? Can't you find me a locomotive? I want to be in the sky again. I need to feel the light of a star on my tail!"

Mr Menagerie holds the creature up and introduces you. The Ratronaut narrows its beady eyes, considering you. Its decision is made: it jumps onto your shoulder and prods your cheek. "Come on, cap'n. Let's get to it."

Mr Menagerie shakes its head and begins to gather up its things, preparing for the next leg of its journey.
translation:
被百兽先生拎出笼子时，宇航鼠瞪大眼睛问："我们又要上路啦？你就不能给我找辆车嘛？我还想在天上飞呢。我得感受尾巴上的星光！"

百兽先生抓起这只小兽，开始介绍起你。宇航鼠眯起圆溜溜的小眼打量着你。它心意已决：跳上你的肩膀，戳起你的脸颊，说道："来吧车长，开始干活吧。"

百兽先生摇了摇头，随后开始打点行囊，准备下一段旅途。

original: Acquire nothing
translation: 只看不买

original:
You won't be purchasing a new scout today.
[Mr Menagerie will move onto another port.]
translation:
你今天不打算购买新的侦察兽。
[百兽先生会继续前往下一个车站。]

original: Away
translation: 离开

original:
Mr Menagerie nods its head. "We are moving elsewhere soon. But we will leave a note saying where we have gone. We will have more things to show. And stories to tell."

It turns away, humming an eery tune to itself as it gathers up its things for the next leg of the journey.
translation:
百兽先生点点头，说："我们马上就要到别处去了。但走之前会留下纸条，说明去处。之后会展出更多东西，讲述更多故事。"

它转过身去，一边旁若无人地哼着怪诞的小曲，一边打点行囊，准备开始下一段旅途。

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: Changed customs
translation: 习俗变迁

original:
Mr Menagerie gestures to the spindle of rock that anchors the circus like a stone weighing down an escaping balloon. 

"Once, we gathered here. We held our bargains and boasted of our chiefs. Our bands displayed the finest of goods. Our magnanimity was sharp as knives. All knew our worth. Then the light came. They made of our grounds sport. A dancing place. A laughing place. They made bargains of their own."

"And now you do the same," it rasps in tones of mild reproach.
translation:
百兽先生指了指那块锚定马戏团的岩石主轴，它仿佛一块压住逃逸气球的石头。

“曾经，我们聚集于此。我们举行交易，夸耀我们的头领。我们的队伍展示着最精美的货物。我们的慷慨锋利如刀。所有人都知晓我们的价值。而后光明降临。他们把我们的地盘当作运动场——一处起舞之地，一处欢笑之地。他们做起了自己的交易。”

“如今你也如法炮制，”它用略带责备的嘶哑嗓音说道。

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: Customs changed
translation: 时过境迁

original:
Mr Menagerie gestures to the ruins that loom over the port like the Sphinx outside Thebes. 

"We were in service here. Long ago – a bargain struck with the old king in the woods. We served at table. Procured deliciousness. Watched. Witnessed. Feared. Freedom is better."

"Freedom is better," it repeats, in tones of mild admonishment.
translation:
废墟如同底比斯城外的狮身人面像，压在车站的上空。百兽先生朝那指了指，说道：

“我们曾在那效力。很久以前，我们和森林的旧王签下协议。我们侍候餐食，搜罗珍馐。我们守望，见证，战栗。自由更可贵。”

他又重复了一遍，语气里含着温和的劝诫意：“自由更可贵啊。”

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: The wild delights
translation: 野性之乐

original:
Mr Menagerie gestures to the Ormswold, out beyond the cozy confines of the Royal Society. 

"Old ground. Hunting ground. When wings spread free and soared, and we were indigo in tooth and claw." Are those teeth you can see below the hood? "When the skies were young. When we were young. Our bargains were savage, our hunts were sacred, we lifted all wings, our appetites naked."

"All gone now. Things change. Time takes all."
translation:
百兽先生指了指皇家学会舒适地界之外的涡野。

“这狩猎场，老地方了。那时翅膀还能自由舒展，翱翔天际，我们的利齿锋爪，颜色靛蓝。”言语间，那兜帽下露出的……是利齿吗？“当年天野初开，我们也还年轻。野蛮的交易，神圣的狩猎，翻飞的我们，赤裸的欲望，犹在眼前。”

“如今全没了，都变了。时间能带走一切。”

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: New Dawn
translation: 新黎明

original: Mr Menagerie gestures to the Throne of Hours that scores the horizon like a burst of golden fire. "Light reigned once. Light hated. No mercy, no bargains. Only judged what is. Now light was. Lights can fail." Mr Menagerie leans in close, so you are faced with the full redness of its eyes; the reek of its breath. "We are the haunters of dark. We are the shrieks in the voids. We are the peddlers of midnight. We welcomed light's failing. You bargain with us. We supply your needs. You supply ours. Such novelties you bring to our collections." It brushes an arm (or perhaps a wing, bony and heavy) over your shoulder, and turns away.
translation: 百兽先生指了指时间王座，它像金色火焰一样在地平线上留下痕迹。 “光明曾统治此地。光明憎恨万物。毫无怜悯，没有还价的余地。它只顾裁定现在。如今光明成了过去。光明也会衰颓。” 百兽先生靠近你，让你直面它红色的眼睛和它恶臭的口气。 “我们是黑暗中的鬼魂。我们是虚无中的嚎叫。我们是午夜的商贩。我们乐意见到光明被扑灭。你和我们交易。我们供给你的需求。你对我们也一样。就是你带来供我们收藏的珍奇。” 它用手（或许是消瘦又沉重的翅膀）拍拍你的肩，转身离开了。

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: A trial
translation: 审判

original: Mr Menagerie shies away from the looming door. It retreats further into its cowl, so even its garnet eyes are lost in the gloom. "A mistake to come back. A place of chains; a place of servitude; a place of torment. And treachery." This last is intoned in a voice like a toppling tombstone. "The light binds. The light blinds. All things it places in a chain. Our place is our worth. Some accept; we liberated."
translation: 百兽先生避开那扇耸立的门。它越发缩进兜帽深处，连那双石榴红的眼睛也隐没在幽暗中。 “回来是个错误。锁链之地；奴役之地；苦难之地；背叛之地。”它说出最后一句时，声音如墓碑倒塌。 “光明束缚。光明致盲。它用锁链禁锢万物。位置即价值。有人顺从；我们挣脱。”

original: Listen to a story of things past
translation: 听听过去的故事

original: Mr Menagerie is keen to tell you a tale from its collection, but requires payment first. "Charity is a crime. The punishment severe."
translation: 百兽先生兴致勃勃，想从它的故事里挑一个讲给你听。但它需要先收取报酬，理由是：“施舍乃罪，不得好报。”

original: And they were beautiful
translation: 而他们也曾是美的

original:
Mr Menagerie gestures to the frescoes where devils in rose-masks walk in procession to a great mirror. 

"Once they were servants of the light. Their eager seneschals. Their celebrated cupbearers. Their willing chamberlains. But they craved to feast at the banquets they served. They were placed high, but not high enough. They began to dream of a time without chains. And so they fled and so they fell."

"We bear our chains, or we break them. Lest we be broken."
translation:
百兽先生指向壁画，上面描绘着戴着玫瑰面具，排队走向一面大镜子的魔鬼。

“他们曾是光明的仆人。热情洋溢的总管。万人敬仰的酒政。心甘情愿的内侍。但他们渴望在自己服侍的宴会上成为座上宾。他们身居高位，但并不满足。他们开始梦想摆脱锁链。于是他们逃走了，衰落了。”

“要么身负锁链，要么将其打碎。以免我们也受到残害。”

original: Show Mr Menagerie the Seal of Mr Barleycorn
translation: 向百兽先生展示麦寸先生的印章

original: Is Mr Menagerie one of the seven Mr Barleycorn is looking for?
translation: 百兽先生是麦寸先生要找的七者之一吗？

original:
A hiss; a heavy jab in your ribs. "Put it away! We will not look!" It covers its face with its wing. "We are not ready to look. Still a long way to go. When we rest maybe, maybe then we will be ready."

[Follow Mr Menagerie to the end of its journey. It might be more receptive to the seal then.]
translation:
只听一声嘶鸣，你的肋骨便挨了重重一拳。百兽先生怒吼道：“拿远点！不想看！”，用翅膀挡住自己的脸。"还没准备好看，还有很长的路要走。等不再奔波时，也许……也许那时就做好准备了。"

[跟随百兽先生的流动摊位，到旅途结束时，它也许会更愿意接受印章。]

original: Ambition: Ask Mr Menagerie about the Fire that Follows
translation: 野心：向百兽先生询问追杀之火

original: Mr Menagerie is not pleased to see Meg. "The Spatchcocker!" it hisses. There is an impasse.
translation: 百兽先生见到梅格，显得不太乐意。他嘶声说道：“褪骨厨师！”对话陷入僵局。

original: Lost lore
translation: 失落的传说

original:
Only when you wheel your stack of Caged Catches forward does Mr Menagerie consent to answer your questions.

"The Fire that Follows. Dangerous knowledge for us; more so for you. The Fire is a hunting-flame. It comes for those who know a thing they should not know." It draws back, out of the starlight, "A secret, sworn between suns. The knowledge itself is the scent it follows. And when it has you, the Courtesy will come."
translation:
直到你把那堆笼中猎获推到百兽先生面前，他才肯开口回答。

“追杀之火一事，对我族很是危险，对你族更甚。这火是狩猎之火，当有人知晓了不应知晓之事，便会追随而来。”它向后退去，走到星光外的黑影中，接着说：“追杀之火是太阳共同守护的秘密，知晓此事本身便会引火追杀。等它找到你时，仪节就会降临。”

original: Ask if it knows this secret of the suns
translation: 询问百兽先生是否知道太阳们的秘密

original: And if it does, why hasn't the Fire come for it?
translation: 如果它知道的话，为什么“火”没来追杀它？

original:
"Once, I did." Menagerie pulls its hood to one side, revealing a bat-like muzzle, mottled fur, and a livid burn mark across one side of its skull. "Burned it out. Better my fire than theirs."

The hood falls forward. "The flame has your scent?" Menagerie asks. 

"No." Meg says. "A friend's. She's missing."

"Ah. Then look for her at the House of Jude, in London. I know its master. I collect my pets, he collects his."
translation:
“我以前知道。”百兽先生把兜帽掀到一边，露出蝙蝠的口鼻、斑驳的毛皮，以及一侧头骨上狰狞的灼伤痕迹。“烧掉了。比起被它们的火烧掉，还是自己来比较好。”

兜帽又滑了下来，百兽先生问道：“那火找上你了？”

“不是我”，梅格说，“是我朋友，她失踪了。”

“噢，那就去伦敦的犹大屋找她吧，我认识房主。我收集我的宠物，他也收集他的。”

original: Ask what the Courtesy is
translation: 询问它什么是仪节

original: The Masked Citizen is investigating the Courtesy. Perhaps you could learn something useful.
translation: 蒙面公民正在调查仪节。或许你能学到些有用的东西。

original:
"Don't know. Knew once, but managed to forget." Mr Menagerie shakes its hooded head. "Only a hollow now, where once was knowing. I think... A compact? A law? A living word, spoken into being!" It hisses, as if remembering even this much causes it pain. 

"The flame is hunting a friend of ours." Meg says. "She's missing."

"Ah. Then look for her at the House of Jude, in London. I know its master. I collect my pets, he collects his. Now go."
translation:
“不清楚，以前是知道的，但想尽办法忘掉了。”戴着兜帽的百兽先生摇了摇头，接着说：“曾经装满知识的地方，如今只是个空洞。我想想……是契约？律法？还是那一出口就活过来的圣言！啊！”它嘶声低吼，仿佛这点回忆都能带来痛楚。

“那火在猎杀我们的朋友”，梅格说，“她失踪了。”

“噢，那就去伦敦的犹大屋找她吧，我认识房主。我收集我的宠物，他也收集他的。快走吧。”

original: Progress of the Struggle
translation: 斗争的进展

original: Some of the workers at Brabazon are fighting for better conditions, and require materials from offworld to aid their efforts.
translation: 布拉巴宗的一群工人正为改善工作条件作斗争，他们需要外界提供材料助力。

original: Speak of other matters
translation: 提起其他事务

original: This will have to wait, for now.
translation: 这件事还得先放一放。

original: Supply tea for the cause
translation: 为事业提供茶叶

original: "We need tea. It's as good as currency," says [qvd:133994(LeaderName)]. "We want some of the newer Overseers on side. It would be useful to remind them where they came from."
translation: “我们需要茶叶，这玩意能充当货币。”[qvd:133994(LeaderName)]说。“最好让新上任的监督者们站在我们这边。如果能提醒他们自己的出身，对我们会很有用。”

original: Eager gratitude
translation: 感激不尽

original: "Excellent," says [qvd:133994(LeaderName)]. "Precious as gold, more fungible, and less suspicious in the hands of a debtor. We can use this to bring out the virtues in some Overseers, and the vices in others. Both will be useful."
translation: “好极了，”[qvd:133994(LeaderName)]说。“这玩意儿价格堪比黄金，买卖更方便，在债务人手里也不那么惹眼。我们可以借此引出一部分监督者的‘美德’，也能勾出另一部分监督者的‘劣根性’。这两者，都是我们所需的。”

original: Supply permits for the cause
translation: 为事业提供许可证

original: The faintly-bearded youth passes a sheet of paper to [qvd:133994(LeaderName)]. "Top of the list is a Ministry Stamped Permit. There's no way I can get my hands on one."
translation: 那位胡子稀疏的青年把一张纸递给[qvd:133994(LeaderName)]。“最有用的是公德部盖章的许可证。我根本搞不到。”

original: As required
translation: 恰如其分

original: "Ideal. We have to get into Little Nice: this may allow us to do so. There are some Overseers I used to know who got promoted out of reach. But they owe me, and I'll be able to remind them of the debt." The leader grins again, fiercely. His youthful assistant quails, but says nothing.
translation: “完美。我们得想办法混进小奈斯，有了这个，或许能行。我以前认识几个监督者，现在都爬得挺高，联系不上了。但他们欠我人情，现在就可以提醒他们还债了。”领头人再次猛地咧嘴一笑。他那年轻的助手有点缩头缩脑，但什么都没说。

original: Provide blackmail material for the cause
translation: 为事业提供可用于讹诈的消息

original: "I need information that I can use as leverage."
translation: “我需要可作为筹码的信息。”

original: Solemn tones
translation: 语气肃穆

original: [qvd:133994(LeaderNameCap)] listens closely to the information you bring him. His eyebrows raise. "Yes. Yes, this I can use."
translation: [qvd:133994(LeaderNameCap)]仔细听着你带来的信息。他抬起眉毛。“不错，不错，这能派上用场。”

original: Provide Chorister nectar for the cause
translation: 为事业提供唱诗蜂蜜

original: What need would they have for this? [qvd:133994(LeaderNameCap)] only smiles. "Bring some, and you will see."
translation: 他们要这个做什么？[qvd:133994(LeaderNameCap)]只是微笑。“帮我带来，你就知道了。”

original: A grateful smile
translation: 感激的微笑

original: He takes the nectar with care. "It has many uses. It is sweet, and so grants cheer and vigour. We will need both. It is a balm to the throat, which is valuable when shouting orders and chanting slogans. Best of all, tipped into the workings of a loom or other machinery, it works merry hell."
translation: 他小心地接过蜂蜜。“它用途很多。它味甜，可以雀跃人心，增添活力，这两样东西我们都用的上。它是润喉药，大声下令和喊口号就需要这个。最重要的是，在时织机或其他机器的轴承里抹上一点，可以把它们搞得一团糟。”

original: All is prepared
translation: 万事俱备

original: "We have everything we need," you are told. "Come."
translation: “我们全都准备好了。”他告诉你，“来吧。”

original: Calming the Masses
translation: 安抚群众

original: Brabazon is always a simmering cauldron of dissatisfaction. Perhaps you could do something about that.
translation: 布拉巴宗向来如同装满沸腾不满情绪的大锅。或许你能为此做点什么。

original: Return to the Backstreets
translation: 返回后街

original: You have other business.
translation: 你还有其他事务。

original: Lower unrest with Gossip
translation: 散播八卦，平息动乱

original: Give them a distraction, something to talk about besides their discomfort.
translation: 找点能让他们从自己悲惨境遇上分心的谈资。

original: Tall tales
translation: 离奇故事

original: You are thoroughly interrogated. "Ooh, really? And they do that in London? Well, I'll be—" The man is abruptly hushed. "Not in front of the orphans!"
translation: 你被仔细审问了个遍。“噢，此话当真？伦敦人会这么干？是我的话，就——”那人马上被打断了。“别当着孤儿们说！”

original: Lower unrest with tea
translation: 用茶叶来平息动乱

original: Tea soothes. Tea comforts.
translation: 茶能舒缓躁动，安慰人心。

original: A panacea
translation: 灵丹妙药

original:
An elderly gentleman volunteers to put a pot on. Nearby workers produce mugs. 

As the kettle comes to the boil, they gripe and complain with increasing vehemence. But then the kettle lets off steam, and so do they. They sip their tea, and their grievances simmer down to a very British level of percolating dissatisfaction.
translation:
一位老先生把自己的壶放上灶台。旁边的工人们拿出杯子。

水壶慢慢沸腾，他们的抱怨也越发激烈。随后水壶便放出蒸汽，而他们也跟着泄了气。他们啜饮茶水，不满的情绪渐渐平息，最终变成最为英式的、渗入骨髓的埋怨。

original: Lower unrest with patriotic literature
translation: 用爱国文学平息动乱

original: London produces a torrent of Ministry-sponsored pamphlets with titles like 'THE VIRTUES OF LABOUR,' 'THE SUN SHINES ON HARD WORKERS,' and 'TOIL FOR YOUR EMPRESS AS SHE TOILS FOR THEE.'
translation: 在公德部资助下，伦敦印刷了无数标题形如“劳动的德行”、“太阳眷顾勤勉者”和“为女皇辛劳，正如她为你辛劳”的小册子。

original: The opiate of the masses
translation: 群众的鸦片

original: Perhaps the literature has stoked the fires of patriotism, and inspired them to dutiful work. Perhaps it is so turgid that they have been reduced to a soporific obedience. The effect is the same.
translation: 或许这些文学作品燃起了爱国心的火焰，激励他们努力劳作。抑或它们太过冗长，以至于他们在昏昏欲睡中陷入了顺从。反正结果都一样。

original: Reduce unrest by feeding a superstition
translation: 传播迷信，平息动乱

original: The notion has begun to circulate that management will accept souls as part-payment towards the discharge of one's debts.
translation: 有流言称，管理层将允许用灵魂偿还部分债务。

original: All that glisters
translation: 闪亮的东西

original: You distribute a brace of souls among the populace. Acquiring them, trading them, and protecting them becomes a vigorous fad, and effective distraction.
translation: 你混入人群，分发出一堆灵魂。他们顿时忙着争抢、交易、看守它们。他们的注意力被很有效地分散了。

original: Reduce unrest by offering a Caged Catch for the bear-baiting
translation: 提供笼中猎获来进行斗兽活动，平息动乱。

original: They hardly ever use bears any more, of course. They are hard to come by, up here. But the sky offers no end of other horrors that can be coaxed into killing each other for the general amusement.
translation: 当然，他们现在几乎不再用熊了。在这里，熊很难找到。但天空中还有数不胜数的其他恐怖生物，可以被引诱互相残杀，以供大众取乐。

original: Bloodletting
translation: 放血

original: The fights take place in a pit sunk into the floor of an abandoned factory. The building is packed with roaring workers. The combatants hiss, coil, lash, spit, maul. The crowd is enthralled.
translation: 斗兽在一家废弃工厂的地下凹坑中举行。整栋建筑里挤满喧哗的工人。两只斗士嘶叫、盘绕、抽击、撕咬、喷吐唾沫。观众们聚精会神。

original: Bet on the matches
translation: 下赌注

original: Your offering appears suitably savage. It may do well.
translation: 你提供的那只看起来就够野蛮。它或许会好好表现。

original: Your Caged Catch acquits itself well, and by the end of the night you have accumulated a small profit. Your combatant is in no state to be returned to you. It is unceremoniously butchered, as the audience makes their way home.
translation: 笼中猎获表现优异，到了晚上，你已经小小地赚了一笔。不过你的斗士领不回来了。它被毫不留情地宰杀，观众们也陆续回家了。

original: Do not participate
translation: 不参与

original: This is barbarism.
translation: 这太野蛮了。

original: You leave the reeking, thundering factory and make your way through the cold streets. A roar from behind you. The melee has begun.
translation: 你离开恶臭不堪、欢声雷动的工厂，穿过寒冷的街道。你身后传来吼叫声。混战开始了。

original: Reduce unrest by telling horrific and educational stories
translation: 讲述警醒后人的恐怖故事，平息动乱

original: Can you convince your audience that there are worse places than this?
translation: 你能否让听众们相信，还会有比这更加糟糕的地方？

original: No greener grass
translation: 金窝银窝不如狗窝

original: Your stories are suitably distressing, and your audience agrees that the sky is very terrible. Perhaps everywhere is either drudgery or horror, and there are no sanctuaries to be found.
translation: 你的故事阴郁得恰到好处，听众们也同意天空的确非常可怕。也许外面哪里都一样恐怖、一样要辛苦劳作，而世上根本没有乐园。

original: Return to the Brabazon Backstreets
translation: 回到布拉巴宗的后街

original: Brabazon is at peace – there is no disgruntlement to be soothed.
translation: 布拉巴宗目前十分安宁，没有急需抚慰的不满情绪。

original: The Titania Redevelopment Committee
translation: 狄坦妮娅重建委员会

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor, Stone-Faced Sculptor and Melancholy Poet stand in a circle of Titania's ever-vocal Bohemians, arguing themselves to a standstill. The Mayor waves you over. "Perfect timing, Captain."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长、石面雕塑家和忧郁的诗人站在狄坦妮娅里一个喧闹不休的波西米亚派艺术家圈子中，争论得难分难解。市长朝你挥了挥手。“车长，你来得正好。”

original: Advocate for a Salon
translation: 主张建立一个沙龙

original:
"A place for poetry, conversation, tea, and scones," offers the Stone-Faced Sculptor.
[Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation:
“一个作诗、谈话、品茶和吃司康饼的地方。” 石面雕塑家说。
[狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the suggestion passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Advocate for a Museum
translation: 主张建立一个博物馆

original:
"Devoted to what? We'll decide later." The Rhapsodic Mayor waves her hand at this minor detail. "Something to impress, to educate. Something worthy."
[Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation:
“它专注于何？我们稍后再决定。 ”热情洋溢的市长挥手不谈这一细枝末节的事务，“反正得是某些令人印象深刻、有教育意义的东西。某些有价值的东西。”
[狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the suggestion passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Advocate for a Scientific Enclave
translation: 主张建立一个科学飞地

original: "A good friend of mine from Benthic College has been looking for a place where they can conduct their... how do I put this... less conservative experiments," offers the Melancholy Poet. "I thought Root's End would be perfect. Remote. Not very flammable." [Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation: “我来自本栖学院的一位好朋友一直在找一个地方进行他们的……怎么说呢……不那么保守的实验，”忧郁的诗人提议道，“我觉得建在根末之地很合适。那里偏远，而且不易燃。” [狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the suggestion passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Advocate for a nature reserve
translation: 主张建立一个自然保护区

original:
"What could be more suitable for our new Eleutherian inspiration than a place to enjoy the glories of the natural world?" The Rhapsodic Mayor can already picture it.
[Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation:
“还有什么比欣赏自然美景更能契合我们全新的厄琉忒里亚风格呢？”热情洋溢的市长已经浮现出那幅景象。
[狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the suggestion passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Advocate for a Poetry Academy
translation: 主张建立一个诗歌学院

original:
The Melancholy Poet almost stamps her feet. "Of course we must make this a home for the greatest and most noble of the art-forms." ("Music?" asks the Rhapsodic Mayor. "Statues?" demands the Stone-Faced Sculptor. The Melancholy Poet glowers. "A plague on both your houses. One with great big festering buboes.")
[Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation:
忧郁的诗人差点跺起脚来：“那当然，我们必须让这里成为最伟大和最卓越的艺术形式之家。” (“那是音乐吗？”热情洋溢的市长发问道，“那是雕像吗？”石面雕塑家追问道。忧郁的诗人怒目而视。“愿瘟神降临你们俩的家。其中一个还要长满脓疮。”)
[狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the decision passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Advocate for a Theatre
translation: 主张建立一个剧院

original:
The Stone-Faced Sculptor spreads his arms. "Not just any theatre. The greatest theatre in the Reach." He hesitates. "Are there any others? Well, if there are, they'll be smaller."
[Titania only has room for two projects of this size.]
translation:
石面雕塑家张开双臂：“不只是剧院。而是外野最大的剧院。”他犹豫了一下，“还有其他剧院吗？嗯，如果有的话，这个得比它们更大。”
[狄坦妮娅只能容纳两个这样规模的项目。]

original: Put to a vote
translation: 开始表决

original: With your support, the suggestion passes. Construction begins.
translation: 在你的支持下，建议通过了。建设开始了。

original: Suggest research into Anti-Bee Defences
translation: 建议研究反蜜蜂防御系统

original: "In retrospect, perhaps we should have started with these..." says the Rhapsodic Mayor. The other councillors nod their slightly embarrassed agreement.
translation: “现在想来，也许我们早就该做这个了……”热情洋溢的市长说。其他议员们略显尴尬地点头同意。

original: Safety for Titania
translation: 狄坦妮娅的安全

original:
The soporific poison from your Caged Catches prove as effective as the Rhapsodic Mayor had hoped. Mixed with Titania's pollen, they lure the hive from the public areas and soon the chorister hive's scouts find themselves slipping into restful sleep.

The Mayor clicks her fingers. "Get some ropes," she orders. "I have an idea."

[You have finished building Titania. Each new Captain in this Lineage can enjoy the Boons you have made available, as well as take advantage of Bargains and Prospects from your buildings.]
translation:
果然如热情洋溢的市长所料，从笼中猎获中提炼的催眠毒素效果显著。混入狄坦妮娅的花粉后，它成功将蜂群引离公共场所，很快，唱诗蜂群的侦察蜂便沉入了酣睡之中。

市长打了个响指，吩咐道：“拿些绳子来，我有个主意。”

[你已完成狄坦妮娅的建造。今后，同一世系下的每位新车长都可继承你已解锁的恩惠，并利用你建立的建筑获取交易与机遇。]

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: They can argue amongst themselves.
translation: 先让他们争论去吧。

original: Listen in on the arguments
translation: 听听他们的争论

original: The three squabble like artists; relentlessly, but with very well chosen words.
translation: 这三人就像艺术家一样争吵不休。他们毫不留情，但用词十分考究。

original: Rebuilding Titania
translation: 重建狄坦妮娅

original: All three are agreed that Titania represents a phenomenal new opportunity for Art. Where they differ is on whose definition to use. At this rate they will be lucky to agree before the dawn of the new century.
translation: 三人都同意狄坦妮娅为艺术领域带来了一个极好的新机遇。不过他们之间的分歧在于使用谁的定义。照这样的速度下去，他们很难在新世纪到来之前达成共识。

original: A New Start For Titania
translation: 狄坦妮娅的新开始

original:
The Rhapsodic Mayor looks relieved to see you. "Ah, Captain. Perhaps you can help settle a little matter for us. We've agreed that we need to choose one style and stick with it, but..." 

She sighs, gesturing at her fellow council members, the Melancholy Poet and Stone-Faced Sculptor. "Well, we find ourselves at an impasse. Your thoughts?"
translation:
热情洋溢的市长看到你，似乎松了一口气。“啊，车长。也许你能帮我们解决一个小问题。我们已经同意，我们要选择一种风格并坚持下去，但是……”

她叹了口气，指了指她的议会成员，忧郁的诗人和石面雕塑家。“好吧，我们发现自己陷入了僵局。你的想法呢？”

original: Advocate for an Albion style
translation: 提议阿尔比恩风格

original:
"A little slice of home in the Reach," says the Stone-Faced Sculptor. "A sturdy rock from which we can help guide the future."
[You must have visited Albion to choose this.]
translation:
“在外野的一方小小家园，”石面雕塑家说，“一块坚固的石头，我们可以借此来引导未来。”
[你需要先拜访过阿尔比恩才能选择此选项。]

original: A direction is agreed
translation: 商定方向

original:
The Stone-Faced Sculptor is quick to capitalise on this moment of agreement. Before the day is out, the docks at least have a familiar Albion look to them. The rest of the port will take a little longer before it is ready for expansion.

[You can continue expanding Titania with your current Captain by donating towards progress, but this will get more expensive as development continues. Alternatively each Captain in this Lineage will be able to choose another expansion, until the Port is completed.]

[The more you expand the Port, then more Bargains, Prospects and other opportunities will be made available, with individual buildings offering one boon per Captain.]
translation:
石面雕塑家迅速抓住了这达成共识的良机。一天还没结束，码头已经初具熟悉的阿尔比恩外观。车站的其他部分还需要一些时间才能做好扩建的准备。

[你可以继续使用你当前的车长扩建狄坦妮娅，通过捐赠来推进建设进度，但随着开发的进行，费用会越来越高。如果你不愿意继续，该世系中的每位车长都可以选​​择其他扩建项目，直到车站建成。]

[车站扩建得越多，就会提供更多的特价商品、机遇和其他机会，每座建筑会分别给车长提供一份恩惠。]

original: Advocate for an Eleutherian aesthetic
translation: 提议厄琉忒里亚美学

original:
"Her dark beauty. The lure of the classic and the pagan." The Melancholy Poet almost cracks a slight smile. "What inspiration we can draw from that horror."
[You must have visited Eleutheria to choose this.]
translation:
“她的黑暗之美。古典和异教的诱惑。”忧郁的诗人几乎露出一丝微笑，“我们能从这种恐怖中获得什么灵感呢。”
[你需要拜访过厄琉忒里亚才能选择此选项。]

original: A direction is agreed
translation: 商定方向

original:
The Melancholy Poet is quick to capitalise on this moment of agreement. Before the day is out, most of the buildings have been cleared away for a more natural look. The rest of the port will take a little longer before it is ready for expansion.

[You can continue expanding Titania with your current Captain by donating towards progress, but this will get more expensive as development continues. Alternatively each Captain in this Lineage will be able to choose another expansion, until the Port is completed.]

[The more you expand the Port, then more Bargains, Prospects and other opportunities will be made available, with individual buildings offering one boon per Captain.]
translation:
忧郁的诗人迅速抓住了这达成共识的良机。一天还没结束，大部分的建筑已经被清理掉，以保持更自然的外观。车站的其他部分还需要一些时间才能做好扩建的准备。

[你可以继续使用你当前的车长扩建狄坦妮娅，通过捐赠来推进建设进度，但随着开发的进行，费用会越来越高。如果你不愿意继续，该世系中的每位车长都可以选​​择其他扩建项目，直到车站建成。]
