translation: 这真是一笔相当可观的捐款!

original: The Mayor is speechless
translation: 市长无言以对

original: This will be more than sufficient. Thank you!
translation: 这将是绰绰有余的。谢谢你!

original: The Benthic Enclave at Root's End
translation: 在根末之地的本栖飞地

original: [qvd:136787(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136787(SletDescription)]

original: Help decide a direction for the Enclave
translation: 帮助决定飞地的方向

original: The Melancholy Poet is surrounded by scientists, demanding to know what they should be building.
translation: 忧郁的诗人被科学家包围着，要求知道他们应该建造什么。

original: The way of progress
translation: 进步之路

original: "No, we are not letting you build another clockwork sun— Ah!" The Melancholy Poet almost looks pleased to see you. "Finally, someone sensible. Help me decide on one of these plans, would you?"
translation: “不，我们不会让你再造一个发条太阳——啊！”忧郁的诗人看到你，几乎露出了高兴的表情。“终于，来了个明白人。你能帮我从这些计划中选一个吗？”

original: Advocate for an observatory
translation: 提议建立观察站

original: The skies are much clearer here than in Albion. What wonders might they see?
translation: 这里的天空比阿尔比恩的天空要清澈得多。他们会看到什么奇观？

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Advocate for a workshop
translation: 主张建立一个工作室

original: This is the perfect place to develop new inventions and devices.
translation: 这里是开发新发明和新设备的完美场所。

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Advocate for a Great Exhibition
translation: 主张建立一个大展览馆

original: A place for the Benthic Enclave to show off the latest Albion technologies.
translation: 为本栖飞地提供一个展示阿尔比恩最新技术的地方。

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Leave them to their arguments
translation: 让他们去争论

original: They won't be resolving them any time soon.
translation: 他们不会很快解决这些问题。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: There is nothing more to be done here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么可做的了。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original: For safety, civilians are not normally allowed to use the telescope, but you are owed a boon. [Every Captain can request a boon. This will get you 10 Sky-Stories.]
translation: 出于安全考虑，通常不允许平民使用望远镜，但你是享有特权的人。 [每位车长都可以请求特权。这将为你带来10个高天轶事。]

original: The wonder of the heavens
translation: 天野奇迹

original: Your guide gives you a detailed tour of the High Wilderness from a whole new perspective. Wherever you shift the telescope, they have an earnest rumour that emerged from the colony/settlement/something there. Some of them may even be true.
translation: 你的导游将从全新的角度为你详细介绍天野。无论你移动望远镜，都有来自殖民地/定居点/那里的某个地方流传出的认真谣言。其中一些甚至可能是真的。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
Perhaps the engineers in one of the Workshops will be able to offer you something.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you 10 Experimental Modifications.]
translation:
也许车间里的工程师能为你提供一些东西。
[每位车长都可以请求一项恩赐，这会给你10个试制改装件。]

original: BOOM! of Titania
translation: 狄坦妮娅的爆炸声

original: The engineer looks shamefaced, as near as you can tell under the thick layer of fresh soot. "Look, I was almost sure it would work," she says. "Here. Maybe they'll be able to do something with the pieces at the Society proper..."
translation: 这位工程师看起来有些羞愧，尽管她脸上覆盖着一层厚厚的煤灰。她说：“听着，我原本很确信它会工作的。”“喏，也许他们能在社团总部用这些碎片做些什么……”

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The Great Exhibition is a place of many wonders. You can gain free entrance.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you 5 Salon-Stewed Gossip. Be sure you have cargo space.]
translation:
大展会是一个充满奇迹的地方。你可以免费入场。
[每位车长都可以请求一个恩惠。这将给你5来源不明的小道消息。请确保你有足够的货物空间。]

original: Propaganda on Parade
translation: 宣传游行

original: Far from being a demonstration of the High Wilderness' potential, the Exhibition is quickly revealed as little but a display of Albion arrogance. "I hear we have you to thank," whispers a figure in black. He squints. "Someone who looked a bit like you, anyway. Either way. Here. For your service."
translation: 展览远非是天野潜力的展示，而迅速暴露为不过是阿尔比恩傲慢的展示。“我听说我们应该感谢你，”一个黑衣身影低声说道。他眯起眼睛。“反正长得有点像你的人。不管怎样。这是给你的。为了你的服务。”

original: Take the Royal Astronomer to the Telescope
translation: 带皇家天文学家去看望远镜

original: Surely one telescope is much like another.
translation: 当然，一个望远镜和另一个望远镜很像。

original: Too far
translation: 太远了

original: The Royal Astronomer takes his eye from the glass. "No. No good. We'll need the main telescope at the Royal Society in Albion. I just hope they let us use it."
translation: 皇家天文学家将视线从望远镜上移开。“不，不行。我们需要阿尔比恩皇家学会的主要望远镜。我只是希望他们能让我们用。”

original: The Gardens of Petal End
translation: 花瓣尽头的花园

original: [qvd:136779(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136779(SletDescription)]

original: Help choose a theme for the nature reserve
translation: 请为自然保护区选择一个主题

original: A space like this has so many possibilities.
translation: 这样一个空间有太多的可能性。

original: Nature's bounty
translation: 大自然的恩赐

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor emerges from the water, shivering. An aide passes her her robe. "Bracing!" she exclaims, pulling the belt tight. "Nothing like a circuit around the petal to get the blood pumping. Still, I think this place could be something more."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长从水中浮上来，浑身发抖。一名助手将长袍递给了她。“真冷啊！”她感叹道，然后拉紧了腰带。“绕着花瓣游一圈就能让血液流动起来，不过，我觉得这个地方还可以变得更好。”

original: Advocate for a Water Garden
translation: 主张建立一个水上花园

original: She has the right idea. Why try to improve on perfection?
translation: 她的想法是正确的。为什么要在完美的基础上尝试改进呢？

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor smiles. "Exactly what I was thinking. Of course, with a few minor changes..."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长微笑着说：“正是我所想的。当然，有一些小改动......”

original: Advocate for the House of Cavy
translation: 主张建立一个豚鼠之家

original: There are rumours of a lost tribe from the Unterzee seeking a home. Titania could be the perfect choice.
translation: 有传言说，来自地下海泽的失散的一群人正在寻找一个家园。狄坦妮娅可能会是个完美的选择。

original:
"Titania welcomes all," says the Rhapsodic Mayor, whispering to an aide to put the word out in hopes of reaching this illusive House.

 It isn't long before a small, eccentrically built locomotive pulls into port. The doors open and out patters an imperious looking guinea pig flanked by a pair of pike-wielding guard rodents. It chirps something that sounds like "It'll do, I suppose," and leads a long procession down to the Petal. The Cavies are ready to establish their new colony.
translation:
“狄坦妮娅欢迎所有人，”热情洋溢的市长说道，他低声吩咐助手把消息传出去，希望能找到这个难以捉摸的家族。

没过多久，一辆造型奇特的小型火车驶进港口。车门打开，一只威风凛凛的豚鼠在两只手持长矛的警卫老鼠的簇拥下走了下来。它吱吱地叫着，声音听起来像“我想还可以吧”，然后领着长长的队伍前往花瓣。豚鼠们准备建立他们的新殖民地。

original: Advocate for a Farm
translation: 主张建立一个农场

original: Titania could become more self-reliant and a little hard work never killed anyone.
translation: 狄坦妮娅可以变得更加自力更生，而且努力工作永远不会害死人。

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor chews the idea over. "I don't know about that," she begins. Then: "But fruit, perhaps. Picking strawberries. Blackberries. Blueberries— Yes!"
translation: 热情洋溢的市长仔细思考了这个想法。“我不知道是不是这样，”她开始说。然后又说：“但是，水果的话，也许可以。摘草莓。黑莓。蓝莓——对！”

original: Leave the Mayor to consider it herself
translation: 让市长自己去考虑吧

original: She is unlikely to decide any time soon.
translation: 她不太可能很快做出决定。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: There is nothing more to be done here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么可做的了。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
A relaxing afternoon is rarely an unwise choice.
[Every Captain can request one boon. This will reduce your Terror to 0.]
translation:
悠闲的下午时光通常都不会是糟糕的选择。
[每位车长都可以要求一份恩赐。这将把你的恐惧降至0。]

original: Peace and relaxation
translation: 和平与放松

original: The ice chill of the pure water against your skin. The careful, firm hands of a skilled masseur. The feel of your problems fading away to nothing, for now.
translation: 纯净水带来的冰冷刺激着你的皮肤。 一位熟练按摩师的小心而坚定的双手。 你的问题此刻逐渐消失，化为乌有。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The Cavies aren't using the fuel from their locomotive. They might be willing to share.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you 5 Fuel. Be sure you have cargo space.]
translation:
豚鼠们没有使用他们火车的燃料。他们可能会愿意分享。
[每位车长都可以请求一份奖励。这会给你5个燃料。请确保你有足够的货物空间。]

original: Loaded up
translation: 装车

original: The guinea pigs struggle to push the barrels up the long path to the docks. A generous captain would help them. Your conscience is your own.
translation: 豚鼠们挣扎着将木桶推上通往码头的长路。一位慷慨的车长会帮助它们。你的良心由你自己掌握。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The harvest is intended for consumption by the residents, but you should be able to get a few baskets for yourself.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you 5 Supplies. Be sure you have cargo space.]
translation:
收获物主要是供居民消费的，但你应该也能为自己留几篮子。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩惠。这将给你5份补给。请确保你有足够的货舱空间。]

original: A bounty of fresh delights
translation: 大量新鲜美味的食物

original: It is all you can do to prevent the crew back from immediately consuming the huge, glistening fruits in your baskets. But they will have to wait.
translation: 你所能做的就是阻止列车员们立即吃掉你篮子里的巨大、闪闪发光的水果。但他们必须等等。

original: The Museum in Bloom Bower
translation: 花亭中的博物馆

original: [qvd:136784(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136784(SletDescription)]

original: Help choose a theme for the Museum
translation: 请为博物馆选择一个主题

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor keeps changing her mind.
translation: 热情洋溢的市长一直在改变她的想法。

original: Endless choices
translation: 无尽的选择

original: The Mayor looks up from a pile of designs. "Everyone has their own idea what our museum should be about. I want to use— hmm. Can I use all of them? No, bad idea. Need to choose one. But which? They all look so... educational."
translation: 市长从一堆设计图中抬起头来。“每个人对我们博物馆应该是什么样的都有自己的想法。我想用——嗯。我能全用吗？不，这是个坏主意。需要选一个。但是选哪一个呢？它们看起来都很有……教育意义。”

original: Advocate for an Imperial Museum
translation: 主张建立一个帝国博物馆

original: A symbol of British greatness, before and after Albion.
translation: 阿尔比恩前后，英国伟大的象征。

original: "You don't think that might be a bit... colonial?" The Rhapsodic Mayor considers it. "Then again, we are already a colony, I suppose. Very well. Let it be done!"
translation: “你不觉得这么做可能有点...殖民主义？”热情洋溢的市长沉思道。“不过，我们本来就是殖民地，我想。好吧，就这么定了！”

original: Advocate for an Art Museum
translation: 主张建立一个艺术博物馆

original: A place of beauty in all its myriad forms.
translation: 一个集万千美丽于一身的地方。

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor closes her eyes to better visualise it. "Of course! What better way to celebrate our achievements? We will begin work immediately."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长闭上眼睛以便更好地想象它。“当然！还有什么更好的方式来庆祝我们的成就？我们马上就开始工作。”

original: Advocate for a Great Library
translation: 主张建立一个大图书馆

original: A new Alexandria, home to all knowledge.
translation: 新亚历山大，知识的家园。

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor nods. "You read my mind. A place where knowledge can be free to all. To most," she corrects herself. "To those who can appreciate it."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长点点头。“你读懂了我的想法。一个所有人都可以自由获取知识的地方。”她纠正自己道，“是对那些能欣赏它的人而言的。”

original: Leave the Mayor to her thoughts
translation: 让市长自己去想吧

original: She is unlikely to decide any time soon.
translation: 她不太可能很快做出决定。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: There is nothing more to be done here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么可做的了。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
There must be some interesting secrets in the depths that the public is not normally allowed into.
[Every Captain can request one boon. This will give you an Unlicensed Chart.]
translation:
公众通常无法进入的深海中一定隐藏着一些有趣的秘密。
[每位车长都可以请求一个恩惠。这将给您一张未经许可的航图。]

original: The Enduring Empire
translation: 永恒的帝国

original: So much fascinating history – some of it perhaps even accurate. You spend a good afternoon browsing through the exhibits, including the darker vaults that the public doesn't get to see. How curious – the logs of the engine Lamorak, long thought lost during an ambassadorial trip to the Blue Kingdom. These warrant exploration.
translation: 这么多迷人的历史——有些甚至可能是准确的。你花了一个下午的时间来浏览这些展品，包括公众看不到的暗窖。机车兰马洛克的日志是多么令人好奇，在一次前往蓝色王国的使节旅行中，人们长期认为它已经丢失了。这些都值得探索。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The art museum is quickly filling up with original works to admire.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you a Moment of Inspiration.]
translation:
艺术博物馆正在迅速被值得欣赏的原作填满。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩惠。这会给你带来瞬间的灵感。]

original: A model citizen
translation: 一个模范公民

original: "Wait!" An artist hurries up to you as you wander the halls. "That poise, that face... I must paint you!" There is no talking him out of it. An hour later, it is done – a fine watercolour portrait that captures your every feature. Truly inspirational.
translation: “等一下！”当你在走廊里闲逛时，一个艺术家急忙向你走来。“那个姿势，那张脸……我一定要画你！”你无法说服他。一个小时后，画完成了——一幅精美的水彩肖像画，捕捉到了你的每一个特征。真是令人鼓舞。

original: Request a Boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The books here must hold many secrets. You could learn a few things.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you a Cryptic Benefactor.]
translation:
这里的书一定藏着许多秘密。你可以学到一些东西。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩赐，这会让你得到隐秘的人脉。]

original: Deep in a world of words
translation: 在文字的深邃世界中

original: Your selection of prohibited books does not go unnoticed by the only other patron in the library's private wing. They quietly sit down across the table from you and slide something to you. A calling card, blank except for a street name in New Winchester. An unspoken nod of recognition from the shadows.
translation: 你选择的禁书并没有逃过图书馆私人区另一位顾客的注意。他们静静地坐在你的对面，然后滑给你一样东西。是一张名片，上面除了新温彻斯特的一个街道名外什么都没有。是阴影中无声的认可。

original: Present the Seal of Mr Barleycorn to the Curator
translation: 向收藏家展示麦寸先生的印章

original: It often pays to be thorough.
translation: 做事彻底往往会得到回报。

original: Accursed terminology
translation: 被诅咒的术语

original: The Curator, being a human man with a thin moustache, as opposed to a cloaked, winged monster – stares blankly at the lump of wax in your hand. "I do not understand," he says. "And things that I do not understand, I rarely approve of. Kindly take that from my sight."
translation: 那位收藏家，一只扮作留着稀疏胡子的人类的，披着斗篷的有翅怪物，他正茫然地盯着你手中的蜡块。“我不理解，”他说。“而对于我不理解的事情，我几乎不会赞成。请把它从我眼前拿走。”

original: The Salon just off Valentine Square
translation: 情人节广场附近的沙龙

original: [qvd:136783(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136783(SletDescription)]

original: Help settle the dispute over the Salon
translation: 帮助解决沙龙的争端

original: What should its primary function be?
translation: 它的主要功能应该是什么？

original: A war of relaxation
translation: 放松的争论

original: Everyone agrees that the Salon, in whatever form it takes, should be a place to relax. So far, however, the arguments only seem to be winding everybody up.
translation: 每个人都同意，沙龙，无论它采取什么形式，都应该是一个放松的地方。然而，到目前为止，这些争论似乎只是让大家更加激动了。

original: Advocate for a pub
translation: 主张建立一个酒吧

original: A place to relax, when creativity isn't flowing.
translation: 当创造力枯竭时，一个放松的地方。

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Advocate for a tea shop
translation: 主张建立一个茶馆

original: A quiet, civilised place for artistic talk, revolutionary musings, and perhaps even a cup of coffee.
translation: 这是一个安静、文明的地方，可以进行艺术交谈、革命性沉思，甚至还可以来杯咖啡。

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Advocate for a Speaker's Corner
translation: 主张建立一个演说角

original: A place for performance art, from poems to blistering rhetoric about the Empress – in a place where she is unlikely to ever hear about it.
translation: 这是表演艺术的场所，从诗歌到对女王的激烈言论——女王不大可能听到这些。

original: "Good, good." The Melancholy Poet seems to care little for the decision, as long as it stays made. "Do that. Hurry up. Before anyone complains."
translation: “好，好。”忧郁的诗人似乎并不太在意这个决定，只要决定已经做了就行。“就这么做吧。快点。在有人抱怨之前。”

original: Leave them to their arguments
translation: 让他们去争论

original: They won't be resolving them any time soon.
translation: 他们不会很快解决这些问题。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: There is nothing more you need to do here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么你可做的了。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
Everyone in town passes through here eventually. The stories the regulars must have!
[Every Captain can request one boon. This will give you 5 Salon-Stewed Gossip.]
translation:
镇上的人最终都会经过这里。这些常客一定有很多故事吧！
[每位车长可以请求一个恩惠。这将为您带来5来源不明的小道消息。]

original: Stories indeed!
translation: 确实有故事！

original: The problem is not getting the regulars to talk, but in getting them to talk slowly enough for you to write it down. You leave struggling to find your feet after all of the free drinks, with your mind humming by the possibilities of what you have learned.
translation: 问题不在于让常客开口说话，而在于让他们说得足够慢，以便你能把他们的话写下来。喝完免费酒水后，你努力站稳脚跟，头脑里回响着你所学到的东西的各种可能性。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The tea is particularly fine here. A few samples would be welcome.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you 3 Caddies of Dried Tea. Be sure you have cargo space.]
translation:
这里的茶特别好。欢迎品尝几种样品。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩赐。这将给您3罐干茶。请确保您有足够的货物空间。]

original: Marketing in action
translation: 实战营销

original: The owner of the salon is happy to give you a little of his tea, if you will tell anyone you might give it to where it came from. An equitable enough transaction.
translation: 沙龙的主人很乐意给你一点他的茶，如果你能告诉你可能给的人关于茶的来源。一个足够公平的交易。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
You can get a front-row seat at Puck's Corner. Angry Jack is about to rant.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will get you 4 Savage Secrets.]
translation:
你可以在帕克之角获得前排座位。愤怒杰克即将开始咆哮。
[每位车长都可以请求一次恩惠，这会使你获得4个残酷的秘密。]

original: Seek him here, seek him there
translation: 在这里找他，在那里找他

original: Who is Angry Jack? Angry Jack doesn't remember. But Angry Jack recalls so much else. Things that make Angry Jack furious. Most laughed off away the other listeners, but you're close enough to hear the ring of truth in his words. Finally, Angry Jack silences, temporarily exhausted. You leave, your notebook full of furious scribblings.
translation: 谁是愤怒杰克？愤怒杰克不记得了。但是愤怒杰克记得许多别的事情。那些让愤怒杰克愤怒的事情。大多数听众对此一笑置之，但你足够接近，能听到他话语中真理的回音。最后，愤怒杰克沉默了，他暂时精疲力竭。你离开了，你的笔记本上写满了愤怒的涂鸦。

original: The Academy in Bloom Bower
translation: 花亭中的学院

original: [qvd:136781(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136781(SletDescription)]

original: Help choose a Poetry School for the Academy
translation: 请为学院选择一个诗歌学派

original: Nobody can agree on a suitable theme.
translation: 没有人能就合适的主题达成一致。

original: A war of three schools
translation: 三大流派的战争

original: The Melancholy Poet is surrounded by three representatives of Albion's great poetry schools – the Nocturnals, the Mycologene and the Bazaarine. All feel that their chosen style should have priority at this glorious new poetry academy.
translation: 忧郁的诗人被阿尔比恩三大诗歌流派的代表人物——夜行派、真菌派和巴扎派——包围着。他们都觉得自己所选的风格应该在这所新成立的、辉煌的诗学院中占据首要地位。

original: Advocate for the Nocturnal School
translation: 提倡夜行派

original: A collection of radicals, embracing the freedom that only the dark can provide.
translation: 这是一群激进分子，他们拥抱只有黑暗才能提供的自由。

original: The Melancholy Poet murmurs agreement. Building begins. Soon after, the Nocturnals have a new home.
translation: 忧郁的诗人轻声表示同意。建造开始了。不久后，夜行派就有了新家。

original: Advocate for the Mycological School
translation: 提倡真菌派

original: The newest of the great schools, inspired by the secret poetry of blemmigans and the sensual allure of fungus.
translation: 最新的一种学派，其灵感来源于真菌虫的秘密诗歌和真菌的感官魅力。

original: The Melancholy Poet murmurs agreement. Building begins. Soon after, the Mycologenes have a new home.
translation: 忧郁的诗人轻声表示同意。建造开始了。不久后，真菌派就有了新家。

original: Advocate for the Bazaarine School
translation: 提倡巴扎派

original: A poetry laced with nostalgia for the old days, when the sky was rock, the snow burned with sorrow, and the night echoed with the beating of leather wings.
translation: 一首充满怀旧之情的诗歌，回忆着往昔岁月，那时的天空坚如磐石，白雪因悲伤而燃烧，夜晚回荡着皮革翅膀的拍打声。

original: The Melancholy Poet murmurs agreement. Building begins. Soon after, the Bazaarines have a new home.
translation: 忧郁的诗人轻声表示同意。建造开始了。不久后，巴扎派就有了新家。

original: Leave them to their arguments
translation: 让他们去争论

original: They won't resolve this any time soon.
translation: 他们不会很快解决这个问题。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: That is enough poetry for now.
translation: 诗歌就到此为止。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The Bazaarine are typically pleased just to see someone show interest in them.
[Every Captain can request one boon. This will get you two Otherworldly Artefacts.]
translation:
巴扎派通常很高兴看到有人对他们感兴趣。
[每位车长都可以请求一项恩惠。这将会为你带来两件异界遗物。]

original: Souvenirs from Old London
translation: 旧伦敦的纪念品

original: The poet speaks of the depths of Old London, and the ammonia tears it shed for the Fifth City. In gratitude for your attention, he fishes around for a few trinkets of value that remind him of the old days, deep underground. He presses them into your hand to keep.
translation: 诗人谈起了老伦敦的深处，以及它为第五城流下的氨水般的泪水。为了感谢你的关注，他四处寻找一些有价值的纪念品，这些纪念品让他想起了过去，深埋于地下。他把这些纪念品塞到你手里，让你保管。

original: Request a Boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The Mycologene School of poetry is pleased to receive visitors.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will get you two Caged Catches. Be sure you have cargo space.]
translation:
真菌派诗歌学院很欢迎游客的参观。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩惠。这将为你带来两只笼中猎获。请确保你有足够的货物空间。]

original: A fungal maze
translation: 真菌的迷宫

original: The stone walls of the academy are already overgrown with vines and mushrooms. Many rooms have been devoted to blemmigan spawning pits. The aroma of the mushrooms and their mulch has drawn in more aggressive creatures. Most are quickly caught, caged and deep-fried, but the poets are happy to let you have a couple of the more unpalatable catches, so long as you promise never to bring them back.
translation: 学院的石墙上已长满了藤蔓和蘑菇。许多房间被用作真菌虫的产卵坑。蘑菇及其堆肥的气味吸引来了更多具有攻击性的生物。大多数生物很快就被抓住、关进笼子并油炸了，但诗人们很高兴地让你拥有一些不那么美味的猎物，只要你保证永远不把它们带回来。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
The Nocturnals have little wish to be disturbed, but traditions must be upheld.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will get you a Selection of Immaculate Souls]
translation:
夜行者并不希望被打扰，但传统必须得到维护。
[每位车长都可以请求一个恩赐。这将使你得到一瓶无垢灵魂。]

original: A short tour, abridged
translation: 走马观花

original: Your guide hurries you through the halls of the Academy without allowing time for questions, or even a quick breath. Cloaked figures glare at you from behind books of poetry. Whispered stanzas are cut off at your approach. You leave with a souvenir of your visit and are sent on your way by the echoing slam of the front door.
translation: 你的向导催促你穿过学院的大厅，不给你提问的时间，甚至不给你喘口气的时间。披斗篷的人从诗集后面瞪着你。轻声细语的诗节在你走近时被打断。你带着访问的纪念品离开，并在前门的回响声中继续前行。

original: The Theatre of Roses Deep
translation: 玫瑰深处的剧场

original: [qvd:136780(SletDescription)]
translation: [qvd:136780(SletDescription)]

original: Help choose a muse for the Theatre
translation: 帮助选择剧院的缪斯女神

original: Every theatre needs one to define its soul.
translation: 每一个剧院都需要一个缪斯来定义它的灵魂。

original: The Nine Muses
translation: 九位缪斯女神

original: Fortunately, the Stone-Faced Sculptor has narrowed the list down to three. "Pity there's no Muse of Vaudeville," he mutters. "Much funnier than this pretentious stuff."
translation: 幸运的是，石面雕塑家已将名单缩小到三个。“可惜没有杂耍的缪斯，”他咕哝道。“比这种花里胡哨的东西有趣多了。”

original: Advocate for Thalia
translation: 提议塔利亚

original: The Muse of Comedy, to bring laughter and joy.
translation: 喜剧的缪斯，她带来笑声和欢乐。

original: The Stone-Faced Sculptor shrugs and calls over his apprentices. He sets them working on a suitable statue.
translation: 石面雕塑家耸耸肩，叫来了他的学徒。他派他们到一个合适的雕像上工作。

original: Advocate for Melpomene
translation: 提议墨尔波墨涅

original: The Muse of Tragedy, to educate and guide the port's morality.
translation: 悲剧的缪斯，她教育并引导这个港口的道德。

original: The Stone-Faced Sculptor shrugs and calls over his apprentices. He sets them working on a suitable statue.
translation: 石面雕塑家耸耸肩，叫来了他的学徒。他派他们到一个合适的雕像上工作。

original: Advocate for Terpsichore
translation: 提议忒耳普西科瑞

original: The Muse of Dance, perhaps with Euterpe bringing the music.
translation: 舞蹈的缪斯，也许应该再来一个奏乐的欧忒耳佩。

original: The Stone-Faced Sculptor shrugs and calls over his apprentices. He sets them working on a suitable statue.
translation: 石面雕塑家耸耸肩，叫来了他的学徒。他派他们到一个合适的雕像上工作。

original: Leave them to their arguments
translation: 让他们去争论

original: They are unlikely to decide any time soon.
translation: 他们不太可能在短期内作出决定。

original: Nobody notices you slip away.
translation: 没有人注意到你溜走了。

original: Return to the Main Dome
translation: 返回主穹顶

original: There is nothing more to be done here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么可做的了。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
Tonight's play is a classic play of horror and tragedy. You can arrange to have front-row seats.
[Every Captain can request one boon. This will get you 3 Tales of Terror]
translation:
今晚的剧目是一部经典的恐怖悲剧。你可以坐在前排。
[每位车长都可以请求一次恩惠。这会给你3个恐怖故事]

original: Death comes to the stage
translation: 死亡来到了舞台

original: As the curtains fall, your crew shame-facedly release each other's clammy hands. You return to the locomotive in silence, your mind aflame.
translation: 当幕布落下时，你的列车员羞愧地松开了彼此汗湿的手。你默默地回到机车上，你的思想在燃烧。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
Tonight's play is a satire. You can arrange to have front-row seats.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will get you 5 bits of Salon-Stewed Gossip.]
translation:
今晚的戏剧是一部讽刺剧。你可以坐在前排。
[每位车长都可以请求一次恩惠。这会给你5段来源不明的小道消息]

original: A knowing piece
translation: 心照不宣的片段

original: As soon as the laughter begins, it becomes obvious why this play is not performed in Albion. It is easy to recognise Lord F______ and Lady D______'s much rumoured 'adventures', and the playwright appears to know a few things the whisper-mongers do not.
translation: 观众席上传出笑声后，这出戏不在阿尔比恩上演的原因就变得明显起来了。很容易就能认出F______勋爵和D______夫人的传闻中的“冒险”，而且剧作家似乎知道一些一般的谣言传播者所不知道的事情。

original: Request a boon of Titania
translation: 请求狄坦妮娅的恩惠

original:
A new opera is due to be performed this evening. You can get tickets for the crew.
[Every Captain can request a boon. This will give you a Moment of Inspiration.]
translation:
一部新的歌剧将在今天晚上演出。你可以为手下的列车员买到票。
[每位车长都可以请求一份恩惠。这会给你带来瞬间的灵感。]

original: Such beauty in song!
translation: 如此美秒的歌声！

original: The music unstoppers your feelings. Tears flow freely as passions swell – mere verse and words could never have this impact. You return to the train unable to sleep: ideas burst forth from that moment when intellect and emotion met. You spend hours feverishly recording realisations before they can fade away.
translation: 音乐使你难以自控。当激情高涨时，泪水肆意流淌——仅仅是诗句和文字永远不会产生这种影响。你回到机车上无法入睡：思想从智力和情感相遇的那一刻就爆发了。你花了几个小时狂热地记录现实，直到它们消失。

original: Meeting with the Rhapsodic Mayor
translation: 与热情洋溢的市长的会面

original: Titania's petals fill the air with a perpetual perfume – but eventually you become accustomed to it. Even so, the scent of the many flowers in the Mayor's small office sends your senses reeling. Obviously unaffected, she sits behind her desk and gestures for you to take the other chair.
translation: 狄坦妮娅的花瓣让空气中充盈着一种永恒的香水味，但最终你还是习惯了它。即便如此，市长小办公室里许多花朵的香味仍会让你感到眩晕。她显然没有受到影响，坐在桌子后面，示意你坐另一把椅子。

original: Return to the Main Square
translation: 返回主广场

original: There is nothing more to be done here.
translation: 这里已经没有什么可做的了。

original: Request a cutting of a petal
translation: 请求剪下一片花瓣

original: The Phlegmatic Researcher in the Leadbeater & Stainrod Nature Reserve has expressed interest in Titania.
translation: 在李德彼特&斯坦罗德自然保护区的淡漠的研究员对狄坦妮娅感兴趣。

original: A simple request
translation: 一个简单的请求

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor is only too happy to oblige you. "I'll have a sample sent to your engine in a moment," she says. "We may not be scientifically minded here, but we do love to learn more about our wonderful flower!"
translation: 热情洋溢的市长非常乐意为您效劳。“我马上就会把样品送到你的机车里，”她说，“我们这里可能没有科学头脑，但我们确实喜欢更多地了解我们美妙的花朵！”

original: Request a cutting of a petal
translation: 请求剪下一片花瓣

original: The Phlegmatic Researcher in the Leadbeater & Stainrod Nature Reserve has expressed interest in Titania.
translation: 在李德彼特&斯坦罗德自然保护区的淡漠的研究员对狄坦妮娅感兴趣。

original: A simple request
translation: 一个简单的请求

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor is only too happy to oblige you. "I'll have a sample sent to your engine in a moment," she says. "We may not be scientifically minded here, but we do love to learn more about our wonderful flower!"
translation: 热情洋溢的市长非常乐意为您效劳。“我马上就会把样品送到你的机车里，”她说，“我们这里可能没有科学头脑，但我们确实喜欢更多地了解我们美妙的花朵！”

original: Ask the Mayor about Titania
translation: 向市长询问狄坦妮娅的情况

original: How can a place like this flourish out here in the dark?
translation: 像这样的地方怎么能在黑暗中蓬勃发展？

original: Flower of the High Wilderness
translation: 天野之花

original: "A spectacular place, isn't it? We couldn't believe that nobody else had colonised it after, well, whoever built all the crystal domes and spires. Honestly, I can't believe our luck."
translation: “这是一个壮观的地方，不是吗？我们不敢相信，无论是谁建造了所有的水晶圆顶和尖顶，居然没有其他人在这里殖民。老实说，我简直不敢相信我们的运气。”

original: Ask the Mayor about Titania
translation: 向市长询问狄坦妮娅的情况

original: How can such a beautiful place exist out here?
translation: 这里怎么会有这么美丽的地方？

original: Flower of the High Wilderness
translation: 天野之花

original: "A spectacular place, isn't it? We couldn't believe that nobody else had colonised it after, well, whoever built all the crystal domes and spires. Honestly, I couldn't believe our luck. Then the chorister hive descended on us. Everything has a price, I suppose."
translation: “这是一个壮观的地方，不是吗？我们不敢相信，无论是谁建造了所有的水晶圆顶和尖顶，居然没有其他人在这里殖民。老实说，我简直不敢相信我们的运气。然后，唱诗蜂群来到了我们身边。我想，一切皆有代价。”

original: Ask the Mayor about Titania
translation: 向市长询问狄坦妮娅的情况

original: How can a place like this flourish out here in the dark?
translation: 像这样的地方怎么能在黑暗中蓬勃发展？

original: Flower of the High Wilderness
translation: 天野之花

original:
"A spectacular place, isn't it? We couldn't believe that nobody else had colonised it after, well, whoever built all the crystal domes and spires. Then we found out that Titania's pollen attracted the chorister hive and that... well, that was less pleasant." 

She smiles. "Ancient history now, though. You really must try some of our fresh nectar."
translation:
“这是一个壮观的地方，不是吗？我们不敢相信，无论是谁建造了所有的水晶圆顶和尖顶，居然没有其他人在这里殖民。老实说，我简直不敢相信我们的运气。然后我们发现狄坦妮娅的花粉吸引了唱诗蜂群，这...嗯，就不那么令人愉快了。”

她笑道：“不过，那已经是历史了。你真的必须尝尝我们新鲜的唱诗蜂蜜。”

original: Ask about work in the Port
translation: 询问港口的工作情况

original: Even a place like this must want for something.
translation: 即使是这样的地方，也一定需要一些东西。

original: A polite refusal
translation: 礼貌的拒绝

original: The Rhapsodic Mayor shakes her head. "I think you will find us most self-sufficient, Captain. Enjoy your visit. Take in some poetry. If I think of anything that we might require, you will be the first to know."
translation: 热情洋溢的市长摇摇头：“我想你会发现我们最自给自足，车长。祝你访问愉快。带上一些诗歌。如果我想到我们可能需要的任何东西，你会第一个知道的。”

original: Drop off a Settler
translation: 放下移民

original: They have arrived at their destination. Whether or not they still wish to be here is another matter entirely.
translation: 他们已经到达了目的地。至于他们是否仍然愿意待在这里，就完全是另一回事了。

original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: You've brought her to her destination, and with a giant bee stinger to boot.
translation: 你把她带到了目的地，还带着一根巨大的蜜蜂毒刺。

original:
She struggles under the weight of the chorister stinger. Your navigator is forced to assist her out over the causeway. She flashes you a quick smile, before taking a deep breath. 

A group of colonists have gathered, drawn no doubt by the severed sting. The settler points back in your direction: a cheer goes up from the crowd. She walks towards them, and does not look back.
translation:
她扛着唱诗蜂刺艰难前行。你的领航员只得上前帮她走过砌道。她向你闪过一个快速的微笑，然后深吸一口气。

一群殖民者已经聚集起来了，无疑是被那断掉的毒刺吸引。移民向你的方向一指：人群中响起了一阵欢呼。她向他们走去，并没有回头。

original:
She gives you a firm handshake before hefting the stinger over her shoulders and departing. You watch her make her way across the station, towards a large group of settlers. 

You make out a few words over the clamour: "Yes, I did it myself. Used a bonesaw – it's the only way. But I must warn you, my services don't come cheap." Then she is lost to the crowd.
translation:
她坚定地握了握你的手，扛起毒刺，转身离去。你看着她穿过车站，走向一大群移民。

你从喧嚣中辨出几个词：“没错，是我亲手做的。用了一把骨锯——别无他法。事先说好，我可不便宜。”随后，她便没入人群之中。

original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: This is where she wanted to go.
translation: 这就是她的目的地了。

original: She gives you a smile as weak as the tea she's been brewing aboard your engine, before making a quick departure. A small purse is all she's left behind in her cabin.
translation: 她给了你一个微笑，就像她在你机车上泡的茶一样寡淡，然后迅速离开。一个小皮夹是她留在在车厢里的所有东西。

original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: You've made good time. They should reward you well.
translation: 你很快地完成了旅程。这人应该给你一笔不错的报酬。

original:
[qvd:131797(QuestEnd)]

[qvd:131798(UnderTimeEnd)]
translation:
[qvd:131797(QuestEnd)]

[qvd:131798(UnderTimeEnd)]

original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: Things might have changed while you were in transit. You may not be rewarded as well, now.
translation: 在你的运输途中，事情也许发生了变化。现在你可能拿不到报酬了。

original:
[qvd:131797(QuestEnd)]

[qvd:131798(OverTimeEnd)]
translation:
[qvd:131797(QuestEnd)]



[qvd:131798(OverTimeEnd)]

original: Encourage your passenger to disembark
translation: 让你的乘客下车

original: You've brought her where she wanted to go, despite her criminal past.
translation: 尽管她有犯罪的前科，你仍然把她带到了她想去的地方。

original: She tips her hat as she disembarks and deposits a heavy purse into your hands.  She whistles a jaunty tune as she makes her way through the station.
translation: 下车时，她向你倾帽致意，把一个颇重的钱袋递到了你手中。她吹着欢快的哨子穿过车站。

original: An Unauthorised Dig in Port Avon
translation: 在埃文村的一次盗掘

original:
The luminous glow of brilliant souls, mined from the ruins, infects this hidden habitation with radiance. 

A group of heavy-set men and women in hobnail boots are just ahead. They are intent not on the deposits of souls but on the hollows amidst the stones, where they are busy burying caches of munitions. 

A crunch of stone behind you. A beam of lantern-light. The burly MacDonald brothers have followed you in.
translation:
从废墟中挖掘出来的灵魂有着灿烂的光辉，照亮了这个隐蔽的居住地。

一群穿着平头钉靴，全副武装的男女就在前面。他们的目标不是沉积的灵魂，而是石头中的空洞，他们正忙着在那里埋藏炸药。

你身后传来石头的脆响。一束提灯的光线。魁梧的麦克唐纳兄弟跟着你进来了。

original: Warn the Tacketies
translation: 警告钉鞋党人

original: If they're discovered, they'll be booted off Port Avon.
translation: 一旦盗挖暴露，他们将被驱逐出埃文村。

original: Whispers in the dark
translation: 黑暗中的私语

original:
You rush in to the breach, startling the illegal miners. A chorus of surprise and alarm greets your sudden entrance, but there's no time for questions. You convince the leader, a hard-bitten ex-prospector, to lead her men out through an alternate escape route blasted into the ruins. 

You cut an expensive deal and stay behind to tell the MacDonalds you were on a night-time stroll when you stumbled on a cave-in. They're more than happy to believe in the stupidity of outsiders.

The Tacketies will be back for their weapons in the future, but next time, they'll be more careful about it.
translation:
你冲到缺口处，吓了非法矿工一跳。一阵惊呼迎接着你突兀的到来，但现在没时间问问题。你说服了领头者，一个顽固的前探矿者，带领她的人从被炸成废墟的另一条逃生路线出去。

你做了一笔昂贵的交易，留下来告诉麦克唐纳兄弟你在夜间散步时偶然发现了一个洞穴。他们很乐意相信外人的愚蠢。

钉鞋党人将来会回来取他们的武器，但他们下次会更加小心。

original: Assist the MacDonalds
translation: 协助麦克唐纳兄弟

original: Tacketies engaged in unauthorised mining of hours? No good can come of it.
translation: 在未经许可的情况下从事采矿的钉鞋党人？不会有什么好结果的。

original: A healthy pummelling
translation: 一场酣畅淋漓的打击

original:
You fall back to stand clearly in the lamplight. Surprised grunts from the MacDonalds; hasty whispering from you. You make the situation plain, and advise a rapid ambush. The MacDonalds do not need telling twice. 

Ten minutes later, you are assisting with the removal of the unconscious Tacketies from the ruins. "We'll make it look like a pub dust up. No one'll be suspicious if I say Angus got a bit lairy." 

The MacDonalds leave you with an assurance the village will be on guard for ne'er-do-wells.
translation:
你向后退去，站到了灯光下。麦克唐纳兄弟发出惊讶的咕哝声：他们慌张地说着些你听不到的内容。你理清现状，并建议他们迅速进行伏击。麦克唐纳兄弟心领神会。

十分钟后，你帮他们将昏迷的钉鞋党人从废墟中抬出来。“我们会让这里看起来像一个落满灰尘的酒吧。如果我说安古斯有点醉了，没有人会怀疑的。”

麦克唐纳兄弟离开时向你保证，村子里的人都会对不务正业的人保持警惕。

original: The Rat Brigade
translation: 老鼠大队

original: The Rat Brigade has made a mess of your galley. Straw, bits of blanket and patches from damaged uniforms have been gathered into a makeshift nest. In contrast: tiny notebooks, battered derringers, and hipflasks – that are not as small as you might expect – are stored with care, stacked in a corner away from prying hands.
translation: 老鼠大队把你的厨房弄得一团糟。稻草、碎毛毯和破损制服的补丁被收拢进临时的栖身之窝里。相比之下，小笔记本、破旧不堪的手枪和烧瓶——它们并不像你想象的那么小——被小心地存放在角落，远离觊觎之手。

original: Talk to the Rat Brigade
translation: 和老鼠大队谈谈

original: Why, exactly, do they need a locomotive? Perhaps sharing a confidence of your own will encourage candour.
translation: 他们究竟是为什么需要登上火车头？或许分享你自己的秘密会鼓励他们坦诚相待。

original: Missing numbers
translation: 丢失的数字

original:
Cinders lights a cigar. "Our Sarge kicked the bucket in the Blockade. But the night before, he told each of us he'd left us something in a vault. Old sod must've been loaded."  

"Thing is, we need his account number to get it. He gave part of it to each of us, so there'd be no thieving. Hence our predicament: that last mission, our Lt sold us out. Half the squad died, the rest scattered."

"We took the numbers off the dead but we need to find the survivors of the company: between us, we have the number. And we still have to find the vault." Cinders grinds her yellow teeth in frustration. "Sarge kept some stuff at Carillon. Doubt it's the vault, but might be a clue."

She cocks her head. "Fifty sovereigns for a trip to Carillon, then?"
translation:
辛德斯点燃一支雪茄：“我们的中士在大封锁中牺牲了。而前一天晚上，他告诉我们每个人他在保险库里留了点东西。那老家伙富得流油。”

“现在问题是，我们需要账号才能取出来。他给我们每个人的数字都只是其中一部分，以防有小偷偷窃。也是因为这样我们才陷入了困境：最后一次任务，上尉出卖了我们。一半的人死了，剩下的也散了。”

“我们从死者那带走了数字，但还需要找到其他幸存的同伴：账号在我们手里。然而还得找到保险库。”辛德斯沮丧地磨着她的黄牙，“中士在钟琴区留了些玩意儿。不一定是保险库，但可能是线索。”

她抬起头，“五十金镑去钟琴区，怎么样?”

original: Ask Albrecht about Sarge
translation: 询问阿尔布雷希特关于中士的事情

original: They're on a quest because of his bequest. What was he like? How did he die?
translation: 他们因为他的遗赠而踏上探寻之旅。他是一只什么样的老鼠？他是怎么死的？

original: The past unburied
translation: 未埋葬的过去

original:
Albrecht is polishing his claws. "Sarge casts a long shadow. He assembled us at ze start of ze Vinchester Var. Ze best fighting rats who came through ze Avid Horizon. He made us a unit."

He adjusts his whiskers. "But ve had no respect. Ve vere expendable. To get better contracts, ve had to be 'respectable'. So he found a rodent of officer class to lead us. Part hamster, I think." He sighs. "And zat's vhere it all vent wrong." He lapses into silence, and will say no more.
translation:
阿尔布雷希特正磨着他的爪子。 “中士的死在我们身上留下了长长的阴影。他在温彻斯特战争打响时便召集了我们。他带领着最优秀的战斗鼠穿过渴求之地平线，使得我们成为了一个小队。”

他理了理胡须。“但我们毫无尊严可言。我们只是可有可无的牺牲品。为了拿到更好的合同，我们必须‘体面’。于是他便找来一只老鼠军官级别的鼠来领导我们。我想他血统里有部分是仓鼠。”他叹了口气。“事情就是从那里开始变糟的，”他陷了入沉默，不再讲话了。

original: Discover what the Brigade are up to
translation: 看看老鼠大队在做什么

original: They know the location of Sarge's vault. They don't seem to want to leave your locomotive. They need the numbers to the account. Where do they think they'll find them?
translation: 他们知道中士保险库的位置，但他们似乎不想离开你的机车。他们需要保险库账户的密码。他们认为密码能在哪里找到呢？

original: Old wounds
translation: 旧伤

original: The air is thick with the scent of jasmine. The rats have acquired a hookah pipe, and are reminiscing over their lost Sarge. Albrecht twitches his immaculate whiskers. "Ve need to find Vilma, our strategist. But it vill be awkvard. She vas Cinders' paramour." There is a snort from somewhere in the nest. Albrecht continues. "Ve lost touch with ze others, but Vilma vill know where zey are. And when ve open ze vault, you vill have a share, of course." "Ze last I heard, Vilma vas residing at Perdurance. As a pet." Albrecht's expression speaks volumes.
translation: 空气中弥漫着茉莉花的香气。老鼠们弄到了一根水烟管，正在怀念他们失去的中士。 阿尔布雷希特扭动着他那整洁的胡须。“我们得找到威尔玛，我们的谋略家。但这会很尴尬。她是辛德斯的旧情人。” 巢穴中传来一声轻哼。阿尔布雷希特继续说道。“我们和其他人失去了联系，但威尔玛知道他们在哪里。等到我们打开金库后，你也有份。” “据我所知，威尔玛一直住在琥珀宫。作为一只宠物。”阿尔布雷希特面容夸张。

original: Speak to the Rat Brigade
translation: 与老鼠大队交谈

original: They have Wilma's part of the account number. Who's next?
translation: 他们已经获取了威尔玛部分的账户号码，接下来是谁呢？

original: A dilemma
translation: 左右为难

original:
Cinders knocks back a shot of something unspeakable. "We have to decide: our medic, Vianne, or our demolitions-rat, Angel. They refuse to work together."

"Lord knows why the Lieutenant kept them in the same unit. Though he did have sponge for brains and managed to bungle betraying us all, so I would venture 'stupidity'." Cinders scowls. "Anyway, Sarge knew we couldn't keep them both. Told me while he was scammered on the gin. Gave both of them the same number." 

[qvd:136956(Dilemma)]
translation:
辛德斯喝下一杯液体。“我们必须做出决定：是我们的医疗兵薇安，还是我们的爆破鼠安吉。他们拒绝在一起工作。”

“天晓得上尉为什么安排他们待在同一个小队。虽说他脑袋灵光，跟块海绵似的，并且设法背叛了我们所有人，但就为这事我还是能说他‘愚蠢透顶’。”辛德斯皱了皱眉头。 “总之，中士知道我们不能同时把他们留在队里。他喝杜松子酒喝得烂醉时告诉的我，他给两人留的号码是一样的。”

[qvd:136956(Dilemma)]

original: Speak to the Rat Brigade
translation: 与老鼠大队交谈

original: Is that all the parts of the account number they need?
translation: 这是他们所需要的全部账号吗？

original: "No."

Petronella explains the situation, while she empties the chambers of Cinders' derringer for polishing.

"So that Lt what shivved us in the back at a critical juncture in return for a cushy position with the Windward Company, right? Yeah, Sarge gave him a number too. Didn't know he was a bad-un. Anyroad, the Lieutenant's got a plum office at Port Prosper. We're gonna have to get in, get his number and get out. Preferably doing him in on the way."
translation:
佩特罗内拉一边清理辛德斯双筒短枪的膛室，一边解释着情况。

“所以上尉在关键时刻朝我们背上来了一刀，以换取迎风公司的一份舒适职位，对吗？没错，中士也给自己留了一个号码。他是不是个坏坯子我不清楚，不过上尉在兴荣港有个不错的职位。我们得进去、拿到他的号码，随后离开，最好在路上就将他解决掉。”

original: Speak to the Rat Brigade
translation: 与老鼠大队交谈

original: You have the number and location of Sarge's account. It's time to head to London.
translation: 你拥有中士的账户号码与地址。是时候去伦敦了。

original: Resolution
translation: 决议

original:
The whole Brigade are gathered around Cinder's nest of spent bottles and old journals. All eyes are on her.

[qvd:136960(Prep)]

The Rat Brigade is ready to head for London.
translation:
整个大队都聚集在辛德斯的“巢穴”旁，那里堆满了用过的酒瓶和旧日记本。

[qvd:136960(Prep)]

老鼠大队已准备好前往伦敦。

original: Spend time with the Rat Brigade
translation: 与老鼠大队共度时光

original: They can be a riot, if they're in the mood.
translation: 如果有兴致的话，他们可以成为一群暴乱者。

original: Rats in the locomotive
translation: 火车头里的老鼠

original: Ask Petronella to continue Sarge's tale
translation: 让佩特罗内拉继续讲述中士的故事

original: Albrecht is sunk in gloom, but she might take up the story.
translation: 阿尔布雷希特陷入沮丧，但她可能会继续讲下去。

original: The past unburied
translation: 未埋葬的过去

original: Petronella takes up the thread, frowning over her glasses, "So we had a new boss: the Lt. Now, he wanted the admiration of Command. But the Tacketies and the Stovies didn't trust us 'cause we was mercs. Just rats, right?" "We did eventually get a lucrative contract from the Tacketies – to sabotage the Governor's engine to stop her fleeing New Winchester. Risky. Who else had the know-how to get it done, right?" Her question is rhetorical; her smile is proud. She pauses. "More some other time, I think."
translation: 佩特罗内拉接过话头，她戴着眼镜皱着眉。“于是我们有了个新老大：上尉。 现在，他希望得到司令部的青睐。但是，钉鞋党人和礼帽党人不信任我们，因为我们是雇佣兵。只是老鼠，对吗？” “我们最终还是从钉鞋党那里拿到了一份有利可图的合同：破坏总督的机车，阻止她逃离新温彻斯特。风险很大。但还有谁有完成这任务的手艺，对吧？”这是个反问：她的笑容里带着自负。她停下了讲述。“下回再聊吧，我想。”

translation: 辛德斯的爪子扣在扳机上。她的胡须颤抖着。上尉给自己倒了最后一杯茶。里面加了五块糖。 砰！几只老鼠跳了起来。吝啬鬼主席骂了一声。辛德斯对着桌子开了一枪。“把他手里的号码记下来，”她咬牙切齿地说，随后窜出了办公室。 上尉喝了最后一口茶，“让我和你一起走吧。这场闹剧之后，公司是不会让我留下的。上车之后，我会给你号码。” 他领着你直接离开了工厂，用别出心裁的谎言驳回了同事们的一个个问题。

Inside is a set of miniature trains. A whole clockwork railway set, commissioned from Icarus & Sons – the renowned toymakers. Petronella examines the set carefully, commenting on the intricacy of the gears, the detail of the antique engines. Then she leaves the room empty-handed.

Now, I've heard a few murmurings of, shall we say, discontent about what happened to the Lt. But he profited from the betrayal, just as if he'd done it himself. So I want no more carping. translation:
辛德斯把小队召集起来。“好吧。我们已经见过了中士留给我们的东西。不是在我们希望的情境下这么做的，但也不是他希望的。现在，我听到了一些杂音，我们可以说，对上尉的遭遇感到不满。 但他从背叛中间接地获益，就像他自己亲手做的一样。所以我不想再听到有鼠抱怨了。我们重聚在一起，走了进去，为那混__做了这件事，并带着战利品出来了！”

老鼠大队中传来一阵沙哑的吱叫声。“没错，老大，”佩特罗内拉喊道。辛德斯恣意地笑着。“去他的中士，”她说，“还有去他的金库吧。现在我们的命是我们自己的。咱们回机车去。”她抬头看着你，“该车长发号施令了。”

original: Leave the vault
translation: 离开金库

original:
You have seen all you care to of Sarge's bequest.
[This will bring the story of the Rat Brigade to a close.]
translation:
你已经看到了你所关心的中士遗赠的一切。
[此举会使老鼠大队的故事来到结局。]

original: Lay down your burdens
translation: 放下你的重担

original: Cinders calls the squad to order. She mounts the stone dais, kicking away Sarge's note. "Now. Some of you may think this was a pointless endeavour. That all we found was a broken rat's regrets. Yes, Sarge was not what we believed. He was a right rotten sod. But did he destroy us? No! We're down good rats, aye. But the rest of us are still here, together, now. How many years later? And that's all down to us." There is a chorus of ragged squeaks from the Rat Brigade. "Right you are, boss," the Lt shouts. Cinders grins fiercely. "Sod Sarge. We did this. We got back together. Grab what you want, then get back on the engine." She looks up at you, "Captain's command now."
translation: 辛德斯把小队召集起来。她登上石台，踢掉中士的纸条。“现在，你们之中的某些鼠可能会觉得这是白费功夫。我们在这里只找到了一只被击垮的老鼠的悔恨。是的，中士不是我们曾相信的那样。他是个该死的烂坯子。但他有没有把我们打垮？不！咱们中是有些好鼠牺牲了，没错。但我们之中还活着的老鼠现在还在这里，重聚到一起。过去了多少年？而这一切都归功于我们。” 老鼠大队中传来一阵沙哑的吱叫声。“没错，老大，”上尉喊道。辛德斯恣意地笑着。“该死的中士。我们做到了。我们终于团聚在了一起。拿上你想要的东西，然后回到机车上去。”她抬头看着你，“该车长发号施令了。”

original: A Nightmare: Hunger by Night
translation: 噩梦：子夜饥火

original: You are ravenous. But the food on your ship is not right. It is food for monkeys. Bats might be content with it. You are used to a different sort of meal, more luminous and harmonious.
translation: 你饿极了。但是车上的食物不对味。这是给猴子吃的。蝙蝠才会就此满足。你习惯的是不一样的食物，更加鲜活，更加和谐。

original: Keep searching
translation: 继续搜寻

original: There must be a meal for you somewhere in these stores.
translation: 仓库里某处一定有你的一餐。

original: The supply boxes chime
translation: 货箱打点

original: Morning finds you in the hold. You've eaten some packing materials, and defiled the actual food. Your stomach is distended. You have forgotten most of last night.
translation: 你在货舱中醒来，发现已是早晨。你吃掉的是包装袋，糟蹋的是食物。你肚子发胀，几乎想不起昨晚的事情。

original: Eat from a live container
translation: 从活皮囊里取食

original:
This crew member won't remember afterward. You need not even bite the body.
[Reduce your Terror by 50, but increase your Nightmares.]
translation:
这列车员不会记得的。甚至无需咬下他的皮肉。
[降低50恐惧，但你的噩梦会加深。]

original: Unexplained death
translation: 无从解释的死亡

original: The corpse is in the hallway in the morning. There are no wounds and no signs of illness on the deceased. His face bears an expression of... would you call that beatific recognition? What could have happened to the poor man?
translation: 早晨，某人横尸门厅。死人身上没有发现伤口，也没有生病的迹象。他的表情是……某种极乐的认同吗？这可怜虫遭遇了什么？

original: Eat something exotic
translation: 吃些奇异的东西

original: Has it been exposed to starlight? Does the meat remember?
translation: 它被星光照耀过吗？这肉会不会记得？

original: Your teeth buzz
translation: 牙齿微鸣

original:
There is a satisfaction that you feel somewhere in the penultimate molars and the base of the skull when you eat a meal like this. It is a matter of texture and rhythm and complexity. 

Your stomach continues to appreciate its intricate resistance, its barbed, bony, unwilling flesh, as you doze off.
translation:
你饱餐一顿，臼齿和颅底便感受到满足。是它的质感，韵律和复杂构造所致。

你逐渐入睡时，肠胃仍在品味那盘根错节的阻力，和那生刺、骨质、不甘心的血肉。

original: A Nightmare: Your Memoirs
translation: 噩梦：你的回忆录

original:
You've been meaning to do this for a long time: write down your true history, someplace not for public consumption, the version you might not tell to strangers.

Chapter One comes quickly and fluidly to your pen. There is comfort in remembering things you have not thought of in a long time. But now what?
translation:
你早就想这么做了：在某个不为人知的地方，写下你真实的过去。你不会和陌生人吐露的版本。

你迅速流畅地写完第一章。回忆起很久没想过的东西，是一种安慰。但是，然后呢？

original: Lock it in a drawer
translation: 把它锁进抽屉

original:
Best if no one else reads this.
[Reduce your Terror by 50, but increase your Nightmares.]
translation:
最好别让别人读到它。
[使你的恐惧值降低50，但增加你的噩梦值。]

original: The drawer is full
translation: 抽屉塞满了

original:
Your private drawer, to which only you have the key. Other manuscripts, all in your handwriting. Chapter One after Chapter One after Chapter One. Some of the incidents are the same – or nearly so – but the motives are different, the chronology jumbled. Some of the happenings definitely did not happen to you. This one has a signature at the end. Your signature looks a bit like that, but you don't use that peculiar flourish, not since... when did you stop?

The hull creaks. You recall yourself. Stack the manuscripts more neatly, cram the drawer shut. Lock it. Only you have the key.
translation:
只有你一人有钥匙的、私人的抽屉。其他的手稿，全是你的笔迹。第一章接着第一章接着第一章。其中有些事件是一样的——或者大致如此——但动机全然不同，顺序也混乱不堪。其中有些事情你绝对没经历过。这一张结尾有个签名。你的签名和它有点像，但你自从某时某刻就再也不用那种花笔了……是什么时候开始的来着？

车体吱嘎作响。你回过神来。把手稿整齐叠好，紧紧关上抽屉。上好锁。只有你一人有钥匙。

original: Burn it
translation: 烧掉它

original: This was an exercise only for yourself.
translation: 这只是你在自娱自乐。

original: A bonfire of fiction
translation: 虚构的篝火

original:
The pages smoke, then curl to black. Here and there you can see a phrase long enough to read it back before the fire consumes it. 

Already these memories are strange and belong to someone else. When did you ever wear a cloak of peacock feathers? When did you submit to having your tongue tattooed? For that matter, did these things ever happen to anyone? What an outrageous set of lies. Whoever wrote this must have been an extraordinary fabulist.

It was no one you know, at least. The fire burns down, the ashes crumble, and you are warm enough to go back to bed.
translation:
纸页冒起烟，然后卷曲变黑。你时不时能瞥到一两个短语，可以在火焰将其烧毁之前将它们读完。

这些记忆已经变得陌生，好像属于别人似的。你什么时候穿过孔雀羽毛做的斗篷？什么时候接受过在舌头上刺青？说真的，这些事情会有别人经历过吗？真是鬼话连篇。写下这些的人一定非常擅长胡编乱造。

至少那个人你肯定不认识。火焰烧尽，灰烬崩碎，而你也暖和起来，可以回去睡觉了。

original: Share it with a trusted crew member
translation: 与一位值得信赖的列车员分享它

original:
Being alone with these thoughts is what makes them so difficult.
[The higher your own Veils, the harder this will be.]
translation:
正是因为你独自承受这些想法，它们才会如此难以面对。
[你的面纱越高，这就越困难。]

original: An unsympathetic audience
translation: 毫无同情心的听众

original:
"Again?" he asks. 

This is upsetting. It is confusing. It displeases you. But you rein in the bad feelings and merely yell at your crewman. Next time this happens, he'll know better. He'll pretend he's never heard your secret memoirs before.

That's best for everyone.
translation:
“又来？”他问道。

这真是令人难过又困惑。你很不高兴。但你压下了坏情绪，仅仅是对那位列车员大喊大叫。等到下次，他会好好表现。他会假装从来没听说过你的秘密回忆录。

这对大家都好。

original: An unsympathetic audience
translation: 毫无同情心的听众

original:
"Again?" he asks.

Then he starts narrating the other versions you've written, and it's hard to hear. You lose track for a while, and when you return to yourself, you're down a crew member.
translation:
“又来？”他问道。

然后他叙述起你笔下的其他版本。你几乎没听懂。你走了一会神。等回过神来，你已经少了一位列车员。

original: Lock it in a drawer
translation: 把它锁进抽屉

original:
Best if no one else reads this.
[Your Terror will increase.]
translation:
最好别让别人读到它。
[你的恐惧会增加。]

original: The drawer is full
translation: 抽屉塞满了

original:
Your private drawer, to which only you have the key. Other manuscripts, all in your handwriting. Chapter One after Chapter One after Chapter One. Some of the incidents are the same – or nearly so – but the motives are different, the chronology jumbled. Some of the happenings definitely did not happen to you. This one has a signature at the end. Your signature looks a bit like that, but you don't use that peculiar flourish, not since... when did you stop?

The hull creaks. You recall yourself. Stack the manuscripts more neatly, cram the drawer shut. Lock it. Only you have the key.
translation:
只有你一人有钥匙的、私人的抽屉。其他的手稿，全是你的笔迹。第一章接着第一章接着第一章。其中有些事件是一样的——或者大致如此——但动机全然不同，顺序也混乱不堪。其中有些事情你绝对没经历过。这一张结尾有个签名。你的签名和它有点像，但你自从某时某刻就再也不用那种花笔了……是什么时候开始的来着？

车体吱嘎作响。你回过神来。把手稿整齐叠好，紧紧关上抽屉。上好锁。只有你一人有钥匙。

original: A Nightmare: They Speak of You
translation: 噩梦：他们在议论你

original: The crew fall silent when you enter a room. One avoids being touched by your shadow. Another never meets your eye. Do they suspect? What do they suspect?
translation: 当你进入房间时，列车员们都沉默了。其中一位避开你的影子。另一位躲开你的目光。他们怀疑你吗？怀疑什么？

original: Ignore it
translation: 无视

original: They're not here. Remember? Your crew is all gone.
translation: 他们不在这儿。记得吗？你的列车员们都走了。

original: They're gone
translation: 他们走了

original:
It only feels like they're talking about you. Really, you're rid of them. There's no one left to notice anything amiss. If you go to sleep, in the morning you'll be alone.

That doesn't stop them from shouting at you as you walk away.
translation:
你只是觉得他们在谈论你。其实你早就摆脱他们了。没有人在，也没人会注意到不妥之处。等你睡下，第二天早晨醒来就又是独自一人。

但你走开时，他们还是冲着你大喊大叫。

original: Remove the most suspicious one
translation: 除掉最可疑的那个

original: That one, in the corner.
translation: 就是躲在角落里的那个。

original: What foolishness
translation: 如此愚行

original:
He says you have strange eyes. He says your eyebrows don't match. He says you've taken in too much starlight and that your cheeks are not made of skin. He says that there's a demon caught in the back of your throat who screams when you try to give orders.

It's all nonsense, but you can't have disrespectful rumours going around on your own ship, can you?
translation:
他说你的眼睛不对劲。他说你的眉毛不对称。他说你照了太多星光，你的脸颊已经不再是皮肤了。他说你喉咙深处有个魔鬼，你试图发号施令时，是他在尖叫。

这都是胡说八道。但你不能任由不敬的谣言在车上流传，对吧？

original: Put a smile on your face
translation: 强装微笑

original:
There is nothing for them to notice. There is nothing amiss. Everything is just as it should be.
[Reduce your Terror by 50, but increase your Nightmares.]
translation:
他们没什么好注意的。没什么不对劲。一切都理所当然。
[降低50恐惧，但你的噩梦会加深。]

original: You should smile more
translation: 你应该多笑一笑

original:
See? This thing that you are doing with your face is called smiling. It means everything is fine, and there is nothing to fear.

You crew begin to talk, loudly, about the weather. You can smell the stink of them. The reek of their always-dying flesh.
translation:
看到了吗？你脸上的这个叫做微笑。这就意味着一切都好，没什么好害怕的。

列车员们开始大声谈论天气。你能闻到他们身上的臭味。他们那持续死亡的肉体的臭气。

original: The New Somerset Hunting Club
translation: 新萨默塞特狩猎俱乐部

original: Thick cigar smoke curls through the air, filling this private chamber with premium grade fog. Bloated gentlemen in well-worn military uniforms sit at mahogany tables, sipping port. They chunter of the old days and how very much better they were.
translation: 浓厚的雪茄烟在空气中袅袅升起，使这个私人房间充满了高档的雾气。穿着老旧军装的臃肿先生们坐在红木桌前，啜饮波特酒。他们喋喋不休地谈论着过去的日子，以及那些日子比现在有多好。

original: Request membership of the Club
translation: 申请加入狩猎俱乐部

original: It was a famous club in Old London, home to not just nobles and distinguished soldiers, but ex-ministers, royal courtiers, and other members of high society.
translation: 在旧伦敦这曾是一个著名的俱乐部，成员不仅有贵族和杰出的士兵，还有前部长、皇家大臣和其他上流社会成员。

original: Our sort of people...
translation: 我等人士……

original:
A Stout Veteran gives you a polite once-over. "Hmm. I suppose we could countenance an application. Of course, membership is not a matter of mere money! No, no."

He directs your attention to the trophies. Most are old and musty; Neath creatures, deer, foxes and a bear, all hunted in the members' now long-distant youth. 

"Perhaps if you could help decorate our walls with some impressive local fauna, we can talk matters of first payment, and then membership. Of course, we could hunt the beasties ourselves, and we will – by thunder, we will! But the fire is so warm, and there is port left in the bottle."
translation:
一个粗壮的老兵很有礼貌地看了你一眼。“嗯，我想我们可以考虑接受申请。当然，入会不是一个单纯的钱的问题！不不不。”

他把你的注意力引向了那些奖杯。它们大多数都陈旧发霉：尼斯生物、鹿、狐狸和一只熊，都是在成员们遥远的青春时猎取的。

“也许，如果你能用一些令人印象深刻的当地动物来装饰我们的墙壁，我们就可以先后商谈付款问题与入会问题。当然，我们可以自己去猎取这些野兽，我们会以雷霆之势去猎取！但这里的火实在是太过温暖，而且瓶子里还有波特酒没喝完。”

original: Deliver a Cantankeri Trophy
translation: 交出从顽固虱上收集到的战利品

original: The club will pay to hang this on their wall.
translation: 俱乐部会付给你钱来让这东西挂在他们的墙上。

original: Mounted and delivered
translation: 安装并交付

original: The Stout Veteran pokes it. "What a horrible creature." He twiddles his bushy moustache. "A perfect centrepiece! Jenkins, fetch the hoist."
translation: 粗壮的老兵戳了戳它。“多么可怕的生物啊。”他捻着浓密的小胡子。“完美的餐桌中心装饰！詹金斯，去把起重器拿来。”

original: Deliver a Chorister Bee Trophy
translation: 交出从唱诗蜂上收集到的战利品

original: The glassy, multifaceted stare will reflect the firelight prettily.
translation: 在火光的映照下，它那玻璃般多面的复眼会显得很漂亮。

original: Mounted and delivered
translation: 安装并交付

original: The Stout Veteran looks deep into its eyes. "Not so tough now, are we?" he crows. "Jenkins, fetch the nails."
translation: 粗壮的老兵凝视着它的眼睛。“现在不神气了，对吧？”他叫道，“詹金斯，拿钉子来。”

original: Deliver a Scrive-Spinster Trophy
translation: 交出从纺书人上收集到的战利品

original: They may need to clear some extra space on the wall.
translation: 他们可能需要在墙上清理出一些额外的空间。

original: Mounted and delivered
translation: 安装并交付

original: The Stout Veteran refuses to touch it. "In my day, we never had nonsense like this, you know. It was all marsh-wolves and ambulatory fungus: good sensible hunting! I mean what even is this? I feel like it's watching me, and it doesn't even have any eyes. Jenkins! Put it somewhere I won't see it."
translation: 粗壮的老兵对它碰都不碰。“你要知道，在我那个年代，我们从来没有狩猎过这样不可理喻的东西。我们打的都是沼泽狼和移动真菌：上好且可理喻的狩猎！我的意思是，这到底算是个什么东西？我感觉它在看着我，但它甚至没有眼睛。詹金斯！放在我看不到的地方。”

original: Ask about your membership
translation: 询问你的会员资格

original: You've filled their wall. Now to talk about your membership.
translation: 你已经用战利品填满了他们的墙。现在得谈谈你的会员资格了。

original: Policies and Such
translation: 政策之类的

original: "Ah, yes." The Stout Veteran twiddles his bushy moustache. "Of course, you will be most welcome, once a spot opens up. Dead men's shoes, I'm afraid, and our chaps do rather cling to their place at the bar. But do come and meet everyone. I'm certain they will be thrilled to hear your stories, and slip your name to the right kind of people."
translation: “啊，没错。”粗壮的老兵捻着他浓密的小胡子。“当然，一旦有空位，我们将非常欢迎你。现在的情况恐怕是前人的屁股占着后人的座。而我们现在的年轻人就宁愿守在酒吧的座位上。但一定要来见见大家。我确信他们会很想听听你的故事，并将你的名字告诉合适的人。”

original: An Abandoned Signal Box
translation: 一个被遗弃的信号箱

original:
[qvd:137035(Description)]

Inside, beneath a desk covered with rusted levers, is a luggage trunk. Captains in dire need can borrow from the cache inside, but custom dictates they must later replenish it.
translation:
[qvd:137035(Description)]

里面，一张布满锈迹斑斑的操纵杆的桌子下面，藏着一个行李箱。急需物资的车长可以从里面借用，但按照惯例，他们之后必须把箱子里的物品补足。

original: Read the ledger
translation: 阅读分类账

original:
Captains who withdraw from the cache (should) note their name and ship, and what they took. Occasionally, they add anecdotes.
[You will gain a Vision of the Heavens or Sky-Stories.]
translation:
从储物箱里取走东西的车长（应该）写下他们的名字和列车名，以及他们拿走了什么。偶尔，他们也会写下一些传闻。
[你将获得天界风景或高天轶事。]

original: A recent entry
translation: 最近的一个条目

original:
The hand writing is poor, but legible. Captain [qvd:137046(Captain)] [qvd:137047(Deposited)].

There is a column for 'miscellaneous notes'. [qvd:137056(Notes)]
translation:
字迹很差，但仍可辨认。[qvd:137046(Captain)]车长[qvd:137047(Deposited)]。

在“杂项注释”那一列，[qvd:137056(Notes)]

original: A recent entry
translation: 最近的一个条目

original:
The hand writing is poor, but legible. Captain [qvd:137046(Captain)] [qvd:137047(Deposited)]. 

There is a column for 'miscellaneous notes'. [qvd:137057(Notes)]
translation:
字迹很差，但仍可辨认。[qvd:137046(Captain)]车长[qvd:137047(Deposited)]。

在“杂项注释”那一列，[qvd:137057(Notes)]

original: Raid the cache
translation: 取走储物箱里面的东西

original: A captain who takes from a cache must later replenish it. This may mean enemy aids enemy, rival succours rival. Better that, than bad luck.
translation: 从储物箱取出物品的车长在之后必须往里面补充物品。这或许意味着敌手互助，仇雠施援。不过最好是按习俗说的做 ，而不是遭遇厄运。

original: Resupply the cache
translation: 补充储物箱

original: You have a skyfarer's debt. If you leave it unpaid, your crew fear it will bring bad luck.
translation: 你背着一笔行天客的债务。你的列车员担心若你不偿还，它便会带来厄运。

original: Leave
translation: 离开

original: This place was a folly. Already nature strives to claim it. It's not a place to linger.
translation: 这个地方愚蠢透顶。自然界已经在奋力侵蚀着它。这不是一个可以逗留的地方。

original: Away
translation: 离开

original: The stokers work vigorously. This place makes them yearn for the riotous camaraderie of New Winchester.
translation: 司炉们卖力地工作。这地方让他们怀念起新温彻斯特的喧闹情谊。

original: Recruit a Fatalistic Signalman
translation: 招募听天由命的信号员

original:
You detect a whiff of cigarette smoke as you enter. A man in a grey uniform and grey bowler rises from a chair. "Evening. I don't suppose you're looking for a signaller?" He does not sound hopeful. How long has he been waiting here?
[The Fatalistic Signalman is an officer: a signaller who increases your Mirrors by 6, Veils by 2, and Villainy by 1.]
translation:
一进门你就察觉到一丝香烟味。一个穿着灰色制服、戴着灰色礼帽的人从椅子上站了起来。“晚上好。我想你不会正好是在找一个信号员吧？”他听起来并不抱有希望。他在这里等了多长时间了？
[听天由命的信号员是一位车务官，他是一名可使你的镜子+6，面纱+2，人脉：恶棍+1的信号员。]

original: A break from duty
translation: 休假

original:
He is startled by your response. "Oh. Right. Was expecting you to say no, to be honest." 

You ask what he was doing here. "I work the Isambard Line. I'm the last one, I suppose. Hitch rides between the boxes, make repairs, sweep up a bit. But I could do with a change of scene." He seems unsure.

"Well, I'd better get my things together." He picks up a modest holdall, and checks his hat is on his head. "Yes, I think that's everything. After you, [qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]."

[You can appoint the Fatalistic Signalman to be your signaller when you are docked in port.]
translation:
他被你的回答吓了一跳。“哦，对。说实话，我还以为你会说不呢。”

你问他在这里做什么。“我在伊桑巴德航线工作。我猜我是最后一个干这一行的。搭信号箱之间的便车，维修，打扫一下。但我也可以换个环境。”他似乎不确定。

“好吧，我最好把我的东西收拾好。”他拿起一个不大的手提包，并检查了一下戴在头上的帽子。“是的，我想这就是所有东西了。您先请，[qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]。”

[停靠在港口时，你可以任命听天由命的信号员作为你的信号员。]

original: Deposit the Signalman at the Battered Signal Box
translation: 在破败不堪的信号箱放下信号员

original: The latch is broken, allowing the signal-box door to bang in the wind. "I won't be long," he promises, "if you don't mind waiting."
translation: 门锁坏了，信号箱的门在风中砰砰作响。“我不会待很久的，”他保证，“如果你不介意等待的话。”

original: Closing up
translation: 收拾

original:
Inside, skeletal leaves are scattered across the floor. Locating a broom, the Signalman sweeps it clear. 

Then he turns his attention to the door. Repairing it is an awkward job for one pair of hands, so you lend him yours. The two of you work in easy silence, one holding while the other hammers; one measuring while the other trims. When you have rehung the door it swings easily on its freshly-oiled hinges, the latch dropping firmly into place.

"Good job well done," he says, as if that is thanks enough. Shutting the door carefully behind him, he hops back onto your locomotive.
translation:
里面的地上散落着风干成骨架一样的叶子。信号员找到一把扫帚，把它们清扫干净。

然后他把注意力转移到门上。修理它是个棘手的工作，所以你帮了他一把。你们两个人在简单的沉默中工作，一个人拿着锤子，另一个人敲打；一个人测量，另一个人修剪。当你把门重新挂好后，它轻松地在刚上过油的铰链上摆动，门闩牢牢地落在原处。

“干得好，”他说，好像这句话就足以作为感谢。他小心翼翼地关上身后的门，跳回你的机车上。

original: Deposit the Signalman at the Overgrown Signal Box
translation: 在杂草丛生的信号箱放下信号员

original: "Look at the state of this place," he grumbles. "Cut it away and it grows back. Fruitless bloody job."
translation: “看看这个地方的样子，”他抱怨道，“把它修剪干净之后，又会不停长出来。没有结果的混蛋工作。”

original: Tidying up
translation: 打扫

original:
Despite his complaint, he prunes away at the vine as neatly as a widow at her window-box. Some recent visitor has left cigarette butts and unwashed cutlery scattered about; the Signalman tidies them away.

Then, taking a key from his pocket, he unlocks a drawer and removes a stuffed envelope from it. It contains old newspaper clippings about the construction of the Isambard Line. Their tone is breathless, exalting the vision of the Quixotic Squire. "Easy to forget people actually thought we'd manage it," the Signalman muses. He stuffs the envelope under one arm.

"All done," he says, clambering back aboard.
translation:
尽管口中抱怨，但他还是像一个窗台前的寡妇一样整齐地修剪着藤蔓。最近的访客留下了烟头和未清洗的餐具，信号员把它们也一并打扫干净。

然后，他从口袋里拿出一把钥匙，打开一个抽屉，从里面取出一个塞满东西的信封。里面是关于伊桑巴德航线建设的旧报纸剪报。剪报的语气极尽奉承，赞美着异想天开的乡绅的愿景。“很容易忘记人们曾经真的认为我们会成功。”信号员沉思着说道。他把信封塞到一只胳膊下。

“都搞定了，”他说着爬回车上。

original: Deposit the Signalman at the Scorched Signal Box
translation: 在烧焦的信号箱放下信号员

original: He wrinkles his nose at the old, sooty scent of smoke that still clings to the place.
translation: 他皱了皱鼻子，这里仍然残留着古老的烟尘气味。

original: Turning the lights off
translation: 关灯

original:
"Some idiot left a candle burning here a year or so ago. Fire made a right mess before the Peacock-wind smothered it. Then marauders started using the old girl for target practice." He pats the wall, sympathetically. "Took me a month to fix her up again, and I've never got rid of the smell."

He gives the signal box a good airing, opening the windows and letting the biting wind blow through. Shivering, he flicks through the ledger attached to the skyfarer's cache, and gives a satisfied nod. 

Before he leaves, he shuts the windows and blows out the lamp. "Can't be too careful."
translation:
“差不多一年前，有个白痴在这里放了根点燃的蜡烛不管。被孔雀风吹灭之前，大火把这里弄得一塌糊涂。然后掠夺者又把这老姑娘当作他们用来练手的靶子。”他爱惜地拍拍墙壁。“我花了一个月才把它修好。那股味我再也忘不掉了。”

他打开信号箱的窗户，让凛冽的寒风吹进来，好好地透透气。他打着寒颤，翻阅附在行天客储物箱上的账本，然后满意地点点头。

他离开之前关上窗户，吹灭灯火。“小心驶得万年船。”

original: Deposit the Signalman at the Spidered Signal Box
translation: 在遍布蜘蛛的信号箱放下信号员

original: He steps from your engine's footplate onto the signal box's porch. "I'm not an admirer of spiders, if I'm frank. Anyway, I shan't be long. Cup of tea?"
translation: 他走下机车的踏板，踩上信号箱的门廊。“老实讲，我不喜欢蜘蛛。不过反正不会待太久。要喝茶吗？”

original: Putting things in order
translation: 整理

original:
He brushes away the worst of the cobwebs, and removes several spiders using a jam-jar he keeps in a drawer for this exact purpose. "This place'll be the death of me," he mutters.

He brews you a cup of tea in a battered old kettle on a battered old stove. Then he tips it away and brews you another one that doesn't have boiled spiders in it.

Examining the skyfarer's cache and the accompanying ledger, he tuts. "Someone's taking out without giving back. Stupid. Sooner or later, the Burrower will get their scent. Anyway, finished your tea?" You return to your locomotive.
translation:
他拂去大部分蛛网，用一个专门放在抽屉里的果酱罐子抓走了几只蜘蛛。“这地方迟早会要了我的命。”他嘟囔着。

他用老破炉子上的一只老破水壶给你煮了茶。他又把它端走重新煮了一杯，这次里面没有煮熟的蜘蛛了。

他检查了行天客储物箱和随附的账本，然后啧了一声。“有人只取不还，愚蠢至极。掘隧神早晚会闻到他们的。总之，你喝完茶了吗？”你回到机车上。

original: Resupply the Cache
translation: 补充储物箱

original: A skyfarer's debt risks drawing the Burrower's attention – or so the more superstitious of your crew say. Still, there are pragmatic reasons to refill the signal box caches while you can. Lives depend on them being well stocked. Perhaps your own, one day.
translation: 行天客若是欠债，就可能引起掘隧神的注意——至少那些比较迷信的列车员是这么说的。不管怎样，出于实用主义的理由，你还是应该尽可能补充储物箱的库存。它是否储备充足对行天客性命攸关。或许有一天，对你来说也如此。

original: Perhaps not
translation: 暂时不要

original: You can't – or won't – afford the sacrifice.
translation: 你不能——或不愿——做出奉献。

original: Restock the cache with fuel
translation: 用燃料来补充储物箱

original: Between you and a couple of stokers, it shouldn't take too long to fill the trunk.
translation: 和几位司炉一起工作，你应该用不了多久就能装满箱子。

original: Your crew's relief at lowering the debt is palpable. Their assistance is willing and eager, making transferring the fuel light work.
translation: 可想而知，列车员们得知可以减轻债务，都松了口气。他们热心地自愿帮忙，所以转移燃料轻而易举。

original: Restock the cache with supplies
translation: 用补给来补充储物箱

original: Salted meat and hard tack could make the difference between a crew returning to their loved ones in port, and a locomotive drifting unmanned in the cold.
translation: 回到车站和亲人团聚的列车员，和全员丧生、在严寒之中飘荡的机车，这两者之间或许只有咸肉和压缩饼干的区别。

original: Your cook pouts when you requisition the food. But he doesn't argue – he understands the necessity of the act.
translation: 你提出征用食物时，炊事员撅起了嘴。但他没有争辩——他也明白这样做的必要。

original: Raiding the Cache
translation: 将储物箱里面的东西掠夺一空

original: The luggage trunk is sturdy and vast – large enough to have held a modest family's worldly goods on the journey through the Avid Horizon. Left here, it still serves those braving the Wilderness.
translation: 储物箱结实、硕大，足以容纳一个普通家庭穿越渴求之地平线时携带的家当。它被留在这里，至今仍服务着天野的冒险者们。

original: Take Fuel
translation: 取走燃料

original: A captain without a locomotive is nothing. And a locomotive without fuel is as good as nothing.
translation: 没机车的车长什么都不是。没有燃料的机车也一样。

original: A decent supply
translation: 充足的补给

original:
Your crew transfer the fuel from the signal box to your locomotive. It is soon safely stashed aboard, in the engine room. [qvd:137020(Debt)]

There's just the question of the ledger. Should you write in it, and accrue a debt? Or take without leaving a record?
translation:
列车员们把燃料从信号箱搬到机车上。它很快便被平安地放进引擎室里。[qvd:137020(Debt)]

还有个问题是账本。要写上去，累积债务吗？还是不留下记录就取走？

original: Write in the ledger
translation: 写进账本

original: You will owe a debt. But this is the done thing.
translation: 你会欠下债务。但这天经地义。

original: Captain's name. Ship name. Home port. Taking or depositing. Reason. There's even a space for any notes that suit your inclination.
translation: 车长的名字。车名。母港。取走或存放。原因。甚至还有一个空栏，用于填写你认为合适的注释。

original: Do not write in the ledger
translation: 不写进账本

original:
Future captains will assume that whoever wrote the most recent entry is responsible for depleting this cache.
[You will not incur debt. Your crew will be unhappy.]
translation:
后来的车长们会假定，写下最近一条账目的人会为库存耗尽负责。
[你不会背负债务。而列车员们不会感到高兴。]

original: Your crew are concerned: you've broken the code. One speaks up. It is too dangerous to be a member of your crew – your behaviour might attract attention. They won't explain further, but they cease work and prepare to leave at the next port.
translation: 列车员们很担心：你违反了惯例。有人出声说话：在你手下做事太危险了——你的所作所为可能引起注意。这人不愿多加解释，但停止了工作，准备在下个车站就下车。

original: Close the trunk
translation: 关上存储箱

original: The cache is depleted. Someone has come before you and taken whatever it contained. Perhaps, in time, they'll come back to refill it. Till then, there's nothing for you here.
translation: 储物箱已经空了。有人在你之前来过，拿走了里面的东西。也许，过一段时间，他们会回来重新填充它。在那之前，这里没有你要的东西。

original: Take Supplies
translation: 取走补给

original: Whoever left these took care that the food was preserved and sealed away. It's still edible. With a bit of salt, maybe even pleasant.
translation: 留下这些食物的人用心地做好了防腐和密封。它还能吃。再加点盐，说不定会很好吃。

original: A crateful
translation: 整整一箱

original:
Two engineers carry the crate from the signal box to your engine. The quartermaster will add it to your stores. [qvd:137020(Debt)]

Should you write in it, and accrue a debt? Or take without leaving a record?
translation:
两位工程师把箱子从信号箱搬回机车。军需官会把它放进货舱。[qvd:137020(Debt)]

要写进账本，累积债务吗？还是不留下记录就取走？

translation: 写进账本

translation: 你会欠下债务。但这天经地义。

original: Take material to repair your locomotive
translation: 取走用于修复机车的材料

original:
Your engine is damaged.
[This will repair 30 hull.]
translation:
机车受损了。
[这将修复30点车体值。]

original: A decent supply
translation: 充足的补给

original:
The stash in the trunk is a valuable one – a large number of steel patches, several blocks of bronzewood. The captain who left all this was kind indeed, or else in desperate need of luck. [qvd:137020(Debt)]

There's just the question of the ledger. Should you write in it, and accrue a debt? Or take without leaving a record?
translation:
箱里的物件价值很高，有大量的钢片，以及几块青铜木。留下这些东西的车长确实很善良，否则就是急需好运了。[qvd:137020(Debt)]

还有个问题是账本。要写上去，累积债务吗？还是不留下记录就取走？

translation: 写进账本

translation: 取走用于修复机车的材料

original:
Your engine is damaged.
[This will fully repair your hull.]
translation:
机车目前受损了。
[此举将完全修复车体。]

translation: 充足的补给

There's just the question of the ledger. Should you write in it, and accrue a debt? Or take without leaving a record?
translation:
箱里的物件价值很高，有大量的钢片，以及几块青铜木。留下这些东西的车长确实很善良，否则就是急需好运了。[qvd:137020(Debt)]

还有个问题是账本。要写上去，累积债务吗？还是不留下记录就取走？

original: Write in the ledger
translation: 写进账本

original: You will owe a debt. But this is the done thing.
translation: 你会欠下债务。但这天经地义。

original: Captain's name. Ship name. Home port. Taking or depositing. Reason. There's even a space for any notes that suit your inclination.
translation: 车长的名字。车名。母港。取走或存放。原因。甚至还有一个空栏，用于填写你认为合适的注释。

original: Do not write in the ledger
translation: 不写进账本

original:
Future captains will assume that whoever wrote the most recent entry is responsible for depleting this cache.
[You will not incur debt. Your crew will be unhappy.]
translation:
后来的车长们会假定，写下最近一条账目的人会为库存耗尽负责。
[你不会背负债务。而列车员们不会感到高兴。]

original: Your crew are concerned: you've broken the code. One speaks up. It is too dangerous to be a member of your crew – your behaviour might attract attention. They won't explain further, but they cease work and prepare to leave at the next port.
translation: 列车员们很担心：你违反了惯例。有人出声说话：在你手下做事太危险了——你的所作所为可能引起注意。这人不愿多加解释，但停止了工作，准备在下个车站就下车。

translation: 取走用于修复机车的材料

original:
Your engine is damaged.
[This will repair 30 hull.]
translation:
机车受损了。
[这将修复30点车体值。]

original: A decent supply
translation: 充足的补给
