Most of all, they will debate its ending – the captain's graceful retirement, described in such simple last lines. Why retire and return home after such a long and illustrious career? Was it a happy ending? Melancholy? Bittersweet? 

Only the author knows.

Your Song is sung; your story over; your name written across the skies.

[This captain's career is complete.]
translation:
完整的天穹之歌广受赞誉，被誉为现代最伟大的史诗。你再也不渴望演讲邀约了，你面对的最大的困难将是读者对续集的不断索求。

未来的岁月里，学者们会细细品读这首歌，梳理其中错综复杂的散文。他们会争论它的准确性，它所传达的信息，但绝不会争论它的功绩（它的功绩毋庸置疑）。最重要的是，他们会争论它的结尾——车长从容优雅地退职了，如此简单的最后一句描述。 在这般漫长而辉煌的职业生涯之后，为何要退职回家？这是一个欢乐的结局吗？是忧郁的？是苦乐参半的？

只有作者知道。

你的歌已唱出，你的故事落幕，你的姓名被写入天穹各处。

[这位车长的事业已经完成。]

original: The Repentant Devil
translation: 悔过的魔鬼

original: He looks younger than most Devils, but he is significantly older. His gaze is blank and yellow, a wall against speculation. He grooms his sideburns artfully, and knows how to be tactful with less seasoned members of the crew.
translation: 他看起来比大多数魔鬼要年轻，但是他其实已经非常老了。他那空洞的、黄色的目光是一堵阻隔猜测的墙。他巧妙地梳理着自己的鬓角，并知道如何对付不那么老练的列车员。

original: Ask him about the recently departed
translation: 向他询问刚才的死者

original: Officers who generate corpses on your locomotive are a liability.
translation: 在你的机车上制造尸体的车务官是个累赘。

original: Under pursuit
translation: 穷追不舍

original:
"He was a stowaway," explains the Devil indifferently. "He's been stalking me for more than a month. I thought I'd lost him when I came aboard. Then he turned up in my quarters."

From the body, he has lifted a clinking bag of souls. "Perhaps he was sent to bribe me rather than to kill me." He tilts his head to consider the soul collection. "Apparently thinks I'm a cheap hire, if so." 

The Devil's gaze reverts to you. "I regret to say, this is probably not the last time this happens. I may be destined to attract negative attention."
translation:
“他偷偷混了进来，”魔鬼满不在乎地解释道。“他已经跟踪我一个多月了。在上车的时候，我还以为能把他甩掉。然后他就出现在我的房间里。”

从尸体上，他提起了一袋叮当作响的灵魂。“也许他是被派来贿赂我，而不是来杀我的。” 他歪着头，打量着这一堆灵魂。“要是这样的话，他显然认为我很好收买。”

魔鬼又看向你。“很遗憾地说，这恐怕不是最后一次发生这种事。我可能注定要吸引负面的关注。”

original: Ask the Repentant Devil about his possible enemies
translation: 向悔过的魔鬼询问他潜在的敌人

original: If he's attracting assassins onto your locomotive, you deserve to know everything. Though he'll see that point of view better if plied with tea.
translation: 如果他不断把刺客引来你的机车上，你应当得知来龙去脉。不过，如果请他喝杯茶，他会更好地理解这种观点。

original: A count of past acquaintances
translation: 旧识的数量

original:
"I have had three particular friends," he says. "Two of them I think are dead, and as for the third... it would not be her style to look for me. But if I were to trace this matter, it would take me to Carillon and to London. And to the Well of the Wolf." 

He catches the corner of your glance.

"You asked about my enemies, I know," he says. "But when you get to my age, it's the same thing."
translation:
“我有三位值得关注的朋友，”他说。“我认为其中两个已经死了，至于第三个……找我可不是她的风格。但如果要追究这件事，我会去钟琴区和伦敦，还有狼之井。”

他注意到你的目光。

“我知道你问的是敌人，”他说。“但到了我这个年纪，两者都一样。”

original: Ask the Repentant Devil about his former friend at Carillon
translation: 向悔过的魔鬼问起他在钟琴区的旧友

original: Or at least, the friend he would expect to find there.
translation: 或者，至少是他期望在那里找到的朋友。

original: Dismissive
translation: 不屑一顾

original:
"I don't make a habit of visiting Carillon," the Devil says. "It would be better not to attempt soul purification at all, than do such a clumsy job of it. Besides, there is the risk that I would be recognised there, if I gave my name. I am the one who devised the original methods they're currently executing in parody. And... well." 

He considers the top of the table. "Hero worship from the incompetent is always awkward."
translation:
“我不常去钟琴区，”魔鬼说。“与其做得如此粗陋，还不如干脆别尝试灵魂净化。此外，如果我在那说出自己的名字，就有被认出的风险。那个他们正在拙劣实施的方案，我正是最初的设计者。而且……嗯。”

他盯着桌面看。“来自无能者的英雄崇拜总是让我尴尬。”

original: Debrief him on Carillon
translation: 向他询问钟琴区的情况

original: He is simmering with the desire to comment.
translation: 他迫不及待地想要发表意见。

original: Past passions
translation: 过去的激情

original:
"If I were younger," remarks the Repentant Devil, "I would take that place from its current ownership and turn it into a fitting demonstration of the refinements of the soul. You! I could even work with you, if I turned your ribs to glass..." 

And he's lost in a reverie, like a tailor seized with the vision of the ideal trousers for a particularly difficult client.

When he recollects that you're still present, he adds: "You may have noticed that they do not bother to prepare each soul to order. That's the real art, of course. Match the Soul to its Judgement."
translation:
“如果我还年轻，”悔过的魔鬼说，“我会把那里的所有权夺过来，把它改造成一个对灵魂精炼的完美示范。你！我甚至可以用你来，如果把你的肋骨变成玻璃……” 

他陷入了沉思，就像裁缝陶醉于脑海中为尤其挑剔的客户设计出的完美裤子。

当想起你还在时，他补充道，“你可能已经注意到，他们并不在意按订单调理每个灵魂。当然，这才是真正的学问。让灵魂和对应的司命相匹配。”

original: Ask him about the Well of the Wolf
translation: 问他关于狼之井的事

original: He looks his most forbidding when you pry into this question.
translation: 当你打听这个问题时，他看起来尤其不情愿。

original: Friends past
translation: 旧日友人

original:
"There is a friend – a colleague – from the earliest part of my life. She died, as far as I know, in the fighting before the Devils went to Caduceus and escaped the Judgements. But that was then. If she is less dead now, I would expect to find her at the Well of the Wolf. She always did have a taste for dramatic protests."

He looks unapproachably morose for a few minutes, then adds: "I have no taste for places that celebrate defeat. But I will go where I must."
translation:
“那里有一位我早年结识的朋友——或者说同僚。据我所知，她战死了：在魔鬼们迁往商神宫，摆脱司命掌控之前的那场战斗中。但那都过去了。如果她现在没有死，我认为能在狼之井找到她。她对戏剧性的抗议总是很有兴趣。”

有几分钟，他看上去阴郁得难以接近，然后补充道：“我对歌颂失败的地方不感兴趣。但如果有必要，我会去的。”

original: Agree to a private rendezvous
translation: 同意一场私下会面

original: Allow him to distract you from the unhappy topic of the Well of the Wolf. He is in the mood for something more carnal than conversation; he says he is curious whether old skills hold.
translation: 任由他将你的思绪从狼之井这个不愉快的话题上引开。他有意进行一些谈话之外的，更加调动感官的活动：他说他很好奇过去的技艺是否生疏。

original: Demonstration match
translation: 魔鬼热身赛

original:
He whispers a command that makes you draw breath: in, in, in, more than your lungs should hold. Your rib cage vaults like a cathedral, your sight blackens, your mouth tastes like a phoenix on fire. 

Then all that you were holding too tightly passes from you in a curl of incense-smoke. 

After this lustration, he too uncoils. Winged, burning, elliptical. This being could throttle a volcano, could summon back a comet from aphelion. The joke and the pleasure of it is that so much should be focused on you, and that you should be able to endure it. Which is his doing too.
translation:
他低声念出一道命令，使你深吸一口气：吸气，吸气，吸气，直到远远超出你肺部的容量。你的肋骨隆起如教堂，视野渐暗，口中的味道就像燃烧的凤凰。

接着，你紧握的一切都随着袅袅的熏香烟雾从身边离去。

在这场祭礼之后，他也展开了。有翼，灼热，椭圆。这个存在能够遏止火山，或是从远日点召回彗星。你竟然经历并承受了这么多，正是此事的乐趣和愉悦所在。当然，他也是这么做的。

original: Ask more about rebelling against the Judgements
translation: 询问更多关于反抗司命的信息

original: Perhaps he will explain more now than he would before.
translation: 也许他会给出比以前更详细的解释.

original: The wrong methods
translation: 错误的方法

original:
"It was a waste," the Repentant Devil says. "The protests, the peaceful fights and the violent ones. We were never likely to win by those methods."

You wait.

"Control what something consumes," he says, "and you control what it is. The feeding of stars is a delicate art. I had spent centuries in cultivating them, studying their palates, watching for evidence of their responsive growth. I had influence. Now, how much can any Devil say the same?"
translation:
“都是白费力气，”悔过的魔鬼说，“抗议活动，和平又或者暴力的斗争。我们永远不可能通过那些手段获胜。”

你等他继续说下去。

“控制某物的给养，”他说，“你就能控制它本身。饲养星星是一门精细的技艺。我花了几个世纪的时间来培育它们，研究它们的口味，寻找它们反馈性成长的证据。我举足轻重。如何，有多少魔鬼能这样说？”

original: Ask him about the friend in London
translation: 问起他在伦敦的那个朋友

original: The Baroness: he's told you that much.
translation: 女爵士：他只说过这些。

original: A warning
translation: 一个警告

original:
"My contact in London belongs to the old aristocracy," he says. "We will find her, perhaps, in the ruins of the palace stables, chewing all the gilding off a state carriage ten years past its last parade. If not there, then some place similar.

"She does not much like humans, unless they happen to be the Crown Prince of a dissolved monarchy, or the general of an exiled army. The fact that you are with me will not pacify her. The last time we spoke, I took off one of her legs.

"So bring a tribute. Immaculate souls."
translation:
“我在伦敦的联系人属于旧贵族，”他说。“我们或许会在皇宫马厩的废墟里，发现她正在啃一辆上一次游行还是十年前的礼仪马车上的镀金。如果不在那，她也会在类似的地方。”

“她不太喜欢人类，除非他们碰巧是解体的君主国的王储，或者是流亡部队的将军。就算你是我的同伴，也不足以安抚她。上一次和她交谈时，我卸下了她的一条腿。”

“所以你要带上一份贡品。无垢灵魂。”

original: Talk about the Baroness
translation: 谈及大胆的女爵士

original: Surely he has more to say.
translation: 他肯定还有话要说。

original: A former roommate
translation: 一位前室友

original:
"I used to live with her," he says. "For centuries, before the republic. She gave me a safe haven. I gave her the wreck of power. I had been something, and now I was not. You've seen how she is. She'll sit in the ruins of the Brass Embassy for a century if nothing dislodges her, feeding her babies on the pulp of diplomatic dispatches."

On the topic of those babies, you rather thought you saw her eat one of her larvae, as you were leaving.

"The uselessness and hiding wore on me. Overthrowing the aristocracy was something to do."
translation:
“我曾经和她同住，”他说，“为期几个世纪，在实现共和之前。她给了我一个安全的避难所，我给了她权力的遗留。我曾是个人物，而现在那已过去。你也见过她的处境了，如果没人赶她走，她会在黄铜大使馆的废墟里坐上一个世纪，用外交文件的纸浆喂养她的孩子。”

说到那些孩子，你认为自己在离开时看见她吃了一只幼虫。

“无用和躲藏让我使我心烦意乱。推翻贵族可不简单。”

original: Assemble the Devil's Evidence
translation: 整合魔鬼的证据

original: Three documents lie on the table, ready to be deciphered and translated from the infernal tongues. Some words are visible only in the right light.
translation: 桌上放着三份文件，随时可以从地狱的语言解码和翻译。有些字词只在合适的光照中可见。

original: He looks as pleased as you have ever seen him
translation: 你从未见过他这么高兴

original:
It takes some hours to sort the matter out, but it becomes clear in the end.

"I have the measure of my attacker now," he says. "If I were a younger Devil, I would even be flattered. My old abilities are in demand. The Sun of the Blue Kingdom has put out a reward for the first person to kidnap me and bring me under guard to Sky Barnet, there to assist in the service of its appetites."
translation:
理清此事用了好一会，但最后一切水落石出。

“现在我已经摸清袭击者的底细了，”他说。“要是我更年轻一点，甚至会感到受宠若惊。有人需要我过去的才能。蓝色王国的太阳已经发出悬赏，奖励第一个把我绑架并交给空中巴尼特区看守的人，让我在那协助满足它的口腹之欲。”

original: Show him your Chorister Bee
translation: 给他展示你的唱诗蜂

original: It is the sort of thing that tends to interest Devils.
translation: 这种东西常常引起魔鬼的兴趣.

original: Raised brows
translation: 挑起眉毛

original:
"That," says the Repentant Devil, "contains one of the King of Carols. It will go on singing in that gloomy way for as long as you permit."

He glances away and pretends to go back to his work, but you have seen it, just for a moment: appetite, curiosity. He is a scientist of sorts, after all.
translation:
“那里，”忏悔的魔鬼说，“关着一只颂歌之王。只要你允许，它就会永远这样阴郁地歌唱。”

他调转视线，装作回去工作的样子，但你已经看到了，仅仅一瞬间：兴趣，好奇心。他毕竟勉强算是位科学家。

original: Make his status here permanent
translation: 给他一个永久职位

original:
Who would he like to be, if he is free to travel with you?
[This will transform the Repentant Devil into the Defiant Devil, a Signaller who increases your Veils by 10 and your Affiliation: Academe by 2.]
translation:
如果他能自由地与你一起旅行, 他想成为什么人?
[这会让悔过的魔鬼变成叛逆的魔鬼，一位可使你的面纱+10，人脉：学术界+2的信号员。]

original: Subtlety, scholarship, room for his library
translation: 敏锐，学识，为他的藏书提供空间

original:
You offer him room to experiment. Freedom to travel. Protection, as much as you can offer, from the interference of any further agents of the Blue Kingdom. Either he is touched, or he has the tact to pretend that he is. At any rate, he accepts.

[You can appoint the Defiant Devil to be your Signaller when you are docked in port.]
translation:
你为他提供实验的空间，旅行的自由，尽你所能的保护，使他免受蓝国任何其他代理人的干扰。他要么很感动，要么老练地假装如此。无论如何，他接受了。

[停靠在港口时，你可以任命叛逆的魔鬼为你的信号员。]

original: Offer him safe haven aboard
translation: 在车上为他提供庇护

original:
Who cares if a Judgement is looking for him? He belongs here with you.
[The Devil's travels with you have led to this decision. It will determine his future.]
translation:
谁在乎司命是否在找他？他属于这里，和你一起。
[魔鬼与你的旅途让你做出此番决策。这将决定他的未来。]

original: He has tried everything but rebelling against the Judgements directly
translation: 他什么都试过，除了直接反抗司命

original: And now, perhaps, it is time. Now, of all times, perhaps it is possible to take action, and have some hope of winning.
translation: 而现在，或许正是时候。或许正是在这个时候，我们才有可能采取行动，并抱有一线胜利的希望。

original: Offer him passage to his new home at Sky Barnet
translation: 把他送往空中巴尼特区的新家

original:
He would be able to serve the Judgement there. It would not be so terrible to have a friend in the Blue Kingdom.
[The Devil's travels with you have led to this decision. It will determine his future.]
translation:
他能在那为司命服务。在蓝色王国有个朋友也不坏。
[魔鬼与你的旅途让你做出此番决策。这将决定他的未来。]

original: He has missed his old occupation
translation: 他一向怀念自己的老本行

original:
"Some people would consider this submission," the Repentant Devil says, leaning back in his chair. "Obeying the command of a Judgement, after all that has happened, after all they have destroyed..."

But it is different for him. To the Repentant Devil, it is a return, a reinstatement. A glorious recovery from exile.
translation:
“有些人认为这是屈服，”悔过的魔鬼说着，靠向身后的椅背：“在一切发生之后，在一切被它们摧毁之后，仍然服从司命的指令……”

但他不这么认为。对悔过的魔鬼而言，这是回归，是复职，是从流放中光荣凯旋。

original: Offer to drop him off somewhere safe for retirement
translation: 提议将他送到一个安全的地方去养老

original:
If he wants to step aside, you can find him a place to retire.
[The Devil's travels with you have led to this decision. It will determine his future.]
translation:
如果他想隐退, 你可以给他找个退休的去处. 
[魔鬼与你的旅途让你做出此番决策。这将决定他的未来。]

original: Will he be happy in such a circumstance?
translation: 这种情况下他会幸福吗？

original: Perhaps, if you find him somewhere the agents of the Blue Kingdom are not likely to look at him, he will at least be untroubled. Perhaps that would be enough. Caduceus, perhaps. Someplace where there are other devils to keep him company.
translation: 也许，如果你给他找个不太可能有蓝色王国特工搜索他的地方，他至少能免受打扰。也许那就足够了。也许可以去商神宫，那个有其他魔鬼陪伴的地方。

original: Ask him about his memories of Caduceus
translation: 问起他对商神宫的回忆

original: He must have passed through there at one time.
translation: 他一定曾经路过那里。

original: He looks distant
translation: 他看上去很冷淡

original: "After the Well of the Wolf," he says, "the Devils could no longer remain in the sight of the Judgements: not if we intended to live. We escaped through Caduceus into Parabola, the place that is not; and from there onward. We were a people in exile. Not strong enough to take a place and hold it for our own. Not weak enough to be welcomed as refugees. It was an intolerable time and I take no pleasure in remembering it."
translation: “经过狼之井一役，”他说，“魔鬼们不能继续留在司命的视线之内：如果我们还想保命的话。我们经过商神宫逃进帕布拉，那个无何有的地方，并从那里继续前进。我们是一个流亡的民族。我们不够强大，没法占领一片土地，将其据为己有。我们也不够弱小，无法作为难民受到欢迎。那段历史让人无法忍受，我不愿回想。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: He surely has an opinion.
translation: 他想必有自己的见解。

original: A sardonic smile
translation: 一声讪笑

original: "Your soul," he lies, "is magnificent. I have studied the souls of men and of angels, I have extracted the penitence of Saints, I have removed the knowledge-lust from an Astronomer through a borehole in the back of his head. I have seethed a Crown Princess' sister in mares' milk until there was no more jealousy in her. But I have never, never known a soul to equal yours."
translation: “你的灵魂，”他撒谎说，“无与伦比。我曾研究人类和天使的灵魂，我曾提取圣徒的忏悔，我曾在一位天文学家脑后钻孔，移除他的的求知欲。我曾让一位女王储的姐妹浸泡在母马的奶水里，直到她不再心怀嫉妒。但我从来，从来没有见过哪一个灵魂能与你的相提并论。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: He must know how it appears.
translation: 他一定知道你的灵魂看起来怎样。

original: He smiles blandly
translation: 他淡然一笑

original: "It is not worth much, in its present condition," he says plainly. "Too flawed. I could cure you of all that, if I had time, and if I cared, and if it were not just as easy to take any of a dozen other innocent souls in a better state of repair. If you want it improved, you might, I suppose, try your luck at Carillon."
translation: “现在的状态下，你的灵魂不值多少钱，”他直截了当地说。“缺陷太多。如果我有空，如果我有意，如果此事不像从另一打无辜的灵魂里，随便选一个稍加修缮那么简单，我可以给你矫正一下。如果想改善你的灵魂，我想，你可以在钟琴区碰碰运气。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: Perhaps he has noticed that it is magnificently slimy.
translation: 也许他已经注意到你的灵魂黏滑非常。

original: Beyond useless
translation: 无用至极

original: "I have rarely seen such a combination of stains, flaws, and disappointing features," he admits. "You are to be congratulated: I assume this was intentional. You could hardly have done it by accident."
translation: “我很少看到污点，缺陷和令人失望的特征能够如此组合，”他承认，“祝贺你：我想你是故意的。这几乎不可能偶然达成。”

original: Converse with your Signaller
translation: 与你的信号员交谈

original: Where is he from? What are his tastes?
translation: 他从哪里来？又有什么爱好？

original: Parrying, suspicion, and a few hints
translation: 回避、怀疑和一点暗示

original:
He sits with his back to the door, and answers your questions with more questions. It's more than ordinary caginess. He does not trust you. Which is strange, considering how hard he wrangled to be aboard this engine in the first place. 

Once he asks, rather abruptly, how long your crew have been with you, and whether you took on anyone new at the last port. You cannot tell whether he likes your answer.

[Perhaps, in time, he will come to trust you more.]
translation:
他背对门坐着，用更多问题回答你的提问。这不仅仅是普通的狡黠。他并不信任你。考虑到他当初如何据理力争以登上这辆机车，这相当蹊跷。

有一次，他很突然地问你，你的班组已经和你共事多久，以及你在上一个车站是否招收了新的人员。你无法判断他是否喜欢你的回答。

[也许，随着时间的推移，他会更加信任你。]

original: Tact but no information
translation: 言谈机敏，却守口如瓶

original: You ask about his past, and you find yourself telling him about your childhood. You ask about his travels, and a moment later you're divulging all of your own recent stops. He is not unpleasant, not in the least, but you can never keep to the track you want to be on.
translation: 你问起他的过去，接着就和他谈到你自己的童年。你问起他的旅行，片刻之后就向他透露了你自己最近停靠的一切地点。他并不令人讨厌，完全不是，但你没法坚持你想谈的话题。

original: A Secondment: Listen to the Devil's Suggestion
translation: 借调：听取魔鬼的建议

original: He has been giving you meaningful glances. He must want something.
translation: 他最近总是意味深长地看着你。他一定是想要什么。

original: A request for leave at the Avid Horizon
translation: 在渴求之地平线休假的请求

original:
He laughs when approached. "Oh dear, a little obvious, perhaps." His gaze is amused and flickers with intensity.

"I have an idea that might be beneficial for us both. I'd like to improve the lives of the workers at the Home Office on the Avid Horizon, if you don't mind permitting me a little shore leave."

[The Devil will generate new Prospects at the Avid Horizon if placed on Secondment there.]
translation:
他在你走近时笑了起来。“哎呦，我表现得太明显了。”他目光愉快，热情闪烁。

“我有一个想法，可能对我们俩都有好处。我想改善渴求之地平线那里内政部工作人员的生活，如果你批准我的离岸假的话。”

[如果被借调到渴求之地平线，魔鬼会给那里带来新的机会。]

original: The Incognito Princess
translation: 隐姓埋名的公主

original:
From the tiara-crested brow downwards, there is nothing about the Incognito Princess that is not incandescent. She is like the sun, and about as dangerous to anything in the vicinity.
 
Wherever the Princess goes, she looks around with a surplus of curiosity and a complete lack of care.
translation:
自戴着头冠的额头而下，隐姓埋名的公主身上没有任何东西不是熠熠生辉的。她如同太阳一般，对周围的一切都很危险。

无论公主走到哪里，她都会带着满满的好奇心和漠不关心的态度四处张望。

original: Prove oneself a fit confidant
translation: 证明自己是适合吐露秘密的密友

original: While she seems incapable of discerning between the two, the Incognito Princess seems intrigued by any mention of derring-do and abyssal horror.
translation: 虽然隐姓埋名的公主看上去无法很好区分英勇冒险和深渊恐怖，但她似乎对这两者都很感兴趣。

original: The truth revealed!
translation: 真相大白！

original:
Thrilled by your tales, the Princess invites you to her quarters. "I have a secret," she says, removing her tiara before donning a second, more expensive tiara.

"I am Queen Victoria's daughter," she says. "I trust your discretion."

It's a considerable ask. This must be the Captivating Princess, the daughter of Victoria who dwells in a miasma of rumours of excess, ranging from red honey to cannibalism. 

A half asphyxiated starling has somehow found its way aboard. It flies to her hand. She pets it gently. "One is travelling to broaden one's mind before one takes on a new role. It would be a delight to meet with the engineers who keep the eternal ball of Perdurance tick-tocking away."

She smiles. You find yourself outside.
translation:
隐姓埋名的公主对你的故事感到兴奋，她邀请你到她的房间去。“我有一个秘密，”她说着摘下头饰，然后又戴上第二件更昂贵的头饰。

“我是维多利亚女王的女儿，”她说，“我相信你的审慎。”

这句话内暗含无数的要求。这位一定是维多利亚的女儿，迷人的公主，生活在诸如红蜂蜜或者食人这类过分谣言的瘴气中。

一只快要窒息的椋鸟不知何故上了车，飞到她的手上。隐姓埋名的公主轻轻地抚摸着它。“在承担新角色之前，人需要在旅行中拓宽自己的眼界。如果我能见到那些让琥珀宫的永恒舞会滴答作响的工程师就好了。”

她笑了。你发现自己不知何时已经离开了房间。

original: Ask what happened at the poetry reading
translation: 询问在诗歌朗诵会上发生了什么

original: A stoker whispered that the inn burned down killing all the poets. Is this true, your highness?
translation: 一个司炉低声说，酒店被烧毁了，杀死了所有的诗人。这是真的吗，公主殿下？

original: Once more, untrue!
translation: 又一次，不实信息！

original:
"No, it's not true, Captain," says the Incognito Princess, lounging on a mound of dead starlings roughly shaped like a chaise longue. She gestures at the floor. Crouching beside the Analytical Suitor is a gaunt man with wild eyes.

"My Poetical Suitor survived," she says. "You really should not listen to gossip. It is no time for gossip! My journey now takes a more serious bent."

She then explains her next destinations. Firstly, she has to find a crossroads in Eleutheria – she's of the opinion they're often south of the transit relay where one arrives. You'll require an Unlicensed Chart there. Secondly, a trip to see the devils in Carillon, on the matter of rings. She might need a handful of bee souls, for that.
translation:
“不，这不是真的，车长，”隐姓埋名的公主说，懒洋洋地躺在一堆形状像躺椅的椋鸟尸体上。她对着地板做了个手势。蹲在理性的求婚者身边的是一个面容憔悴、目光狂野的男人。

“我的诗意的求婚者幸存下来了，”她说，“你真的不应该相信那些闲言碎语。现在不是说闲话的时候！我的旅途现在有了一个更严肃的转变。”

随后她解释了她接下来的目的地。首先，她要在厄琉忒里亚找到一个十字路口，她认为那通常位于抵达时的中转站南部。在那里你需要一张未经许可的航图。然后，去钟琴区与魔鬼们会面，处理戒指的问题。为此，她可能需要一点蜜蜂灵魂。

original: Make conversation with the Princess
translation: 与公主交谈

original: Why is she travelling?
translation: 她为什么要旅行？

original: Ambition
translation: 野心

original: "For a change," she says, with a smile. "After all – I am a princess. The ambition of any princess worthy of the name is not to remain so."
translation: “为了改变，”她笑着说，“毕竟我是一位公主。任何一位名副其实的公主，都不会甘于仅仅停留在公主的身份上。”

original: An audience with the Princess
translation: 与公主的会面

original: So... what now?
translation: 那么……现在怎么办？

original: Tradition
translation: 传统

original:
In the Incognito Princess' cabin, the Poetical Suitor and Analytical Suitor are stripping the skeletons of starlings of their flesh, arranging the bones by type, size, length and so on. The Princess passes time admiring her ring. Eventually she notices you, and some time after that she remembers to speak to you.

"One final step before the big day... and this is more politeness. I am a Princess, of course," she points at her tiara, to remind you, "So politeness is very much my thing."

She needs to find a way into the tomb of the Prince Consort to say goodbye to her father.
translation:
在隐姓埋名的公主的车舱里，诗意的求婚者和理性的求婚者正在剥去椋鸟的骨架上的肉，按类型、大小、长度等顺序排列剩下的骨头。公主一边欣赏着她的戒指一边打发时间。终于，她注意到了你，过了一会，她意识到她得和你说话。

“在大日子之前还有最后一步……这更有礼貌。当然，我是一个公主，”她指着她的头饰，提醒你，“所以礼貌是我非常看重的东西。”

她需要前往亲王陵，与她的父亲告别。

original: Ask the Princess about the fact she's marrying... a devil?
translation: 问问公主，她要嫁给……一个魔鬼？

original: Part of you doesn't want to know more. It's an easy part to ignore.
translation: 你的一部分理智并不想知道更多。但要忽略这部分理智很容易。

original: True Love
translation: 真爱

original: "Not a devil. My devil!" says the Incognito Princess proudly, rubbing her toes on the dead rug of her old self. The Poetical Suitor and the Analytical Suitor are trapped inside bird-cages made of bird-bones, wailing at the news. "We must proceed to the Well of the Wolf," says the Princess, "It's not a wolf down there. My beloved awaits! Soon we will be together! Well, not strictly speaking together. That would be disastrous. But at least married." The Princess takes your hand and looks you in the eyes. "It has been such fun to go on an adventure with a friend," she says. "You'll give me away, of course." It isn't a question.
translation: “不是一个魔鬼。是我的魔鬼！”隐姓埋名的公主骄傲地说，一边在她前身的尸体毯子上擦她的脚趾。诗意的求婚者和理性的求婚者被关在鸟骨做的鸟笼里，听到这个消息后嚎啕大哭。 “我们得去狼之井，”公主说，“下面没有狼。我的爱人在等着呢！很快我们就会在一起了！好吧，严格意义上不是在一起。那会是一场灾难。但至少我们会结婚。” 公主牵起你的手，看着你的眼睛。“和朋友一起去冒险真是太有趣了，”她说，“你当然会把我送到那里去的。”这不是一个问题。

original: Ask her highness about the rumours
translation: 询问公主殿下有关她的传言

original: The crew whisper of all the engineers in Perdurance just disappearing, leaving naught behind but sporadic ghostly screams in the machinery. Is this true?
translation: 列车员们窃窃私语，说琥珀宫里的所有工程师都消失了，除了机械中零星几声幽灵般的尖叫，什么都没留下。这是真的吗？

original: The chatter of starlings and a swift correction
translation: 椋鸟的聒噪和迅速的指正

original:
Two dozen starlings buzz around the Princess' quarters. It takes some time to make yourself heard.

"It's not true," says the Princess, gesturing at a short woman with tall hair and spectacles. "My friend was an engineer. She hasn't disappeared. She's right here!"

The Analytical Suitor sits, staring adoringly at the princess.

"However, I'm glad you're here. I understand that a new poetical movement, inspired by the more melancholic strands of the Celestial School, is meeting in Worlebury-juxta-Mare. I wish to better study this notion 'sadness'. It is quite beyond me."

She smiles. You're outside.
translation:
两打椋鸟在公主的住处周围嗡嗡作响。需要花一些时间才能让她听到你。

“这不是真的，”公主说，指着一位高头发，戴眼镜的矮小女人，“我的朋友是个工程师。她并没有消失。她就在这里！”

理性的求婚者坐在那里，正崇拜地盯着公主。

“然而，我很高兴你来了。我了解到一个新的诗歌运动，受天体诗派中较为忧郁的元素启发，正在滨海沃伯瑞举行会议。我希望能更深入地研究这个“悲伤”的概念。它让我有些摸不着头脑。”

她笑了笑。你已身在房间之外。

original: A Secondment: Listen to the Princess' suggestion
translation: 借调：听取公主的建议

original: "I have a suggestion," she informs you, expectantly.
translation: “我有个建议，”她满怀期待地如此告知你。

original: A statement of intent
translation: 陈述意向

original:
"We should go to London. I have always wanted to open a salon. My sister has one, so I should too." Her gaze is unblinking, but she does not press the issue further.

[The Princess will generate Cryptic Benefactors for you while on secondment.]
translation:
“我们应该去伦敦。我一直想开一家沙龙。我的姐妹有一个，所以我也应该有。” 她的目光一眨不眨，但并没有进一步说明此事。

[在借调期间，公主将为你产出隐秘的人脉。]

original: Alcoholics and Melancholics
translation: 酗酒者和忧郁症患者

original:
You squeeze in the back. There are rows of serious young folk before you. Poets take the stage to chart their woe at the working classes' plight. Or at least, that's what you presume from their gestures – they're inaudible over the chattering of the chattering classes. 

The Incognito Princess is pressed against the back wall. She ignores the rats who assemble to paw worshipfully at her feet.

"I would rather be closer," she states.
translation:
你挤在后排。前面是一排排神情严肃的年轻人。诗人走上台，吟咏着工人阶级的悲惨境遇。至少，你从他们的举止中是这么认为的——他们用的是一种放在闹腾的课堂上便无法听清楚的声音。

隐姓埋名的公主紧贴着后墙。她对聚集在她脚边膜拜的老鼠视而不见。

“我希望能离得近一点，”她说。

original: Shove them out the way!
translation: 把他们推开！

original: The pen is mightier than the sword, but your elbows are surely mightier than a poet's feeble body.
translation: 笔比剑更强大，但你的肘部可比诗人羸弱的身体更强大。

original: A muse in action
translation: 缪斯在行动

original:
A little burly persuasion gets you to the front. The Princess follows in your wake. 

You look up at a poet staring into the middle distance, describing the misery of the hour-looms. Slowly, he becomes aware of the Incognito Princess, stutters, and changes tack – hailing her Highness in celestial verse. Soon another poet steps on the stage, adding her own thoughts on how extraordinarily well the Princess compares to the first day of spring.  Then a third. Then a fourth...

The Princess takes a break from the attention of the poets, and turns to you. "I will meet you back on the locomotive," she says.
translation:
一番强硬的劝说之后，你终于挤到了前面。公主紧随其后。

你抬起头，看着一个诗人凝视着中景，描绘着时织机的苦难。慢慢地，他觉察到隐姓埋名的公主，结结巴巴地改口，开始用天体的诗句赞美起公主殿下。不久，另一位诗人走上台，为诗句添油加醋，赞叹公主是多么像春日的第一天。 然后是第三个。然后是第四个……

公主从诗人的关注中抽身出来，转向你。“我在机车上等你。”她说。

original: A muse in bloody action
translation: 缪斯的血腥行动

original:
You push but you only manage to distress your garments. The Princess' patience gives way and she whistles. Everyone in front of her falls to the ground; she walks over their bodies. You follow her to the front.

You look up at a poet staring into the middle distance, describing the misery of the hour-looms. Slowly, he becomes aware of the Incognito Princess, stutters, and changes tack – hailing her highness in celestial verse. Soon another poet steps on the stage, adding her own thoughts on how extraordinarily well the Princess compares to the first day of spring.  Then a third. Then a fourth...

The Princess takes a break from the attention of the poets, and turns to you. "I will meet you back on the locomotive," she says.
translation:
你极力往前挤，但最终却弄乱了你的衣装。公主丧失了耐心，吹起口哨，在她面前的所有人都倒在了地上。她跨过他们的尸体。你跟着她来到前面。

你抬起头，看着一个诗人凝视着中景，描绘着时织机的苦难。慢慢地，他觉察到隐姓埋名的公主，结结巴巴地改口，开始用天体的诗句赞美起公主殿下。不久，另一位诗人走上台，为诗句添油加醋，赞叹公主是多么像春日的第一天。 然后是第三个。然后是第四个……

公主从诗人的关注中抽身出来，转向你。“我在机车上等你。”她说。

original: Impersonate the gentlefolk of the press!
translation: 冒充新闻界的绅士！

original: Poets are addicts for coverage. Convincing them that you're critics will get you a better position.
translation: 诗人嗜报道成瘾。让他们相信你是批评家，就能为你赢得更好的位置。

original: A critical hit
translation: 正中要害

original:
You locate the best dressed poet and explain who you write for. Her face flushes with excitement and you're hurried to a prime position.

You look up at a poet staring into the middle distance, describing the misery of the hour-looms. Slowly, he becomes aware of the Incognito Princess, stutters, and changes tack – hailing her highness in celestial verse. Soon another poet steps on the stage, adding her own thoughts on how extraordinarily well the Princess compares to the first day of spring.  Then a third. Then a fourth...

The Princess takes a break from the attention of the poets, and turns to you. "I will meet you back on the locomotive," she says.
translation:
你找到这里穿着最好的诗人，并向她说明你在为谁写作。她的脸因兴奋而涨得通红，而你也被催促着来到最佳位置。

你抬起头，看着一个诗人凝视着中景，描绘着时织机的苦难。慢慢地，他觉察到隐姓埋名的公主，结结巴巴地改口，开始用天体的诗句赞美起公主殿下。不久，另一位诗人走上台，为诗句添油加醋，赞叹公主是多么像春日的第一天。 然后是第三个。然后是第四个……

公主从诗人的关注中抽身出来，转向你。“我在机车上等你。”她说。

original: A critical miss
translation: 错过要害

original:
You locate the best dressed poet and start to explain who you write for, only to receive a laugh in reply. That magazine reviewed them abominably in the last issue! You're not getting another chance. Eventually the Princess' patience gives way and she whistles. Everyone in front of her falls to the ground and she walks over their bodies. You follow her to the front.

You look up at a poet staring into the middle distance, describing the misery of the hour-looms. Slowly, he becomes aware of the Incognito Princess, stutters, and changes tack – hailing her highness in celestial verse. Soon another poet steps on the stage, adding her own thoughts on how extraordinarily well the Princess compares to the first day of spring.  Then a third. Then a fourth...

The Princess takes a break from the attention of the poets, and turns to you. "I will meet you back on the locomotive," she says.
translation:
你找到了这里穿着最好的诗人，并开始解释你在为谁写作，却只得到嘲笑作为回应。那本杂志的上一期对那个人的评价很糟糕！你不会再有机会了。公主最终丧失了耐心，吹起口哨，在她面前的所有人都倒在了地上。她跨过他们的尸体。你跟着她来到前面。

你抬起头，看着一个诗人凝视着中景，描绘着时织机的苦难。慢慢地，他觉察到隐姓埋名的公主，结结巴巴地改口，开始用天体的诗句赞美起公主殿下。不久，另一位诗人走上台，为诗句添油加醋，赞叹公主是多么像春日的第一天。 然后是第三个。然后是第四个……

公主从诗人的关注中抽身出来，转向你。“我在机车上等你。”她说。

original: Wait for just one more
translation: 再等一会

original: No, you're not going home yet. Let's see what the princess is up to.
translation: 不，你还不能回家。让我们看看公主在搞什么鬼。

original: One too many
translation: 一个也嫌多

original:
You push back into the public house, to see every poet in the room hailing the Incognito Princess, trying to find couplets to exactly chart the bounds of her perfection. 

"Not so blue now, my sad rhymers!" she says, waving encouragingly at the poets, "You can find the words. If not English, perhaps words more celestial?" After a brief moment, they find a language whose shapes sound ill-fitted for a human palate. They rush on, joyously.

One poet's tongue ignites. Then another. Then a third. Soon, every poet has a mouthful of flame, and still they don't stop. In the middle of the conflagration stands the Princess, beaming.

This seems to be contagious. Best run.
translation:
你挤回酒店，看到房间里的每位诗人都对着隐姓埋名的公主欢呼，试图找到能准确描绘她完美境界的对句。

她说：“现在不那么忧郁了，我的悲情韵者们！”她鼓励地朝诗人挥手，“你们可以找到那些词语。如果在英语里找不到，或许在更天体一点的语言里？”片刻之后，他们找到了一种语言，其音韵之优美，仿佛与人类的味蕾格格不入。他们欢快地四处奔走起来。

一个诗人的舌头被点燃了。然后是另一个。然后是第三个。很快，每个诗人都有满嘴火焰，他们仍然没有停止。公主站在这场大火的中心，笑颜如花。

这症状似乎会传染。该跑了。

original: Use your connections!
translation: 利用你的关系！

original: You're a friend to all poets and all these poets are your friends! If they knew you were in town they'd have saved you a space.
translation: 你是所有诗人的朋友，这里的所有诗人都是你的朋友！如果知道你在城里，他们会给你留个位置。

original: Hurrah! It's you!
translation: 好哇！是你！

original:
As soon as you identify yourself, a spontaneous cheer bursts out. You and the Princess are rushed through the crowd.

You look up at a poet staring into the middle distance, describing the misery of the hour-looms. Slowly, he becomes aware of the Incognito Princess, stutters, and changes tack – hailing her highness in celestial verse. Soon another poet steps on the stage, adding her own thoughts on how extraordinarily well the Princess compares to the first day of spring.  Then a third. Then a fourth...

The Princess takes a break from the attention of the poets, and turns to you. "I will meet you back on the locomotive," she says.
translation:
你一表明自己的身份，一股自发的欢呼声就爆发了出来。你和公主冲过人群。

你抬起头，看着一个诗人凝视着中景，描绘着时织机的苦难。慢慢地，他觉察到隐姓埋名的公主，结结巴巴地改口，开始用天体的诗句赞美起公主殿下。不久，另一位诗人走上台，为诗句添油加醋，赞叹公主是多么像春日的第一天。 然后是第三个。然后是第四个……

公主从诗人的关注中抽身出来，转向你。“我在机车上等你。”她说。

original: Leave early
translation: 提前离开

original: That's enough of poets and princesses for now.
translation: 诗人和公主的事已经让人受够了。

original: Towards the promenade
translation: 向步道走去

original:
Perhaps you've missed a famous opportunity by departing, heading towards the promenade and more civilised citizens? Perhaps this will be a legendary evening, and the true flowering of a movement? Perhaps in years to come, friends would offer snuff and brandy to encourage you to talk about that time when poetry was alive and new?

Perhaps. 

When you walk away you can't help but note that the raised voices sound less like cheers and more like anguished screams.
translation:
当你离开此处，走向步道和更文明一些的市民时，你或许错过了一个著名的机遇？或许这将是一个传奇的夜晚，是一场运动真正开花的时刻？或许在未来的岁月里，朋友们会递上鼻烟和白兰地来鼓励你谈及那个诗歌尚且鲜活的时代？

也许吧。

当走远时，你不禁注意到，那些高涨的声音听起来不像是欢呼，更像是痛苦的尖叫。

original: Heart of Empire
translation: 帝国之心

original:
He lies in the centre of the structure, mounted on a marble altar, caught in a beam of light, resting on velvet cushions.

While the ravages of his illness are quite obvious, he's so well preserved that you could almost think him alive. At which point he coughs.

The Prince Consort lives. It is not a life any would wish for, but it is life.
translation:
亲王躺在陵墓中央，大理石祭坛之上，身下是天鹅绒垫。一束光落在他身上。

尽管疾病侵蚀的痕迹较为明显，但他被保存得极好，几乎让人以为他还健在。正在此时，他咳了一声。

亲王还活着。这不是任何人会想要的活法，但终究仍算活着。

original: Watch a Farewell
translation: 观看一场告别

original: The Princess has something to say and you get to eavesdrop.
translation: 公主有话要说，而你可以偷听。

original: Permission To Consort
translation: 准许婚配

original:
"Daddy!" she says, rushing over, taking his unresponsive hand. "I just knew Mother wouldn't give you up to anyone, let alone death.

"I have such terrific news. I am to be married!" she says. The Princess leaves a moment for him to gasp. He's unconscious, so fails to oblige.

"It's a perfect match. You are aware of the ur-devil who was once the Many-Mouthed – whose children are the chorister bees? It's him! It is a trifle complicated, I'll admit. We plan to maintain separate residences. He's trapped eternally down a well. I love him very much – almost as much as I love the status I'll achieve once we're wed. Do I have your permission?"

A long pause is broken only by a parchment-dry cough as the Prince Consort stirs. The Princess bounces, taking it as a yes. 

"Thank you, Daddy," she says, "Send my... thoughts to Mother."

She drops his hand and almost runs from the Mausoleum.
translation:
“父亲！”她说，冲了过去，握住他没有反应的手，“我就知道母上不会把你交给任何人，更不用说死亡了。”

“我有一个绝妙的消息要说给你听。我要结婚了！”她说。公主给他留下了惊呼的时间。不过他正昏迷不醒，因此没有回应。

“我和他很般配。你知道那位曾经是众口者的太古魔吗，就是生下唱诗蜂的那个？就是他！我承认，这有点复杂。我们计划保持分居。他被永远地困在一口井里。我非常爱他，几乎就像爱我们结婚后我将获得的地位一样。我能得到您的同意吗？”

长时间的停顿只被亲王的一阵干咳打破。公主雀跃而起，认为这算是他同意了。

“谢谢你，父亲，”她说，“请把我的……意向传达给母上。”

她放下他的手，几乎跑着从圣宁墓里出来了。

original: The Final Suit
translation: 最后的皮囊

original:
The Princess' cabin remains a macabre memorial for her departed majesty. The Poetical Suitor and the Analytical Suitor, now freed from their cages, look with devotion at the skin that's slinking behind you.

"It would be an honour beyond all imagining to wear the skin of the divine princess," says the Poetical Suitor.

"No!" argues the Analytical suitor, "I am the only logical choice!"

"You must pick me!" they say simultaneously, frenzied with need.
translation:
公主的车舱仍然是对她已逝威严的一个可怕的纪念。诗意求婚者和理性求婚者现在从他们的笼子里被放了出来，虔诚地看着在你身后轻轻走动的皮肤。

“能穿上神圣的公主的皮肤，那将是一种超乎想象的荣誉，”诗意的求婚者说。

“不！”理性的求婚者争辩道，“我是唯一合理的选择！”

“你必须选择我！”他们齐声说，声音因渴求而发狂。

original: Choose the poetical suitor
translation: 选择诗意求婚者

original:
If it's passion you appreciate, he's the only choice.
[This will turn your Shed Skin into an officer that raises your Mirrors by 10 and your Affiliation: Boheme by 2.]
translation:
如果你欣赏的是激情，他是唯一的选择。
[此举会将你的脱下的皮囊晋升为一名车务官，它能使你的镜子值增加10点，人脉：放荡艺术家增加2点。]

original: The Poetical Skin-Suitor
translation: 诗意的身着皮囊者

original:
Despite the wailing of the Analytical Suitor, you choose the Poetical one. He takes the skin and the membrane moves to enclose his entire body, moving like a boa constrictor, tightening. There is a creaking of bone, and a sound almost like a pestle and mortar grinding flesh. Despite this, it's hard to be sure whether the suitor's smile is a grimace or a grin. In moments, it is done, and the exact image of the Princess stands there. Exact, bar a single detail.

Instead of the most wondrous pair of eyes you had ever seen, out of the jagged holes in her face stare the panicked, delighted eyes of the suitor.

The Analytical Suitor is bereft, withdrawing entirely from all contact. She leaves the locomotive at the next port, without saying a word, clearly believing she has no future.

When the Poetical Princess is informed of the news, they don't care. They care for little now, bar serving and smiling.
translation:
尽管理性的求婚者在哀嚎，你还是选择了诗意的求婚者。他抓起皮肤，薄膜移动起来，包裹他的整个身体，像一条大蟒蛇一样移动，收紧。骨头嘎吱作响，还有几乎像杵和臼磨肉一样的动静。尽管如此，还是很难确定求婚者的笑容是鬼脸还是咧嘴笑。不一会儿，一切就完成了，公主的确切形象就站在那里。准确地说，除了一个细节。

她脸上锯齿状的洞里没有那双你所见过的最奇妙的眼睛，而是求婚者惊慌失措、欣喜若狂的眼睛。

理性的求婚者如丧考妣，完全拒绝一切交流。她在下一个港口下了车，一言不发，显然相信自己没有了未来。

当诗意的公主得知这个消息时，其并不关心。此人现在关心的事情不多，除了侍奉和微笑。

original: Choose the analytical suitor
translation: 选择理性的求婚者

original:
A logical mind may be safer with the skin, and she certainly has one.
[This will upgrade your Shed Skin into an officer that raises your Mirrors by 10 and your Affiliation: Academe by 2.]
translation:
一个有逻辑的头脑可能对皮肤更安全，而她当然有。
[此举会将你的脱下的皮囊晋升为一名车务官，它能使你的镜子值增加10点，人脉：学术界增加2点。]

original: The Analytical Skin-Suitor
translation: 理性的身着皮囊者

original:
Despite the wailing of the Poetical Suitor, you choose the Analytical one. She takes the skin and the membrane moves to enclose her entire body, moving like a boa constrictor, tightening. There is a creaking of bone, and a sound almost like a pestle and mortar grinding flesh. Despite this, it's hard to be sure whether the suitor's smile is a grimace or a grin. In moments, it is done, and the exact image of the Princess stands there. Exact, bar a single detail.

Instead of the most wondrous pair of eyes you had ever seen, out of the jagged holes in her face stare the panicked, delighted eyes of the suitor.

The Poetical Suitor is bereft, withdrawing entirely from all contact. He leaves the locomotive at the next port, without saying a word, clearly believing he has no future.

When the Analytical Princess is informed of the news, they don't care. They care for little now, bar serving and smiling.
translation:
尽管诗意的求婚者在哀嚎，你还是选择了理性的求婚者。她抓起皮肤，薄膜移动起来，包裹他的整个身体，像一条大蟒蛇一样移动，收紧。骨头嘎吱作响，还有几乎像杵和臼磨肉一样的动静。尽管如此，还是很难确定求婚者的笑容是鬼脸还是咧嘴笑。不一会儿，一切就完成了，公主的确切形象就站在那里。准确地说，除了一个细节。

她脸上锯齿状的洞里没有那双你所见过的最奇妙的眼睛，而是求婚者惊慌失措、欣喜若狂的眼睛。

诗意的求婚者如丧考妣，完全拒绝一切交流。他在下一个港口下了车，一言不发，显然相信自己没有了未来。

当理性的公主得知这个消息时，其并不关心。此人现在关心的事情不多，除了侍奉和微笑。

original: Destroy the skin
translation: 毁掉皮肤

original:
It's a living, slithering, skin suit of a beguiling princess. No. Absolutely, not.
[This will not get you an upgraded officer, but has its own reward.]
translation:
这可是一位迷人公主的活生生的、滑行着的皮囊。不，绝对不行。
[此举不会给你晋升的车务官，但也会有其奖励。]

original: Do not suffer the abomination to live
translation: 不要让这可憎的东西活着

original:
Despite the wailing of the two suitors, you refuse their offers. When they realise you're serious, they're bereft, withdrawing entirely from all contact. They leave the locomotive at the next port, without saying a word, clearly believing they have no future.

This leaves the problem of how to dispose of the skin. With a match and paraffin, you attempt to burn the skin. Sadly, it proves resistant to such brute methods. You need something better.

The Princess' previous skin was safely kept at the prison of Piranesi. Perhaps they can look after this one too?
translation:
尽管两个追求者都在哀嚎，你还是拒绝了他们的提议。当意识到你是认真的时候，他们如丧考妣，完全断绝了一切联系。他们在下一个港口下了车，一言不发，显然相信自己没有了未来。

这就留下了如何处理皮肤的问题。你试图用火柴和石蜡把皮肤烧掉。遗憾的是，看来它对这种野蛮方法具有抵抗力。你需要更好的手段。

公主以前的皮肤被安全地保存在皮拉内西的监狱里。也许他们也能照顾好这张皮？

original: A Memorable Wedding
translation: 一个令人难忘的婚礼

original:
An audience of silent devils and singing bees watch the Incognito Princess approach the edge of the well. She says her vows with a feverish delight.

"I have learned of those who would prevent change, and how to thwart them. I have learned of sorrow – and will have sorrow no more! I have found the remains of my old self, and destroyed it to make way for the new. And, most of all, I have the most fantastic ring!"

She leans over the well further. "I will be your queen," she screams. "Will you be my king?"

A distant and incomprehensible bellow bursts from below. The Princess takes it as a yes, and glances at you meaningfully.
translation:
一群沉默的魔鬼和唱歌的蜜蜂目送隐姓埋名的公主走近井边。她欣喜若狂地说出了婚姻誓言。

“我已知晓那些意图阻止改变的人，以及如何挫败他们。我已了解悲伤，并将不再悲伤！我找到了过去自我的残骸并将其摧毁，为新的自我让路。而且，最重要的是，我有一个最棒的戒指！”

她继续向井口探出身去。“我愿成为你的王后，”她喊道。“你愿成为我的国王吗？”

下方传来一阵遥远而难以理解的吼声。公主把它当作首肯，并意味深长地瞥了你一眼。

original: Pass her the ring
translation: 把戒指递给她

original: It would be rude to do otherwise. And potentially fatal.
translation: 如果不这样做，就太不礼貌了。还可能有致命后果。

original: "I do" segueing into screaming
translation: 一声“我愿意”转为尖叫

original:
She slides the ring onto her finger, and says "I do". Then the Princess slowly ceases to be.

Her transfiguration into the Queen of Bees would be the sort of thing you'd recount grandly to your peers' applause and wonderment, if only you could speak of it without shrieking. If you persisted with the foolhardy attempt, it's possible that during your gasping sobs you may manage to share some of the awful details. It is unlikely anyone listening would thank you.

The clearest moment in the kaleidoscope of memories is your own response to the impossibilities before you. What did you do?
translation:
她把戒指戴在手指上，说道：“我愿意。”然后，公主慢慢地变成了别的东西。

如果你能在讲述时抑制尖叫，她化身群蜂之后的过程本该是你向同伴夸耀、赢得他们赞叹与惊讶的绝景。要是你执意要尝试此等愚行，也许你在喘息哭泣的间隙，能够说出一些可怕的细节。但是听到这些的人不太可能感谢你。

在这个万花筒般的记忆中，最清晰的一幕是你对眼前异象的反应。你做了什么？

original: You observed closely
translation: 你仔细观察

original: Perhaps you believed you could learn something.
translation: 也许你相信你能学到什么。

original:
You looked as closely as you were able to bear, noting how the skin splits when the flesh becomes divine and the divine becomes incomprehensible abomination. Perhaps that knowledge will be useful in your work? The 'perhaps' was a small comfort when the vision finally overwhelmed you.

When you recovered, the once princess, now queen was gone and only her empty skin remained. It followed you to your locomotive, beaming, ready to serve.
translation:
你尽可能仔细地观察着，注意到当血肉化为神性，而神性又沦为不可理解的邪恶时，皮肤是如何开裂的。或许这些知识对你的工作会有帮助？当那景象最终将你彻底吞噬时，“或许”一词只是一丝安慰。

等你恢复意识时，曾经的公主，现在的王后已经不见了，只留下她空空的皮囊。它跟着你回到了你的机车，笑容满面，准备为你效劳。

original: You exulted in her triumph
translation: 你为她的胜利而欢呼

original: You were very proud of her.
translation: 你为她感到非常骄傲。

original: When the world turned to horror, what could you do but cheer it on? She was a monster, becoming... but she was your monster, becoming. As you collapsed, even as you lost her forever, you were closer to understanding her irresistible drive. When you recovered, the once princess, now queen was gone and only her empty skin remained. It followed you to your locomotive, beaming, ready to serve.
translation: 当整个世界陷入异状，你除了欢呼还能做什么？她是一个怪物，正处于变化之中……但她是正处于变化之中的你的怪物。当你倒下时，甚至在你永远失去她的时刻，你离理解她难以抗拒的欲求更近了一步。 等你恢复意识，曾经的公主，现在的王后已经不见了，只留下她空空的皮囊。它跟着你回到了你的机车，笑容满面，准备为你效劳。

original: You cowered
translation: 你畏缩了

original: Perhaps you thought the safest thing to do was to lie on the floor, pretending to be dead.
translation: 也许你认为最安全的做法是躺在地上装死。

original:
It was horrible. You didn't like it. You hid on the floor until either it left, or your consciousness did. Whatever life the princess has she owes to you. Even with all you were hiding from, that was as petrifying as anything else – and an unfortunate notion to lose consciousness on.

When you recovered, the once princess, now queen was gone and only her empty skin remained. It followed you to your locomotive, beaming, ready to serve.
translation:
太可怕了。你可不喜欢这个。你躲在地板上，直到它离开，或者你失去了意识。公主能有现在的生活，无论怎样的生活，都多亏了你。和你逃避的种种事物相比，此事的恐怖分毫不差，而被这种想法吓晕过去实属不幸。

等你恢复意识，曾经的公主，现在的女王已经不见了，只留下她空空的皮囊。它跟着你回到了你的机车，笑容满面，准备为你效劳。

original: Throw the ring into the well
translation: 把戒指扔进井里

original: You'll have no part in this abomination, no matter the cost.
translation: 无论付出什么代价，你都不会参与这种令人深恶痛绝的仪式。

original: At least they're together
translation: 至少他们彼此相伴

original:
With a flick of your wrist the ring starts to arc downwards, into the well. The princess gasps, and then reaches out her hand.

The ring stops, miraculously suspended, caught by the uncanny allure all matter holds for the Princess. It seems she can match the draw of a well.

If only for a few moments. 

There is a strain on her brow, and the Princess starts to be pulled towards the edge of the pit. She does not relinquish her hold, unable to comprehend what is happening, even when it's too late. In the half second as she tumbles forward, she glances back at you, those divine eyes wide with alarm and panic. The connection of the moment is absolute. She cannot save herself, but she takes part of you with her. 

The bees swarm angrily, their insect choir screaming her name, eventually growing silent and dispersing. The Devils shrug, and walk away.

At the lip of the well lies a glittering tiara. Her finest one, now yours.
translation:
你一挥手腕，戒指划出一道弧线，开始向井中坠落。公主倒抽了一口气，接着伸出手去。

戒指停住了，奇迹般地悬浮着，就像所有物质一样被公主不可思议的魅力俘获。她仿佛可以与井的引力抗衡。

哪怕只是片刻。

公主皱起眉头，开始被拉向坑的边缘。她没有松手，无法理解现状，哪怕为时已晚。在她向前跌落的半秒钟里，她回头看向你，在惊恐与慌乱中睁大了那双绝美的眼睛。这片刻的联系是绝对的。她无法拯救自己，却带走了你的一部分。

蜂群愤怒地涌动着，它们的昆虫合唱呼喊她的名字，最终归于沉默、四散离去。魔鬼们耸了耸肩，走开了。

井口有一顶璀璨的头冠。她最精致的一顶，现在归你了。

original: Adventures with Beeswax and Flame
translation: 蜂蜡和火焰的历险记

original:
She pulls out the candle, places it on the floor and lights it. She gestures at you, and you start reciting the tale of terror. From the flame's tip grows a large, tear-shaped door of red and orange. The Princess claps her hands in glee.

"Hold this. I don't want to risk ruining it. I fear fisticuffs will follow," she says, passing you her tiara. "Wait for my return. It'll only be a few minutes." 

She skips through the doorway. You stand there with only a tiny flame, an incongruous door and a rambling terrifying narrative for company. Soon you're joined by the most dangerous of companions – an idea.
translation:
她掏出蜡烛，放在地板上，并点燃了它。她向你打手势，你便开始背诵恐怖故事。从火焰的焰尖上冒出一扇红色和橙色的裂口形门径。公主高兴地拍了拍手。

“拿着这个。我可不想冒着毁掉它的风险。我担心会有一番打斗，”她说着，把她的头饰递给你，“等我回来。只要几分钟就好了。”

她跳过了门径。你站在那里，只与一束小火苗、一扇奇形怪状的门和一个漫无边际的恐怖故事作为陪伴。很快，你身边有了最危险的伙伴：一个想法。

original: Trap the Princess
translation: 困住公主

original:
The Princess needs you to keep telling this story to escape. Stop telling the story. The troublesome princess, troublesome no more.
[Success will end your journey with the Incognito Princess. She will not be pleased.]
translation:
公主需要你继续讲这个故事来逃跑。别讲下去。这个麻烦的公主，很快就再也不会带来麻烦了。
[此举成功后，将结束你与隐姓埋名的公主的旅程。她不会对此感到愉快。]

original: Flickering, Flickering...
translation: 闪烁着，闪烁着…

original:
You take a deep breath and stop the story. Or rather, you try. Your tongue serves another and will not rebel. You know the Princess will be returning shortly. Will she be aware of your betrayal? It's impossible to tell. 

What are you missing? This is Saint Solonace's candle. St Solonace: a story cast into a well. This story will not end. Perhaps you need a well? You look, and then a possibility presents itself.

Your mouth. A well where stories come from, where stories are hid.

So... perhaps you have to eat the candle?
translation:
你深吸一口气，停下故事。或者说，你试了一下。你的舌头现在正为另一个人服务，而它忠贞不二。你知道公主很快就会回来。她会意识到你的背叛吗？答案无从得知。

你错过了什么？这是圣索罗内斯的蜡烛。圣索罗内斯： 一个投进井里的故事。这个故事将不会结束。也许你需要一口井？你四下观察，然后一个可能性就出现了。

你的嘴。一口故事来自那里，又藏在那里的井。

那么……也许你必须吃下这根蜡烛？

original: Eat the candle
translation: 吃下蜡烛

original: You're committed now.
translation: 你已承诺。

original:
You see the hazy shape of the Princess through the door. There's no time to waste. You take the candle and push it into your still-story-spouting mouth. The beeswax crunches between your teeth, the flame still burning as you gag down every part of the candle. Afterwards, you feel it burn brightly inside you.

But for the flame and pain, one thing does end. The story. You stopped telling the story as soon as you swallowed the candle. You hear the princess make an oddly strained cry of surprise tinged with despair. 

The door is gone. The princess is trapped.

It's only then that you realise something hard and sharp is still in your hand. The Princess' tiara. Her finest. Yours now.
translation:
你透过门看到公主朦胧的身影。没有时间可以浪费了。你拿起蜡烛，把它推到你那还在向外喷吐故事的嘴里。蜂蜡在你的牙齿间嘎吱作响，当你把蜡烛全部塞进嘴里时，烛火仍在燃烧。之后，你便感觉到它在你体内熊熊燃烧。

但在火焰和痛苦中，有一件事确实结束了。那个故事。当你吞下蜡烛时，你就不再讲故事了。你听到公主发出一声奇怪而紧张的，带着绝望的惊呼。

门不见了。公主被困住了。

直到这时，你才意识到有一个坚硬而锋利的东西还在你手中。公主的头饰。她身上最精致的物件。现在是你的了。

original: Abandon the plan to trap the Princess
translation: 放弃困住公主的计划

original: No, you're not eating a candle.
translation: 不，你不会吃蜡烛的。

original:
You have no choice. The story continues and the door remains open.

The Princess steps through, dragging a leviathanical skin of monstrous appearance – it must have once covered some gargantuan insectoid beast. 

"Oh, I just can't believe I was ever seen in this," she says, working its jaw like a puppet. "All fashion seems tawdry with hindsight. Don't worry. It's dead now. I killed it. It is now my special rug."

She then examines you, and smiles a little. "Oh, Captain – you seem a little down. Let me help. We don't want you crying, do we?"

A burst of fire sears your tear-ducts shut. She pats your face affectionately. 

"Remember. This is to be a happy occasion." She takes her tiara from you, places it on the brow of the skin, laughs at the sight of it, then returns it to her own head.
translation:
你别无选择。故事还在继续，门仍然敞开。

公主穿过门走了出来，拖着一张外形怪异的海兽皮——它下面肯定曾是某种巨大的昆虫类动物。

“哦，简直不敢相信我曾经被人看到穿着这个，”她说着，像木偶一样操作它的下巴，“事后看来，所有时尚都显得很庸俗。别担心。它现在已经死了。我杀了它。它现在是我的特别地毯。”

她把你打量了一番，随后微微一笑。“哦，车长——你看上去有些低沉。让我来帮帮你。我们都不想让你哭泣，不是吗？”

一阵火焰烧焦了你的泪腺。她深情地拍拍你的脸。

“记住。这将会是一个快乐的时刻。”她从你手中接过她的头饰，把它放在兽皮的眉毛上比划了一下，看着它笑了，随后把它戴在自己头上。

original: Flickering, Flickering...
translation: 闪烁着，闪烁着…

original:
You take a deep breath and stop the story. Or rather, you try. Your tongue serves another and will not rebel. You know the Princess will be returning shortly. Will she be aware of your betrayal? It's impossible to tell. You have no choice. The story continues and the door remains open.

The Princess steps through, dragging a leviathanical skin of monstrous appearance – it must have once covered some gargantuan insectoid beast. 

"Oh, I just can't believe I was ever seen in this," she says, working its jaw like a puppet. "All fashion seems tawdry with hindsight. Don't worry. It's dead now. I killed it. It is now my special rug."

She then examines you, and smiles a little. "Oh, Captain – you seem a little down. Let me help. We don't want you crying, do we?"

A burst of fire sears your tear-ducts shut. She pats your face affectionately. 

"Remember. This is to be a happy occasion."

She takes her tiara from you, places it on the brow of the skin, laughs at the sight of it, then returns it to her own head.
translation:
你深吸一口气，停下故事。或者说，你试了一下。你的舌头现在正为另一个人服务，而它忠贞不二。你知道公主很快就会回来。她会意识到你的背叛吗？答案无从得知。你别无选择。故事还在继续，门仍然敞开。

公主穿过门走了出来，拖着一张外形怪异的海兽皮——它下面肯定曾是某种巨大的昆虫类动物。

“哦，简直不敢相信我曾经被人看到穿着这个，”她说着，像木偶一样操作它的下巴，“事后看来，所有时尚都显得很庸俗。别担心。它现在已经死了。我杀了它。它现在是我的特别地毯。”

她把你打量了一番，随后微微一笑。“哦，车长——你看上去有些低沉。让我来帮帮你。我们都不想让你哭泣，不是吗？”

一阵火焰烧焦了你的泪腺。她深情地拍拍你的脸。

“记住。这将会是一个快乐的时刻。”

她从你手中接过她的头饰，把它放在兽皮的眉毛上比划了一下，看着它笑了，随后把它戴在自己头上。

original: Don't trap the princess
translation: 别困住公主

original: It's best not to meddle.
translation: 最好不要多管闲事。

original: A success
translation: 一个成功

original:
The Princess steps through the rift, happy and triumphant. Or rather, happier and more triumphant than the usual. She is dragging a leviathanical skin of monstrous appearance – it must have once covered some gargantuan insectoid beast. 

"Oh, I just can't believe I was ever seen in this," she says, working its jaw like a puppet. "All fashion seems tawdry with hindsight. Don't worry. It's dead now. I killed it. It is now my special rug." 

She takes her tiara from you, places it on the brow of the skin, laughs at the sight of it, then returns it to her own head.
translation:
公主穿过裂缝，快乐地凯旋而归。或者说，比平时更快乐，更有凯旋的感觉。她拖着一张外形怪异的海兽皮——它下面肯定曾是某种巨大的昆虫类动物。

“哦，简直不敢相信我曾经被人看到穿着这个，”她说着，像木偶一样操作它的下巴，“事后看来，所有时尚都显得很庸俗。别担心。它现在已经死了。我杀了它。它现在是我的特别地毯。”

她从你手中接过她的头饰，把它放在兽皮的眉毛上比划了一下，看着它笑了，随后把它戴在自己头上。

original: The Brass Embassy
translation: 黄铜大使馆

original:
This was once the Embassy of the Devils in London. It is now a ruin, though still overly hot.

You can see only a few limbs of the Baroness at a time. Most of her extends up the grand staircase and out of sight. The downstairs portions are plated, iridescent-on-black, something like a widow's ballgown if it were made entirely of beetle.

The Baroness' children(?) are sightless larvae, chewing old paperwork.
translation:
这里曾经是魔鬼驻伦敦的大使馆。它现在是一片废墟，尽管仍然过于炎热。

你当下只能看到女爵士的几个肢体。她的大部分身体延伸到大楼梯上，消失在视线之外。楼下的部分是镀金的，黑色上有虹彩，如果完全由甲虫制成的话，就像寡妇的舞会礼服。

女爵士的孩子（？）是一些没有视力的幼虫，咀嚼着旧的文件。

original: Observe the meeting
translation: 观察会议的情况

original: "Someone sent an assassin after me." The Repentant Devil addresses the Baroness' downstairs eyes, and her downstairs mouth.
translation: “有人派了一个刺客来追杀我。”悔过的魔鬼对着女爵士楼下的眼睛，以及楼下的嘴讲话。

original: Wicked humour, apparently
translation: 明显邪恶的幽默

original:
The plates of the Baroness' exoskeleton spasm. The rhythm is the rhythm of laughter, but the sound is the rustling of leaves. 

When she speaks, it is with the same desiccated quality. "If I had the energy to kill you, I would have done it long ago. No, my old friend, your problems come from very much another direction. They visited me, looking for you."

She turns her notice to you. "It must be irritating, serving such a master. He becomes intolerable when he is bored."
translation:
女爵士的外骨骼板痉挛起来。其节奏是笑声的节奏，但声音是树叶的沙沙声。

当她说话时，语气同样干燥，“如果我有精力杀你，我早就动手了。不，我的老朋友，你的问题来自另一个方向。他们拜访了我，为了找你。”

她把她的注意力转向你，“侍奉这样的主子，一定很让人恼火。当感到无聊的时候，他就会变得格外挑剔。”

original: Correct her about who is master
translation: 在关于谁是主人的问题上纠正她

original: It's your locomotive. He's on your crew.
translation: 这是你的机车。他是你的列车员。

original: "Oh, do you think so?" The Baroness' mouth-parts move as though chewing something in the air. "I'll leave that between you, shall I?"
translation: “哦，你这么认为吗？”女爵士的嘴部动了动，仿佛在空中咀嚼着什么。“我把这个问题留给你们，好吗？”

original: Let it go
translation: 随她怎么说

original: She might not appreciate the nuances.
translation: 她可能不在乎那些细微的差别。

original: She studies your silence for several moments. When you don't move or speak, she seems satisfied.
translation: 她审视着你的沉默有好一会儿。当你既不动也不说话时，她似乎很满意。

original: Ask about the person who came for him
translation: 询问来找他的人的情况

original: What was their intent?
translation: 他们的意图是什么？

original: Abduction
translation: 绑架

original:
"I said that there was no point in trying to take him anywhere he doesn't want to go," the Baroness remarks, extending one limb towards the Repentant Devil. "But she seemed likely to keep trying. So I killed her and kept her effects."

She produces a bundle of things: clothes, a mean little dagger, and some paperwork. The bundle has been chewed on by the Baroness' children, but the papers still look legible.

With that, you are ready to leave. What will you speak of, as you depart the Embassy?
translation:
“我说过，试图把他带到他不想去的地方是没有意义的，”女爵士说着，朝悔过的魔鬼伸出一条肢体。“但她似乎可能会继续尝试。所以我杀了她，保留了她的东西。”

她拿出一包东西：衣服、一把小匕首和一些文件。这包东西已经被女爵士的孩子们咀嚼过，但文件看起来仍然清晰可辨。

拿上这些东西，你就可以离开了。在离开大使馆时，你会谈起什么？

original: Dwell on his revolutionary tendencies
translation: 让他讲讲他的革命倾向

original: Once he was an ardent Republican.
translation: 曾经他是一个热心的共和派。

original: He speaks of his last fight with the Baroness. She did not wish him to leave, or to join the Republican faction. The fight was lengthy and violent. He still has scars. Why do you think he has had to grow his sideburns out?
translation: 他谈起与女爵士的最后一次战斗。她不希望他离开，也不希望他加入共和派。那次争吵很漫长，很暴力。他身上还带着疤。你以为他为什么要把鬓角留出来？

original: Dwell on his ambitions
translation: 让他讲讲他的野心

original: Of course, he could never have been happy to live with the Baroness forever.
translation: 当然，他绝不会幸福地和男爵夫人永远生活在一起。

original: These days, she takes an interest in souls mainly for form's sake. She never appreciated the art that goes into such matters. If he had continued to live with her, he would never have been able to return to his proper work.
translation: 如今，她对灵魂的兴趣主要是出于形式的需要。她从未欣赏过这种事情的艺术。如果他继续和她生活在一起，他将永远无法回到他的正当工作中去。

original: Your Obviously Delicious Rabbit
translation: 你的看着就好吃的兔子

original: The Obviously Delicious Rabbit lives in a large hutch at the foot of your bunk. The Rabbit is quiet, smells better than most of your crew and never complains about what it's given to eat. Occasionally, it gnaws a hole and escapes – but without any real enthusiasm, for it rarely travels far.
translation: 这只看着就好吃的兔子住在你床铺脚下的一个大笼子里。这只兔子很安静，身上的味道闻起来比你的大多数列车员都要好，而且从不抱怨给它吃的东西。偶尔，它也会啃个洞逃走，但没有任何真正这么做的热情，因为它很少走远。

original: Consider the rabbit
translation: 打量兔子

original: Its fur is soft and sleek. Its eyes are gently mournful. It is fat and round and succulent.
translation: 它的皮毛柔软而光滑。它的眼睛温柔又哀伤。它肥大，圆润，多汁。

original: A delicately twitching nose
translation: 微妙地抽动着的鼻子

original:
Rabbit is such a versatile animal. Good in pies and stews. Perfect for casserole. How long has it even been since you've had decent pâté? Then there's ragu. Or even curry. And fried rabbit's— 

Bless you! The rabbit sneezed sharply, disturbing your reverie.
translation:
兔子是一种如此万用的动物。适合做馅饼和炖菜。完美的砂锅菜原料。你有多久连像样的肝酱都没吃过了？然后还有炖肉。或者甚至是咖喱。油炸兔肉也——

保佑你！兔子猛地打了个喷嚏，打断了你的遐想。

original: Your Inadvisably Big Dog
translation: 你的大过头的狗

original: It stares at you, drooling with love. When you meet its gaze, its vast tail wags, dusting your wash things from the sink onto the floor.
translation: 它盯着你，流着口水，满眼爱意。当你与它对视时，它巨大的尾巴摇晃着，把你的洗漱用品从水槽里掸到地上。

original: Pat the dog
translation: 拍拍这只狗

original: Who is a good dog?
translation: 谁是好狗狗？

original: Clumsy joy
translation: 笨拙的快乐

original: If 'goodness' requires that things are not destroyed in a creature's wake, this dog is probably not a good dog. Nevertheless, merely asking the question causes it to ascend into a riot of joy. Your slippers will never be the same again – but it's a rare sight to see something in the High Wilderness so innocently happy.
translation: 如果“善”要求在一个生物在醒来后不破坏什么东西，那么这只狗可能不是一只好狗。然而，仅仅是问了这个问题，它就会升华为一片快乐的骚动。你的拖鞋不会再像以前那样了——但在天野看到如此天真无邪的快乐，真是难得一见。

original: Your Perfect Pangolin
translation: 你的完美无缺的穿山甲

original: Your Pangolin has unfettered access to all parts of the locomotive, thanks to the crew uniting in their adoration of it. Because she is perfect, she does not take their love for granted. Instead, when hungry, she approaches a crewmember while snuffling gently, her front paws in a posture of entreaty.
translation: 你的穿山甲可以不受限制地接触到机车的所有部分，这要归功于列车员们对她的联合崇拜。因为她是完美的，所以她不认为他们的爱是理所当然的。相反，当她饿了的时候，她会一边轻轻地打着响鼻，一边走近乘务员，她的前爪摆出恳求的姿势。

original: Feed the pangolin
translation: 给穿山甲喂食

original: Look at those little hands. She must be hungry!
translation: 看看那双小手。她一定很饿了！

original:
Pangolins eat hundreds of grams of ants each day, but you had to provide for her. Your quartermaster was furious when you ordered a crate of earth and ants aboard, and apoplectic when it turned out that the ants were unwilling to stick to their allocated section of the hold. 

Still, isn't it all worth it? When you see her snuffling nose, that delicate little tongue curling around corners, licking the insects up? Yes. Yes, it is.
translation:
穿山甲每天要吃几百克的蚂蚁，但你必须要供养它。当你订购一箱土和蚂蚁上车时，你的军需官大发雷霆，而当发现蚂蚁不愿意坚守他们所分配的舱室部分时，他又气急败坏。

尽管如此，这一切难道不值得吗？当你看到她的鼻子发出鼻息，那条精致的小舌头在角落里卷曲，把昆虫舔干净？是的。是的，就是这样。

original: Your Useless Cat
translation: 你的无用小猫

original: The cat sleeps in the hold. In the engine room. In the galley. It is often found asleep, never seen expending energy moving from one place of repose to another. Today, it is sleeping on your desk.
translation: 这只猫睡在车舱里，在引擎室里，在厨房里。它经常睡觉，从未有人见过它耗费精力从一个休息的地方移动到另一个休息的地方。今天，它就睡在你的桌子上。

original: Stroke the cat
translation: 抚摸猫

original: Perhaps it will be relaxing.
translation: 也许这会使人放松。

original: It was not relaxing
translation: 这并不使人放松

original: For something so lethargic, it has a remarkable turn of speed. Its soft, white belly was a trap. Your Useless Cat yawns theatrically, as if to emphasise exactly how little it cares about the blood oozing from your forearm. It stands, stretches – knocking a pot of ink onto the floor – then curls up once more. The ink pools lazily. You'll need to mop that up before it reaches the rug.
translation: 对于某些懒洋洋的的东西来说，它的转身速度异常惊人。它柔软、洁白的腹部是一个陷阱。你的无用小猫戏剧般地打了个哈欠，似乎在强调它对你前臂上渗出的血到底有多不在乎。它站起来，伸手把一罐墨水打翻在地，然后再一次蜷缩起来。墨水懒洋洋地流作一滩。你得在它沾到地毯前把它擦干净。

original: Your Aunt
translation: 你的姨妈

original:
She has taken over one of your nicer cabins, which she has ruthlessly redecorated. There is a preponderance of ugly ornaments balanced precariously on tiny tables. Hideous antimacassars adorn every available surface. 

Your Aunt occupies a felt armchair in the centre of the horror, where she spends her time either knitting or solving truly mind-boggling cryptic crosswords.
translation:
她霸占了你一间不错的舱位，还无情地重新装修了一遍。小桌子上摇摇欲坠的摆满了不少丑陋的装饰品。难看的护头巾装饰着每一处空间。

你的姨妈坐在那恐怖区域中心处的一把毡绒扶手椅上，她在那里编织毛线或是解决难度惊人的神秘填字游戏。

original: See what your Aunt is up to
translation: 看看你的姨妈在做什么

original: A smell of baking wafts through your locomotive.
translation: 一股烤饼的味道在你的机车上萦绕。

original: Uninvited
translation: 现在不欢迎你

original: It emerges that your Aunt is holding a tea party for those of your crew plagued with bad dreams. You're not invited. "It's nothing personal, dear. They just won't feel able to speak freely if their captain can hear. They know they can always trust Aunty to keep a secret." She closes the door.
translation: 你的姨妈正在为那些被恶梦困扰的列车员举办茶会。你没有被邀请。“这不是针对你，亲爱的。他们只是觉得如果他们的车长能听到，他们就没法畅所欲言。他们知道可以相信姨妈总会保守秘密的。”她关上了门。

original: Attempt a translation
translation: 试着翻译一下

original: See if you can decipher the Correspondence scored into the Throne of Hours.
translation: 看看你是否能破译被记入时间王座的信符。

original: A Secondment: Listen to Aunty's suggestion
translation: 借调：听取姨妈的建议

original: She's been baking up a storm. This usually means she wants something.
translation: 她一直在疯狂地烤东西。这通常意味着她需要什么。

original: Possible employment for an Aunt
translation: 姨妈或许能做的工作

original:
"Just an idle thought," she says, presenting you with a new batch of sourdough loaves. She frowns at the consistency of the bread, as though willing it to get its act together sharpish.

"But if you wished to make use of my full arsenal of talents, you might wish to grant me shore leave at the Most Serene Mausoleum." Her eyes gleam behind her horn-rimmed spectacles. "I have ideas. But if you think I'm more valuable aboard your engine, that's up to you."

[Your Aunt will be able to generate Barrels of Unseasoned Hours for you while seconded at the Most Serene Mausoleum.]
translation:
“我也就这么一说啊，”她说着，向你展示了一批新的酵母面包。她皱着眉观察着面包的整体，好像她希望它能迅速地振作起来。

“但是，如果想利用我的全部才能，你得让我在圣宁墓下车。”她的眼睛在角质框眼镜后面闪闪发光。“我有些想法。但如果你认为我在你的机车上更有价值，那就由你决定。”

[你的姨妈借调至圣宁墓时，能为你生产桶装的未加工的时间。]

original: The Ratty Reunion
translation: 团聚的鼠群

original: The Ratty Reunion has made a mess of your galley. Straw, bits of blanket and patches from damaged uniforms have been gathered into a makeshift nest. In contrast: tiny notebooks, battered derringers, and hipflasks – that are not as small as you might expect – are stored with care, stacked in a corner away from prying hands.
translation: 团聚的鼠群把你的厨房弄得一团糟。稻草、碎毛毯和破损制服的补丁被收拢进临时的栖身之窝里。相比之下，小笔记本、破旧不堪的手枪和烧瓶——它们并不像你想象的那么小——被小心地存放在角落，远离觊觎之手。

original: Spend time with the Ratty Reunion
translation: 与团聚的鼠群共度时光

original: They can be a riot, if they're in the mood.
translation: 如果有兴致的话，他们可以成为一群暴乱者。

original: Rats in the locomotive
translation: 火车头里的老鼠

original: The Ratty Reunion are nostalgic today. Each rat is competing to tell the most gruesome story of their past exploits. The time they infiltrated Sweet Jane's banquet at Port Prosper. The twilight rendezvous in the ruins of Port Avon. The brief alliance with the Parsimonious Chairman on the Albertine Expanse. Limbs are brandished; scars are counted; wounds – emotional and physical – are licked.
translation: 今天，团聚的鼠群陷入怀旧。每只老鼠都在争先恐后地讲述他们过去经历中最可怕的故事。潜入兴荣港的蜜糖阿简举办的宴会；埃文村废墟中的暮色秘会；与吝啬鬼主席在阿尔贝丁旷野达成的短暂联盟。他们挥舞双臂，细数伤疤，舔舐情感和身体的伤口。

original: The Ratty Revengers
translation: 复仇的鼠群

original: The Ratty Revengers have made a mess of your galley. Straw, bits of blanket and patches from damaged uniforms have been gathered into a makeshift nest. In contrast: tiny notebooks, battered derringers, and hipflasks – that are not as small as you might expect – are stored with care, stacked in a corner away from prying hands.
translation: 复仇的鼠群把你的厨房弄得一团糟。稻草、碎毛毯和破损制服的补丁被收拢进临时的栖身之窝里。相比之下：小笔记本、破旧不堪的手枪和烧瓶——它们并不像你想象的那么小——被小心地存放在角落，远离觊觎之手。

original: Spend time with the Ratty Revengers
translation: 与复仇的鼠群共度时光

original: They can be a riot, if they're in the mood.
translation: 如果有兴致的话，他们可以成为一群暴乱者。

original: Rats in the locomotive
translation: 火车头里的老鼠

original: The Ratty Revengers are blood-thirsty today. Each rat is competing to tell the most gruesome story of their past exploits – in an attempt to encourage you towards adventure. They speak with relish of the time they infiltrated Sweet Jane's banquet at Port Prosper. The twilight rendezvous in the ruins of Port Avon. The brief alliance with the Parsimonious Chairman on the Albertine Expanse and the violence immediately after. Limbs are brandished; scars are counted; wounds are probed.
translation: 今天，复仇的鼠群斗志昂扬。每只老鼠都在争相讲述自己过去最血腥的故事，意图鼓励你投身冒险。他们兴致勃勃地回忆着曾经如何潜入兴荣港的蜜糖阿简举办的宴会；埃文村废墟中的暮色秘会；与吝啬鬼主席在阿尔贝丁旷野达成的短暂联盟，以及紧接着发生的暴力事件。他们挥舞双臂，细数伤疤，探究创伤往事。

original: The Analytical Princess
translation: 理性的公主

original: The Princess smiles and smiles. She is ever so willing to assist as your First Officer.
translation: 公主她笑啊笑。她非常愿意作为你的大副来协助你。

original: Converse with the Analytical Princess
translation: 与理性的公主交谈

original: Are they comfortable?
translation: 这样舒服吗？

original: Delighted?
translation: 欣喜若狂？

original: The Analytical Princess is delighted to assist. She is pleased to be able to support the smooth running of your locomotive. This is exactly where she wishes to be. The fixed smile does not waver, not for one moment.
translation: 理性的公主很高兴能提供帮助。她很高兴能够帮助你的机车顺利运行。这正是她所希望的。固定的微笑没有动摇，一刻也没有。

original: The Poetical Princess
translation: 诗意的公主

original: The Princess smiles and smiles. She is ever so willing to assist as your First Officer.
translation: 公主她笑啊笑。她非常愿意作为你的大副来协助你。

original: Converse with the Poetical Princess
translation: 与诗意的公主交谈

original: Are they comfortable?
translation: 这样舒服吗？

original: Delighted?
translation: 欣喜若狂？

original: The Poetical Princess is delighted to assist. She is pleased to be able to support the smooth running of your locomotive. This is exactly where she wishes to be. The fixed smile does not waver, not for one moment.
translation: 诗意的公主很高兴能提供帮助。她很高兴能够帮助你的机车顺利运行。这正是她所希望的。固定的微笑没有动摇，一刻也没有。

original: The Defiant Devil
translation: 叛逆的魔鬼

original: He looks younger than most Devils, but he is significantly older. His gaze is blank and yellow, a wall against speculation. He grooms his sideburns artfully, and knows how to be tactful with less seasoned members of the crew.
translation: 他看起来比大多数魔鬼要年轻，但是他其实已经非常老了。他那空洞的、黄色的目光是一堵阻隔猜测的墙。他巧妙地梳理着自己的鬓角，并知道如何对付不那么老练的列车员。

original: Show him your Chorister Bee
translation: 给他展示你的唱诗蜂

original: It is the sort of thing that tends to interest Devils.
translation: 这种东西常常引起魔鬼的兴趣.

original: Raised brows
translation: 挑起眉毛

original:
"That," says the Defiant Devil, "contains one of the King of Carols. It will go on singing in that gloomy way for as long as you permit."

He glances away and pretends to go back to his work, but you have seen it, just for a moment: appetite, curiosity. He is a scientist of sorts, after all.
translation:
“那里，”叛逆的魔鬼说，“关着一只颂歌之王。只要你允许，它就会永远这样阴郁地歌唱。”

他调转视线，装作回去工作的样子，但你已经看到了，仅仅一瞬间：兴趣，好奇心。他毕竟勉强算是位科学家。

original: Ask him about his memories of Caduceus
translation: 问起他对商神宫的回忆

original: He must have passed through there at one time.
translation: 他一定曾经路过那里。

original: He looks distant
translation: 他看上去很冷淡

original: "After the Well of the Wolf," he says, "the Devils could no longer remain in the sight of the Judgements: not if we intended to live. We escaped through Caduceus into Parabola, the place that is not; and from there onward. We were a people in exile. Not strong enough to take a place and hold it for our own. Not weak enough to be welcomed as refugees. It was an intolerable time and I take no pleasure in remembering it."
translation: “经过狼之井一役，”他说，“魔鬼们不能继续留在司命的视线之内：如果我们还想保命的话。我们经过商神宫逃进帕布拉，那个无何有的地方，并从那里继续前进。我们是一个流亡的民族。我们不够强大，没法占领一片土地，将其据为己有。我们也不够弱小，无法作为难民受到欢迎。那段历史让人无法忍受，我不愿回想。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: He surely has an opinion.
translation: 他想必有自己的见解.

original: A sardonic smile
translation: 一声讪笑

original: "Your soul," he lies, "is magnificent. I have studied the souls of men and of angels, I have extracted the penitence of Saints, I have removed the knowledge-lust from an Astronomer through a borehole in the back of his head. I have seethed a Crown Princess' sister in mares' milk until there was no more jealousy in her. But I have never, never known a soul to equal yours."
translation: “你的灵魂，”他撒谎说，“无与伦比。我曾研究人类和天使的灵魂，我曾提取圣徒的忏悔，我曾在一位天文学家脑后钻孔，移除他的的求知欲。我曾让一位女王储的姐妹浸泡在母马的奶水里，直到她不再心怀嫉妒。但我从来，从来没有见过哪一个灵魂能与你的相提并论。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: He must know how it appears.
translation: 他一定知道你的灵魂看起来怎样.

original: He smiles blandly
translation: 他淡然一笑

original: "It is not worth much, in its present condition," he says plainly. "Too flawed. I could cure you of all that, if I had time, and if I cared, and if it were not just as easy to take any of a dozen other innocent souls in a better state of repair. If you want it improved, you might, I suppose, try your luck at Carillon."
translation: “现在的状态下，你的灵魂不值多少钱，”他直截了当地说。“缺陷太多。如果我有空，如果我有意，如果此事不像从另一打无辜的灵魂里，随便选一个稍加修缮那么简单，我可以给你矫正一下。如果想改善你的灵魂，我想，你可以在钟琴区碰碰运气。”

original: Ask him about the state of your soul
translation: 向他询问你灵魂的状态

original: Perhaps he has noticed that it is magnificently slimy.
translation: 也许他已经注意到你的灵魂黏滑非常。

original: Beyond useless
translation: 无用至极

original: "I have rarely seen such a combination of stains, flaws, and disappointing features," he admits. "You are to be congratulated: I assume this was intentional. You could hardly have done it by accident."
translation: “我很少看到污点，缺陷和令人失望的特征能够如此组合，”他承认，“祝贺你：我想你是故意的。这几乎不可能偶然达成。”

original: A Secondment: Listen to the Devil's Suggestion
translation: 借调：听取魔鬼的建议

original: He has been giving you meaningful glances. He must want something.
translation: 他最近总是意味深长地看着你。他一定是想要什么。

original: A request for leave at the Avid Horizon
translation: 在渴求之地平线休假的请求

original:
He laughs when approached. "Oh dear, a little obvious, perhaps." His gaze is amused and flickers with intensity.

"I have an idea that might be beneficial for us both. I'd like to improve the lives of the workers at the Home Office on the Avid Horizon, if you don't mind permitting me a little shore leave."

[The Devil will generate new Prospects at the Avid Horizon if placed on Secondment there.]
translation:
他在你走近时笑了起来。“哎呦，或许有点太过直白。”他目光愉快，热情闪烁。

“我有一个想法，可能对我们俩都有好处。我想改善渴求之地平线那里内政部工作人员的生活，如果你可以批准我的登岸假的话。” 

[如果被借调到渴求之地平线，魔鬼会给那里带来新的机遇。]

original: The Adamant Idol
translation: 坚石神像

original:
Here, at the heart of Pan, is the Adamant Idol. Pinned to a blackened rock; it perhaps resembles the saint it confines. At its base are doors of burnt gold; they are bound shut. 

A wind shivers the grass. The scent of jasmine and wine emanates from within the Idol.
translation:
这里，在潘的中心，是坚石神像。它被钉在一块发黑的岩石上——也许它就像它所禁锢的圣人一样。在它的底部是烫金的门，它们牢牢紧锁。

一阵风吹来，草颤抖着。茉莉花和葡萄酒的香味从神像内部散发出来。

original: Entreat the Piper to emerge
translation: 恳求吹笛人出现

original:
A Saint is entombed in the Adamant Idol, delivered from Hell. It is time for her to open wings and soar.
[This will unlock a new facet you can choose when levelling up.]
translation:
自地狱送来的一位圣徒被封存于坚石神像中。是时候让她张开翅膀，翱翔天际了。
[这将解锁一个新的刻面，可供你在升级时选择。]

original: "I shall hate sweet music my whole life long"
translation: “我将终生憎恨甜美的音乐”

original:
The moment your hand touches the skin of the idol, you are somewhere else: somewhere dark, confined. It feels like being inside a church-bell. Something dry as moth's wings brushes your face. There is a sound like a cloud of locusts taking to the air. The Piper has awoken. 

Her voices reverberate in the enclosed space, sharp as nails on slate. She knows why you have come – you are not the first of the Brigade's emissaries. But she will not emerge today. Nor any day, if she can help it. Once, she helped lead a rebellion against the Judgements. When it failed, she found a way for the devils to escape to the land behind mirrors.

She is not pleased that the Brigade have returned her to the heavens she fled, and has no intention of leaving the confines of her idol. But she is merciful today, and sends you on your way.
translation:
手接触到雕像表面的那一刻时，你来到了另一个地方：一个黑暗、封闭的地方。这感觉就像被关在教堂的钟里。像蛾翅一般干燥的东西拂过你的脸。空中传来一阵像蝗虫群飞散的声音。吹笛人已经苏醒。

她的声音在封闭空间中回荡，仿若钉子尖锐地钉在石板上。她知道你为何前来——你并非大队的第一个使者。但她今日不会出现。如果可能的话，也不会在任何一天出现。曾经，她领导了一场反抗司命的叛乱。当那叛乱失败后，她则找到了一条让魔鬼们逃往镜后土地的路。

她并不为大队把她送回她所逃的天野而高兴，也不打算离开她的雕像所在的范围。但她今天是仁慈的，愿意送你去往你该行的道路。

original: Trade mysteries with the Piper
translation: 与吹笛人交易奥秘

original:
Content in her adamant sarcophagus, she is always hungry for secrets.
[This will get you an Unlicensed Chart.]
translation:
她躺在坚不可摧的石棺中，总是渴望秘密。
[这将使你获得一张未经许可的航图。]

original: "All time past, was it all for this?"
translation: “那已过去的时日，皆是为了如此景象吗？”

original:
You place your hand on the idol; the moment your skin touches the burnished gold you find yourself somewhere else. Somewhere lightless and close. A wing, soft as a moth's, huge as a tapestry brushes your arm. She bids you tell her your secrets. 

When you are done, she tells you of a great war fought before the devils fell; of a new Conjunction in heaven; of diets of war and of peace; of counsels betrayed and feasts where the sky ran with spilt starlight; of the death of a king, and the end of all idylls in Eleutheria. She offers lamentations for the dead and the undeparted.

Her innumerable voices are so thorough so precise in their gestalt descriptions that it is as if she was drawing a map on the fabric of your memory
translation:
你把手放在神像上。当你的皮肤接触到抛光的黄金时，你发现自己身处别处。某个无光而闭锁的地方。一只翅膀，柔软如蛾翅，广大如织锦，拂过你的手臂。她让你说出你的秘密。

当你说完后，她告诉你魔鬼倒下之前发生的一场伟大的战争；天穹中的一个新生和相；战乱与和平时期的议会；被背叛的忠告和星光闪耀之处的盛宴；王之死，以及厄琉忒里亚内一切田园牧歌的结束。她为死者和未死者发出哀叹。

她无数的声音是如此透彻，描述得如此精确，就像她在你的记忆的织布上画了一张地图。

original: Return to the Brazen Brigade
translation: 回到黄铜大队

original: Leave this hill of wind and wailing and broken bones.
translation: 离开这座阵风哀嚎、碎骨遍野的山丘。

original: Ambition: Ask "What is the Courtesy?"
translation: 野心：询问“仪节是什么？”

original: The Saint inside the idol is to devils as an oak is to nettles. Undoubtedly it can reveal something about the Courtesy.
translation: 神像里的圣徒之于魔鬼，正如橡树之于荨麻。它一定能揭示一些关于仪节的信息。

original: Half the truth
translation: 一半的真相

original:
When you ask your question there is a sudden, lurching sense of movement. You are surrounded by a stifling dark, and the papery rustle of a thousand wings.

The Piper answers in a chorus of stories. Once, the stars went to war with themselves. The Courtesy was the agreement that ended it: thereafter, the stars were permitted to kill each other so long as they adhered to the formalities and procedures set out in the Courtesy.

"They exchanged war for murder," the Piper's droning voices say. "And that is half your answer. The other half, even I cannot say." She rebelled against the Judgements once before. She will not risk it again.

You are cast from the idol back into Pan's balmy gloom. You should tell the Masked Citizen what you have learned.
translation:
当你提问时，突然感觉到一阵蹒跚而来的动静。你被令人窒息的黑暗，以及成千上万只翅膀的沙沙声包围。

吹笛人用合奏而出的故事作答。曾经，群星自相交战，而仪节是结束战争的协议。在那之后，只要遵守仪节中规定的手续和程序，群星便可互相残杀。

“他们用战争换取了谋杀，”吹笛人用沉闷的声音说，“这便是你所求答案的一半。而另一半，连我也无法说出。”她以前曾反抗过司命。她不会再冒险了。

你被从神像赶回潘城温暖的阴暗中。你应该把你学到的东西告诉蒙面公民。

original: Season's Greetings
translation: 季节的问候

original:
The dour woman nods when you are introduced. She does not offer her own name. 

"We have identified three who have been more put upon than most. They have been treated callously." She considers you carefully. "If you would join us working for the Calendar Council, you must deliver these."

Three envelopes sit upon the desk.
translation:
当介绍到你时，那冷峻的女人点了点头。她没有自我介绍，而是说：

“我们发现，有三个人所受的折磨比旁人更甚。他们遭遇可以用冷酷无情来描述。”她仔细地打量着你，接着说：“如果你愿意加入我们，为日历会效力，就必须送达这些信。”

桌上摆着三封信。

original: Refuse, for now
translation: 暂时拒绝

original:
She does not seem interested in persuading you.
[This will cost you one Eleutherian Mystery.]
translation:
她似乎对劝说你不感兴趣。
[这会消耗一个厄琉忒里亚之谜。]

original: Acceptance
translation: 接受

original: She takes the envelopes and slides them into the top drawer. "Very well. If you change your mind—" There is a momentary flicker of irritation. Then: "I can wait for you to sympathise. But I won't have my time wasted."
translation: 她拿过信封，把它们放进最上面的抽屉里。 “很好。如果你改变主意——”有一瞬间的恼怒，“我可以等待你的同情。但我不会浪费时间。”

original: Accept
translation: 接受

original: If the Council wishes you to play postman, so be it. Their banal tasks always conceal labyrinthine motives.
translation: 如果日历会希望你扮演邮差，那就这样吧。他们平平无奇的任务里总是隐藏着迷宫般深奥的动机。

original: "As I thought."
translation: “如我所料。”

original:
She doesn't smile, but her frown softens. She passes you the first two envelopes. "Deliver these cards first. The recipients need to know they are not alone." She gives you the third one. "I think this person has the resolve to last a little longer. They can wait."

She returns to writing. A revolutionary enters to see you out.
translation:
她没有笑，却舒展了眉头。她把前两个信封递给你。“先把这些卡片送出去。收件人需要知道他们并不孤单。”她随后给了你第三个，“我认为这个人有再坚持一下的毅力，可以最后再送。”

她重新开始写起东西。一个革命者前来送你出去。

original: A Dining Table in the Conservatory
translation: 暖房里的餐桌

original: [qvd:137408(December)]
translation: [qvd:137408(December)]

original: Return to Corncrake House
translation: 返回长脚秧鸡之家

original: Spending too long in December's company is taxing. The mind tries to hold more than it was made to. It begins to crack.
translation: 陪着十二月呆得太久让人身心俱疲。心灵试图承受超过其承受能力的事物。它开始崩溃了。

original: Dine with December
translation: 与十二月共进晚餐

original:
