[If you succeed, this will triple the time you receive. If you fail, you'll still get time-and-a-half.]
translation:
或许有办法防止时刻的丝线缠绕在一起……
[如果成功，这将使你收到的时间变为三倍。如果失败，你仍然会得到一点五倍的时间。]

original: The advance of modernity
translation: 现代性的进步

original: Your process is successful. Lesser minds would call it magic. Years, spun from nothing!
translation: 你取得了成功。庸众会称它为魔法。岁月，无中生有！

original: Teething pains
translation: 出牙的痛苦

original: The process is only partially successful. Snarls of dying time ribbon in the air. When you pause for a break, you make a point of asking a passing devil what day it is. Their answer is reassuring. It's the same week, at least.
translation: 你只取得了部分成功。垂死时间丝带的咆哮声在空中响起。停下来休息的时候，你特意问一个路过的魔鬼今天是什么日子。那位的回答令人安心，至少你还位于同一个星期。

original: Tell stories to a barrel of hours
translation: 对着一桶时间讲故事

original:
It's probably an old wives' tale. But it's said that time spent in a story is time best spent.
[If you succeed, you will automatically get the best result, 10 years, from a single barrel of time.]
translation:
这或许只是个民间传说。但据说，把时间花在故事里是最值得的。
[如果成功，你从一桶时间中提取出10年，这是你能得到的最好结果。]

original: The best of times, the worst of times
translation: 最好的时代，最坏的时代

original: As you spin your yarn, there is a soft sigh from the geodes. The atmosphere becomes a shade less melancholy. You think it's working.
translation: 当你旋转你的纱线时，从晶洞那里传来了轻轻的叹息。气氛变得不那么忧郁了。你认为这很有效。

original: A waste of time
translation: 浪费时间

original: Do you feel silly, pontificating to a barrel of silent geodes? You've had worse company, you suppose, but you can't tell if this is having any effect.
translation: 对着一桶无言的晶球高谈阔论，你是否觉得很傻？你有过更糟糕的同伴，你想，但你无法判断这是否有任何影响。

original: Refine ten barrels of hours with a Searing Enigma
translation: 用一个灼热的谜团炼制十桶时间

original:
Forge hours into weeks with a word of fire!
[You will gain three times the usual benefit from these hours.]
translation:
用一个燃烧的字符将小时锻造成星期！
[你将从这些时间中获得三倍的收益。]

original: Spoken into being
translation: 言语铸就

original: The Toll Tower quakes as you utter the word. The geodes glow, red as cherries, in the after-heat. Then they begin to crack, like eggs. Spools of time unravel from them, licked by lingering flames.
translation: 当你说出词句的时候，渡灵塔在颤抖。在余热中，晶球发亮，变得像樱桃一样红。然后它们开始如鸡蛋一般破裂。时间的线轴从它们身上解开，被萦绕的火焰舔舐。

original: Store three barrels of hours with an Otherworldly Artefact
translation: 使用异界遗物储存三桶时间

original:
Sometimes, hours stored in the dark in the company of an artefact like this will inexplicably multiply. Perhaps they mate.
[This will double the benefit from these hours.]
translation:
有时，像这样与一件遗物相伴，在黑暗中度过的时间会莫名其妙地倍增。或许它们会交配。
[这将使这些时间翻倍。]

original: Some secrets are better unknown
translation: 有些秘密最好不为人知

original:
You come back a day later and dig the artefact from the bottom of the barrel. It crumbles in your hand, eroded by the weight of years. 

When you crack one of the hour-geodes open, you find it improbably fecund.
translation:
你隔了一天回来，从桶底挖出了那件遗物。它在你的手中碎裂开来，被岁月的重量侵蚀得脆弱不堪。

当你敲开其中一块时间晶洞时，发现它竟然异常地丰饶。

original: That's will do for now
translation: 目前这样就足够了

original: Return to your schemes.
translation: 回到你的计划中去吧。

original: You have accumulated the hours you need
translation: 你已经积累了所需的时间

original: A trove of them. A dragon-hoard. A mountain of hours, for a handful of centuries.
translation: 一大堆。像龙一样积攒的宝藏。足有数个世纪的，堆积如山的时间。

original: A Web Hung Between the Stars
translation: 一张挂在星星之间的网

original: [qvd:139307(Gallery)]
translation: [qvd:139307(Gallery)]

original: Answer it
translation: 接过它

original: An Eyeless Priest stands outside. Wordlessly, he hands you a copper box.
translation: 一个失明的牧师站在外面。他默默地递给你一个铜盒子。

original: The Mother-Poison
translation: 母毒

original:
You take it, and close the door. Inside the box is a glass phial. It contains the elaborate poison a dozen spider-councils have laboured over for the last seventy years. It is so rarefied it is not liquid or vapour. It is a thought, scintillant and shivering behind the glass.

Unstoppering the phial, you pour the venom-notion into a silver tea-pot.

The copper box was padded with newspaper to protect its contents. Curious, you unfold and flatten it.

An article about recurring Albion-wide blackouts following the Great Malfunction. Speculation that the Parliament of the Reach is debating a declaration of war. An account of the arrival of the wintery ambassadors of a distant white star, seeking an accord with London.
translation:
你接过盒子，关上门。盒子里装着一个玻璃药瓶。它里面装的是十几位蜘蛛议会过去七十年间精心研制的毒药。它如此罕见，既不是液体也不是气体。它是一个念头，在玻璃后面闪烁着、颤动着。

你拔掉瓶塞，将那个带毒的念头倒入一个银质茶壶中。

铜盒子里面用报纸垫着，以保护里面的物品。你出于好奇，把报纸展开铺平。

报纸上有一篇文章，讲述了自大故障之后全阿尔比恩反复出现的停电情况。文中推测，外野议会正在辩论是否要宣战。还有一篇报道，讲述了一位来自遥远白星的冬日使者抵达伦敦，寻求与伦敦缔结和约的事宜。

original: Admit your guests
translation: 接待你的客人

original: It is the Presiding Deviless of Carillon, accompanied by a demure shade with a brass-trimmed death-mask.
translation: 这是钟琴区的女魔鬼主管，身旁跟随着一位端庄的遗魂，戴着铜边死神面具。

original: The carrier
translation: 载体

original:
The Deviless sits primly on the edge of your chaise-longue. "I think you will find everything to your satisfaction: I would describe this shade's soul as irresistible. 

"Not fortifying, but fascinating. Exhilarating, even. The equivalent of Turkish Delight, perhaps, rather than steak."

You smile at the shade and reach for the silver teapot. "Tea?" 

The mother-poison does not affect it at all as it drinks. The shade's mind cannot perceive or conceive the venom-thought. That is as intended. The shade is not the victim, but the vector.
translation:
女恶魔端庄地坐在你长沙发的边缘。“我想你会发现一切都令你满意：我会将这种阴影的遗魂描述为无法抗拒。

“不是增强力量，而是迷人。甚至令人振奋。或许，它相当于土耳其软糖，而非牛排。”

你对着遗魂微笑，伸手去拿银色的茶壶。“要喝茶吗？”

这种母毒在它喝水时完全没有影响。遗魂的心灵无法感知或构想毒药的概念。这正是预期的效果。遗魂不是受害者，而是传播者。

original: Examine the shade
translation: 审视遗魂

original: The shade's naked soul is not visible, of course, nor would its virtues be apparent to you if it was.
translation: 当然，遗魂那赤裸裸的灵魂是不可见的，即便可见，它的优点于你而言也并不会显而易见。

original:
But you note its additional eyelids, arrayed one behind the other and only visible when it blinks in a distressing cascade. You note the many-jointed grace of its movements, and the marble-smooth skin of its hands, without follicle or fingerprint.

When it has consumed the venom, you stand and bid your guests good day. They depart, and you return to your waiting.
translation:
但你注意到了它额外的眼睑，一层叠着一层，只有在它痛苦地快速眨眼时才可见。你注意到了它动作中多关节的优雅，以及它手部大理石般光滑的皮肤，上面没有毛囊或指纹。

当它吞下毒液后，你站起身来，向客人们道别。他们离开后，你回到原地继续等待。

original: Make conversation with the Deviless
translation: 与女恶魔交谈

original: While it drinks, you enquire about the world outside. You have to push. The Deviless does not pay close attention to political events.
translation: 在它喝水的时候，你询问外面的世界。你得催它。女魔鬼可不关心政治事件。

original:
She describes the discovery of webs in the wastes: strung across once-lifeless spans of the sky.

She mentions the construction of a new transit relay to a recently-discovered region, "a place of change and forbidden arts." 

She refers, with the edge of a smile, to the dismay of Londoners when they learned that the French had found their way to the heavens.

When the shade has consumed the venom, you stand and bid your guests good day. They depart, and you return to your waiting.
translation:
她描述了在废墟中发现的网状物：它们横跨天际，曾经那里了无生机。

她提及向一个新近发现的区域建设新的交通中继站，“那是一个充满变化与禁忌法术的地方”。

她略带微笑地提及伦敦人的沮丧，当他们得知法国人已经找到了通往天堂的道路时。

当遗魂吞噬了毒液，你站起身来，向宾客道别。他们离去后，你回到原地继续等待。

original: Read the letter
translation: 阅读这封信

original: The handwriting is so improbably neat it could only be the work of a devil.
translation: 这种字迹整洁得不可思议，只能是魔鬼所为。

original: Finished
translation: 完成了

original:
It says, simply, "The shade has passed beyond Death's Door."

And that's it. You have moved each piece to its proper place. The rest of the work passes to someone – something – else.
translation:
它简单地写道：“遗魂已越过死亡之门。”

就这样，你把每一块拼图都放到了正确的位置。剩下的工作就交给了其他人——或者某种其他存在。

original: Leave your chamber of hours
translation: 离开你的时间之室

original: You push open the door to your Gallery of Aeons. You climb the brass-banistered stair. You emerge, and look up at the broken ruin of the Blue Kingdom.
translation: 你推开了通往你的永恒长廊的门。你爬上有黄铜护栏的楼梯。你走出来，抬头看了看蓝色王国的破碎废墟。

original: Heavens Incandescent
translation: 炽热的天堂

original:
As you stare, the air is split by alarms. A Logos has found you, and is calling for reinforcements. 

Hundreds approach in the distance; a fire that swallows the sky. The lone Logos hurls itself against your hull, catching you in flames.

You can't stay a moment longer. You must escape back to the High Wilderness, or perish.
translation:
当你凝视之时，警报声撕裂了空气。一个圣言发现了你，正在呼叫增援。

远处，数百个身影逼近；火焰吞噬了天空。那个孤独的圣言奋力撞向你的车体，将你置于火海之中。

你不能再停留片刻。你必须逃回天野，否则死。

original: Send engineers to douse the inferno in the engine-room
translation: 派遣工程师前往机房扑灭熊熊大火

original:
This will enable a speedier escape, though the unfortunate souls sent into that fire-shrouded room will not return.
[You will lose 10 of your Crew.]
translation:
这将使得逃生速度加快，尽管那些被送入火海笼罩房间的不幸之人将无法生还。
[你将损失10名列车员。]

original: Out!
translation: 熄灭！

original:
With doomed engineers working valiantly to douse the flames, your engine rumbles into action. You flee the encroaching wall of Logoi, streaking like a comet.

Death's Door is open; when you slip through to safety, it slams shut. 

As the smoke clears, you begin recovery of your still-smouldering dead from the ravaged engines.
translation:
在英勇无畏却注定失败的工程师们奋力扑灭火焰的同时，你的引擎轰鸣着启动了。你逃离了逼近的圣言火墙，如同彗星般划破天际。

死亡之门敞开着；当你穿过它逃向安全之地时，它轰然关闭。

随着烟雾散去，你开始从受损的机车中搜寻那些仍在闷烧的遗体。

original: Plough right through the wall of advancing Logoi
translation: 直接穿过前进中的圣言火墙。

original:
Your engine should endure, though by the time you escape it will be charred beyond recognition.
[Your Hull will be badly damaged.]
translation:
你的机车应该能够承受住，尽管当你逃离时，它已经被烧得面目全非了。
[你的车体将严重受损。]

original: Out!
translation: 熄灭！

original:
You burst through the flames, leaving the Logoi in disarray. Glass breaks; metal glows, warps. You streak back to Death's Door like a ruby-red comet.

The Logoi don't want you to stay any more than you do. The Door is open; when you slip through into safety, it slams shut.
translation:
你冲破火焰，让圣言陷入混乱。玻璃破碎，金属发光、扭曲。你如同一颗红宝石般鲜红的彗星，迅速掠回死亡之门。

圣言并不比你更希望你留下。门敞开着；当你溜进安全之地时，它轰然关闭。

original: The Azazel
translation: 阿撒泻勒号

original: A small encampment is tucked into the tumbled pillars. Someone has tried to grow a plot of verdant seeds there, but the winds and cold have choked them. There is a lean-to, constructed against the side of a locomotive, which has been stripped for parts to build makeshift components.
translation: 在坍塌的柱子之间，藏着一个小小的营地。有人试图在那里种植一片青翠的种子，但风和寒冷使它们窒息。这里有一个靠火车头一侧搭建的简易棚，它是用火车上拆下来的部件组成的。

original: Find the [qvd:139308(ID2)]
There is no sign of her at the camp. Perhaps she has taken shelter in the scavenged remains of her locomotive.
translation: 营地里没有她的踪迹。也许她已经躲进了机车的废墟中。

original: The reunion
translation: 重逢

original: You find her in the engine room, rolled in blankets beside the now-cold firebox. She is half-starved and bitten with frost. Another day and you'd have been too late. You are struck by the familiar curl of her hair on one cheek, the sharp arch of her eyebrows. Her forearms and hands are wrapped in bandages. She opens her eyes. Recognition dawns in them, then horror. She pushes you away. "The Fire follows! If you find me, it finds me! If it finds me, it finds you! Leave me. Please!"
translation: 你在引擎室找到了她，她蜷缩在毯子里，旁边是现已冰冷的火箱。她几近饿死，遍身冻伤。再过一天，你就来不及了。她一侧脸颊上熟悉的卷发和尖尖的眉毛令你愣了一下。她的前臂和手都缠着绷带。 她睁开了眼睛，眼里浮现的先是意识，随后是恐惧。她把你推开。 “追杀之火！如果你找到我，它也会找到我！如果它找上我，它也会找上你！快离开。求你了！”

original: Leave her
translation: 离开她

original:
If you do, you will also abandon your quest for the truth. But perhaps you have learned enough.
[Abandon your ambition. You can choose a new one at New Winchester.]
translation:
如果你这样做，你也会放弃对真理的追求。但也许你已经学得够多了。
[放弃你的野心。你可以在新温彻斯特选择一个新的目标。]

original: You reach out, but she shrinks from you, trying to hide herself from your gaze. You leave the gutted Azazel, the failed camp, the ghosted ruins. You return to your engine, and set a silent course for home.
translation: 你向她伸出手，但她却躲闪开来，试图避开你的目光。你离开了被摧毁的阿撒泻勒号、那座失败的营地、那片荒废的废墟。 你回到自己的机车上，默默设定了回家的航线。

original: Take her home
translation: 带她回家

original: None of that. She's coming with you.
translation: 别说了。她会和你一起回去。

original:
She fights you, but has no strength. You carry her back to your engine, and put her in your cabin. She weighs next to nothing. You'll need to get her back to New Winchester, and a doctor.

As for the Fire that Follows, and the wrath of the stars... Well. What will happen, will happen.
translation:
她试图抵抗，但没有力量。你把她带回你的机车，然后把她安置在你的舱室。她轻的像一张薄纸。你需要把她带回新温彻斯特，还要请一名医生。

至于追杀之火，以及群星的愤怒……走一步看一步吧。

original: A Fateful Bequeathment
translation: 一个命运攸关的遗赠

original:
The lawyer's office is so cramped that her desk fits snugly from wall to wall. Her route of escape is not visible; perhaps some kind of secret hatch, or perhaps she simply eats and sleeps in her chair.

"Your final endowment," she says, carefully pulling a brown parcel from her bottom drawer. "The testator was most insistent that this item be bequeathed separately."
translation:
律师的办公室如此逼仄，她的桌子紧紧夹在两堵墙中间。她的逃跑路线不明显；或许是通过某种秘密舱口，又或许她只是坐在椅子上吃饭睡觉。

“这是给你的最后的遗物，”她说，小心翼翼地从底下的抽屉里拿出一个棕色的包裹。“遗嘱人特别强调，这件物品要单独遗赠。”

original: Open the package
translation: 打开包装

original: You pull at the knot with trembling hands.
translation: 你用颤抖的手拉开绳结。

original: An Ichor-stained Journal
translation: 一本受灵液沾染的日志

original:
Tearing apart the wrapping-paper you reveal a small black notebook, its front cover stained in unidentifiable reds and golds. This once belonged to the Dismal Chamberlain, steward of the Most Serene Mausoleum; then it belonged to your predecessor; now it is yours, its secrets waiting to be unlocked. 

Every page is written in baffling code. "It would be remiss of me if I did not mention," says the lawyer, "that along with the journal, the testator enclosed a note requesting that you destroy it. Under no circumstances should you attempt to decipher it."

[Collect 5 Sky-Stories, then leave port, to decipher the journal.]
translation:
剥开包装纸，你发现了一本小巧的黑色笔记本，封面沾染着难以辨认的红色和金色痕迹。这本笔记本曾属于阴沉的宫廷内侍——那位圣宁墓的管家；之后它归你的前任所有；现在，它属于你了，它的秘密正等待着被揭开。

每一页都写满了令人困惑的密码。“我必须提醒你，”律师说道，“除了这本日记，立遗嘱人还附了一张纸条，要求你销毁它。在任何情况下，你都不应尝试去破译它。”

[收集5个高天轶事后，离开港口，以破译这本日记。]

original: A Short Respite
translation: 短暂的休息

original:
The [qvd:139308(ID2)] is sitting up in the bed, now, demolishing a bowl of soup. 

[qvd:139492(Fire)]

[qvd:139492(Itch)]
translation:
[qvd:139308(ID2)]坐在床上，正在狼吞虎咽着一碗汤。

[qvd:139492(Fire)]

[qvd:139492(Itch)]

original: Ask why she fled to the wastes
translation: 询问她为什么逃去荒漠

original: What did she hope to achieve?
translation: 她希望达到什么目的？

original: Fruitless
translation: 无果

original:
"A few more months, maybe. The Fire had already found me, more than once. The last time I barely escaped. I hoped the stars would find it harder to see, out in the wastes. That it would be harder for the Fire to find me; perhaps even that it might be afraid."

She looks into your eyes. "I was wrong. There is no escape."

You'll see about that.
translation:
“再拖延几个月，大概。那火已经找到我不止一次了。上次我差点没能逃脱。我曾希望，在这片荒漠，星辰会更难看到我，那火也会更难找到我，或许它甚至会感到恐惧。”

她凝视着你的双眼。“我错了。根本无法逃脱。”

而你马上就会知道了。

original: Talk about old times
translation: 聊起曾经的日子

original: Forget suns and their strife; hunting-fires and the Courtesy. Talk instead of better days.
translation: 忘记太阳以及它们的争斗；忘记狩猎的火焰与仪节。转而谈论更美好的日子。

original: A brief warmth
translation: 短暂的温暖

original:
For a time, you try to forget. You talk about old escapades and friends, bicker companionably about unsettled arguments, tease each other with familiar precision.

It is good, for a while. But soon her eyes settle on her gloves, and she remembers the Fire that Follows and the hopelessness of her position.
translation:
你试图暂时忘记那些东西。你们谈论旧时的历险和友人，友好地在尚未解决的争论上拌嘴，用熟悉的方式互相取笑。

有一段时间，这让人感觉很好。但很快她的目光就落在了她的手套上，她想起了追杀之火和她当前处境的绝望。

original: Discuss what you have learned about the stars
translation: 讨论你们所学到的关于群星的知识

original: Not even the seasoned captains know everything that the two of you have learned. You can speak of this with no one else.
translation: 即使是老练的车长也不知道你们两个人所得知的一切。再无其他人可以诉说。

original: Careless talk
translation: 无忌的谈话

original:
For a while, you talk about the war of the stars, and the terms of the Courtesy that conceals it. Soon, though, she asks to stop. The more you discuss it, the more you think about it, the easier it will be for the Fire to find you.

"When I began learning these secrets, I knew you'd want to know too. Even when I learned of the Fire, I assumed we'd be able to beat it – like we beat everything else." She frowns. "I'm sorry."
translation:
有一阵子，你们谈论星星的战争，以及掩盖它的仪节的条款。但很快，她就要求你停下来。你们讨论得越多，想得越多，火就越容易找到你们。

“当我开始学习这些秘密时，我就知道你也会产生好奇。即使当我得知了火的存在之后，我也认为我们能够打败它——像打败其他东西一样。”她眉头紧锁，“我很抱歉。”

original: Help your friend escape to the roof
translation: 帮助你的朋友逃到屋顶上

original: You knew it was only a matter of time. You have made preparations.
translation: 你知道这只是一个时间问题。你已经做了准备工作。

original: Hunted
translation: 受到追杀

original:
You knew the Fire would come, but not that it would come so soon or so stealthily. 

It inhabited the hearths of four houses around your location. Then put forth embers and fingers of flame. It crept down into their cellars and then through them, to adjacent cellars, building in size and intensity. Then it rose. 

When you emerge onto the roof, an abrupt inferno has broken out. Blue flames, spewing clouds of smoke, consume the surrounding buildings. They have burned a sigil onto New Winchester itself, and now – moving with impossible speed – the fires close in.
translation:
你知道火会来，但不知道它会来得如此之快、如此之隐蔽。

它先是栖息在你们周围四栋房屋的壁炉里，随后放出余烬和火焰的手指。火焰蔓延到房屋的地下室，然后穿过地下室，到达相邻的地下室，规模和强度不断增大。然后它升到了空中。

当你来到在屋顶上时，一场炼狱般的大火突然爆发。蓝色的火焰喷出滚滚浓烟，吞噬了周围的建筑物。它们在新温彻斯特灼上了一个符印。而现在，以一个不可思议的速度，火势逼近了。

original: The Fire has Followed
translation: 火之追杀

original:
On the roof, with a ring of smoke drawing in, the [qvd:139308(ID2)] leans on you, heavily.

"I'm sorry. You know as much as I do, now. It will never stop hunting us. If I could offer myself up to spare you, I would."

You feel an abrupt itching at your neck. Your second mouth, the 'gift' from the Halved, speaks once more. "This is possible," it says.
translation:
屋顶上，随着一串浓烟吸入，[qvd:139308(ID2)]重重地倒在了你身上。

“对不起。你现在知道的和我一样多。它永远不会停止追捕我们。如果我能献出自己来换取你的生命，我会那样做的。”

你感到脖子上突然痒了一下。你的第二张嘴，来自半分者的“礼物”，再一次开口了。“这是有可能的，”它说。

original: Sacrifice the [qvd:139308(ID2)] to the Courtesy
translation: 将[qvd:139308(ID2)]献给仪节。

original: It is too late for her. She knows so much the Fire will always find her. But her sacrifice will summon the Courtesy, and allow you to bargain.
translation: 对她来说已经太晚了。她知道的太多了，火总是会找到她。但她的牺牲会召唤出仪节，让你可以寻求宽大处理。

original: The bargain
translation: 宽大处理

original:
The Fire pounces, and the [qvd:139308(ID2)] is engulfed. The last of her secrets bloom across her skin. The petty, gnawing wrongs of her youth. The extent of her feelings towards you. The fact that, in the moments before she dies, she regrets making this bargain, and wishes desperately that the fire had taken you instead of her.

Your second mouth speaks words in the language of suns. Its tongue is a yellow flame. Its voice is deep as a brass bell. The Fire that Follows has burned a sigil on the city, and from the sigil arises a Logos of the Courtesy – a servant of the Judgements; a word of living flame.

It pulls the soul from the [qvd:139308(ID2)] and brands you with it. A livid sigil is seared into your skin, closing your second mouth forever. It symbolises your admission to the Courtesy. A license to kill a sun.

The smoke swirls. The fire fades. You are alone on the rooftop.

[You must find a way to kill a sun. You can begin at New Winchester.]
translation:
大火猛扑而来，吞噬了[qvd:139308(ID2)]。她最后的秘密在她的皮肤上绽放。是她年轻时那些琐碎的、折磨人的错误。还有她对你的情感。事实上，在她死前的那一刻，她后悔做了这个交易，并不顾一切地希望大火能带走你而非她。

你的第二张嘴说着太阳的语言。它的舌头是黄色的火焰。它的声音如铜钟一样深沉。追杀之火在城市中烧出了一个符印，从这个符印中产生了一个仪节的圣言，一个司命的仆人：一个由活火焰构成的词语。

它把灵魂从[qvd:139308(ID2)]中扯出，并以其烙印你。一个铁青色的符号被烙在你的皮肤上，永远地关闭了你的第二张嘴。它象征着你对仪节的接纳。一个杀死太阳的许可。 

烟雾旋转。火焰消退。屋顶上只有你一个人了。

[你必须寻找某种杀死一个太阳的方式。你可以在新温彻斯特开始这项任务。]

original: Flee together; ignore the words of your extraneous mouth
translation: 一起逃亡，无视你另一张嘴说出的话

original: You prepared an escape, but it will only be the first. If you stay in the skies, you will be fleeing forever. You will have to find a way to escape the heavens.
translation: 你准备了一次逃亡，但这将只是第一次。如果你留在天空中，你将永远逃亡。你们将不得不找到逃离天穹的方法。

original: Friends in high places
translation: 权贵之交

original: The second mouth closes, tight as a vice. It never speaks again. Over the crackling of fire and the shouts, you hear another, more welcome noise: the shrill scream of a locomotive's whistle. The smoke billows, and out of it thunders the Bodichon, the Plucky Baroness' engine. A rope ladder is flung down, and you help the [qvd:139308(ID2)] climb up and inside as the locomotive pulls away. The fires leap, one last time, and then their blueness fades from them. The Fire that Follows is patient. You think it is enjoying this. "I'll drop you at the station!" the Baroness tells you. "And then you'd better start running." She hugs each of you, once. [Your old friend is now an officer on your locomotive. Talk to her to decide what's next.]
translation: 第二张嘴像虎钳一样紧紧地闭合。它再也不会说话了。 在火焰的噼啪声和叫喊声中，你听到另一种更亲切的噪音：机车汽笛的尖锐鸣笛声。浓烟滚滚，大胆女爵士的博迪雄号风驰电掣地赶来。一架绳梯扔了下来，机车开走时，你帮助[qvd:139308(ID2)]爬到里面去。 火焰最后一次跃起，然后蓝色从它们身上消退。追杀之火很有耐心。你认为它很享受这一切。 “我送你到车站！”女爵士告诉你， “然后你最好跑起来。”她和你们每个人拥抱了一次。 [你的旧友现在成为了你机车上的一名车务官。与她交谈，决定下一步该怎么做。]

original: Ask what it means
translation: 问它是什么意思

original: Time is short. What is it suggesting?
translation: 没时间了。它在暗示什么？

original: The bargain
translation: 宽大处理

original:
"You cannot flee the Courtesy, or defy it. You can only join in. You could appeal for the right to slay a star."

You point out that you are not, in fact, a sun.

"Quite. However, the Courtesy is unspecific on that point. Perhaps, since only suns are capable of defeating other suns, they did not think it worth forbidding others from trying. Or perhaps the idea amused them.

"Regardless, the requirements are the gift of a soul, and an exact supplication. You are not capable of the latter, but I am. And while customarily a rare and elaborate soul is given, to symbolise the weight of the act, hers will do.

"Then, of course, you will ultimately have to kill a sun."
translation:
“你无法逃避仪节，也无法违抗它。你只能参与其中。你可以申请杀死星星的权利。”

你指出，你实际上并非太阳。

“确实如此。然而，仪节在那一点上并未具体说明。或许，因为只有太阳才能击败其他太阳，他们认为禁止其他尝试并不值得。或者，这个想法让他们觉得有趣。

“无论如何，要求是献上灵魂，并提出确切的请求。你无法做到后者，但我可以。而且，按照惯例，通常会献上稀有且复杂的灵魂，以象征这一行为的重量，她的灵魂就足够了。

“当然，最终你必须杀死一个太阳。”

original: The Felined Eccentric
translation: 猫咪怪人

original:
She has a cabin, but usually sleeps on a spare mattress in the engine-room. There, she can hear the rhythm and rumble of the engine, and wake when it hiccups.

[qvd:140261(Root)]
translation:
她拥有一间车舱，但通常会选择在引擎室的备用床垫上睡觉。在那里，她可以听到引擎的节奏和隆隆声，并在发生小问题时立刻醒来。

[qvd:140261(Root)]

original: Break the ice with an offer of approved reading material
translation: 提供已审批的读物来破冰

original: When she is not tinkering with the engine, she likes to read. Perhaps she'd like to pick through some of the material in the hold?
translation: 当她不修理机车的时候，她喜欢阅读。也许她想看一下货舱里的一些读物？

original: Thwarted
translation: 受挫

original:
She smiles. "Thanks, capt—" A cat hisses furiously at you from its perch on the overhead piping. "Stop it, Asmoday!" the Eccentric scolds. "Thanks, captain," she continues. "I brought some books with me, but I've alre—"

A prolonged, deafening clamour interrupts her. A second cat has knocked over a toolbox, covering the floor in spanners. The third climbs under the engine and becomes trapped in a gauntlet of pumping pistons and whirring wheels. It yowls, pitiably. 

You tell her that she can help herself to the books when she's less occupied. Three sets of yellow, baleful eyes watch you depart. They seem smug.
translation:
她笑了。“谢谢，车——”一只猫站在头顶的管道上，突然朝你愤怒地哈气。“别闹了，阿斯莫代！”猫咪怪人骂道。“谢谢，车长，”她继续说，“我带了些书，但我已经……”

一连串震耳欲聋的喧闹声打断了她的话。第二只猫打翻了一个工具箱，地板上洒满了扳手。第三只猫爬到了发动机下面，被困在活塞和飞转车轮的铁笼子里。它发出可怜的叫声。

你告诉她，当不太忙的时候，她可以随意取阅。三双黄色的、充满敌意的眼睛看着你离开。他们似乎很得意。

original: Investigate an eery noise
translation: 调查奇怪的噪音

original: Your dreams are plagued by a star-wind, moaning and mournful. In lieu of sleep, you walk the corridors for a time. A mysterious noise is coming from the engine-room.
translation: 你的梦被星风所困扰，呻吟充耳，哀伤弥漫。你没有睡觉，而是在走廊里走了一会儿。引擎室里传来一阵神秘的声音。

original: The midnight patriarchs
translation: 午夜的元老们

original:
The Eccentric is asleep in her tangle of blankets at the foot of the engine. Three hunched shapes cluster about her. Her cats. 

One of them gnaws at the fingers of the Eccentric's left hand. Another sits on her chest; its weight making her struggle for breath. The third chews insistently at her hair, tugging at it like yarn.

The Eccentric is caught in a dream, her sleepy attempts to dislodge the cats watery and weak. "...spiders in the well..." she moans. "My eyes were fire; the dead grovelled..."

One of the cats looks up, then the others. As one, they consider you, their eyes yellow as sovereigns. Then they melt into the crannies of the engine-room.

[Discuss this with the Felined Eccentric.]
translation:
怪人在发动机脚下的毯子里睡着了。三个弓着身子的身影围绕着她。她的猫。

其中一只咬着怪人左手的手指。另一只坐在她的胸前：它的重量让她呼吸困难。第三只坚持不懈地咬着她的头发，像拉纱线一样扯着它。

怪人陷入了梦境，她迷蒙地试图把猫赶走，但举动显得虚弱无力。“……井里的蜘蛛……”她呻吟着，“我的眼睛曾是火；死者拜倒……”

一只猫抬起头来，然后是其他猫。他们整齐一致地打量着你，他们的眼睛是黄色的，像金镑的颜色一样。然后，他们消融在引擎室的缝隙中。

[就此事与猫咪怪人交谈。]

original: Break the ice with an offer of illicit reading material
translation: 提供非法的读物来破冰

original: The Ministry would not approve of these books, but perhaps the Eccentric will. You've seen her reading, when she can find time away from the engines, and when her cats allow her.
translation: 公德部不会同意这些书通过审查，但也许猫咪怪人会同意。你见过她在读这种东西，当她能找到时间离开发动机，并且她的猫允许她阅读时。

original: Thwarted
translation: 受挫

original:
She quirks an intrigued eyebrow. "Thanks, capt—" A cat hisses furiously at you from its perch on the overhead piping. "Stop it, Asmoday!" the Eccentric scolds. "Thanks, captain," she continues. "I brought some books with me, but nothing—"

A prolonged, deafening clamour interrupts her. A second cat has knocked over a toolbox, covering the floor in spanners. The third climbs under the engine and becomes trapped in a gauntlet of pumping pistons and whirring wheels. It yowls, pitiably. 

You tell her that she can help herself to the books when she's less occupied. Three sets of yellow, baleful eyes watch you depart. They seem smug.
translation:
她感兴趣地扬起眉毛。“谢谢，车——”一只猫站在头顶的管道上，突然朝你愤怒地哈气。“别闹了，阿斯莫代！”猫咪怪人骂道。“谢谢，车长，”她继续说，“我带了些书，但我已经……”

一连串震耳欲聋的喧闹声打断了她的话。第二只猫打翻了一个工具箱，地板上洒满了扳手。第三只猫爬到了发动机下面，被困在活塞和飞转车轮的铁笼子里。它发出可怜的叫声。

你告诉她，当不太忙的时候，她可以随意取阅。三双黄色的、充满敌意的眼睛看着你离开。他们似乎很得意。

original: Talk to her about her cats
translation: 与她谈论她的猫咪

original: You discovered them chewing and smothering her while she slept. Why does she tolerate this?
translation: 你发现他们在她睡觉时啃食她，使她窒息。为什么她能容忍这些事情？

original: The Prison Without Walls
translation: 没有围墙的监狱

original:
Her black cat, Beleth, climbs up her legs with its claws and sprawls about her shoulders.

"Because they're mine. Or I'm theirs; I'm not sure there's a difference. Look, I don't want to make a fuss. Best to just leave it alone." She removes the bandages on her fingers, to reveal the tracery of light scars. "See, it's not so bad." She tries to sound brisk.

You are clearly unconvinced. The Eccentric sighs. "They've been with me since Piranesi," she says. "If you really must know, we'll need to go there. The Chaplains can explain."

[dir:06401842-00d7-463c-8d6b-6fdd41b2edae].
translation:
她的黑猫布锐斯用爪子爬上她的腿，在她的肩膀上爬来爬去。

“因为他们属于我。或者说我属于他们——我不确定这有什么区别。听着，我不想大惊小怪。最好的办法就是不去管它。”她取下手指上的绷带，露出浅浅的疤痕，“看，没那么糟糕。”她试图让自己的声音显得很轻松。

你显然没有被说服。怪人叹了口气。“从皮拉内西开始，他们就一直跟在我身边，”她说，“如果你真想知道，我们得到那里去。牧师们可以解释。”

[dir:06401842-00d7-463c-8d6b-6fdd41b2edae]。

original: Consider secrets you've learned, and how to rid her of Asmoday
translation: 考虑你得知的秘密，以及如何让她摆脱阿斯莫代

original: Asmoday is a saggy ginger cat, his face scarred from countless fights. When you approach him he hisses at you, his ears flat back.
translation: 阿斯莫代是一只皮毛松垮的橘猫，他的脸在无数次的争斗中留下了疤痕。当你接近他时，他会对你哈气，耳朵向后平放。

original: Asmoday, the Thunderer
translation: 阿斯莫代，又名雷霆

original:
The Eccentric shows you her ankle, livid with a lattice of claw-marks. "Asmoday is a ball of anger."

As if on cue, there is a hiss from under the galley table, and Asmoday attacks your knee. You fend him off. He climbs onto a shelf, his fur bristling.

"There's somewhere he might feel at home," the Eccentric says, reluctantly. "But it's not anywhere I want to go. The White Well, in the Blue Kingdom. The things that were cast into it rage against their fate."

Alternately, you could drive him away by damping his fury. The attendants at Magdalene's, it is said, can soothe the wildest soul.
translation:
怪人给你看她的脚踝，上面有一格格的爪痕，都是新伤。“阿斯莫代是个愤怒的毛球。”

仿佛是在提示你，厨房桌子下面传来嘶嘶声，阿斯莫代攻击你的膝盖。你击退了他。他爬上了一个架子，全身的毛炸起。

“有个地方可能会让他感觉舒适一点，”怪人不情不愿地说道。“但那不是我想去的地方。白井，在蓝色王国。被扔进井里的东西对他们的命运感到愤怒。”

或者，你可以通过抑制他的怒火，赶走他。据说，抹大拉之家的侍者可以抚慰最狂野的灵魂。

original: Speak to the Felined Eccentric
translation: 与猫咪怪人交谈

original: You seek her out. She is repairing a leaking pipe with an expression of harried concentration.
translation: 你找到她。她正在修理一个漏水的管道，表情凝重。

original: Otherwise occupied
translation: 忙着做别的事

original:
"Sorry, Captain – busy," she says, half disappearing into a cavity filled with machinery. She swears, floridly, as another pipe springs a leak.

[Your engine will need to be in better repair before the Eccentric has time to talk about personal matters.]
translation:
“抱歉，车长——忙着呢，”她说着，一半身子探进一个满是机械装置的空腔里。当另一根管子漏水时，她用华丽的语言咒骂了一声。

[在你的机车得到维修后，你才能与猫咪怪人就其个人事务进行交谈。]

original: Speak to the Felined Eccentric
translation: 与猫咪怪人交谈

original: Your locomotive has taken a pounding recently, and the Eccentric is having to strip and rebuild the injector. Parts are arrayed, neatly, on a tarpaulin.
translation: 你的机车最近遭受了重创，猫咪怪人不得不拆卸并重新组装喷油器。零件整齐地排列在防水布上。

original: Spit-and-twine
translation: 东拼西凑

original:
She pulls herself out from under the engine and glares at you. For a moment she looks as if she's going to shout at you, but she bites her tongue.

"You need to take better care of her, Captain. Now if you don't mind, I'm busy keeping us in the sky."

[Your locomotive will need to be in better repair before the Eccentric has time to talk about personal matters.]
translation:
她从引擎下面探出头来瞪着你。有那么一刻，她似乎要冲你大喊大叫，但她什么也没说。

“你需要对她好一点，车长。现在如果你不介意的话，我正忙着让我们安稳地待在天上。”

[在你的机车得到维修后，你才能与猫咪怪人就其个人事务进行交谈。]

original: Muse on tales of the sky, and discuss how to rid her of Paimon
translation: 思考天空的故事，并讨论如何让她摆脱拜蒙。

original: Paimon, an aloof flat-faced grey, gives you a baleful look. He has climbed into a cranny under the ceiling, and won't let anyone near.
translation: 拜蒙，一只冷漠的短吻灰猫，给了你一个可怕的眼神。他爬到了天花板下的一个裂缝里，不让任何人靠近。

original: Paimon, the Denier
translation: 拜蒙，又名否认者

original: "Paimon is very governed," the Eccentric observes. The grey cat watches you stiffly, out of reach. "He never plays. And he doesn't like it when I... well, watch this." She comes and sits next to you. Immediately, Paimon jumps up, pries you apart, and sits primly between you. He is aloof and restrained. Perhaps he would enjoy Carillon, where penitents submit themselves to stern punishments and endure them without complaint. "Or, to drive him away, I've heard that at Achlys one can buy substances that make fools even of kings and bishops."
translation: “拜蒙非常守规矩，”怪人观察道。灰猫直直地看着你，遥不可及。“他从来不玩耍。而且他不喜欢我……呃，这么做。”她走过来，坐在你旁边。拜蒙立刻跳了起来，把你们拨开，然后端正地坐在你们中间。 他是一只冷漠而克制的猫。也许他会喜欢钟琴区，在那里，忏悔者服从于严厉的惩罚，并毫无怨言地忍受它们。 “或者，为了赶走他，我听说在埃克吕斯，人们可以买到能使国王和主教变傻的物质。”

original: Scour your charts and discuss how to rid her of Beleth
translation: 仔细查看航图并讨论如何让她摆脱布锐斯。

original: Beleth is a gaunt black cat, always pushing himself to the front at feeding-time; always sitting where people need to be.
translation: 布锐斯是一只憔悴的黑猫，在喂食时总是挤到前面，还总是坐在别人要坐的地方。

original: Beleth, the Demander
translation: 布锐斯，又名索求者

original:
Beleth barges past you in the corridor. He has heard two stokers arguing. When he finds them he watches, rapt, with the air of an ancient philosopher-king. He is fascinated by their red faces, their bristling moustaches, their pointing fingers and clenched fists.

The Eccentric joins you. "Beleth admires force," she whispers.

He would fit in at the Floating Parliament, where MPs push their beliefs into law using words as swords and procedure as nooses.

"Yes," the Eccentric muses. "I think he'd like that. And I know what he'd find intolerable: dreams. Those dreams where the rules all change and your strength is useless. The roses of Caduceus could help."
translation:
布锐斯在走廊从你身边冲撞而过。他听到两个司炉在争吵。当他发现他们时，他全神贯注地看着，带着古代哲人王的气质。他被他们的红脸、他们的小胡子、他们的手指和紧握的拳头所吸引。

猫咪怪人来到了你身边。“布锐斯崇拜武力，”她低声说。

他很适合浮空议院，在那里，议员们化语言为刀剑，化程序为绞索，化信念为法令。

“不错，”猫咪怪人思忖道，“我想他会喜欢这样。而且我知道他受不了什么东西：梦。使规则改变，力量无用的梦。商神宫的玫瑰可以帮助你。”

original: Talk to the Eccentric without her cats
translation: 在她的猫不在的情况下，与猫咪怪人交谈

original: Her eyes are bright. She's been sleeping. She has been able to mingle with the crew without her cats intervening or haunting her new friends with nightmares.
translation: 她的眼神明亮了。她的睡眠安稳了。她可以和列车员们打成一片，而她的猫不会干扰她，也不会让她的新朋友做噩梦。

original: A decision
translation: 抉择

original:
As she works, she talks softly to the engine. Her voice is rhythmed, as if she was soothing an animal.

You hunch near her, and pass her a wrench when she gropes for it.

"Trying to decide what to do with myself," she tells you, still working. "Apart from this, I mean." She sits back on her haunches. "On one hand, I could put it all behind me. Start fresh. On the other—" her eyebrows furrow "—I fancy causing some trouble."  

[Help the Eccentric make her choice.]
translation:
工作时，她会对着发动机轻声说话。她的声音富有节奏，就像在安抚一只动物。

当她摸索着找扳手时，你弯腰递给她一把。

“我在思考没有猫在身边时自己该做什么，”她说着，仍在工作，“我的意思是，除了这个。”她坐回椅子上，“一方面，我可以把这一切都抛在脑后。重新开始。另一方面——”她的眉毛皱了起来，“我希望能大闹几场。”

[帮助猫咪怪人作出选择。]

original: Encourage her to misbehave
translation: 鼓励她恣意行事

original:
She's carried a burden for a long time. Now she should live a little.
[She may become a Brilliant Eccentric, who grants +10 Mirrors, and +1 to the Affiliations of Villainy and Bohemia.]
translation:
她已经背了很久的包袱。现在她应该活得轻松一点。
[她可能会成为聪颖的怪人，她能使你的镜子+10，人脉：恶棍与人脉：波西米亚派艺术家各+1。]

original: The Brilliant Eccentric
translation: 聪颖的怪人

original:
She breaks into a crooked smile. "Why not?" she says. "The sky could do with a little more trouble in it."

Over the next few days, the crew come to meet the new unfelined Eccentric. She laughs more, and apologises less. She invents several modifications for your engine, which no one can understand but nevertheless work brilliantly. She forges a small number of close, fierce friendships.

She still sleeps in the engine-room, most times, and still talks to your locomotive as if it were alive. She does not like cats.

[You have completed the Felined Eccentric's story. Future captains will be able to recruit the Brilliant Eccentric at the Royal Society.]
translation:
她露出了一个诡秘的笑。“为什么不呢？”她说，“天空里容得下更多的麻烦。”

接下来的几天里，列车员们都认识到了这位无猫怪人的新面貌。她笑得更多，道歉更少。她为你的发动机进行了诸多改良，虽然没人能理解，但却运行得非常出色。她与少数几个人建立了亲密无间的友谊。

大多数时候，她仍睡在引擎室里，仍对你的机车说话，好像它是活的一样。她不喜欢猫。

[你完成了猫咪怪人的故事。未来的车长可以在皇家学会招募聪颖的怪人。]

original: The Gentle Eccentric
translation: 温柔的怪人

original:
She is unconvinced. "I'm tired," she says. "I want a quiet life for a while. I've found a home, here, and I want to enjoy it."

Over the next weeks, the crew come to know the unfelined Eccentric. She is a calming, almost motherly presence; sensitive to the mood of the crew, and a sure, steady source of advice. 

She still sleeps in the engine-room, most times, and still talks to the engine when she's working on it. Everything is kept in impeccable order; your locomotive practically purrs. 

[You have completed the Felined Eccentric's story. Future captains will be able to recruit the Gentle Eccentric at Lustrum.]
translation:
她不为所动。“我累了，”她说，“我想过一阵子安宁的生活。我已经找到了一个家，在这里，我想享受它。”

在接下来的几周里，列车员们都认识到了这位无猫怪人的新面貌。她是一个使人平静的、几乎像母亲一样的存在：她对列车员的情绪很敏感，而且是一个可靠而稳定的建议来源。

她仍睡在引擎室里，在工作时仍对你的机车说话。一切都保持着无可挑剔的秩序：你的机车几乎像猫一样打呼噜。

[你完成了猫咪怪人的故事。未来的车长可以在伍载镇招募温柔的怪人。]

original: Try to talk to her cats
translation: 试着和她的猫交谈

original: The cats of London can talk, when they deign to do so. They can be polite, but like to give the impression they know more than you do. And perhaps they do, for they are hoarders of secrets.
translation: 伦敦的猫会说话，当它们愿意这样做的时候。它们很有礼貌，但喜欢给人一种它们比你知道的更多的印象。也许它们确实如此，因为它们是秘密的囤积者。

original: Imposters
translation: 冒名顶替者

original:
The cats do not respond to your greeting. When you ask about their relationship to the Eccentric, one of them yowls. Another washes its paw. The third yawns.

You comment, critically, on their lack of courtesy. They only stare. You see no comprehension in their eyes.

You try the ultimate test: you share a secret, careful to get one detail wrong. They don't correct you. They don't patronise you. They don't even give you a disdainful look.

These aren't cats.
translation:
猫咪们对你的问候没有反应。当你问及它们与怪人的关系时，其中一只猫叫了一声。另一只舔起爪子。第三只打了个哈欠。

你针对它们的无礼批判了一番。它们只是盯着你。你在它们的眼睛里看不到任何理性。

你做了最终的测试：你对它们分享了一个秘密，小心翼翼地把其中一个细节弄错。它们没有纠正你。它们没有嘲讽你。它们甚至没有给你一个不屑的眼神。

这些生物不是猫。

original: Offer to get rid of her cats by more direct means
translation: 提出用更直接的手段来摆脱她的猫。

original: What is there, for example, to prevent you simply throwing them into a well? Or abandoning them on a wreck? Oo! Or flinging them into a weft of unravelling time?
translation: 比如说，有什么可以阻止你把它们扔进井里？或者把它们遗弃在一个机车残骸上？哦！或者把它们扔到崩溃的时间纬线上？

original: The subtraction of cats
translation: 猫的减法

original:
The Eccentric's eyes are shadowed and sunken. She is tired. "Try, if you like," she says. "I already have. It doesn't work."

Her grey cat, Paimon, gives you a smug glare from its nest in the pipework.
translation:
猫咪怪人的眼窝深陷，其中覆着阴影。她很疲惫。“试试看吧，如果你想的话，”她说道。“我已经做过了。它们不起效果。”

她的灰猫，拜蒙，在它位于管道中的窝里给了你一个自鸣得意的瞪视。

original: Encourage her to leave the past behind
translation: 鼓励她抛弃过去

original:
She has been locked in a struggle with those damn cats for years. She deserves some peace and quiet.
[She may become a Gentle Eccentric, who grants +10 Hearts and +1 to the Affiliations of Villainy and Academe.]
translation:
她已经和那些该死的猫斗争很多年了。她应该享受一些安宁和平静。
[她可能会成为聪颖的怪人，她能使你的镜子+10，人脉：恶棍与人脉：波西米亚派艺术家各+1。]

original: The Gentle Eccentric
translation: 温柔的怪人

original:
She nods. "I've found a home, here. It'd be good to enjoy it for a bit.

Over the next weeks, the crew come to know the unfelined Eccentric. She is a calming, almost motherly presence; sensitive to the mood of the crew, and a sure, steady source of advice. 

She still sleeps in the engine-room, most times, and still talks to the engine when she's working on it. Everything is kept in impeccable order; your locomotive practically purrs. 

[You have completed the Felined Eccentric's story. Future captains will be able to recruit the Gentle Eccentric at Lustrum.]
translation:
她点点头。“我已经找到了一个家，就在这里。享受一下应该不会错。”

在接下来的几周里，列车员们都认识到了这位无猫怪人的新面貌。她是一个使人平静的、几乎像母亲一样的存在：她对列车员的情绪很敏感，而且是一个可靠而稳定的建议来源。

她仍睡在引擎室里，在工作时仍对你的机车说话。一切都保持着无可挑剔的秩序：你的机车几乎像猫一样打呼噜。

[你完成了猫咪怪人的故事。未来的车长可以在伍载镇招募温柔的怪人。]

original: The Brilliant Eccentric
translation: 聪颖的怪人

original:
She thinks about it, but shakes her head. "No. No, I think I've done with being meek and reasonable for a while."

Over the next few days, the crew come to meet the new unfelined Eccentric. She laughs more, and apologises less. She invents several modifications for your engine, which no one can understand but nevertheless work perfectly. She forges a small number of close, fierce friendships.

She still sleeps in the engine room, most times, and still talks to your locomotive as if it were alive. She does not like cats.

[You have completed the Felined Eccentric's story. Future captains will be able to recruit the Brilliant Eccentric at the Royal Society.]
translation:
她思考了一会，但摇了摇头。“不，不，我想我已经不再温顺、不再通情达理了。”

接下来的几天里，列车员们都认识到了这位无猫怪人的新面貌。她笑得更多，道歉更少。她为你的发动机进行了诸多改良，虽然没人能理解，但却运行得非常出色。她与少数几个人建立了亲密无间的友谊。

大多数时候，她仍睡在引擎室里，仍对你的机车说话，好像它是活的一样。她不喜欢猫。

[你完成了猫咪怪人的故事。未来的车长可以在皇家学会招募聪颖的怪人。]

original: Dissuade one of the Eccentric's cats from terrorising a stoker
translation: 劝说一只猫咪怪人的猫不要恐吓司炉工

original: The man is pressed against the wall, white-faced and sweating. The cat sits in front of him, its back to you. It stares at the stoker, though from here you can't see why this terrifies him.
translation: 那个男人紧紧靠在墙上，脸色发白，满头大汗。那只猫坐在他面前，背对着你。它盯着司炉，目前你并不明白这么做为什么会让他感到害怕。

original: Cornered
translation: 逼入死角

original:
"Get it away!" the stoker pleads. "It's weighing my soul! Judging it like I was one of the dead!" He tries to raise his hands – to shield his gaze? – but the life seems to have gone out of them. They flop, limply, back to his sides.

The cat is statue-still.
translation:
“把它赶走！”司炉哀求道，“它正在衡量我的灵魂！就像评判一个死者一样评判它！”他试图举起双手——为了遮住他自己的目光？——但生命似乎已从他的双眼中流走了。司炉虚弱地翻起白眼。

那只猫像雕塑一样静止不动。

original: Keep your distance
translation: 和它保持距离

original: That cat is not right.
translation: 那只猫不对劲。

original:
You keep back, as the stoker screams then swoons.

The cat stalks away, sparing you an uninterested look. When it passes you, you feel a wash of heat, as if someone had opened a furnace door.

The stoker is coming to. "I saw a court of statues, presided over by a sphinx," he mumbles. "I saw a parade of the dead brought before it, and I was among them. It's only a matter of time."

You can get no more sense – or work – out of the man, and are forced to put him ashore at the next port.
translation:
司炉发出一声尖叫，随后晕倒在地。你没有靠近一步。

那只猫悄然离开，对你不屑一顾。当它经过时，你感觉到身边传来一股热流，仿佛有人打开了一扇炉门。

司炉醒了过来，“我看到了一个雕像法庭，由一只斯芬克斯主持，”他喃喃地说，“我看到成列的死者被带到法庭面前，而我也在其中。那一天总会来的。”

你没法从他那里得到更多的理性——以及劳动力。你不得不让他在下一个车站离开。

original: Frighten the cat away
translation: 把猫吓跑

original: Clap your hands. Shout at it. Stamp your foot. That sort of thing.
translation: 用力拍手。冲它喊叫。跺脚。诸如此类。

original:
The cat's head whips round to face you. You stumble back – instead of eyes, two writhing sigils of savage fire blaze in its face.

It blinks. The sigils are gone, replaced by its usual supercilious yellow gaze. It hisses at you, and stalks away.

The stoker thanks you, and hurries away.
translation:
猫猛地转头向你。你踉踉跄跄地向后退去，它的脸上没有眼睛，而是两道野火翻腾的符印。

它眨了眨眼。符印消失了，取而代之的是它一贯傲慢的黄色目光。它对你哈气，然后悄然离开了。

司炉对你道谢，随后匆匆离开。

original: Feed Paimon the Achlean catnip
translation: 给拜蒙喂食埃克利猫薄荷

original: For a cat of prim aloofness and cast-iron dignity, succumbing to kittenish delight might be the most severe embarrassment.
translation: 对于一只本性冷漠，心高气傲的猫来说，屈服于幼猫的快乐行为可能会让他极为尴尬。

original: Disportment
translation: 得意忘形

original:
The Eccentric places the catnip on the floor in front of Paimon. He ignores her, studiously.

Then, sniffing the air, he advances cautiously on it. His whiskers splay. His eyes grow wide. He pounces! Springing on the muslined ball, he sinks his teeth into it, raking at it in a frenzy with his rear claws. It escapes him! He leaps after it—

He realises you are watching. He stops, knowing he has disgraced himself. A prim wash will not restore the dignity he has squandered. He must leave.

The next time you are in a station, he slinks from your locomotive, never to be seen again.

The Eccentric straightens, as if a burden had been lifted.
translation:
猫咪怪人把猫薄荷放在拜蒙面前的地上。那只猫故意无视了她。

然后，他嗅着空气，小心翼翼地走到它前面。他的胡须翘了起来。他的眼睛越来越大。他扑了上去！跳到那只绒毛球上，他用牙齿咬住它，用后爪疯狂地扒拉着它。它从他的怀里逃跑了！他蹦起来追赶——

他意识到你一直看着它。他停了下来，知道自己丢了脸。再怎么给自己舔毛也不能恢复他挥霍一空的尊严。他必须离开。

下次你在车站时，他从你的火车头上溜走，再也见不到了。

猫咪怪人直起身来，好像卸下了一个包袱。

original: Check in on the Eccentric
translation: 检查怪人的情况

original: She is busy tinkering with a nest of piping and valves.
translation: 她正忙着修补纠缠在一起的管子和阀门。

original: Patience
translation: 耐心

original:
"Morning, [qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]," she says, as you approach. She has shadows around her eyes, as if she hasn't been sleeping well. One hand is bandaged. Her cats coil about her feet, glaring at you with naked malevolence.

You ask if she's alright, and she smiles breezily. "Oh yes. Mustn't grumble."

Perhaps, in time, she will come to trust you more.

[The Eccentric's story will automatically continue as time passes.]
translation:
“早上好，[qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]，”当你走近时她说道。她带着黑眼圈，似乎没睡好。一只手缠着绷带。她的猫围在她的脚边，带着赤裸裸的恶意瞪着你。

你问她是否还好，她轻松地微笑着。 “哦，是的。没什么要抱怨的。”

也许，过一段时间，她会更加信任你。

[随着时间的推移，猫咪怪人的故事将自动推进。]

original: Consider the Eccentric's situation
translation: 考虑一下猫咪怪人的处境

original: You are helping her rid herself of her troublesome cats.
translation: 你正在帮助她摆脱那些麻烦的猫。

original: Beset by cats
translation: 被猫咪所困扰

original:
The Eccentric was not always as she is now. Once she was something else; something vast and celestial, something masculine, something unknowable and inhuman. But she was cast into the tangles of Piranesi, and when she emerged she was the lean, diligent engineer before you. 

Her cats followed her from Piranesi. They are vestiges of her old self that refused to detach from her. Angry, isolationist, forceful, they are making her life – and the efficient functioning of your engine – difficult.

[Rid the Eccentric of her cats.]
translation:
猫咪怪人曾经不是这样。她曾经是另一种存在：浩瀚无垠、超凡脱俗，充满阳刚之气，神秘难解，并非人类。但她被投进变幻莫测的皮拉内西，脱身后，变成了你眼前这位精瘦勤奋的工程师。 

她的猫自皮拉内西跟随着她。它们是她过去自我的残余，不愿与她分离。它们愤怒、孤立、强硬，使她的生活——以及你机车的高效运转——变得异常艰难。

[帮助猫咪怪人赶走她的猫。]

original: Share an intimate moment when you offer to help her repair the engine
translation: 主动提出帮她修理引擎，与她共度一段亲密的时光

original: Normally when she's like this she closes off, wanting to focus on the work. But you've grown close. She'd accept your help.
translation: 通常情况下，当她干这种事时，她会封闭起来，试图全神贯注于工作。但你们已经变得很亲密了。她会接受你的帮助。

original: Moving as one
translation: 默契

original:
Normally, she protects her corner of the engine room like a tigress; she has everything just how she wants it. But she puts a hand on your arm to say it's all right, and draws you in.

Everything has a place. Tools here, so she can find the one she wants without looking. Spare parts there, ordered according to how often she needs them.

Her instructions are practical; her voice is soft. She places a handful of bolts in your palm, and you note that her skin, still fresh from Piranesi, is already calloused from work. The two of you set to it. 

It comes easily. When she needs to tighten a valve, you hand her the three-quarter inch spanner before she asks for it. When you struggle with a stiff bolt she steps close and lends her strength to yours. 

You replace a gasket. She tightens a belt. You cast a glance her way, and find her casting one back at the same moment. A warm smile rolls across her face, and she turns back to her work.

You throw a lever. The engine rumbles, then settles into a contented purr. "It'll do until we make port," she grins, and nudges you teasingly with her shoulder. "Nice work, you."
translation:
通常情况下，她像母老虎一样保护着她所在的机车角落；她想要的每样东西都在手边。但她会拍拍你的手臂告诉你没关系，并把你拉进来。

每件物品都有它的位置。工具放在这里，这样她不用看就能找到她想要的。备件放在那里，按照她需要的频率排序。

她的指示很实用，声音也很温柔。她在你手心里放了一把螺栓，你注意到她的皮肤，刚从皮拉内西回来时还很水灵，现在却因为工作而变得粗糙。你们两人开始工作。

这很容易。当她需要拧紧阀门时，你还没开口她就接过你递上的四分之三英寸的扳手。当你与一颗顽固的螺栓较劲时，她走近并把自己的力量借给你。

你更换了一个垫片。她收紧了皮带。你抬头一看，发现她也做了同样的事情。她脸上浮现出温暖的微笑，然后转身继续工作。

你扳动一个杠杆。发动机隆隆作响，然后发出满足的咕噜声。“它能撑到我们靠岸，”她笑着，用肩膀轻轻撞了你一下。“你做得很好。”

original: A Secondment: Listen to the Eccentric's suggestion
translation: 借调：听听怪人的建议

original: She has been more pensive than usual today. She almost seems distracted. It has, of course, had no impact on her duties.
translation: 她今天比平时更易沉思。她看起来似乎心烦意乱。当然，这并未对她的职责造成任何影响。

original: A moment of inspiration
translation: 瞬间的灵感

original:
She shakes her head when you ask. "Sorry to trouble you; just an idea I can't shake. I like to be useful." Her smile is crooked. "I wondered about taking some leave at the Royal Society. I could help you out while I'm there. The engineers will have all sorts lying about." 

She turns back to the engine. "Just a thought."

[The Eccentric will generate Experimental Modifications for you while on Secondment. You can drop her off at the workshops of Portsmouth House, at the Royal Society.]
translation:
当你问起时，她摇了摇头。“不好意思打扰你了。只是我有一个无法摆脱的想法。我喜欢成为有用的人。”她的笑容有些拘谨，“我想在皇家协会请几天假。我在那里可以派上用场。工程师们会把各种各样的东西摆在那里。”

她又开始修理引擎。“只是一个想法。”

[怪人将在借调期间为你生成试制改装件。你可以将她送到皇家学会朴茨茅斯工厂的工作室。]

original: The Cobwebbed Throne
translation: 蛛网王座

original: Above, a web of incomprehensible vastness stretches across a quarter of all the sky. Its strands are hung from star to star, smothering their light in jackets of strangling cobweb. The sun of the Blue Kingdom is a twitching, riven husk. You can see where the mother-poison planted a seed deep within it. Where the spiders grew and multiplied, feasting on its innards and its innermost secrets. When its skin split open, and a new spider-senate spilled into the sky. The spider-senate stirs in the recesses of the web. The strands dance. The captive stars quiver, helpless as flies. WELCOME, SPINNER OF THE ALL-WEB. SUB-REGENT IN THE EMPIRE OF SILK. FRIEND. A million spiders spin a soaring bridge, and you cross it to the gargantuan, cobwebbed throne of the Westernmost King. You sit, a tiny fleck upon its seat. Its authority is yours to wield. WHAT WILL YOUR ROYAL NAME BE, NOW YOU ARE REGENT? And you answer...
translation: 头顶，一张无法理解的浩瀚之网延伸到所有天空的四分之一。它的丝线从一颗星挂到另一颗星，把它们的光闷在扼杀的蜘蛛网的外套里。 蓝色王国的太阳是一个抽搐的、被撕裂的躯壳。你可以看到母毒在它的深处种下了一颗种子。蜘蛛在那里生长和繁殖，在它的内脏和它内心深处的秘密上大快朵颐。当它的皮肤裂开时，一个新的蜘蛛大议院就会涌向天空。 蜘蛛大议院在网的凹陷处搅动。蛛丝在舞动。被捕获的星星颤抖着，像苍蝇一样无助。 欢迎，一切网络的编织者。蛛丝帝国的摄政王。朋友。 一百万只蜘蛛纺织出一座高耸的桥，你穿过它，来到蓝宝石之王的巨大的、布满蛛网的王座上。你坐在那里，是王座上的一个小斑点。它的权力由你来行使。 既然你已成为摄政王，你的王室名称会是什么？ 你回答……

original: "All-Conqueror."
translation: “万物征服者。”

original: And you turn your attention to distant Albion.
translation: 然后你把注意力转向遥远的阿尔比恩。

original: A throne of your own
translation: 一个属于你自己的王座

original:
The spider-senate exults. Those few Logoi who surrendered to the all-web will be your generals. Your armies will be of shades and spiders. 

Perhaps, in time, your alliance with the spider-senate will fail. Tomorrow, you will start scheming for that eventuality. But for now, there are three-quarters of the heavens still to claim, and you can be useful to each other.
translation:
蜘蛛大议院欣喜若狂。那些向宏伟罗网投降的少数圣言将成为你们的将军。你的军队将是遗魂和蜘蛛。

也许，假以时日，你与蜘蛛大议院的联盟会失败。明天，你将开始为这种可能性做准备。但就目前而言，还有四分之三的天空要占领，你们可以互相帮助。

original: "Psychopomp."
translation: “普绪科蓬”

original: You will be a shepherd of the dead.
translation: 你将成为死者的牧者。

original: A throne of your own
translation: 一个属于你自己的王座

original:
Perhaps you will be kinder than the last regent, or more fair. 

Perhaps you will make these districts of the dead your playground. 

Perhaps they will become your feasting-hall. 

Perhaps you will negotiate with other deathly regents, or war on them from your silken throne.

Your duty and your burden will be great. For life is only a brief accident, and the living will forever be outnumbered by the patient throngs of the dead.
translation:
也许你会比上一任摄政王更仁慈，或者更公平。

也许你会把这些死者的地域当作你的游乐场。

也许它们会成为你的宴会厅。

也许你会与其他不死的摄政谈判，或者从你的丝绸王座上向他们宣战。

你的责任和负担将无比巨大。因为生命只是一场短暂的意外，生者终将被耐心的死者所压倒。

original: "I will have no name."
translation: “我将没有名字。”

original: The first and only act you will take as regent will be to cast open the doors to your realm.
translation: 作为摄政王，你将采取的第一个也是唯一一个行动是打开你王国的大门。

original: A throne of your own
translation: 一个属于你自己的王座

original:
The old laws need not stand. Let the walls between life and death be torn down. In your domain, the dead will be free to return to their life, and the living free to depart. All will be welcome, and all will be free.

The suns will be horrified. The spider-senate seethes in glee.
translation:
旧律法不需维存。要叫那生与死间的墙垣塌圮。在你的领地，亡者将自由重返他们的生活，而生者也可自行离去。万物皆受迎，诸者俱恣意。

太阳们将会为之惊骇。而蜘蛛大议院则会欢呼雀跃。

original: Join the Grey Conformer for tea
translation: 加入灰暗的顺应者的茶会

original: The Conformer is stern and brusque, but fascinated by the Eccentric and her cats. She brews you strong, dark tea and peppers your officer with questions.
translation: 顺应者严肃而粗鲁，但对猫咪怪人和她的猫着迷。她给你泡浓茶，向你的车务官提出很多问题。

original: Ask about getting rid of the Eccentric's cats
translation: 问及如何摆脱猫咪怪人的猫

original: Is it really impossible, as the Eccentric claims?
translation: 难道真的像猫咪怪人所说的那样，不可能吗？

original: The changes of Piranesi
translation: 皮拉内西的改变

original: "Oh yes. You can't cast them aside any more than you could cast aside your shadow. They are vestiges of that version of you that entered Piranesi long ago; vestiges you chose not to keep. For some reason they followed you out. Perhaps the old you was not cast deep enough into Piranesi. He was notably stubborn." "You see?" the Eccentric says to you. "I'm stuck with them." "Of course," the Conformer says, slurping her tea loudly, "they could choose to leave you." "Wait, what?" the Eccentric's head whips around to face her. "Why didn't you bloody say so?"
translation: “哦，是的。你不能把它们丢在一边，就像你不能把你的影子丢在一边一样。它们是很久以前进入皮拉内西的你的残余：你选择不去保留的残余。出于某种原因，它们跟着你出去了。也许以前的你被投进皮拉内西的程度不够深。他曾经尤为顽固。” “你看到了？”猫咪怪人对你说，“我被他们困住了。” “当然，”适应者说，大声啜饮着她的茶，“他们可以选择离开你。” “等等，你说什么？”猫咪怪人的头向她扭去，“那你__的为什么不早说？”

original: Enquire about convincing the cats to leave
translation: 询问如何说服猫咪们离开

original: The Conformer said that the cats could choose to leave the Eccentric. Perhaps they can be encouraged to do so.
translation: 适应者说，这些猫可以选择离开猫咪怪人。也许可以鼓励它们这样做。

original: The carrot and the stick
translation: 胡萝卜和大棒

original:
"This is an unusual case," the Conformer says, defensively. "But these vestiges are – in essence – aspects of the being who entered Piranesi and emerged as you. They have opinions and preferences, as do we all. 

"If you find somewhere they like, they may stay there. Or if you do something they hate, they may leave! Carrot, or stick."

The Eccentric frowns at the cats. "How do we know what they like and hate?" 

The Conformer shrugs. "No one knows them better than you."

The tea is finished. You return to your engine. "I need to think," says the Eccentric.

[Talk to the Eccentric to discuss how to deal with her three cats.]
translation:
“这种情况十分特殊，”适应者辩解说，“但这些残余物，本质上来说，是进入皮拉内西并最终变成你的那个人的各个方面。他们有各自的性格和偏好，就像我们所有人一样。”

“如果你找到他们喜欢的地方，他们可能会留在那里。或者如果你做了他们讨厌的事情，他们可能会离开！胡萝卜，或者大棒。”

猫咪怪人冲着她的猫皱起眉，“我们怎么知道他们喜欢和讨厌什么？”

适应者耸耸肩。“没有人比你更了解他们。”

茶已经喝完了。你回到你的机车上。“我需要思考，”猫咪怪人说。

[与猫咪怪人交谈，讨论如何处理她的三只猫。]

original: Coggy Conversation
translation: 不甚顺畅的谈话

original: The Fastidious Inspector has a round face, brown eyes and short, dark hair. She gives the impression of being perpetually busy.
translation: 一丝不苟的检察官长着一张圆脸、棕色眼睛和黑色短发。她给人的印象是永远都在忙个不停。

original: Enquire about her work
translation: 聊聊她的工作

original: What are the duties of an agent of the Horological Office?
translation: 时计部的官员有什么职责？

original: A higher calling
translation: 更崇高的使命

original:
She sniffs. "It is of fundamental importance that ten o'clock on the second of June in one corner of the empire occurs at the same time as ten o'clock on the second of June in the opposite corner. How is an Empire to function if it can't agree what day it is?

"Unfortunately, the process is complicated by the fact that time is less reliable than it was. The hours-trade has seen to that."
translation:
她吸了吸鼻子。“在帝国的任何一角，6月2日的10点和另一角6月2日的10点同时发生，是基础的基础。如果一个帝国不能对今天是什么日子达成一致，它该如何运作？”

“不幸的是，由于时间不如以前可靠，这个过程变得复杂。时间贸易已经注意到了这一点。”

original: Ask about the hours trade
translation: 询问时间贸易的情况

original: You've heard the Empress rewards her favourites with gifts of years to extend their lives. And that you can become rich, mining for hours to satisfy London's hunger for them.
translation: 你听说女王用年岁赏赐给她的宠臣，以延长他们的寿命。而且你可以通过开采时间以满足伦敦对它们的饥渴，并借此致富。

original: The tangles of time
translation: 纠缠的时间

original:
"Oh, hours have more uses than that. We use them to increase the efficiency of workworlds, to speed journeys to distant regions, to resolve overcrowding in prisons. It does make my life more difficult, when time knots and stretches like wool on the loom. More difficult, but more vital.

"Her Majesty seized a great trove of them when she assumed the Throne of Hours. And now even more have been found in the Reach. Miners dig them from the ground!" She looks momentarily wistful. "I hope, some day, to retire with a modest pension of years, myself. To prolong the better part of my retirement."
translation:
“哦，时间有多得多的用途。我们用它们来提高工业区的效率，加快前往遥远地区的速度，解决监狱的拥挤问题。它确实使我的生活更加复杂，尤其是时间像织布机上的羊毛一样纠缠伸展的时候。更复杂，但这至关重要。”

“女王陛下在夺取时间王座时占领了一个巨大的时间宝库。而现在，更多的时间在外野地区被发现。矿工们正从地下挖出时间！”有那么一瞬间她显露出了渴望。“我希望，未来的某一天，我自己也能带着年岁作为退休金。延长我退休后的美好时光。”

original: Ask about the Winchester War
translation: 询问温彻斯特战争的情况

original: The Reach is torn by discontent between London loyalists and the more independent settlers.
translation: 外野被伦敦的忠诚派和倾向独立的开拓者对立产生的不满情绪割裂。

original: "An unfortunate business."
translation: “真是不幸之至。”

original:
"There are those who feel that London is a long way away, and that they'd do a better job of governing themselves. The frontier attracts independent spirits. We call them 'Tacketies', for the hobnail boots that are so practical out here."

"London, unsurprisingly, disagrees. The Windward Company earnestly represents Her Majesty's interests in the region. Sometimes very earnestly indeed. The Tacketies call London's loyalists 'Stovepipes'. For our hats, I suppose."

She avoids looking at you. "And you, captain? Where do your sympathies lie?"
translation:
“有些人觉得伦敦离得太远，不如由他们来自治。新边疆吸引着渴望独立的灵魂。我们称他们为‘钉鞋党’，因为在这里，那种钉了铁钉的靴子非常实用。”

“伦敦当然不会放任他们。迎风公司忠实地代表了女王陛下在该地区的利益。有时确实是忠实过头了。钉鞋党称伦敦的效忠者为‘高帽党’。我想大概是因为我们的高礼帽。”

她的目光躲开了你。“你呢，车长？你支持哪一边？”

original: With London
translation: 支持伦敦

original: You remember your heritage, and the Queen who led you to the skies.
translation: 你还记得自己的传承，而且是女王领导你来到天上。

original: "Glad to hear it," she says.
translation: “真高兴你是这么想的，”她说。

original: With the Tacketies
translation: 支持钉鞋党

original: These are new lands. Why should old rules – or old masters – hold sway?
translation: 这里是全新的天地。为什么还要让旧法律，旧主子掌握权柄？

original: "We are never free of the past," she says, her hand touching her pocketwatch. "Never."
translation: “我们永远不能摆脱过去，”她抚摸着她的怀表说道。“永远不能。”

original: You feel no loyalty to either side
translation: 你并不效忠于任何一方

original: Perhaps you'd rather be left alone. Perhaps you are undecided. Perhaps you see the conflict as an opportunity.
translation: 也许你宁愿孤身一人。也许你还没决定好。也许你觉得冲突会带来机遇。

original: "What a remarkable indulgence," she remarks, with a raised eyebrow.
translation: “真是让人印象深刻的包容，”她眉毛一扬，评论道。

original: Discuss the Reach
translation: 讨论外野

original: The wide, wild frontier. A sunless domain, but impossibly verdant – with gargantuan vines, cathedral-sized bronzewoods, and livid fungal archipelagos.
translation: 广阔而狂野的边区。一个无光的领域，但有着不可思议的生机——庞大的藤蔓，主教堂大小的青铜木，狂乱生长的真菌群岛。

original: Far from home
translation: 远离家乡

original: "It has an uncouth splendour. But I miss Albion, and the steady light of the Clockwork Sun. These sunless reaches are so misty and quiet." She pauses. "But critical. The territories here are rich with raw hours, and enough vegetation grows on them to feed the whole of London. Even if some of it is a dubious shape."
translation: “这里有种野性的绚丽，但我想念阿尔比恩，以及发条太阳那稳定的光。这没有无光的疆域过于缥缈，过于安静了。”她停顿了一下。“但却不可或缺。这里的地块富含时间生矿，而且尽管有些长得比较可疑，这里生长的植被足以养活整个伦敦。”

original: Ask for news of London
translation: 询问有关伦敦的新闻

original: The seat of the Empire lies in far-off Albion, where a man-made sun burns in the sky. Another sun blazed there once, before Her Renewed Majesty conquered it.
translation: 帝国坐落于遥远的阿尔比恩，彼处有人造的太阳于天空燃烧。在新生的女王陛下征服那里前，曾有另一个太阳闪耀过。

original: Homesickness
translation: 思乡

original: "London sits in her coat of smog. Courtiers squabble at the foot of the Throne of Hours, hoping to receive endowments of years. Meanwhile, hard-working civil servants labour to ensure everything runs as it should." Was there a touch of archness, there? "All as normal. I miss her, though: there is no city like London in all the Skies. And Albion is very different from the Reach. Much more civilised."
translation: “伦敦端坐在她那烟霾城墙之中。侍臣们在时间王座下争吵，希望得到时间作为赏赐。而辛勤工作的公务员们努力确保一切正常运行。”你有没有感觉到一点滑稽？“都和往常一样。不过我很想念她：在整个天空中，没有哪个城市能像伦敦一样。阿尔比恩与外野非常不同。更加文明。”

original: Discuss suns
translation: 讨论太阳

original: What happened to the Reach's sun? And London has a man-made sun: how did Her Majesty defeat the old one?
translation: 外野的太阳怎么了？再说，伦敦有个人造太阳：女王陛下又是如何击败旧的那个太阳的？

original: Sunless Skies
translation: 无光之空

original:
"We warred and we won. It's not my area of expertise, I'm afraid. The suns made the law, they say. Now Her Majesty makes it.

"As for the Reach's sun?" she looks through the window, at the lightless, stirring mists. "I don't know. Do suns grow old? Do they die of natural causes? I think that would probably be better than the alternative, wouldn't it?"
translation:
“我们征战，且获胜了。恐怕这不是我的专业领域。有人说太阳制定律法。现在则是女王陛下来制定。”

“至于外野的太阳？”她透过窗户，看着无光的、翻涌的薄雾。“我不知道。太阳会变老吗？它们会自然死亡吗？我想这大概好过另外一种可能，不是吗？”

original: Compliment her skills
translation: 恭维她的技术

original: Her hands are deft and sure. She polishes, she cleans, she reassembles.
translation: 她的双手灵巧稳健。她抛光，她清洁，她重组。

original: A compliment
translation: 溢美之辞

original: "Thank you," she says. A small, embarrassed silence.
translation: “谢谢你，”她说。随后是一小段尴尬的沉默。

original: Finish speaking with her
translation: 结束与她的对话

original: Make your parting remarks.
translation: 向她道别。

original: Parting
translation: 分别

original: "Thank you, Captain – for getting me here swiftly and safely."
translation: “谢谢你，车长。让我快速而安全地到达这里。”

original: Begin with pleasantries
translation: 以寒暄开始

original: The journey here was not a calm one. The locomotive was buffeted by a boisterous stellar wind. Perhaps you could talk about the weather?
translation: 来这里的旅程并不平静。机车受到了剧烈星风的冲击。也许你可以谈谈天气？

original: An initial exchange
translation: 最初的交流

original: "I suppose it was rather gusty," she says. "My work requires extensive travel; I've grown accustomed to the High Wilderness' little tantrums. And your engine weathered them well. Some of the vessels I've been on couldn't even keep the wind on the outside."
translation: “我想这风的确相当大，”她说，“长途旅行是我的工作需要：我已经习惯了天野的小脾气。你的机车就能很好地克服它。我坐过的一些机车甚至不能挡住外面的风。”

original: Speak with a Penitent Nurse
translation: 与忏悔的护士交谈

original: She is huddled in a corner with cotton stuffed into her ears.
translation: 她蜷缩在一个角落里，耳朵里塞满了棉花。

original: Attempt to communicate with her
translation: 试图与她沟通

original: It's too loud to speak, certainly.
translation: 当然靠说是不行的，这里声音太大。

original: You communicate in writing
translation: 你用文字交流

original: She has been within the sound of the bells for forty days. The clangour is starting to disrupt her mind. She begs you will help her, and out of your kindness, pay part of her penance for her. She would do the same for you. She is a very kind and forgiving soul. To convince you of this point, she scribbles down assurances, compliments, and a sketch of herself ministering to a leprous child.
translation: 她已经在钟声内呆了四十天了。铿锵的声音开始扰乱她的思想。她恳求你帮助她，并且好心地为她支付部分忏悔。她也会为你做同样的事。她有一个非常善良和宽容的灵魂。为了让你相信这一点，她潦草地写下了保证书、赞美词，以及她为一个麻风病儿童提供服务的素描。

original: Let the Nurse be
translation: 放着护士不管

original: She has enough to tolerate as it is.
translation: 她能忍下去。

original: Donate your Deprivation to the Nurse
translation: 将你的剥夺捐给护士

original: You have done without. You have paid a price. And now you are donating that price to her. You'll have to walk her out, as well.
translation: 你已经受到了剥夺。你已经付出了代价。而现在你要把这个代价捐赠给她。你也要送她出去。

original: Calmer
translation: 镇静

original:
You donate your penance, and she becomes more composed immediately. But the sound of the bells is still bothering her, and she's dizzy and unfit to walk. "I feel like I've had a long fast," she remarks, clinging to your arm on the descending stairs. "I can't say I think much of the Deviless' prescriptions here."

On the remaining stairs, she tells you about the corruption at the hospital where she used to work, the kindly orderlies who drank too much, the administrator who stole from the system, and other peccadillos hardly worth punishing.
translation:
你将忏悔献上，她立刻显出几分镇定。但钟鸣声仍在噬咬她的神经，眩晕使她难以独行。“像是经历了漫长的斋戒，”她攥着你的胳膊蹒跚下楼时低语，“恕我直言，女魔鬼开的这些方子未必高明。”

残阶盘旋而下，她开始絮语往昔医院里的阴翳：酗酒的善良护工、盗用公款的行政主管，以及其他不值惩戒的鸡毛蒜皮。

original: Donate a mix of Deprivation and Ordeal to the Nurse
translation: 将剥夺和折磨的混合物献给护士

original: What good is control if it doesn't come with strength?
translation: 若控制不与力量共生又有何用？

original: Fiercer
translation: 激烈

original:
You donate your penance to her. She struggles: the penance was painful to perform and it is not easy to receive, either.

On the way down the staircase, she tells you about the hospital where she used to work: administrators who stole from the medical funds, doctors who drank before surgeries. Some meant well. Some meant poorly. "I can't say I did much about it. I didn't want to be too harsh with the ones that were trying," she says. "But I should have done, for the patients' sake."
translation:
你将忏悔献给她。她内心备受煎熬：这样的忏悔做起来痛苦不堪，承受起来同样艰难。

旋梯幽转间，她开始絮语往昔医院里的阴翳：染指医疗基金的行政人员，开刀前饮酒的医生。善念如游丝，恶欲若藤蔓。“我终究无所作为，对尚存医者仁心者，总不忍苛责太甚。”她说忏悔，“早该铁腕整顿的，为那些病人。”

original: Ask the Nurse about the Devil with the rose-coloured gloves
translation: 向护士问起戴玫瑰色手套的魔鬼

original: Has he passed this way? Does he like bell music?
translation: 他有没有经过这里？他喜欢钟声音乐吗？

original: Frenzy
translation: 癫狂

original:
She shakes her head in distress. The words she scribbles for you are (if you can read her writing): "Seen the kind before. Had them in hospital sometimes."

You can't get anything clearer out of her.
translation:
她痛苦地摇头。为你潦草写下的字句是（如果你能认出她的笔迹）：“以前见过这种的。医院里时不时就有。”

你无法从她口中得到更清晰的表述了。

original: Speak with the Rubbery Man
translation: 和软体人交谈

original: No one has dressed him for the chess game, or let him enter the board.
translation: 无人替他备好棋局，亦不允他落子入盘。

original: Leave the Rubbery Man alone
translation: 别管软体人

original: Perhaps the game of chess is a better diversion.
translation: 也许下棋是一种更好的消遣。

original: Speak with the Rubbery Man
translation: 和软体人交谈

original: He stands off to one side, tentacles squirming.
translation: 他站在一边，触手在蠕动。

original: Writhing introductions
translation: 辗转的初遇

original: He is surprised that you approach him. He moves to make room for you, in case you are merely trying to occupy his space. When you speak to him, he offers you a squishy handshake. By various signals, gestures, and directions of his eyes, he indicates that he has come here looking for his place in the world.
translation: 他对你的靠近感到惊讶。他挪动身子给你腾出地方，以防你只是想要占据他的空间。当你开口搭话时，他向你伸出绵软无力的手。通过种种信号、手势和目光方向，他暗示自己来到这里，是为寻找在这世间的立足之地。

original: Redemption of a Rubbery Man
translation: 软体人的救赎

original: Conversion requires a change of understanding, an alteration of state both sudden and permanent.
translation: 蜕变需要从认知的改变开始，此举将令存在状态发生突然而持久的变化。

original: Two lumps
translation: 两个疙瘩

original:
You offer the Penance. May the Rubbery use a human penance? Are such penances, well, compatible?

The Rubbery Man accepts it; takes it into an orifice; digests it. His eyes close. Then they open again: they are your eyes. Your eye colour. The same pattern in the iris you know from mirrors. He stares around as though seeing everything for the first time. "Thank you," he says. Perhaps he has grown your tongue and teeth, too.

Then he places two damp objects in your hand, and walks away towards the staircase. Well, it stands to reason that his original eyes had to go somewhere.
translation:
你递出一份忏悔。软体人能否使用人类的忏悔？这类忏悔，呃，能兼容吗？

软体人接过了它，将其纳入一处孔窍，溶解吸收。他闭上双眼。而后再度睁开：那是你的眼睛。属于你的瞳色。虹膜上的纹路与你在镜中所见如出一辙。他环顾四周，仿佛初次目睹万物。“谢谢，”他说。或许他也长出了你的舌头与牙齿。

随后他将两枚湿润的物体置于你掌心，转身朝楼梯走去。显然，他原先的那对眼睛总得有个去处。

original: Elevation of a Rubbery Man
translation: 软体人的提升

original: What would such a person need? Perhaps understanding cut with ambition.
translation: 这样的生物需要什么？或许是理解力与雄心壮志的结合。

original: Transferred
translation: 转蜕

original:
Enlightenment for a start; conversion for a chaser. He consumes both. Tentacles are involved, and the twitching of excessively mobile... would one call those lips?

But then. What a transformation! His features smooth and flatten. His tentacles retract. From a distance, one might take him for a human gentleman with an especially prominent brow.

He assesses you. Then – no thanks, no comment, not even the wave of a tentacle, what an ingrate! – he takes up someone's freshly discarded crozier. As a Bishop, he joins the game in play.
translation:
以顿悟为始，以蜕变为继。二者皆被他吞噬。触腕缠卷其间，还有过度活跃的……那该称之为嘴唇吗？

然而，何等剧变！他面容渐趋平滑，触腕缩入体内。从远处看，他就像一位眉毛格外突出的绅士。

他审视着你。随后——没有谢词、没有评价、连触腕都懒得挥动，真是个忘恩负义的家伙！——他捡起了别人刚丢弃的牧杖，以主教的身份加入了这场棋局。

original: Ask the Rubbery Man about the Devil with the rose-coloured gloves
translation: 向软体人询问戴玫瑰色手套的魔鬼的情况

original: ...and then hope you can understand the answer.
translation: ……然后希望你能理解它的回答。

original: Startling
translation: 惊愕

original:
The Rubbery Man holds up one tentacle, representing the Devil with the rose-coloured gloves. Then he holds up another tentacle. After a moment, he twists the two together. Are the tentacles meant to be kissing? Is that what that is?

When you look blank, the Rubbery Man repeats the pantomime several times. Perhaps the Devil has a lover. Perhaps the Devil loves the Rubbery Man. Perhaps the Devil enjoys exotic forms of dance.
translation:
软体人举起一根触手，代表戴着玫瑰色手套的魔鬼。然后他举起另一根触手。过了一会儿，他把这两条触手扭在一起。这些触手是要接吻吗？是这样一回事吗？

你面色茫然的时候，橡皮人重复了几次这个哑剧。也许魔鬼有一个爱人。也许魔鬼爱着橡皮人。也许魔鬼喜欢异国情调的舞蹈。

original: Speak with the Hellish Penitent
translation: 与地狱忏悔者交谈

original: At the centre of the garden is a picnic banquet. There is too much frosting on all of the cakes, too much oil in the salads; but several of the Penitents sit glumly eating, with only their own clothes for napkins. The Deviless sits among them, eating treacle from a jar.
translation: 花园中央设有一处野餐宴会。所有蛋糕上的糖霜都涂得太厚，沙拉里的油也放得太多；但几位忏悔者只是闷闷不乐地坐着吃东西，只能用自己的衣裳当餐巾布。女魔鬼坐在他们中间，正从罐子里舀糖蜜吃。

original: Ask what she's doing here
translation: 问她在这里做什么

original: She is paying a price on her own behalf.
translation: 她正在为自己的行为付出代价。

original: Hell
translation: 地狱

original: "Supposedly," says the Deviless, between bites, "the souls of Devils are incapable of being refined. You make some adjustments, improve here and there, and then a death or two later and all the work is gone. But I'm determined. If humans can be improved, so can I."
translation: “据说，”女魔鬼主管边咀嚼边说，“魔鬼的灵魂无法被精炼。修修补补做些改良，经历一两场死亡后，所有努力就烟消云散。但我意已决。既然人类能被改良，我亦如是。”

original: Offer a serving of self-knowledge
translation: 提供一份自知

original: She's facile and changeable. Can the truth alter that?
translation: 她是个轻率而多变的人。真相能改变这一点吗？

original: Unwelcome, but...
translation: 不受欢迎，但……

original:
"Thanks," she says dubiously, considering the Penance. It's coiled up on itself, rather vegetal, and with a stink halfway between old flowers and burnt hair.

Then it takes hold. She wears the expression of someone easing into a too-hot bath. 

Finally, when she's acclimatised, she says: "Yes. Well. I was misguided to come here. I see now how it is." She pushes a tower of books in your direction. They have titles like THE TRUTH ABOUT HELL and TRUE TALES OF TERROR... FROM WITHIN THE BRASS EMBASSY. "They were having me read these for penance. You can keep them, if you want."
translation:
“谢了。”她将信将疑地打量着忏悔。那东西蜷曲如藤蔓，泛着植物般的青灰色，散发着介于陈腐花香与焦发之间的怪味。

药效发作时，她的表情如同试探着踏入滚烫浴池的人。

待适应后，她正色道：“是了。看来我来此实属愚行。”她将一摞书推向你，书名尽是《地狱真相录》《黄铜使馆惊魂纪》之类，“他们让我读这些作为忏悔。想要就留着吧。”

original: Offer a serving of endurance
translation: 提供一份忍耐

original: If the Deviless has trouble remaining the same for long, perhaps this is the cure.
translation: 如果女魔鬼难以长时间保持不变，也许这就是解药。

original: A hard penance
translation: 艰难忏悔

original:
"That makes me feel old just looking at it," she says, prodding what you offer with one fingertip. "How long did you hang around to get this?" The desiccated Penance rolls lopsided across the table.

But when she stops jesting long enough to try it, what a change! Her colour changes; her eyes darken from yellow to amber and then almost to brown. "Will the change last?" she demands. "Can my soul truly be refined now?"

Across the table, one of the other penitents mutters, "Still haven't learned to stop asking questions you don't want answers to." But the Deviless is happy.
translation:
“光是看着这玩意儿就让我觉得自己老了，”她用指尖戳了戳你呈上的物品，“蹲守了多久才弄到手？”干瘪的忏悔卷歪斜着滚过桌面。

可当她收起戏谑尝了一口，霎时容光焕发！面颊泛起血色，瞳色从琥珀渐转为深褐：“这变化能持久吗？我的灵魂当真能被精炼了？”

长桌另一端，某个忏悔者嘀咕道：“啧，还没学会别问那些不想知道答案的问题吗。”但女魔鬼已然笑意盈盈。

original: Leave her to her picnic
translation: 让她继续野餐

original: She has a great deal to get through.
translation: 她有很多东西要吃。

original: Speak with the Penitent Ape
translation: 与猿猴忏悔者交谈

original: He has collected human souls, and now he is here to cultivate them.
translation: 他已经收集了人类的灵魂，现在他在这里培养它们。

original: Leave the Ape alone
translation: 不要打扰猿猴

original: You've things to be getting on with.
translation: 你有事情要做。

original: Assist a Penitent Ape
translation: 协助一只猿猴忏悔者

original: How did he even gain entry to the Sand Garden?
translation: 他是如何进入黄沙花园的？

original: Nonsensical chatter
translation: 无意义的唠叨

original:
He tells you, in a low mutter: this soul was a gambler, but a good one, able to remember odds and figures, fast at seeing an opponent's bluff. Took bets where he shouldn't. Calculated the odds of dying in a knife fight and decided he didn't mind a ten percent risk, if the pot was large enough. 

A good soul, but it would be a better one if it could be coaxed, post-mortem, into a little more sense of mortality. That would make it more poignant. (At least, so you gather. The Ape does not use words like poignant. But you take its meaning.)
translation:
他低声咕哝着告诉你：这个灵魂是个赌徒，但赌技精湛，能记住赔率与数字，看穿对手的虚张声势。在不该下注的地方押注。计算过白刃战中死亡的几率后，认定只要赌注足够大，自己并不介意承担百分之十的风险。

是个不错的灵魂，但若能在死后被哄劝着多些对死亡的认知，或许能更上一层楼。那样会让它更具悲剧性。（至少你是这么理解的。猿猴不会用“悲剧性”这种词。但你领会了它的意思。）

original: Give the Ape a truth
translation: 给猿猴一个真相

original: Souls can't be polished post-death. Probably not, anyway.
translation: 灵魂无法在死后被打磨。反正多半不行。

original: You offer the Ape understanding
translation: 你向猿猴提供理解

original: ...and it bites you on the arm. Not a little nip, either, but a deep, angry bite. It has seen nothing but contempt since it arrived here at Carillon. Your honesty, if you like to call it that, is the latest in a line of humiliations. It is finished; it is through. It does its business next to your shoe and scuffles off with its soul collection, leaving one or two trinkets behind.
translation: ……它狠狠咬住了你的手臂。不是轻咬一口，而是带着怒意的深深撕咬。自从来到钟琴区后，它遭受的唯有轻蔑。你所谓的诚实，不过是漫长羞辱链上最新的一环。受够了；彻底完了。它在你鞋边解决完生理需求，然后带着收集的灵魂匆匆离去，留下一两件小饰物。

original: Give the Ape some knowledge
translation: 给猿猴一些知识

original: There are things you have seen and learned, in your sojourn in the Garden of Insatiable Roses.
translation: 你在贪婪玫瑰花园的旅居期间，目睹并领悟了一些东西。

original: Excursions outside death
translation: 死亡之外的游历

original:
It's true that the soul of a dead being cannot be significantly changed. But the gambler: does the Ape still have the corpse handy? Might it not be taken where Death is more forgiving? So sudden a resurrection alone might be enough to make useful alterations in the gambler's attitude to death...?

It is a long journey from here to any place where Death is so forgiving. But the Ape seems game, and well provisioned. He pays you for your insight.
translation:
确实，亡者的灵魂固然无法被大幅改变。但那个赌徒——猿猴手头还留着那具尸体吗？或许能带它去死神更为宽容之地？单是骤然复活这件事，就足以促使其对死亡的态度产生有益转变……？

从这里到任何死神宽容之地都路途遥远。但猿猴显得兴致勃勃，且物资充足。它为你的洞见支付报酬。

original: Meet the Professional Penitent
translation: 面见专业忏悔者

original: She collects penance for other people.
translation: 她为其他人收集忏悔。

original: Speak with the Professional Penitent
translation: 与专业忏悔者交谈

original: It's a slow process, but the quality is better than the indulgence penance one may buy from the Presiding Deviless.
translation: 这过程固然缓慢，但品质终究胜过从女魔鬼主管手中买来的放纵忏悔。

original: Quantities of sorbet
translation: 冰糕的数量

original:
The Penitent is seated on a stool, eating from an enormous barrel of violet sorbet. There is enough to supply a Carnival. The Penitent's lips are blue. Her fingers are sticky. There are purple smears on her frock. Wasps are taking an interest in the side of her face.

When you come over, she puts down her spoon long enough to greet you. "I'm here on behalf of a Viscountess who doesn't love her children. She is waiting back in London for me to deliver her penance."

Pointedly, the Supervising Devil sets another long-handled spoon at her elbow.
translation:
忏悔者坐在矮凳上，正从足以供应整场嘉年华的巨型木桶里舀着紫罗兰冰糕。她的嘴唇泛着靛蓝，指尖粘稠，罩衫上洇开大片紫色污渍。黄蜂正绕着她脸颊打转。

见你走近，她放下长柄勺致意：“我受某位不爱子女的子爵夫人委托而来。此刻她正在伦敦等候我将这份忏悔奉上。”

监督魔鬼意味深长地将另一把长柄勺摆在她肘边。

original: Ask the Penitent about the Devil with rose-coloured gloves
translation: 向忏悔者问起戴玫瑰色手套的魔鬼

original: Perhaps she knows something. She seems well acquainted with the place.
translation: 也许她知道些什么事情。她看起来很熟悉这个地方。

original: Oh, yes...

She smiles reminiscently when you describe the Devil in question. "I know him," she says. "I've been coming here a long time, in my line of work. He used to be very highly placed, you know, and then the Presiding Deviless caught him pinching supplies from the storehouse, and gave him a demotion.

"Now he performs a few of the lesser punishments: some lightweight pitchforking, a little work with a hot poker. But his heart isn't in it. Devils don't stick long at anything."
translation:
听你描述那位魔鬼时，她泛起怀旧的微笑：“我认得他，”她说，“干我这行的，往来此地已久。要知道他曾经位高权重，直到女魔鬼主管逮着他偷拿仓库物资，便将他贬了职。”

“如今他只做些轻量级的叉刑，操弄火钳的小差事。但心思早不在此。魔鬼做任何事都没长性。”

original: Donate Ordeal to the Professional Penitent
translation: 向专业忏悔者捐赠磨难

original: You could provide her with what she needs.
translation: 你可以为她提供她需要的东西。

original: Confused gratitude
translation: 疑惑地道谢

original: "Thanks," she says, accepting your gift and wrapping it carefully in silk. "It's really very kind of you. But you know that this is work for me? I do ordeals as a job. Pain is my skill. I don't mind doing it; as a matter of fact I miss it when I go too long without. Start to worry I'm losing my edge. If you really don't have any other use for it, let me pay you something for it. A commission, we'll say."
translation: “谢谢，”她说，接受了你的礼物，并小心地用丝绸包裹起来。“你真是太客气了。但你知道这对我来说是工作吗？我把折磨当成一份工作。痛苦是我的技能。我不介意做这件事；事实上，当我和它分别太久时，我会想念它。开始担心我会失去优势。如果你真的不需要它们，让我付你一些钱。我们就把它当作是佣金吧。

original: Donate Ordeal and Deprivation to the Professional Penitent
translation: 将折磨和剥夺捐给专业忏悔者

original: She likely has a use for these, for her current customer or for a future one.
translation: 她很可能需要这些，为了给她现有的客户或未来的客户提供服务。

original: Good stuff
translation: 好东西

original: She accepts both Penances gratefully. "Let me pay you," she says. "Deprivations are not my favourite. I still do them, of course. There's nothing I won't live through for a client. But the fasting gets dull. So nice to be able to stock this without having to do it myself."
translation: 她感激地收下两份忏悔。“请容我支付报酬。”她说，“苦修戒律实在不合我胃口。当然仍会照做。为委托人赴汤蹈火本是我的天职。但禁食实在乏味得紧。能囤积现成的免于亲历——何其乐事。”

original: Leave the Professional Penitent
translation: 离开专业忏悔者

original: She has work to do.
translation: 她有工作要做。

original: Meet a Grim Penitent
translation: 遇到一个严峻的忏悔者

original: The man is slim and there are circles under his eyes.
translation: 男人身材瘦削，眼睛下面有黑眼圈。

original: Let the Grim Penitent be
translation: 离开严峻的忏悔者

original: He seems exhausted.
translation: 他看起来很疲惫。

original: Meet a grim Penitent
translation: 遇到一个严峻的忏悔者

original: The man is slim and there are circles under his eyes. He shows no energy at all.
translation: 男人身材瘦削，眼睛下面有黑眼圈，看上去毫无活力。

original: Through the glass
translation: 透过玻璃

original: He lifts his eyes when you seat yourself. It takes time to get him to speak; he finds the effort of conversation very hard going. For the first few exchanges he confines himself to the weather at Carillon. But finally he tells you why he is here. "Too many years I lived on the other side of a mirror," he says. "So long that I forgot everything but that place and its ways, where Is and Is Not change places. I took a companion, and endured his Not-Love. It took me a long time to recognise it for what it was."
translation: 当你坐下时，他抬起眼睛。让他开口需要一些时间：说话对他来说是一件非常困难的事情。在最初的几次对话中，他只谈论钟琴区的天气。但最终，他告诉了你他来这里的原因。“我在镜子另一边生活了太久，”他说，“久到我忘记了一切，除了那个‘是’与‘非是’互换的地方，以及它的规则。我带着一个伴侣，忍受着他的‘非爱’。很久以后，我才意识到那到底是什么。”

original: Share with the Mirrorbound Penitent a Penance suited for those who cross the wrong borders
translation: 与镜缚的忏悔者分享适合跨越错误的边界之人的忏悔

original: He shouldn't have been that side of the mirror to start with.
translation: 他一开始就不应该在镜子的那一边。

original: A world of snakes and mirrors
translation: 一个充满蛇和镜子的世界
