original: A handful of sovereigns will tip the scales.
translation: 只要几枚金镑就会打破均势。

original: The coins gleam on the table. Your newest crewman snatches them up, and attempts an experimental salute. They'll do.
translation: 硬币在桌子上闪闪发光。你最新的列车员把它们捡起来，尝试了一个实验性的敬礼。这就够了。

original: Unwelcome
translation: 不受欢迎

original: Conversation stills. The clientele stare at you, balefully. "Last orders just closed," the barman grunts.
translation: 对话定格。顾客们恶狠狠地盯着你。“最后一轮点单刚结束，”酒保咕哝道。

original: Cast out
translation: 扫地出门

original:
You leave the stuffy, silent pub, and return to the dock.

[You may be able to improve your welcome back at the Port Avon Dock.]
translation:
你离开了那个闷热寂静的酒吧，回到了码头。

[你也许要回到埃文村码头提升你的受欢迎度。]

original: Appreciate an amount of cider
translation: 品鉴一些苹果酒

original: Made from real apples, from the world you left behind! "Careful, now," a local warns you, placidly.
translation: 用真正的苹果制成，来自你离开的世界！“小心点喝。”一个当地人平和地警告你。

original: Memories
translation: 回忆

original: The taste is so sweet, so appley, so heart-twangingly, breath-catchingly nostalgic that it would be easy to miss the kick. What a dangerous little beverage! You drink judiciously, and only allow yourself one more mug. Every sip reminds you of a world that is lost, somewhere at the far end of the universe.
translation: 这味道如此甜美，饱含苹果的香气，如此触动心灵，带着摄人心魄的怀旧质感，以至于很容易让人忽略它的酒劲。多么危险的小饮料啊！你浅酌慢饮，只允许自己再多喝一杯。每一口都让你想起一个已经失去的世界，它远在宇宙遥远的彼端。

original: Oh dear
translation: 哦天啊

original:
It tastes of golden sun and the fields left behind. Another! You must have another! The second tastes even better. The third— Well, you don't remember the third one very well. Perhaps, in addition, there was a fourth, and a fifth. 

You awake beneath one of the trees in the orchard, its hard bark against your cheek. You dimly remember singing something inappropriate, and dark looks from the other patrons. Perhaps you remember climbing on a table – but to what end? 

Goodness, the stars are very bright, aren't they? Very bright indeed. Like bright little needles. Ouch.
translation:
它尝起来有金色阳光和遗留田野的味道。再来一杯！你必须再来一杯！第二杯味道更好了。第三杯——嗯，你不大记得第三杯是什么滋味了。或许，除此之外，还有第四杯和第五杯。

你醒在果园里的一棵树下，它坚硬的树皮抵着你的脸颊。你依稀记得自己唱了一些不合时宜的歌，还收到了其他顾客的白眼。或许你记得自己爬上了桌子——但那又是为什么呢？

天啊，星星好亮啊，不是吗？确实很亮。就像明亮的小针一样。哎哟。

original: Speak to a Short-Sighted Cryptozoologist
translation: 与一名近视的隐居动物学家交谈

original: She perches on a stool in the corner, staring at a map of the Reach. "I could have... no. Must have taken a wrong connection at New Winchester."
translation: 她端坐在角落里的一张凳子上，盯着一张外野的地图。“我本可以……不。一定是在新温彻斯特搭错了线。”

original: Intercede in a mushroomy matter
translation: 针对一件关于菌类的事情进行交涉

original: The pub is out of scrumpy. The barman blames a creature – a cross between a mushroom and a jellyfish. It sways in its seat at the bar.
translation: 酒馆里一团乱。酒保责怪着一个介于蘑菇和水母之间的生物。它在酒吧的座位上晃来晃去。

original: Head upstairs
translation: 往楼上走

original: The New Somerset Hunting Club has exclusive rights to the rooms above the pub, as well as its finest brandies.
translation: 新萨默塞特狩猎俱乐部专享酒馆二层，还有最好的白兰地。

original: Recruit the Rat Brigade
translation: 招募老鼠大队

original:
"Oi! Down here." Three rats glower up at you from below a table, where spilt beer has trickled down to form a rat-reachable puddle.
[This will get you Chief Engineers who will increase your Veils by 6, Iron by 2, and Affiliation: Villainy by 1.]
translation:
“喂！看着点下面。” 三只老鼠从桌子下面怒视着你，洒出的啤酒滴落在那里，形成了一个老鼠语境下的水坑。
[这将使你获得几位轮机长，可使你的面纱+6，钢铁+2，人脉：恶棍+1。]

original: A new beginning
translation: 一个新的开始

original:
The smallest, most scarred rat is called Cinders. She introduces her companions. "This—" she indicates the rat wearing goggles "—is my second, Petronella: our mechanic." She gestures towards a rat with glossy fur. "And this is our agent provocateur, Albrecht." The rat inclines his head. "We need a locomotive."

These battle-hardened rats are all that remain of the Rat Regiment: a mercenary company active in the early days of the Winchester War. "Used to be a dozen of us – the best sappers around," says Cinders. "Now look at us." Her whiskers twitch. "Time for that later. We'll pay, [qvd:131182(SpeechInformal)]."
translation:
身形最小，疤痕最多的老鼠叫做辛德斯。她介绍起了她的同伴们。“这个——”她指的是戴着护目镜的老鼠，“是我的副手，佩特罗内拉，也是我们的机械师。”她指向了一只有着油亮皮毛的老鼠，“而这个呢，是我们的密探，阿尔布雷希特。”阿尔布雷希特颔首示意。“现在我们需要一辆车。”

这些身经百战的老鼠都是老鼠军团帮的残部，那是在温彻斯特战争早期很活跃的一个佣兵公司。“我们以前鼠还不少——第一流的地道兵，”辛德斯说。“看看我们现在的样子。”她的胡须在颤，“一会再说，我们会付钱的，[qvd:131182(SpeechInformal)]。”

original: Recruit an Incorrigible Vagabond
translation: 招募一个无可救药的流浪汉

original:
You find a Vagabond telling stories at the inn with a pint of bitter in his hand.

When he spots you, he buys you a drink and manoeuvres you into a corner. He mentions that he knew a captain in your lineage, and that the two of them came to an agreement. 

After much cautious preamble, he makes his offer. His services are exemplary, he assures you, but they come at a terrible price. Every year, he will take the life of one of your crew.

[This Officer does not require a sign-on fee.]
translation:
你发现一个流浪汉在客栈里讲故事，手里拿着一品脱苦啤酒。

当他发现你时，他请你喝酒并把你拉到一个角落里。他提到他认识一个和你同族的车长，他们两个达成了一个协议。

经过一番谨慎的铺垫，他提出了他的报价。他向你保证，他的服务堪称典范，但要付出可怕的代价。每年，他都会夺走你一位列车员的生命。

[招募车务官需要一笔签约费。]

original: Recruit him as a signaller
translation: 招募他为信号员

original:
Many wouldn't countenance such a bargain. But you can.
[This will get you a Signaller who will increase your Veils by 10 and your Affiliation: Villainy by 2.]
translation:
许多人不会接受这样的交易，但你可以。
[这将使你获得一位信号员，可使你的面纱+10，人脉：恶棍+2.]

original: A new officer
translation: 一位新车务官

original:
He raises his drink to you in a toast, and downs it in a single swig. "May this be the beginning of a beautiful friendship," he says, showing you his teeth in something that approximates a grin.

He doesn't have a bag to pack. He just collects his bindle and his battered violin-case from the corner. When he boards your engine, he starts moving between your crew, chatting to each one amiably, learning names and gathering gossip with fearsome precision.
translation:
他举杯向你敬酒，然后一饮而尽。“愿这是美好友谊的开始，”他说道，露出近似于咧嘴笑的笑容。

他没有包来打包东西。他只是从角落里拿起他的包裹和破旧的小提琴盒。当他登上你的机车时，他开始在你的列车员之间穿梭，与每个人友好地交谈，用惊人的准确度记住每个人的名字和八卦。

original: The Ruins
translation: 遗迹

original:
Not one of the looming stones is quite square, yet they all slot together immaculately. What were these ruins, before their fall? Even their bones are tall and stately as the finest cathedrals of old France. What purpose did they serve in the past, plentiful days when their sun still shone?

[Actions here will wear out your welcome.]
translation:
隐约可见的石头没有一块是方形的，但它们都完美地拼接在一起。在它们坍塌之前，这些废墟是什么？即使是它们的根基，也如同法国最宏伟的大教堂一样高大庄严。在过去阳光依旧照耀的丰饶日子里，它们有何用途？

[在这里的行动可能会让你失去受欢迎度。]

original: Conduct a nocturnal excavation
translation: 进行夜间挖掘工作

original: Port Avon's chief export is souls, quarried from vast stores entombed within the ruins. You'll need assistants, luck and discretion; the locals would not approve.
translation: 埃文村主要出口灵魂，这些灵魂产自废墟中埋葬的巨大储库。你需要助手、运气和谨慎才能采出；当地人不会赞同你擅自挖掘。

original: Quietly does it
translation: 悄悄地做

original: Your spades are muffled. Your voices are low. Furtive hours pass. Hard labour is harder still when it must be done in silence. Eventually, your crew heave on a steel rod, prying a gap between two stones. Something glints within: souls, trapped in lenses the size of soup-plates, and stirring irritably in the light.
translation: 你们铲土时声音低沉。你们低声交谈。时间悄然流逝。当必须悄无声息地工作时，沉重的劳动变得更加艰难。终于，你的列车员用力拉动一根钢杆，在两块石头之间撬开一条缝。里面有什么东西在闪闪发光：那是被困在汤盘大小的透镜中的灵魂，它们在光线下烦躁不安地蠕动着。

original: Empty-handed
translation: 空手而归

original: All night, you dig, prying up vast stones and peering into the dusty cracks for any sign of souls. There is nothing. Perhaps they were crushed. Perhaps other miners got here first.
translation: 整夜，你都在挖掘，撬起一块块巨石，在积满灰尘的裂缝中仔细搜寻，看是否有任何灵魂的迹象。什么都没有。也许它们已被压碎。也许其他矿工先到了这里。

original: An interruption
translation: 一个插曲

original: You wait until the lights in the cottages have all gone out before you begin your starlit work. Your crew quietly clear the mossy rubble and set to prying one of the vast stones from its setting. Suddenly, your lookout hisses a warning. Someone is coming.
translation: 你等到村舍里的灯火全都熄灭，才开始你在星光下的工作。你的列车员悄悄清理掉长满苔藓的碎石，动手把一块巨石从原位撬起。突然，你的放哨者嘶声发出警告。有人来了。

original: Capture them, and continue your plunder
translation: 抓住那人，继续你的掠夺

original:
You dispatch your burliest stokers to overwhelm the wanderer. 
[You may lose additional Welcome.]
translation:
你派出你最强壮的司炉去制服那个漫步者。
[你可能会失去更多的受欢迎度。]

original: It is a villager on a midnight stroll, quickly dealt with. He didn't see your face, but suspicion will inevitably fall on visitors. You finish your work, retrieving a set of gleaming lenses, each holding a soul, from the ruins.
translation: 这是一个半夜闲逛的村民，很快就被处理掉了。他没有看到你的脸，但怀疑不可避免地落在来访者身上。你完成了你的工作，从废墟中取回了一套微微发亮的镜片，每个镜片上都有一个灵魂。

original: Flee
translation: 逃吧

original:
Abandon your work. 
[You will not retrieve any souls.]
translation:
放弃你的工作。
[你无法找回任何灵魂。]

original: Swiftly, you gather your tools and hurry back to your engine, no richer except for a tale of a narrow escape. The villagers will notice someone was digging at the ruins, but they have no reason to be more suspicious of you than usual.
translation: 你迅速收拾好工具，匆匆回到机车旁，除了一个死里逃生的故事外，你一无所获。村民们会注意到废墟受过盗掘，但并无理由对你多加怀疑。

original: Hurry!
translation: 快！

original:
The entrance you've made is narrow and unbraced. But perhaps a nimbler member of your crew could squeeze through. 
[You will lose a Crew.]
translation:
你弄出的入口狭窄且未加固。但也许你列车员中一个更灵巧的成员能挤过去。
[你将损失一名列车员。]

original: They squirm in, and roll out a dozen lenses of smoke glass, in which ancient souls shimmer. Then a rope snaps, the stone collapses, sealing or crushing your crewmate. You escape, richer and lonelier.
translation: 此人扭动着身子进去，滚出十几个烟色玻璃透镜，古老的灵魂在其中闪烁。然后绳子断了，石头塌了，把你的同伴封住或压碎。你逃脱了，变得更加富有，但也更加孤独。

original: Enjoy the picturesque surroundings
translation: 享受如画的风景

original:
How they soar! How tragic! How solemn! Like the most rampant visions of Turner.
[Success will gain you a Vision of the Heavens.]
translation:
他们是如何翱翔的！多么悲壮！多么庄严！就像透纳的最狂放的景象。
[成功后你将获得天界风景。]

original: The house of giants
translation: 巨人屋

original: How vast were the beings that resided here? Were they kings? Was this their palace? You sit in the monumental shadow of a stone, and watch the stars wheel above. What must they think, those stars, to see such grand ruins become the abode of such tiny, brief things?
translation: 居住在这里的生物有多么庞大？他们是国王吗？这是他们的宫殿吗？你坐在一块石头的巨大阴影下，看着星辰在头顶旋转。那些星星看到如此宏伟的废墟成为如此渺小、短暂的事物的居所，它们会怎么想呢？

original:
A milky mist billows across the sky. The stones pour cold shadows over you. They loom like stooping giants. You are so tiny. So fleeting. So easily squashed.

You hurry from their choking immensity, seeking the smaller, familiar shapes of cottages, of trees, of locals leaning on their painted gates.
translation:
乳白色的薄雾笼罩着天空。石头倾泻而下的阴影笼罩着你。它们像弯腰的巨人一样逼近。你是那么渺小。那么短暂。那么容易被压碎。

你匆忙逃离了它们令人窒息的庞然大物，寻找着更小、更熟悉的形状，比如小屋、树木，还有靠在涂满色彩的栅栏上的当地人。

original: Not alone
translation: 并不孤单

original:
Your peace is interrupted by a whistling: a popular tune, appallingly executed. A painter is here. He has set his back to a towering arch, and is painting its reflection from a mirror set beside his easel. The mirror's glass is black, dulling the vibrant green of the moss and the scintillating hues of the sky. 

"The truly picturesque requires a certain restraint," he explains, frowning irritably over his shoulder at the splendid view. "This is trying rather too hard, don't you think?" His presence has ruined the atmosphere, but your walk is not unpleasant.
translation:
一阵刺耳的口哨声打断了你的宁静：那是一首流行歌曲，演奏得极其糟糕。一位画家在这里。他背对着高耸的拱门，正在画板上方的镜子里描绘拱门的倒影。镜子的玻璃是黑色的，使青苔的鲜绿色和天空的闪烁色调变得暗淡。

“真正如画的美景需要一定的节制，”他解释道，同时烦躁地转过头去，皱着眉头看着壮丽的景色。“这太过分了，你不觉得吗？”他的出现破坏了气氛，但你的散步并不因此不快。

original: You have worn out your welcome
translation: 你变得不受欢迎了

original: A couple of the brawnier MacDonald boys are watching the ruins, truncheons in hand.
translation: 几个更强壮的麦克唐纳家的男孩子正手持棍棒看着废墟。

original:
"Best keep out. Dangerous place."

[You may be able to improve your welcome back at the Port Avon Dock.]
translation:
“最好离远点。危险之地。”

[你也许要回到埃文村码头提升你的受欢迎度。]

original: Investigate the rumours of Tacketies in the ruins
translation: 调查废墟中关于钉鞋党的谣言

original: Tackety men have been seen entering the ruins in the dead of night, armed with shovels and lanterns.
translation: 有人看到，手持铁锹和提灯的钉鞋党在深夜悄悄潜入废墟。

original: Into the gloom
translation: 潜入阴影

original:
You wait until the sky is dark and the distant stars have dimmed before making your way to the ruins. You go alone, bearing only a shuttered lantern. 

Dust rises underfoot as you tread along shadowed halls, greater and gloomier than the manors of Old London; through gaps between stones, narrower than the inside of a coffin. Voices grow near; voices and a rich, resplendent light.
translation:
你等到天黑，远处的星星都暗淡了，然后才向废墟走去。你独自前行，只提着一盏带遮光罩的提灯。

你沿着阴暗的大厅一步步走去，大厅比旧伦敦的庄园还要宽敞阴森；穿过比棺材内部还要狭窄的石缝。声音越来越近；是说话声还有明亮耀眼的光芒。

original: Enjoy the picturesque surroundings
translation: 享受如画的风景

original: How they soar! How tragic! How solemn! Like the most rampant visions of Turner.
translation: 他们是如何翱翔的！多么悲壮！多么庄严！就像透纳的最狂放的景象。

original: The house of giants
translation: 巨人屋

original: How vast were the beings that resided here? Were they kings? Was this their palace? You sit in the monumental shadow of a stone, and watch the stars wheel above. What must they think, those stars, to see such grand ruins become the abode of such tiny, brief things?
translation: 居住在这里的生物有多么庞大？他们是国王吗？这是他们的宫殿吗？你坐在一块石头的巨大阴影下，看着星辰在头顶旋转。那些星星看到如此宏伟的废墟成为如此渺小、短暂的事物的居所，它们会怎么想呢？

original:
A milky mist billows across the sky. The stones pour cold shadows over you. They loom like stooping giants. You are so tiny. So fleeting. 

You hurry from their choking immensity, seeking the smaller, familiar shapes of cottages, of trees, of locals leaning on their painted gates.
translation:
乳白色的薄雾笼罩着天空。石头向你投下冰冷的阴影。它们像弯腰的巨人一样逼近。你是那么渺小。那么短暂。

你匆忙逃离了这些令人窒息的庞然大物，寻找着更小、更熟悉的形状，比如小屋、树木，还有靠在涂满色彩的栅栏上的当地人。

original: You are observed
translation: 你被看到了

original:
Your peace is interrupted by a tuneless whistling. A painter is here, meticulously recreating the ruins in oils on his tall canvas. He has made an addition: on a jut of stone he has painted a rag-clad child sitting on the ground, its knees drawn up. Its skin is chalky white. Its back is to you, but its head is turned, one milky eye catching yours.

You examine the ruins. There is no child there. Only the tumbled stone, the moss, and the wind that whistles through the ruin. You leave quickly. The walk has not been as soothing as you hoped.
translation:
一阵刺耳的口哨声打断了你的宁静。一位画家正在这里，他一丝不苟地在高大的画布上用油画颜料重现废墟。他添加了一些内容：在一块突出的石头上，他画了一个衣衫褴褛的孩子坐在地上，膝盖蜷缩着。孩子的皮肤苍白如粉笔。他的背对着你，但头却转了过来，一只乳白色的眼睛与你的目光相遇。

你仔细检查了废墟。那里并没有孩子。只有倒塌的石头、苔藓和穿过废墟呼啸而过的风。你迅速离开了。这次散步并没有像你希望的那样让人心旷神怡。

original: The Claim Fields
translation: 认领地

original: The Mother of Mountains stretches on almost forever, from its snowy peak down through seemingly endless strata of lethal nebula gas. On the far side of its cliffs, the Windward Company's machines strip the rocky flesh from the mountain and cast its ore into the perpetual fire of their furnaces. Prospectors from Lustrum have to do everything the hard way, chip-chipping away at their frozen, hard-won claims in search of precious Hours.
translation: 群山之母几乎无边无际，从雪顶一路延伸，一直到看似无尽的致命雾气层。在其遥远一端的峭壁，迎风公司的机器从山上剥下它坚硬的血肉，把矿石投进熔炉的永恒烈焰中。伍载镇的探矿者不得不费尽周折，一点一点凿着他们来之不易的冻结领地，寻找着珍贵的时间。

original: Search for a claim
translation: 寻找认领地

original: The mountain is treacherous. Most of the accessible parts are already staked out.
translation: 这座山很险峻。大多数可通行的地方都已经被占据。

original: An aborted journey
translation: 一次被中止的旅行

original:
Conditions are harsh. The mountain seems to fight your every step. Ropes left behind by other prospectors coil around your ankles. Old boxes of supplies loiter under the snow, ready to trip you. It's almost impossible to tell the difference between one patch of land and another, never mind the value of individual claims.

"What you need is an hour harker," advises a passing hour-harker. He grins. He doesn't have many teeth, but those that remain are capped with gold. "Come find me in town if you want. Or not. There's always more of you showing up, eh?"
translation:
条件很艰苦。这座山似乎在与你的每一步作斗争。其他探矿者留下的绳索缠绕着你的脚踝。旧箱子在雪里徘徊，随时准备绊倒你。几乎不可能分辨出一块土地和另一块土地的区别，更不用说单个矿权的价值了。

“你需要一个时间探子，”一个路过的时间探子建议道。他咧嘴笑了。他牙齿不多，但剩下的都镶着金。“如果你想来找我，就到镇上来找我。或者不来也行。你们这样的人总是源源不断地出现，是吧？”

original: Visit your Claim
translation: 视察矿区

original: It would not do to leave it for too long. Claim jumping is rife.
translation: 让它闲置太长时间是不好的。 认领地易主的现象比比皆是。

original: Your claim is silent
translation: 你的认领地很安静

original: Nothing remains of your small mining operation.
translation: 你的小型采矿作业什么也没有留下。

original: The mountain giveth
translation: 大山赐予

original: More prospectors keep flooding into town. Every day, new claims are snapped up. Most will leave with nothing but regret. You may not have made great riches out of this place, but at least you leave to new opportunities and new adventure. Not all are so lucky.
translation: 更多的探矿者不断涌入小镇。每天都有新的矿权被抢购一空。大多数人在离开时都会留下遗憾。你可能没有在这个地方赚到大钱，但至少你离开时还有新的机会和新的冒险。不是所有人都这么幸运。

original: Attempt to climb the mountain
translation: 试图攀登大山

original: No path leads up to the peak, but with a sturdy stick and a stubborn attitude, you may be able to forge one.
translation: 到山顶没有路可走，但你或许可以用结实的手杖和顽强的态度开出一条。

original: A long, challenging hike
translation: 漫长而艰难的徒步

original: The snow is deep and much of the mountain demands scaling cliff-sides and clambering across treacherous ledges. There is no way to tell how long the climb is. Eventually, you claw up onto a ledge near the peak and sit, exhausted. The air is too thin to keep going, even if you had any strength left.
translation: 雪很深，山里许多地方都必须攀登悬崖，或爬过险峻的岩壁。你无从得知还需要爬多久。最后，你终于来到山顶附近的岩架，精疲力竭地坐了下来。空气太稀薄，即使你还有力气，也没法继续前进了。

original: An almost impossible climb
translation: 几乎不可能的攀登

original: The snow is deeper than expected, and the cliffs in your way both taller and more treacherous than you can handle. You reach for a rocky handhold; it crumbles under your hand. Luckily, a snowdrift not too far below catches your fall. Lying winded in the snow, you give up. The mountain is victorious, for today. You retrace your already fading footprints back to the relative flatness of the Claim Fields.
translation: 雪比预期的要深，挡在你面前的悬崖既高又险，超出了你的承受能力。你伸手去抓一个岩石支架；它在你的手下崩溃了。幸运的是，下面不远处的一个雪堆接住了你的坠落。躺在雪地里，你放弃了。山是胜利的，就今天而言。你沿着逐渐消失的脚印回到了相对平坦的领地。

original: Welcome to Worlebury-juxta-Mare
translation: 欢迎来到滨海沃伯瑞

original: Worlebury-juxta-Mare dazzles like a Fabergé egg, lamp-lit, rich brass and Britain in baroque. In the distance, carnival music mixes with faint cheering. A queue twists and snarls along the dock. Visitors are not allowed to just stroll into the port. They must be admitted. Every fortnight, the Bureau of Entertainments holds a lottery to give out a number of pauper's passes which grant free admittance. The queue for these is long, but it's not the only way into the port.
translation: 滨海沃伯瑞就像一颗法贝热彩蛋一样耀眼，灯火通明，有着华丽的黄铜和英国巴洛克风格建筑。在远处，狂欢节的音乐与幽幽的欢呼声混杂在一起。码头上排着长长的队伍，蜿蜒曲折。游客不得随意漫步进入港口。他们必须被接纳。 每两周，娱乐局都会举办一次抽奖活动，给穷人发放一些通行证，让他们免费进入。排队等候的队伍很长，但这并不是进入港口的唯一途径。

original: Bypass the queue, at the insistance of the authorities
translation: 绕过队列，无视官方的坚持

original: A fox-jawed man, smartly dressed in cobalt, takes notice of you. He crooks a finger. "First time visiting Worlebury-juxta-Mare, eh? Come on. Come over then."
translation: 一个尖嘴猴腮、穿着漂亮钴色衣服的男人注意到了你。他勾起一根手指。“第一次来滨海沃伯瑞，是吗？来吧。那就过来吧。”

original:
The representative of the Bureau of Entertainments introduces himself. "We are a department of the Ministry of Public Decency, but we're entirely autonomous. We run this port for the benefit of weary travellers."

He leads you past a queue that doesn't even bother to grumble. "Yes, yes. I know. Queue jumping is terribly uncouth. But would you really rather be mingling with the proletariat when you could be enjoying our port? And I'm sure once you've seen what we have to offer, you'll need to come back again."

He leads you to a fitting station. "Everyone goes through this. There's a dress code."

[The Bureau of Entertainments wishes to encourage industrious captains to patronise the port. To this end, on a captain's first visit they are allowed in both without charge and without having to queue.]
translation:
娱乐局的代表进行了自我介绍。“我们是公德部的一个部门，但我们完全自主。我们经营这个港口是为了疲惫的旅行者的利益。”

他带着你走过一个甚至懒得抱怨的队列，“是的，是的。我知道。插队是非常不礼貌的行为。但是，当你可以享受我们的港口时，你真的愿意和无产阶级混在一起吗？而且我相信，一旦你看到了我们所提供的服务，你就会再回来的，那时你就需要排队了。”

他把你带到一个试衣间。“每个人都会经历这一步。着装是有要求的。”

[娱乐局希望鼓励勤勉的车长们光顾这个港口。为此，在车长的第一次访问中，他们可以免费进入，而且不需要排队。]

original: Queue for a 'Pauper's Pass' to Worlebury
translation: 排队领取前往滨海沃伯瑞的“贫民通行证”。

original: It is time for the lottery. The crowd churns and mutters to itself, politely despairing.
translation: 抽奖的时间到了。人群汹涌澎湃，喃喃自语，礼貌性地感到绝望。

original:
[qvd:135187(Chat)]

It is time. A drum roll is performed by a smugly beaming child in a bright blue uniform. A maternal figure, similarly attired in cobalt, counts off those at the front of the queue. She reaches you, then three behind you, then stops. 

"That's it. The rest of you will have to come back for the next lottery."

Workers from the Bureau of Entertainments swoop in, gathering the lucky winners. A man and a woman appear beside you, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. "Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation:
[qvd:135187(Chat)]

是时候了。一个穿着亮蓝色制服的孩子自鸣得意地打起了鼓。一位同样穿着钴色衣服的母亲数着排在队伍前面的人。她走到你身边，然后在你身后三个人，然后停了下来。

“就这样了。其他人参加下一次抽奖。”

娱乐局的工作人员蜂拥而至，包围了幸运的获奖者。一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等待。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Bribe your way through the door to the Off Season
translation: 通过你的方式贿赂以通过淡季的大门

original:
There is a worker keeping tourists away from the door. He'll need encouragement to let you through.
[You can also enter the Off Season from Worlebury-juxta-Mare pier, but even there, there is a price.]
translation:
有个工人让游客远离门口。他需要贿赂才能让你通过。
[你也可以从滨海沃伯瑞码头进入淡季，但即使在那里，也是有代价的。]

original: The door to the Off Season isn't so much a door as it is a lidless slit, a cut along a periwinkle wall. From where you stand, you can see the corridor is both long and claustrophobic, a throat full of waiting dark. You take a deep breath as you step through and into a miasma of rotting faecal matter.
translation: 淡季的门与其说是一扇门，不如说是一条无盖的裂缝，一条沿着长春花墙的切口。从你站的地方看去，走廊又长又窄，令人窒息，仿佛一条黑暗的咽喉。你深吸一口气，踏入其中，一股腐烂粪便的恶臭扑面而来。

original: Pay for entrance to Worlebury
translation: 花钱进入滨海沃伯瑞

original:
The rich claim their willingness to pay is because their time is expensive. It is definitely not that this is an opportunity to flaunt their wealth.
[This enables you to both skip the queue and avoid donating to the port authorities. It's ludicrously overpriced – but perhaps you can afford it.]
translation:
富人声称他们愿意付钱是因为他们的时间很贵。这绝对不是说这是一个炫耀他们财富的机会。
[这让你既可以跳过排队，又可以避免向港口当局捐款。它的价格高得离谱，但也许你能负担得起。]

original: Authorities quickly commandeer your attention; a man and a woman appearing on each side, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. "Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation: 当局很快就吸引了你的注意力；一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等人。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Gain admittance by supplying the port authorities
translation: 通过向港口当局供货获得准入

original: Someone unglued the ducks in one of the entertainments in the Lanes. Many people won before anyone recognised the problem. The fair needs to replenish its stash of prizes.
translation: 在巷子里的一次娱乐活动中，有人把鸭子解了胶。在人们意识到这个问题之前，许多人已经赢了。博览会需要补充奖品。

original: As soon as you've handed over your goods, the official clicks his fingers. Workers from the Bureau of Entertainments quickly commandeer your attention; a man and a woman appearing on each side, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. "Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation: 你一交出你的货物，官员就叩了叩他的手指。娱乐局的工人很快就吸引了你的注意力；一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等待。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Gain admittance by supplying the port authorities
translation: 通过向港口当局供货获得准入

original: People will keep pilfering the cups for mementos. Replacing them is a constant chore. If you help the Bureau of Entertainments out, they'll slide you in past the queue.
translation: 人们常常会偷杯子作为纪念品。替补它们是一项持续的任务。如果你帮助娱乐局，他们会把你从队列中提出去。

original: As soon as you've handed over your goods, the official clicks his fingers. Workers from the Bureau of Entertainments quickly commandeer your attention; a man and a woman appearing on each side, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. "Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation: 你一交出你的货物，官员就叩了叩他的手指。娱乐局的工人很快就吸引了你的注意力；一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等待。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Enquire about the lottery
translation: 打听抽奖的情况

original: There is no indication as to when it'll next be held. Is it at the whim of the port authorities?
translation: 没有迹象表明下一次何时举行。是由港口当局决定的吗？

original:
The queue snakes across the lip of the docks like an umbilical cord, or a garland. Scalpers bark temptations, promising expedited access. Vendors patrol the undulations of the line, offering drinks, snacks, anything to spare the mind from the doldrums.

Finally, a woman in tattered mourning attire answers. "It's every fortnight, more or less. You'll want to be near the front; they only give out a few passes. Don't want to dilute the quality of the clientele, I hear."

It appears you'll have to come back later, if you want to get in via the Pauper's Pass.
translation:
队伍蜿蜒在码头边缘，像脐带或者花环。黄牛们大声叫嚷，声称能帮人插队。商贩们在起伏的队伍中走来走去，贩售饮料、小吃以及任何能让心情摆脱忧郁的东西。

最后，一个穿着破旧丧服的妇女回了话，“大约两星期抽一次奖。越往前越好：他们只发几张通行证。我听说，他们不想降低顾客的质量。”

如果你想通过贫民区通行证进去，你似乎得晚点再来。

original: Bribe your way through the door to the Off Season
translation: 通过你的方式贿赂以通过淡季的大门

original: The worker keeping tourists away from the door makes one thing clear: you're going to have to compensate him if you're going to enter. You might go in and work – taking income from others. [You can also enter the Off Season from Worlebury-juxta-Mare pier, but even there, there is a price.]
translation: 阻止游客进入的工作人员说得很清楚：如果你要进去，就必须给他补偿。你可以进去工作——从别人那里获取收入。 [你也可以从滨海沃伯瑞码头进入淡季，但即使在那里，也是有代价的。]

original: The door to the Off Season isn't so much a door as it is a lidless slit, a cut along a periwinkle wall. From where you stand, you can see the corridor is both long and claustrophobic, a throat full of waiting dark. You take a deep breath as you step through and into a miasma of rotting faecal matter.
translation: 淡季的门与其说是一扇门，不如说是一条无盖的裂缝，一条沿着长春花墙的切口。从你站的地方看去，走廊又长又窄，令人窒息，仿佛一条黑暗的咽喉。你深吸一口气，踏入其中，一股腐烂粪便的恶臭扑面而来。

original: Distract the officer with a pangolin
translation: 用穿山甲分散官员的注意力

original:
You raise the Perfect Pangolin in defiance. Would he really make this face wait?
[You will only be able to use this short cut once.]
translation:
你挑衅地举起了完美穿山甲。他真的会让这张脸等下去吗？
[你只能使用这条捷径一次。]

original: Butter wouldn't melt
translation: 一脸无辜

original:
The Perfect Pangolin must have been an accomplice to more than a few crimes; she doesn't look the least bit scandalised at your behaviour. She merely steeples her paws and raises a beseeching look at the workers from the Bureau of Entertainments. As expected, they sigh and coo. It isn't long before one steps forward.

"No need to make the pretty thing stand out 'ere. You go inside." They flash you a bright shark smile. "But just this once, you hear?"
translation:
完美无缺的穿山甲一定是不止一次犯罪的帮凶：她对你的行为没有丝毫的忌惮。她只是竖起爪子，向娱乐局的工人们投去乞求的目光。不出所料，他们叹息着，咕哝着。没过多久，就有一个人走了过来。

“没必要让这个漂亮的东西站在外面。你进去吧。”这人向你抛出一个灿烂的鲨鱼笑容，“但就这一次，你听到了吗？”

original: Prove you are permitted to enter Worlebury
translation: 证明你被允许进入沃伯瑞

original: The Ministry admits its own. And you have the necessary paperwork.
translation: 公德部承认了自己的失误。而且你也拥有必要的文件。

original:
The official scans your permit carefully, nods, then clicks his fingers twice. Workers from the Bureau of Entertainments quickly commandeer your attention; a man and a woman appearing on each side, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. 

"Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation:
官员仔细检查了你的许可证，点了点头，然后叩了叩他的手指。娱乐局的工人很快就吸引了你的注意力；一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。

“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等待。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Prove you know the right sorts
translation: 证明你了解合适的人选

original: You've done work for those important to the Ministry. They will have heard of you.
translation: 你为公德部里那些重要人物做过工作。他们一定听说过你。

original:
The official checks a list for your name, nods, then clicks his fingers twice. Workers from the Bureau of Entertainments quickly commandeer your attention; a man and a woman appearing on each side, both exquisitely dressed, their smiles well-whetted knives. 

"Come. Come already. The Couturier doesn't like waiting. You need an outfit. Come, come, come."
translation:
官员在一份名单上查看你的名字，点了点头，然后叩了叩他的手指。娱乐局的工人很快就吸引了你的注意力；一个男人和一个女人出现在你身边，两人都穿着精致，他们的笑容犹如锋利的刀子。

“来吧。快来。时装设计师不喜欢等待。你需要一套衣服。快来快来快来。”

original: Deliver your artist from the Blue Kingdom Embassy
translation: 放下来自蓝色王国使馆的艺术家

original: It's her stop.
translation: 她到站了。

original: The artist disembarks
translation: 艺术家下船

original:
It takes an hour to move all her brushes, easels, paints, pots and other materials from your cargo hold.

"This gives me an idea," she says feverishly, gazing out over the grey seaside. "Imagine a world where all this was... better. Imagine if the process of decay was given the chance to conclude."

Frenziedly, she begins to paint.
translation:
把她的所有画笔、画架、颜料、调色盘和其他材料从你的货舱里搬出来需要一个小时。

“这让我有了个主意，”她狂热地说着，凝视着灰蒙蒙的海边，“想象一下，要是所有这些……都变得更好，那该多好。要是腐烂的过程有机会完成，又会怎样呢？”

她疯狂地开始作画。

original: Exchange Ministry-Approved Literature for Condemned Experiments
translation: 用已审批的文学作品换取违背伦理的实验品

original: Those who work at the cutting edge of scientific endeavour often wish to legitimise their profits. Worlebury's popularity provides an anonymous location for the exchange of goods.
translation: 那些在科学事业的最前沿工作的人往往希望使他们的利润合法化。沃伯瑞的知名度为商品交换提供了一个无名地点。

original: Sealed with a handshake
translation: 握手为证

original:
The scrawny apprentice scratches his downy chin. He conceals the literature within his ill-fitting jacket. 

Your payment taken, he nods several times at a dubiously stained box while wiggling his eyebrows. He is anything but discreet; fortunately, nobody here cares. There are far more interesting entertainments available.
translation:
瘦小的学徒挠了挠他的绒绒的下巴。他把文学作品藏在他那不合身的外套里。

你的报酬已经拿到了，他对着一个可疑的染色盒子点了几次头，同时扭动着他的眉毛。他一点也不谨慎。幸运的是，这里没有人在乎。那边有意思的娱乐活动多着呢。

original: Find your Aunt
translation: 找到你的姨妈

original: She has abandoned her secondment for a trip to the seaside. You'd best locate her before anything disastrous happens.
translation: 她抛下借调的工作不管跑去海边旅行了。你最好在灾难发生之前找到她。

original: A jolly day out
translation: 愉快的休假日

original:
You scour the tea-shops, then follow the trail of devastation and weeping proprietors down to the shore. 

Your Aunt is enjoying a donkey ride. People scatter out of her way as she charges up and down the beach. "Look!" She cries as she passes you, "Donkeys!" It takes some time to convince her to get down.

She looks shame-faced at having abandoned her post. "I suppose I should get back to it," she says, contemplating her sensible flats.
translation:
你搜遍茶行，然后顺着被撞毁的小径和哭泣的店主走到了海边。

你的姨妈正在享受骑驴的乐趣。当她在海滩上冲锋陷阵时，人们纷纷避开给她让道。“看！”她经过你身边时喊道：“驴子！”你花了好一会儿才说服她下来。

她看起来很羞愧，因为她抛下了自己的工作。“我想我应该回去了。”她说，一边盘算着她朴素实用的公寓。

original: Instruct your Aunt to curry favour with the Deathless
translation: 吩咐你的姨妈去讨好不死者。

original: You need connections at the Mausoleum.
translation: 你需要在陵墓中的关系。

original:
Your Aunt nods briskly. "I shall get right to it. I shall organise," she smiles with distinct menace, "an afternoon tea."

You part ways at the shoreline; she back to the sepulchre, you back to the stars.
translation:
你的姨妈轻快地点点头。“我会马上去做。我会去组织，”她微笑着，带着鲜明的危险，“一次下午茶。”

你们在岸边分道扬镳。她回到了墓穴，你回到了星辰间。

original: Instruct your Aunt to gather Hours
translation: 吩咐你的姨妈去收集时间

original: You need time.
translation: 你需要时间。

original:
Your Aunt nods. "The Deathless keep moving their treasuries. But I have an advantage they do not:" she fixes her hat with another pin, "they are not me."

You part ways at the shoreline; she back to the sepulchre, you back to the stars.
translation:
你的姨妈点点头。“不死者一直在转移他们的库房。但我有一个他们没有的优势：”她用另一个别针固定了她的帽子，“他们不是我。”

你们在海岸线上分道扬镳；她回到了墓穴，你回到了星辰间。

original: Bring your Aunt back aboard
translation: 把你的姨妈带回车上

original: She was plainly bored out of her skull at the Mausoleum.
translation: 她在圣宁墓里显然百无聊赖。

original:
"Oh thank Christ," she says. "Pardon my French." Her eyes narrow as you make for the station. "You've not made any changes to my quarters have you? I'll find out if you have!" 

Your crew are, if not happy, then at least relieved that they know definitively where your Aunt is again.
translation:
“哦，感谢上帝，”她说，“原谅我的法语。”当你向车站走去时，她的眼睛眯了起来，“你没有对我的宿舍做任何改动吧？如果你有的话，我会发现的！” 

你的列车员即使不高兴，至少也松了一口气，因为他们又明确知道了你姨妈的位置。

original: The Mists of Worlebury
translation: 沃伯瑞之雾

original: Fog rises from below, seeping through the wooden slats of the dock. The crowds waiting in the queue begin to sing; a watery, ululating tune of no discernible melody.
translation: 雾自下方升起，透过码头的木板条渗透进来。排队等候的人群开始唱歌，一种寡淡的、哀嚎般的曲调，听不出其中旋律。

original: Join the song of the mists
translation: 加入迷雾之歌

original: It rises from the crowd, spreading slowly.
translation: 它从人群中升起，慢慢扩散。

original: The mists recede
translation: 迷雾退去

original: As the final harmony dies with it, peace is restored. Even the memory of the song and your part in its choir fades from memory. Looking down, there is something in your hand. A doll embedded with many small sticks and bound with rope. It has no face, but its stare is no blanker than those on the faces of the people surrounding you.
translation: 当最后的和声消逝，宁静也随之恢复。甚至连这首歌的印象和你在合唱团中的角色也从记忆中消失了。低头一看，你的手里有东西。一个嵌着许多小棍子的娃娃，用绳子捆着。它没有脸，但它的目光并不比你周围人的脸上的目光更空洞。

original: Commingling
translation: 混合

original:
The song spills from your lips. There are no words in it, but as your voice rises with the others there is a sense of belonging.  

Gradually, the mists ebb. The song stills. A woman exclaims with joy, and holds up her right hand. The mists have left her a gift: a pink, new finger sprouting beside her thumb.
translation:
歌声从你的嘴里溢出。它没有任何歌词，但当你的声音与其他人一起升起时，你有一种归属感。 

渐渐地，迷雾退去。歌声停止了。一个女人高兴地叫喊，并举起她的右手。迷雾给她留下了一份礼物：在她的拇指旁边长出了一个粉红色的新手指。

original: Offer sanctuary aboard your train
translation: 在你的火车上提供庇护

original: Most of those queuing are unsettled by the mist. A few are frantic with terror. This would be a good recruitment opportunity.
translation: 排队的人大多都被迷雾吓坏了。少数人因恐惧而疯狂。这会是一个很好的招募机会。

original: Welcome aboard
translation: 欢迎上车

original: You hurry the panicked visitors aboard, and they quickly sign contracts of service. Anything to get away from here as soon as possible.
translation: 你催促惊慌失措的游客上车，他们很快签署了服务合同。他们无论如何都要尽快离开这里。

original: Sell 'protective talismans' to the crowd
translation: 向人们出售“护身符”

original: Yes, yes. Terrifying mists. You have just the solution...
translation: 是的，是的。可怕的薄雾。你正好有解决办法...

original: A little extra profit
translation: 小赚一笔

original: The crowd snaps up your 'guaranteed protections against the transformative properties of the mist'. Customers squeeze their talismans tight as the mist grows deeper. For yourself, you prefer the cozy, mist-free confines of your cabin, watching it slowly recede.
translation: 众人抢购你那“保证免受雾气转化特性影响”的护身符。随着雾气越来越浓，顾客们紧紧地捏着护身符。而对于你自己来说，你更喜欢呆在舒适、无雾的小屋里，看着它慢慢退去。

original: Explore London
translation: 探索伦敦

original:
Liberated from her prison below the earth and elevated to the heavens. Prickled with chimneys. Mantled in sooty smog. Here are old, proud buildings, transported block by pale block to the sky. Here are new edifices of soaring steel and stone and gleaming glass!

The ultimate achievement of Victorian ambition, unhampered by terrestrial concerns. London is a feverish brew of aspiration, empire, and appetite.
translation:
她自地下的监牢中解放，直升天穹。烟囱密布，煤烟遮掩。此处古老而荣耀的建筑，曾是自地底一块块运往天空的苍白石块。这里有飞架铁桥、石头与闪亮玻璃构成的新大厦！

伦敦，维多利亚时代雄心壮志的终极成就，全然不受陆地的诸多阻碍。一个由抱负、君权和欲望组成的狂热城市。

original: Find the Listless Aristocrat's Brother
translation: 寻找无精打采贵族的兄弟

original: The aristocrat stuck at the Avid Horizon mentioned a brother responsible for his predicament.
translation: 那位被困在渴求之地平线的贵族提到了一个导致他陷入困境的兄弟。

original: Doppelganger
translation: 二重身

original:
It takes some time to track down someone resembling the aristocrat. The sooty slums are empty of any fallen nobility. The grand houses close their doors to you. It is as if London would prefer all detainees of the Avid Horizon to remain there.

You've all but given up when you receive a note to meet in the Crown Jewel. A distinguished gentleman sits by the fire, his porcelain features a flawless mirror of his brother's. He intimates a litany of unsavoury habits and hobbies possessed by his younger sibling. Calumny in the nursery; scandal in boarding school; horror in the Young Stags' club. He would very much prefer it if his brother were to stay where he was.
translation:
要找到一位与那位贵族相像的人需要一些时间。肮脏的贫民窟里找不到任何落魄贵族的身影。那些宏伟的宅邸都对你大门紧闭。仿佛伦敦更愿意让所有渴求之地平线的拘留犯都留在那里。

就在你几乎要放弃的时候，你收到了一张纸条，让你在皇冠珠宝店见面。一位显赫的绅士坐在炉火旁，他瓷白的面容与他兄弟别无二致。他暗示了一系列他弟弟拥有的不良习惯和爱好：在育婴室中造谣生事；在寄宿学校里丑闻缠身；在年轻雄鹿俱乐部里骇人听闻。他倒是非常希望他的弟弟能留在那儿。

original: Hand in a new law at the Throne of Hours
translation: 在时间王座处呈递新法

original: One of Her Renewed Majesty's servants awaits you. Perhaps she will deign to give this one her Royal Assent, enshrining your hard work into official Albion law.
translation: 新生女王陛下的一位仆人在等你。也许她会屈尊授予此法以王室批准，把你的辛劳成果铭刻于阿尔比恩的官方法令之中。

original: Politics in action
translation: 政治落地

original:
You present the new law in its ceremonial purple-cushioned box. Not to the Empress, of course. The servants whisper that this is for the best. The last time someone disturbed her, she became Displeased. 

Instead, a page takes the honour of removing the finely written vellum scroll from the box, ceremonially tearing it from top to bottom, lighting it on fire and ceremonially stamping the burning pieces into ash. A parliamentary envoy awaits you outside, bearing a bonus for having got a new bill at least this far.
translation:
你把新法放在铺着紫色垫子的盒子里。当然，不是给皇后的。仆人们低声说这么办最好。上次有人打扰她的时候，她变得“很不高兴”。

作为代替，一位侍从荣幸地从那个盒子里取出字迹工整的牛皮纸卷轴，郑重地从上到下撕开它，把它点燃，并郑重地把燃烧的碎片踩成灰。一位议会特使在外面等着你，带着让新法案至少走到这一步的奖金。

original: Listen to the Will Of The People
translation: 听取民意

original: A delegation has been sent to petition you in your role as Minister.
translation: 一个代表团被派来向作为议员的你请愿。

original: Endless problems, few solutions
translation: 麻烦无穷，办法甚少

original: You listen with appropriate amounts of care to each person who begs a moment of your time. The majority are local issues, not worth bringing up in Parliament. Occasionally, inspiration strikes for a new law. You promise with a politician's sincerity that even if there is nothing you can do, you will do it to the best of your ability. They seem mollified.
translation: 你以恰到好处的谨慎态度倾听每个请求占用你一点时间的人。大多都是本地的问题，不值得被带到议会那里。偶尔也会有新法案的灵感出现。你以政治家的诚意承诺，即使你无能为力，你也会尽你所能去做。他们似乎对此感到欣慰。

original: Endless problems, few solutions
translation: 麻烦无穷，办法甚少

original: You listen with appropriate amounts of care to each person who begs a moment of your time. Until the egg hits you in the face. The perpetrators run off giggling. You wipe away the dripping yolk. Someone should make a law against that sort of thing...
translation: 你以恰到好处的谨慎态度倾听每个请求占用你一点时间的人，直到鸡蛋打在你的脸上。肇事者傻笑着跑开了。你擦去滴落的蛋黄。应该有人制定一项法律，禁止这种事情发生……

original: Present a Bowlderised Poem to Storridges
translation: 向斯托里奇展示一首“鲍德勒化”的诗歌

original: The Ebullient Decadent's work is, ah, strong stuff. You'll need to doctor it to get it past the publisher.
translation: 兴奋的颓废者的这部作品啊，实在是强而有力。你得修改一下才能通过出版社的审核。

original:
Mr Storridge takes the poem from you himself, leaving you to amuse yourself in the waiting room of his posh offices across from St Dominic's. His secretary provides little amusement of her own, though she does share a few choice excerpts from the submissions pile. 

Some hours later, Mr Storridge returns, red-faced, but smiling. "I am entirely convinced that this is an innocent poem about a young gentleman encountering a thorny maiden amidst her bounty of weeping roses. I am delighted to publish this charming contribution to literature."
translation:
斯托里奇先生亲自从你手中接过诗作，让你在他位于圣多米尼克教堂对面的豪华办公室候客室里自娱自乐。他的秘书虽然提供不了多少乐趣，但她会分享一些从投稿中精选的诗句。

几个小时后，斯托里奇先生回来了，他红着脸，但面带微笑。“我完全相信这是一首纯洁的诗，讲述了一位年轻绅士在一片哭泣的玫瑰丛中邂逅了一位带刺的少女。我很高兴能够发表这篇迷人的文学佳作。”

original: Mr Storridge doesn't bother to take the poem into his office, but reads the entire thing in front of you. After the first few stanzas, he turns an exciting shade of red. "Captain," he says. "'Cousins' is not an appropriate rhyme for 'bosoms'." This is the extent of his comment.
translation: 斯托里奇先生懒得把诗拿到办公室去，而是就当着你的面把它全读完了。读了前几节后，他的脸变得异常通红。“车长，”他说，“拿‘cousins’（表姐）和‘bosoms’（胸部）押韵可不太合适。”这就是他的全部评论。

original: Entirely rewrite the Decadent's Work – and give that to the Publisher instead
translation: 完全重写颓废者的作品，并将其交给出版商

original: You are, after all, a poet.
translation: 毕竟你也算是个诗人。

original: Serious edits
translation: 认真编辑

original: You work late into the night, burning several candles to improve upon the Decadent's overheated rhapsodies. Eventually, you've suitably recast the core imagery into something less fleshy and more spiritual in its overtones. And undertones. But the core thematic matter still needs to be addressed. How will you do it?
translation: 你工作至深夜，废了数根蜡烛，力求改进颓废者那过分狂热的狂想曲。最终，你成功地将核心意象重塑得不那么肉欲，而是更具精神内涵。以及更深层次的内涵。但核心主题仍然需要探讨。你会如何着手？

original: A Celestial Cast
translation: 以天界为主题

original: Eleutheria has a star, of a sort. You can work with that.
translation: 从某种意义上来说，厄琉忒里亚有一个星星。你可以借此写作。

original:
You produce a panoply of iambic pentameter, comparing the squirming star of Eleutheria with the luminescent glories of the Empire's new sun. 

It passes Mr Storridge's desk without comment. You appear to have got away with it.
translation:
你创作了一系列抑扬格五音步诗句，将厄琉忒里亚那颗闪烁不定的星辰与帝国新日的光辉璀璨相提并论。

它从斯托里奇先生的桌上掠过，未引起任何评论。看来你这次算是侥幸过关了。

original: A Nocturnal Cast
translation: 以夜行为主题

original: The problem is not really the subject matter. It's the quality of the writing.
translation: 问题其实不在于主题内容，而在于写作的质量。

original: You produce verse as rich as a velvet gown, as heady as well-aged wine. You avoid politics entirely and simply indulge. Mr Storridge asks to see you personally. He tugs at his collar. "Harrumph." He says. "Harrumph." He does promise to publish the poem, but there will be absolutely no illustrations.
translation: 你创作的诗句如同华贵的天鹅绒长袍一般丰富，又如陈年佳酿一样令人陶醉。你完全避开政治话题，只是纯粹地沉浸其中。 斯托里奇先生要求亲自见你。他拽了拽衣领，哼了一声，“哈哧。” 他又说了一声，“哈哧。” 他确实承诺会出版这首诗，但绝对不会有任何插图。

original: A Sovereign Cast
translation: 以皇权为主题

original: Is Her Majesty's Empire not glorified by a meditation on its dark mirror?
translation: 难道通过对帝国阴暗面的沉思，不能彰显女王陛下帝国的荣耀吗？

original:
You make a valiant attempt at putting the argument into rhyming couplets. Happily, 'far' rhymes with star, though you have more difficulty with 'pernicious'. 

Mr Storridge is delighted. "Just the thing," he says. "Never would have thought he'd have come to his senses."
translation:
你尝试将论点以押韵的对句形式表达，这一尝试颇为出色。幸运的是，“far”（远）与“star”（星）押韵，尽管你在处理“pernicious”（有害的）这个词时遇到了更多困难。

斯托里奇先生非常高兴。“太合适了，”他说，“我从未想过他会恢复理智。”

original:
It's no use. It's like trying to improve upon William McGonagall. To the Ebullient Decadent's credit, everything does rhyme, even if you wish, frequently, that it wouldn't. You take out every reference to 'heaving', 'rods', 'chains', 'matrons', and every single occurrence of the word 'lissom'. 

Mr Storridge takes one look at your 'improved' efforts and orders you to leave his office immediately, lest he be forced to fetch the broom.
translation:
这没用。这就像试图改进威廉·麦格那盖尔的作品一样。必须承认的是，兴奋的颓废者的作品确实每句都押韵，即使你经常希望它不要押韵。你删去了所有关于“喘息”、“权杖”、“锁链”、“主妇”的引用，以及每一个“轻盈”这个词的出现。

斯托里奇先生看了一眼你“改进”后的作品，便命令你立即离开他的办公室，以免他不得不拿起扫帚把你赶出去。

original: Deposit the dead
translation: 存放死者

original: Home, at long last. Your crew will be pleased to have them off the train.
translation: 终于到家了。你的列车员们乐于见到他们下车。

original: A creaking return
translation: 艰难的回归

original:
All in all, your navigator admits, they've not been bad passengers – despite their insistence on joining the crew for meals, watching enviously and, in one regrettable instance, dropping a jawbone into the stew.

The Behatted Chaperone sees her charges off the engine with efficiency and tenderness. Her charges slowly disappear into the teeming smog of London. When the last has gone, she turns to you. "Would you come with me? I'm – I'm not sure how my husband will take my return."
translation:
总而言之，你的领航员承认，尽管他们坚持要和列车员一起吃饭，满怀羡慕地旁观，甚至还在一次令人遗憾的事故中把一块颌骨掉进了炖菜里，但他们还算不上糟糕的乘客。

戴着帽子的监护人高效而温柔地目送着她的孩子们下了机车，逐渐消失在伦敦拥挤的烟雾中。当最后一个也离开后，她转向你，说道：“你愿意和我一起走吗？我——我不确定我丈夫会如何看待我的归来。”

original: Agree
translation: 同意

original: There might be tea at the end of it.
translation: 最后可能会有茶。

original:
She rubs her skull. "In case you can't tell, Captain, I am smiling." She leads you through crowded thoroughfares to a quiet street, just behind St Dominic's. There, a little tea shop is waiting. 

Her husband sits inside. While tea for three steeps, he weeps. When he eventually composes himself, you are repaid for her return, with tea as well as coin.
translation:
她摸了摸自己的头骨，说道：“以防万一你看不出来，车长，我在笑呢。”她带着你穿过拥挤的大街，来到圣多米尼克教堂后面的一条安静的街道上。在那里，有一家小茶馆在等着你们。

她的丈夫坐在茶馆里。当三人的茶正在泡制时，他哭了起来。等他最终平静下来后，为了她的归来，他用茶水和钱币向你表示了感谢。

original: Decline
translation: 拒绝

original: Some things must be done alone.
translation: 有些事情必须独自完成。

original: The Behatted Chaperone sighs, the breath rattling through her rib cage. "I suspect you're right. Nothing for it then. Wish me luck." She turns, then stops. "Forget my own head next!" She fiddles in her hat for a large purse. "God bless you and keep you, Captain." She walks away, and is rapidly lost in the smog.
translation: 戴帽子的女监护人叹了口气，气息在她的肋骨间呼噜作响。“我想你说得对。那就没办法了。祝我好运吧。”她转过身，却又停了下来。“别忘了把我的头也算上！”她在帽子里摸索着，找出一个大钱袋。“上帝保佑你，车长。”说完，她便走开了，很快便消失在了烟雾之中。

original: Bring Percy Blythe Home
translation: 带珀西·布莱斯回家

original: The fruiting corpse of the hero moulders in your hold. Time he was home.
translation: 英雄那满是孢子的尸体在你的车舱里腐败着。他该回家了。

original:
An inquiry at the Ministry, in one of their more approachable offices near the station, results in an armada of black-clad Auditors descending upon your engine. Questions are asked. Crew are probed. Poor Percy is prodded, rolled over, prodded some more, and then covered in sheets and bundled away. 

The senior auditor goes to shake your hand, but thinks better of it. "I have a reward here. You will, of course, be sensitive to the memory of the Lieutenant. We would not wish to hear any unauthorised stories of his heroic demise circulating."
translation:
在车站周边一个比较近的办事处里，向财政部进行的一次问询，使一支由黑衣审计员组成的舰队降落到了你的机车上。他们会提出问题，盘问列车员。可怜的珀西被戳刺几下，翻个身，再被戳刺几下，然后被盖上床单，捆绑着离开。

高级审计师想和你握手，但想了想还是没这么做。“我这里有一个奖励。当然，你会对上尉的记忆保持敏感。我们不希望听到任何未经授权的关于他英勇牺牲的故事流传开来。”

original: Bring Percy Blythe Home
translation: 带珀西·布莱斯回家

original: He has been a silent, grim passenger. His eyes are flecked with gold; his cheeks wet with tears.
translation: 他一直是一个沉默而严峻的乘客。他的眼睛里有金色的斑点；他的脸颊被泪水打湿。

original:
An inquiry at the Ministry, in one of their more approachable offices near the station, results in an armada of black-clad Auditors descending upon your engine. Questions are asked. Crew are probed. Percy Blythe is subjected to a number of intrusive questions, all of which he answers perfectly. His memory, and his lucidity, seems much improved by his time aboard your engine. 

He is eager to leave with the auditors when asked. He turns his pale gaze on you, one last time. "Thank you, captain. All shall be well. You've done us a great service." He leaves your engine with the Auditors, trailing spores as he goes.
translation:
在车站周边一个比较近的办事处里，向财政部进行的一次问询，使一支由黑衣审计员组成的舰队降落到了你的机车上。他们会提出问题，盘问列车员。珀西·布莱斯被问到了许多侵扰性的问题，他都回答得很好。他的记忆力，以及清醒程度，似乎因为在你机车上的时间而有了很大的提升。

当被问及时，他很想和审计员一起离开。他把苍白的目光投向你，最后一次。“谢谢你，车长。一切都会好起来的。你已经为我们做了很大的贡献。”他和审计员一起离开了你的机车，一边走一边拖着孢子。

original: Open Sarge's account for the Rat Brigade
translation: 为老鼠大队开启中士的账户

original: The Rat Brigade are ready. Hallidges is no match for their tiny, squeaky resolve.
translation: 老鼠大队已经准备好了。哈里奇不是他们小小的、吱吱叫的决心的对手。

original: The heart of commerce
translation: 商业之心

original:
Hallidge's central office is a restrained art nouveau building, not far from the Ministry. Its girders are curlicued. Its ornamentation offers a tasteful nod to the Clockwork Court; its palette is faded gold, like the afterglow of a sunset. 

Inside: darkwood furnishings, bronzewood counter-tops, and comfortable chairs beside verdant potted plants. Anything to make the customer forget that they are dealing with anything so crass as money.

You approach the nearest clerk, introduce the Rat Brigade, and produce the relevant account number. The clerk's eyebrows rise. "At Hallidges, we measure ourselves by the quality of our clientele," she says, sounding thoroughly miserable. "This way, please."
translation:
哈利吉银行的中央办事处是一座内敛的新艺术风格的建筑，且离公德部不远。它的梁柱弯曲，内部装饰品致敬了发条宫廷。它的色调是褪色的金色，就像夕阳的余辉。

在内部，摆放着黑木陈设与青铜木制柜台，以及摆在青翠盆栽旁边的舒适椅子。全都是能让顾客忘记他们正和像金钱这样粗俗的东西打交道的事情。

你走到最近的柜员面前，向她介绍老鼠大队，并出示相关的账号。柜员的眉毛扬起。“在哈利吉银行，我们以客户的质量来衡量自己，”她说，声音听起来悲惨无比，“请往这边走。”

original: Write the sixth canto of the Song of the Sky
translation: 写下《天野之歌》的第六章

original: Your writing will need to be novel and enticing if you hope to delight the more experienced palates of London.
translation: 如果你希望取悦伦敦更有经验的评论家，你的作品必须新颖且有吸引力。

original: The Sixth Canto
translation: 第六章

original: The city bustles outside your window, paying you very little mind. It's liberating, somehow, to be in a city where you're relatively unknown – in New Winchester, the weight of expectation was crushing. Here, the indifference feels like freedom.
translation: 窗外的城市熙熙攘攘，对你不屑一顾。某种程度上来说，身处一个无人问津的城市是一种解放——在新温彻斯特，期待的重量能把人压垮。在这里，这种冷漠能让你感受到自由。

original: Help the Incautious Driver hunt for the Verdant Fragment
translation: 帮助鲁莽的司机寻找青翠的碎片

original:
Their connection to its progenitor should assist.
[The more places you search, the easier your search will get. Failing here will not harm your quest.]
translation:
这个人与它祖先的联系应该会派上用场。
[你搜索的地方越多，就越容易找到。在这里失败不会让阻碍你的搜索。]

original: A taste on the wind
translation: 风的味道

original:
The Driver sniffs at the air for any hint of loose Verdant spores dragged in by passing travellers. "I can taste something. A fear. Not death, but the loss of something important. The Fragment doesn't want to return. It doesn't want to give up what it's become."

They close their eyes, focusing. "I can taste its design, as well. Its... host knew of a place called Hostrop Deep: a desolate corner of the sky. It meant to hide there. The Deep will be hard to find. When we're close, we'll need to use our scout."

The Deep [dir:15a02c74-f737-4094-b02b-01a35defe13e].
translation:
司机嗅着空气，搜寻着来往过客是否带有些许翠树孢子。“我能感觉到……恐惧的味道。不是惧怕死亡，而是怕失去某种重要的东西。离散孢子不愿回归母体，它不愿舍弃如今的模样。”

此人闭眼凝神，接着说道：“我还能了解它的打算。它的……母体知道一个名叫霍斯特罗普深渊的地方，那是天野中的一个荒凉角落。它打算藏在那里。深渊不好找寻，等我们接近时，得靠侦察兽来精确定位。”

深渊[dir:15a02c74-f737-4094-b02b-01a35defe13e]。

original: A failed attempt
translation: 失败

original: The Incautious Driver spends hours sniffing at the air in search of familiar spores, but to no avail. "We should try somewhere else," they reluctantly decide, shuffling with uncharacteristic glumness back towards the train.
translation: 一连几个小时，鲁莽的司机嗅着空气，寻找着熟悉的孢子，但徒劳无功。司机不情愿地建议道：“我们应该去别的地方试试，”阴沉着脸回到机车上，一反常态。

original: Look for the Baroness of Hell
translation: 寻找地狱的女爵士

original: The Repentant Devil does not know her current address, but he is certain it will be someplace formerly grand.
translation: 悔过的魔鬼不知道她现在的地址，但他肯定那将是一个以前很宏伟的地方。

original: What used to be the Brass Embassy
translation: 曾是黄铜大使馆的地方

original:
You try the remains of the Palace. You try a few townhouses that have fallen on hard times. Then the Repentant Devil cackles to himself and says, "I know where she will be. Hard to believe I did not think of it first."

He leads you unerringly through the streets. It seems he lived here for a time, not long ago.
translation:
你去皇宫的遗迹寻找了一番，又到几座已陷入困境的联排别墅去碰了碰运气。然后，忏悔的魔鬼咯咯一笑，说道：“我知道她在哪里了。很难相信我没有首先想到它。”

他带领你准确无误地穿过街道。看来他在这里住过一段时间，就在不久之前。

original: Seek an Audience with Queen Victoria
translation: 寻求与维多利亚女王会面

original: There is only one person alive who can answer your Aunt's question about the Unclear Bomb.
translation: 只有一个活着的人可以回答你的姨妈关于晦暗炸弹的疑问。

original: Black and gold and glory
translation: 黑色、金色和荣耀

original:
The Throne of Hours rises above the smog of London like an imperial cathedral. False sunlight reflects from it, clear as cut glass and pitiless as dawn. Your Dispensation gets you into the Clockwork Court, where courtiers are permitted to attend upon the Imperial Presence. 

Courtiers outfitted in the Imperial colours of black and gold survey you with a mixture of curiosity and fear. New blood is the engine of change at court, and change is the enemy of security. 

The Royal Chamberlain sweeps you through the Court and into the throne room itself.
translation:
时间王座像帝国大教堂一样耸立在伦敦的烟雾中。它的表面反射出伪日之光，如琉璃般澄澈，如黎明般无情。你的特许状让你得以进入发条宫廷，彼处是朝臣们觐见女王陛下的地方。

身着帝国的黑金华服的朝臣们带着好奇和恐惧打量着你。新鲜血液是宫廷变革的动力，而变革则是安稳的敌人。

皇家内侍领着你穿过宫廷，进入王室。

original: Deliver a Christmas card
translation: 递送圣诞贺卡

original: The card is for 'The Obsolescent Weaver', at a slum near the vast textile factory. A child returning from work gives you directions.
translation: 这张卡片是给“过时织布工”的，位于那座大型纺织厂附近的贫民窟里。一个下班回家的孩子给你指了路。

original: A stinking garret
translation: 一个发臭的车库

original: The weaver sits by the window, breathing through a soot-grey cloth. When you hand her the card, she peers at it to read the address, then fumbles it open. Finally, she speaks, while considering the factory opposite. "'Obsolescent' is polite. Useless is what I am. Can't even patch up their uniforms. I'm nothing but a burden – not that them here would admit it. Bunch of kind-hearted fools." The old weaver fetches an ancient carpet bag from the corner. "Your Council thinks I can be of use. Makes a bl___y change. I owe it to my neighbours to try, anyway. I'll meet the contact now."
translation: 织布工坐在窗边，通过一块烟灰色的布呼吸。当你把卡片递给她时，她眯着眼睛看上面的地址，然后笨拙地打开它。 最后，她一边看着对面的工厂，一边说道：“‘过时’这个词还挺委婉的。我就是个废物，连他们的制服都修补不了。我不过是个累赘——尽管他们不会承认这一点。一群心地善良的笨蛋。” 老织布工从角落里拿出一个古老的毛毯包。“你们的议会认为我还有用。这真是个该死的改变。不管怎样，我得为了我的邻居们试试。我现在就去见联系人。”

original: Collect a telegram for the Incautious Driver
translation: 替鲁莽的司机拿走电报

original: These are expensive to send. It must be important.
translation: 这种东西寄起来很贵。它一定很重要。

original:
The Driver reads the telegram without expression. They show it to you without saying a word. COME HOME STOP YOUR FATHER STOP FUNERAL STOP NEW WINCHESTER STOP DRIVE SAFE STOP.

"He was ill for a long time," the Driver finally manages. "I need to pay my respects."
translation:
司机毫无表情地读着电报。之后，其一言不发地把它拿给你看。回家，句号，家父，句号，丧礼，句号，新温彻斯特，句号，慢点开，句号。

“他病了很久，”司机终于开口，“我得前去吊唁。”

original: Go with the Navigator to the ambassador's house
translation: 与领航员一同前往大使府邸

original: The Navigator waits for you. "I've been away some time. Your vouching for me would make a good impression. I want to make her proud."
translation: 领航员在等你。“我离开了一段时间。你为我担保会留下好印象。我想让她为我感到骄傲。”

original: Disseminate a dangerous essay on Blue Kingdom Philosophy
translation: 传播关于蓝色王国哲学的危险文章

original: The Ministry of Public Decency will never allow it, so you must distribute it illicitly.
translation: 公德部不会允许这样做，所以你必须非法散发。

original: A well-conducted scheme
translation: 一个精心策划的计划

original:
You hire a ragtag crew of enterprising urchins. Though they continuously attempt to pick your pockets, they can be trusted not to turn you over to the Ministry of Public Decency.

After a few evenings spent handing out essays on street corners across London, you've managed to offload over a thousand copies. Most of them will no doubt end up as wastepaper or chip-wrappers, but at least some of them will be read.
translation:
你雇佣了一群虽然衣衫褴褛但很有拼劲的小顽童。尽管他们不断企图掏你的口袋，但你可以相信他们不会把你交给公德部。

在伦敦的各个街角分发了好几个晚上的传单后，你终于成功发出了上千份。其中大部分无疑会沦为废纸或薯片包装纸，但至少有一部分会被阅读。

original: Betrayal
translation: 背叛

original:
You hire a crew of rough-looking fellows to help you sneakily distribute the essays on street-corners, but they throw your pamphlets in the river and abscond with the money you gave them. 

You manage to recover some of the lost essays and hand them out to sympathetic passers-by. But it probably won't prove enough to make a difference.
translation:
你雇佣了一群外表粗犷的家伙帮你偷偷地在街角分发文章，但他们却把你的传单扔进了河里，并且带着你给他们的钱逃之夭夭。

你设法找回了一部分丢失的文章，并将它们分发给了同情你的路人。但这可能不足以产生什么影响。

original: Deliver your poet from the Blue Kingdom Embassy
translation: 放下来自蓝色王国使馆的诗人

original: It's his stop.
translation: 他的终点站到了。

original: The poet disembarks
translation: 诗人下了车

original:
The greasy-haired poet steps down from your locomotive, tapping his pen to his teeth.

"And in the pounding hearts of those who march forth grimly, The knowledge of approaching death burns like a gruesome... like a..." He glances at a nearby rooftop. "Chimney? I suppose that'll do."

He vanishes among the swelling London crowd.
translation:
那位头发油腻的诗人从你的机车上走下来，用笔轻敲着牙齿。

“在那些毅然前行的人们砰砰直跳的心中，对即将到来的死亡的认知燃烧着，如同一个恐怖的……如同一个……”他瞥了一眼附近的屋顶。“烟囱？我想那样也行。”

他消失在了拥挤的伦敦人群中。

original: Spread the Blue Kingdom's influence by publicly denouncing the Empress
translation: 公开谴责女皇，宣扬蓝色王国的影响力

original: Her attempts to extend her Consort's life are an abomination! She sits on a throne of blasphemy and deceit!
translation: 她企图延长她伴侣的寿命，真是令人憎恶！她坐在满是亵渎与欺骗的宝座上！

original: Shock and outrage
translation: 震惊与愤怒

original:
It's not long until the first stone is thrown, but you persist, wiping the blood from your face. You continue your tirade until the constables arrive. They drag you away, still ranting about the Empress's misdeeds.

Most of the crowd were baying for your blood, but you're sure you saw some thoughtful faces among the sea of rage. Your voice was, to some degree, heard. The constables let you go with nothing more serious than a night in the cells and a light beating.
translation:
不久，第一块石头就被扔了出来，但你坚持不懈，擦去脸上的血迹。你继续慷慨陈词，直到治安官赶到。他们把你拖走，你还在不停地咒骂着女皇的恶行。

人群中大多数人都在叫嚣着要你的命，但你确信在这片愤怒的海洋中，你看到了一些若有所思的面孔。你的声音，在某种程度上，被人听到了。治安官只是把你关了一晚上牢房，并稍加殴打，没有更严重的惩罚。

original: An overwhelming tide
translation: 势不可挡的浪潮

original:
Your rant is cut short when the red-faced crowd rises like an angry sea and rushes at you. 

You hop fences and dash across rooftops and eventually manage to lose them, but you never managed to properly make your point. Still, you did the best you could in the circumstances.
translation:
当你滔滔不绝时，脸红的人群如愤怒的海浪般涌起，向你冲来，打断了你的话。

你跳过栅栏，在屋顶上狂奔，最终甩掉了他们，但你始终没有机会把自己的观点好好表达出来。不过，在当时的情况下，你已经尽力而为了。

original: Investigate the smuggling trade
translation: 调查走私

original: Illicit goods – red honey, prohibited literature, starshine – are smuggled in and out of the city. There may be opportunities for profit for a daring skyfarer.
translation: 违禁品——红蜂蜜、禁书、星光酒——在这座城市中进进出出，走私贩卖。对于胆大的行天客来说，这里可能蕴藏着获利的机会。

original: A lead
translation: 一丝线索

original:
You piece together the stories you've heard, and ask careful questions in dubious places. Soon you have an invitation to talk to a Gloomy Middleman at the Admiral Benbow Inn, a few levels down. He is looking for resourceful captains who possess a selective relationship to the law.

[You can find the Gloomy Middleman here in London.]
translation:
你将听到的故事拼凑起来，在可疑的地方仔细询问。很快，你就收到了一份邀请，去位于几层之下的海军上将本保的旅馆与一位阴郁的中间人交谈。他正在寻找那些足智多谋且与法律有着特殊关系的车长。

[你可以在伦敦的这里找到阴沉的中间商。]

original: Attend a meeting with a Gloomy Middleman
translation: 与阴沉的中间商会面

original: He conducts business in a smoky corner of the Admiral Benbow Inn, down in the smoggy lower levels of the city.
translation: 他开展业务的地方在海军上将本保的旅馆中一个烟雾缭绕的角落，在这个城市的烟尘弥漫的下层区域。

original: Smuggling
translation: 走私

original: The Middleman is nursing the same glass of beer he began the evening with. "Ah, [qvd:131182(SpeechInformal)]. To claim it is a good evening would be duplicitous, but it is at least an evening, and here you are in it." He waits until you sit. "My employer can open a profitable door for you. There are goods that Her Majesty's government do not want to see bought or sold. Prohibition begets scarcity. Scarcity begets profit. "One example of this contraband is red honey, gathered by the Midnight Rose at Titania. Unfortunately, supplies have dried up. Prove your value: find out why, and fix the problem."
translation: 中间商正喝着他今晚开始时喝的那杯啤酒。“啊，[qvd:131182(SpeechInformal)]。要说这是一个不错的夜晚，就显得有些口是心非了，但它至少是个的夜晚，而你此刻就身处其中。” 他一直等到你坐下再继续，“我的雇主可以为你打开一扇有利可图的大门。有一些商品是女王陛下的政府不希望看到购买或出售的。禁令带来紧俏。紧俏产生利润。” “这种违禁品的一个例子是红蜂蜜，由狄坦妮娅的午夜玫瑰收集。不幸的是，供应已经枯竭。证明你的价值：找出原因，解决这个问题。”

original: Return to the Gloomy Middleman at the Benbow Inn
translation: 回到本保旅馆的阴沉的中间商那里

original: You have resolved the situation with the Midnight Rose. Soon, red honey will return to London. Will that satisfy the Middleman's employer?
translation: 你已经解决了午夜玫瑰引发的事端。很快，红蜂蜜就会重回伦敦。这能满足中间商雇主的要求吗？

original: Moving up the ladder
translation: 晋升

original:
The Middleman grunts. "And so things return to normal," he says, in the tones of a vicar at a funeral. "Cause for giddy celebration." But you notice that he finishes his drink, and even orders another. 

"Your performance was as expected. My employer would like to meet with you." The Middleman gives you an address: the company offices for the Wit & Vinegar Lumber Company.

[The Wit & Vinegar Company can be found at a separate platform elsewhere in London. You'll need to fly there.]
translation:
中间商哼了一声。“于是，一切又恢复了正常，”他用牧师在葬礼上的语调说道，“真是值得狂欢庆祝的理由。”但你注意到他喝完了酒，甚至又叫了一杯。

“你的表现符合预期。我的雇主想见见你。”中间人给了你一个地址：尖酸&狡黠公司的办公室。

[尖酸&狡黠公司位于伦敦另一处独立站台上。你需要飞过去。]

original: Deliver the Dignity of Albion Bill to the Throne of Hours
translation: 将《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》呈禀时间王座

original: This will blackmail Her Majesty into restoring Parliament's status.
translation: 这将迫使女王陛下象征性地恢复议会部分地位。

original: Royal Dissent
translation: 御驳

original:
Her Renewed Majesty, Empress of Albion, the Reach, London, and the Soon-to-be-Conquered Territories, Victoria, Queen of Britannia, grants you an audience before the Throne of Hours. Her expression upon reading the Dignity of Albion Bill is more amused than concerned.

"What a busy little nuisance," she says, crumpling it up. "I knew this was coming, of course. In a way, it's admirable, attempting to commit treason using the law of the land. As it used to be, at least. I think we both know that my new Albion has outgrown such childish necessities. Ah, but the people must feel involved, mustn't they? To work themselves into a furore over exactly which malcontents will profit from their little problems?"

Victoria sighs. "Very well. We will grant Parliament the power to make its own laws, at least on matters of little consequence. It may at least serve to offer a convenient scapegoat for certain revolutionary elements. I will not, however, tolerate the current talk of this new 'People's Sponge'. You may consider yourself dismissed."
translation:
阿尔比恩、外野、伦敦与即将征服之地的女皇，不列颠尼亚的维多利亚女王——新生的女王陛下，在时间王座前赐予你一次觐见。她翻阅《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》时的神情，与其说是忧虑，不如说是玩味。

“真是个停不下来的眼中钉，”她一边将法案揉成一团，一边说道，“我早知这一天终将来临。你竟试图以昔日国法之名行谋逆之实，说来，倒也令人钦佩。可那不过是旧时遗规罢了。如今的阿尔比恩，早已不再受这类稚气规条的拘束。唉，但百姓总得有点参与感，不是吗？要让他们群情激昂，好争论究竟是哪些满腹牢骚之徒会借其琐屑烦忧牟利。”

维多利亚叹息一声，说道：“罢了。朕将允许议会自行立法，当然，只限于无关重轻之事。至少可以用议会作挡箭牌，转移某些激进分子的攻讦。然而，关于所谓‘人民海绵’的流言蜚语，我绝不容忍。你可以退下了。”

original: Deliver the Dignity of Albion Bill to the Throne of Hours
translation: 将《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》呈禀时间王座

original: This will blackmail Her Majesty into restoring Parliament's status.
translation: 这将迫使女王陛下象征性地恢复议会部分地位。

original: Royal Dissent
translation: 御驳

original:
Her Renewed Majesty, Empress of Albion, the Reach, London, and the Soon-to-be-Conquered Territories, Victoria, Queen of Britannia, grants you an audience before the Throne of Hours. Her expression upon reading the Dignity of Albion Bill is more amused than concerned.

"I do believe we already discussed this matter, did we not?" she says, crumpling it up. "I am not... accustomed... to repeating myself. Ah, but I suppose you were at least courteous enough to follow the proper channels, and at least this keeps our little circle of conspiracy small."

Victoria sighs. "Very well. We will grant Parliament the power to make its own laws, at least on matters of little consequence. It may at least serve to offer a convenient scapegoat for certain revolutionary elements. I will not, however, tolerate the current talk of this new 'People's Sponge'. You may consider yourself dismissed."
translation:
阿尔比恩、外野、伦敦与即将征服之地的女皇，不列颠尼亚的维多利亚女王——新生的女王陛下，在时间王座前赐予你一次觐见。她翻阅《阿尔比恩之尊严法案》时的神情，与其说是忧虑，不如说是玩味。

“我记得我们已经谈过这件事了，不是吗？”她再次将法案揉皱，“我并不……习惯于……旧话重提。唉，不过你至少还算守了规矩，按部就班地行事，倒也不至于让这阴谋圈子变得太大。”

维多利亚叹息一声，说道：“罢了。朕将允许议会自行立法，当然，只限于无关轻重之事。至少可以用议会作挡箭牌，来转移某些激进分子的攻讦。然而，关于所谓‘人民海绵’的流言蜚语，我绝不容忍。你可以退下了。”

original: Arrange matters for your upcoming heist
translation: 为你即将到来的抢劫安排事项

original: The Tower of Chimes is a drifting ruin, but still an important part of London history. You can't be caught vandalising it.
translation: 钟楼是一座飘摇欲坠的废墟，但它仍是伦敦历史的重要组成部分。你不可以破坏它。

original: Preparations
translation: 准备工作

original:
Leveraging your connections across the capital, as well a few hefty bribes, you arrange matters so that official patrols will give the Tower of Chimes a much wider berth than usual.

You have a window of opportunity. Now you just need to travel to the Tower of Chimes and take advantage of it.

[You will need to fly to the clock-face of the Tower of Chimes.]
translation:
你利用自己在首都的人脉，再加上几笔巨额贿赂，安排了一切，让官方巡逻队比平时更加远离钟楼。

现在，你迎来了一个机会窗口。你只需前往钟楼并充分利用这个机会。

[你需要飞往钟楼的钟面。]

original: Track down Isery
translation: 追踪伊瑟琳

original: The shaven-headed, androgynous quester who almost beat you in the Grand Tournament. Are they willing to die to see the quest's conclusion?
translation: 那个在大骑士会武中差点打败你的，剃着光头、雌雄难辨的探寻者，愿意为了看到探索的结果而赴死吗？

original: Isery
translation: 伊瑟琳

original:
The Unseen Queen knows exactly where her second-greatest knight can be found. She gives you directions; Isery lives above a shoe-shop, supporting their quest habit with various dubiously-legal odd-jobs and the occasional lucrative assassination. 

When Isery sees you at their doorstep, they welcome you into their cramped home and starts making you a cup of tea. "I never thought I'd see you again," they admit. "How goes the quest?"

You tell Isery that you have found the Cup. The teapot drops from their hand and shatters.
translation:
无形女王知道她第二强大的骑士在哪里。她会给你指路：伊瑟琳住在一家鞋店楼上，靠各种合法性存疑的零工和偶尔的有利可图的暗杀来维持其的探险爱好。

当伊瑟琳在家门口看到你时，这人欢迎你来到其狭小的家中，并开始为你泡茶。“我从没想过会再见到你，”此人坦言，“任务是什么？”

你告诉伊瑟琳你找到了圣杯。茶壶从这人手中掉落，摔碎了。

original: Ambition: Collect your inheritance
translation: 野心：取走你的遗产

original: In their will your predecessor bequeathed you one final item, crucial to your search for the Martyr-King's Cup.
translation: 你的前辈在遗嘱中留给你最后一样东西，它对你寻找殉道王圣杯至关重要。

original: Wander the streets
translation: 漫步街头

original: How often does one find themselves with a spare moment in London?
translation: 伦敦待一天，几度能得闲？

original: A day in London
translation: 伦敦一日

original: [qvd:139638(Wander)]
translation: [qvd:139638(Wander)]

original: Allow the Signalman to curry favour with London's elites
translation: 让信号员讨好伦敦的精英

original:
He has expressed interest in doing some work in London for you.
[He will leave your engine. You can pick him up again at any time.]
translation:
他已表露出在伦敦为你做一些工作的兴趣。
[他将离开你的机车。你可以随时再去接他。]

original: A purveyor of gloomy predictions
translation: 灰暗预测的传播者

original: "I'm going to set up shop in London and offer my services to this generation of builders and industrialists." He sighs. "I suppose they're a dreadful bunch. But someone has to stop them making the mistakes we did." He heads off into the smog, and does not look back.
translation: “我打算在伦敦开店，为这一代的建筑商和工业家提供服务。”他叹了口气，“我想他们是一群可怕的人。但必须有人阻止他们犯我们曾犯下的错误。”他走入烟尘中，没有回头。

original: Let the Princess set up a salon
translation: 让公主开设沙龙

original:
She will be gone for a little while. You will have to manage without her, you poor thing.
[The Princess will leave your engine. You may pick her up again – but only while the salon is open.]
translation:
她将会离开一段时间。可怜的你将不得不在没有她的情况下管理机车。
[公主将暂时离开你的机车。你可以再去接她，但只能在沙龙开放的时候这么做。]

original: The briefest of farewells
translation: 最短暂的告别

original:
The Princess sweeps away into the smog; for a moment, her tiara sparkles in a single beam of distant sunlight.

She has left you an invitation. It is to the 'Red Salon'. No further details are given. You'll have to find it – and the Princess – yourself.
translation:
公主在烟雾中消失了。有那么一瞬间，她的头饰在远处的一束阳光下闪闪发光。

她给你留下了一份去“红色沙龙”的邀请函。没有更多细节。你之后需要独自寻找它，还有公主。

original: Hunt for the shop that the Auroral Sommelier mentioned
translation: 搜寻曙光品酒师提到的那家店

original: It must be here somewhere.
translation: 它一定就在这里的某处。

original: There!
translation: 在那里！

original: You find the establishment between the roofs of two collapsed houses. Under their steepled walls, it bulges like a tumour. You enter – the floorboards sigh in warning under your feet.
translation: 你在两座倒塌的房屋的屋顶之间找到了这个店铺。在它们的尖塔墙下，这家店像肿瘤一样隆起。你进门时，地板在你脚下发出警告的叹息。

original: Hand in a new law at the Throne of Hours
translation: 在时间王座处呈递新法

original: One of Her Renewed Majesty's servants awaits you. Perhaps she will deign to give this one her Royal Assent, enshrining your hard work into official Albion law.
translation: 新生的女王陛下的一位仆人在等你。也许她会屈尊授予此法以王室批准，把你的辛劳成果铭刻于阿尔比恩的官方法令之中。

original: Politics in action
translation: 政治落地

original:
You present the new law in its ceremonial purple-cushioned box. Servants draw straws, hoping to avoid the task of delivering the box to the Empress. One, grimacing, bears the box away. Another returns with a short note. Victoria will consider it. For a very long while. They recommend that you do not wait.

A parliamentary envoy awaits you outside, bearing a bonus for having got a new bill at least this far.
translation:
你把新法放在铺着紫色垫子的盒子里。仆人们抽签，希望避开把它送到皇后手中的任务。其中一人做了个鬼脸，把盒子拿走了。另一个带着一张短笺回来。维多利亚会考虑它，考虑很长时间。那人建议你不必一直等下去。

一位议会特使在外面等着你，带着让新法案至少走到这一步的奖金。

original: Venture into Hallidge's
translation: 挺进哈利吉银行

original: Hallidge's central office is a restrained art nouveau building, not far from the Ministry. Its girders are curlicued. And the rats must go inside.
translation: 哈利吉银行的中央办公室是一座内敛的新艺术风格的建筑，且离公德部不远。它的梁柱弯曲。而老鼠们要到那里去。

original: The heart of commerce
translation: 商业之心

original: You approach the nearest clerk, introduce the Rat Brigade, and produce the relevant account number. The clerk's eyebrows rise. "At Hallidges, we measure ourselves by the quality of our clientele," she says, sounding thoroughly miserable. "This way, please."
translation: 你走到最近的柜员面前，向她介绍老鼠大队，并出示相关的账号。柜员的眉毛扬起。“在哈利吉银行，我们以客户的质量来衡量自己，”她说，声音听起来悲惨无比，“请往这边走。”

original: Seek an Audience with Queen Victoria
translation: 设法与维多利亚女王会面

original: There is only one person alive who can answer your Aunt's question about the Unclear Bomb.
translation: 只有一个活着的人可以回答你的姨妈关于晦暗炸弹的疑问。

original: Black and gold and glory
translation: 黑色、金色和荣耀

original:
Courtiers outfitted in the Imperial colours of black and gold survey you with a mixture of curiosity and fear. New blood is the engine of change at court, and change is the enemy of security. 

The Royal Chamberlain sweeps you through the Court and into the throne room itself.
translation:
身着帝国的黑金华服的朝臣们带着好奇和恐惧打量着你。新鲜血液是宫廷变革的动力，而变革则是安稳的敌人。

皇家内侍领着你穿过宫廷，进入王室。

original: A Polite But Firm Customs Search
translation: 礼貌而强硬的边境搜查

original: Your train is flagged down as you approach, and are redirected to one of the Ministry's platforms. Gloved customs agents wait to search your vessel for stowaways, contraband, and anything else deemed a threat or potential distraction to London society.
translation: 当接近港口时，你的机车被拦停，随后被重新引导到公德部的一个平台。戴着手套的边关人员等待着搜查你的火车，看看里面是否藏有偷渡者、违禁品，以及其他被认为对伦敦社会有威胁或潜在干扰的东西。

original: Give up the workworld refugee
translation: 抛弃工作世界的难民

original: If it's you or them, it's probably going to be them. There may even be a reward.
translation: 如果要在放弃你的利益和放弃他们的利益中选的话，那很可能还是放弃他们的比较好。这么做甚至可能还有奖励。

original: Taken away in chains
translation: 带着镣铐被带走

original: You give them up, pretending to be shocked at the discovery of a stowaway. The customs agents clap them in irons, promising to return them to their employers. The glare you get as they are loaded into the carriage is not a pleasant one. The reward for turning in a fugitive eases the pain.
translation: 你放弃了他们，假装对在车上发现偷渡者而感到震惊。边关人员给他们戴上手铐，承诺将他们送回雇主那里。当他们被装进运输车时，看向你的目光并不让人愉快。上交逃犯获得的奖励则可以减轻这种痛苦。

original: Attempt to hide your contraband
translation: 试图藏起你的违禁品

original:
The crew stands poker-faced and ready for the search.
[The more contraband you have, the harder this will be.]
translation:
列车员们板着脸，准备接受搜查。
[你的违禁品越多，这么做就越难。]

original: They seek, but do not find...
translation: 他们找了，但没有找到……

original: The customs agents' cynical faces do their best to insist that it is not you who have beaten them, but they who have simply lost interest in searching for hidden passages and barrels that may or may not contain what they claim. They disembark and wave your train on.
translation: 边关人员带着讥诮的表情，坚称不是你打败了他们，而是他们根本没有兴趣去寻找里面可能有也可能没有他们声称的东西的，藏起来的通道和桶。他们下了车，挥手让你的火车继续前进。

original: Caught in the act!
translation: 抓个正着！

original: The thorough search soon turns up everything you were hoping to hide. Smiling, the customs officials order it removed from the train, and begin writing out your fine.
translation: 彻底搜索下，他们很快就发现了你希望隐藏的一切。边关官员微笑着下令将其从火车上移走，并开始写下你的罚单。

original: Agree to the search
translation: 同意接受搜查

original: You have nothing to hide from the law.
translation: 在法律面前，你没有什么好藏的。

original: The sweep is complete
translation: 扫荡结束了

original: The customs agent do their usual rigorous job, and are disappointed to find nothing. They disembark leaving much of the train a mess, but wave you onwards to the main London docks.
translation: 边关人员一如既往地严格工作，但很失望地什么也没发现。他们下了车，留下火车上的一片狼藉，但还是挥手让你们继续前往伦敦的主要码头。

original: Confess to your contraband
translation: 承认你的违禁品

original: It will be confiscated, of course. But you should avoid a fine.
translation: 当然，它们会被没收。但你应该能避免被罚款。

original: The easy way
translation: 简单的方法

original: The customs inspectors exchange a knowing eye. If even half of your confiscated goods end up on the record, it'll be a miracle. They haul everything away and their chief blows his whistle, guiding you into the docks.
translation: 边关检查员们交换了一个会意的眼神。如果你被没收的货物中哪怕有一半最终被记录在案，那都将是一个奇迹。他们拖走了所有东西，在那之后，他们的长官吹响了哨子，引导你进入码头。

original: An Eggmonger
translation: 蛋贩

original:
A young woman strides down the platform towards you, pushing a barrow piled high with crates the size of shoe boxes. 

"I can always tell the ones that have got an egg. Have any you'd care to part with?"
translation:
一位年轻女子推着一辆手推车大步走下平台，上面堆满了鞋盒大小的板条箱。

“我一眼就能认出有蛋在手的人。方便卖我一个吗？”

original: Sell the egg
translation: 把蛋卖掉

original: It's only taking up space in your hold.
translation: 它在你货舱里只是白白占用空间。

original: A short, neat transaction
translation: 一次简短利落的交易

original: She opens one of the crates to reveal a bed of sawdust. Very carefully, she takes the egg and lays it gently in the crate. She replaces the lid and restacks the crate among the others. She produces a small packet of coins from a deep pocket in her coat. Then, with a grin, she heads off, pushing her barrow down the platform.
translation: 她打开其中一个箱子，露出铺在底部的一层锯末。她非常小心地拿起蛋，轻轻地把它放在箱子里，随后重新盖上盖子，将板条箱放在其他箱子中。她从大衣的一个深口袋里拿出一小包硬币给你。然后，她笑着将手推车推下站台，离开了。

original: Sell all of your eggs
translation: 卖掉你的所有蛋

original: A little extra coin is never a bad thing.
translation: 多赚一点钱总不是坏事。

original: A short, neat transaction
translation: 一次简短利落的交易

original: One by one she places each egg in one of her sawdust-lined crates. She replaces the lids and restacks the crates in her barrow. She produces a small packet of coins from a deep pocket in her coat. Then, with a grin, she heads off, pushing her barrow down the platform.
translation: 她把鸡蛋一个个地分别放进她铺有锯末的箱子里，随后盖上盖子，将板条箱重新堆放在手推车中。她从大衣的一个深口袋里拿出一小包硬币给你。然后，她笑着将手推车推下站台，离开了。

original: Hire on Crew at St Dominic's Station
translation: 在圣多米尼克站招募列车员

original:
If you need to replace lost crew, you can always find venturesome candidates loitering at the station.

[You will only be able to do this once every 15 days.]
translation:
如果需要补充失去的列车员，你总能在车站发现有冒险精神的候选人。

[每15天才能这么做一次。]

original: Hire a handful of crew
translation: 招募少量列车员

original:
There's no shortage of old hands and eager youngsters seeking a fortune among the stars.
[Recruit two or three Crew.]
translation:
这里不乏老手和热衷于在星空寻求财富的年轻人。
[招募两至三名列车员。]

original: New hands
translation: 新帮手

original: The crew you pick have become firm friends over repeated dockside card games. Glad that you're keeping them together, they are willing to accept a lower signing-fee.
translation: 在三番五次的码头纸牌游戏中，你挑选的列车员已经成为了你坚定的朋友。他们为能被你聚在一起而高兴，愿意接受较低的签约费。

original: New recruits
translation: 新成员

original: After interviewing several disappointing candidates, you find a group fresh from a merchant trader. They've learned a few things about haggling – you won't get away with paying them anything less than their value.
translation: 在面试了几位令人失望的候选人后，你找到了一个刚从商贩那里来的团队。他们先前学了些关于讨价还价的本事，你没法用低于他们价值的价格来蒙骗他们。

original: Go on a recruitment mission
translation: 开展招聘工作

original:
You are short-staffed. And loneliness is dangerous in the skies.
[Recruit four to six Crew.]
translation:
你人手不足。在天空中，孤独是危险的。
[招募四至六名列车员。]

original: New hands
translation: 新帮手

original: Perhaps your reputation preceded you. You're besieged by hopeful candidates, and are able to negotiate extremely civilised signing fees for them.
translation: 也许你早已名声在外。你被有希望的候选人团团围住，并能与他们谈出极其体面的签约费。

original: New hands
translation: 新帮手

original: A long day of interviewing, assessing, and haggling. The poorer candidates are weeded out, the stronger ones offered a place on board.
translation: 长达一天的面试、评估和讨价还价。贫弱的候选人被淘汰，身强力壮的候选人则有机会上车工作。

original: Dispose of the Sequencer's Well-Intentioned Package
translation: 处理新秩序者出于善意的包裹

original: The Dazzled Sequencer at the Clockwork Sun asked you to deliver a package to the needy.
translation: 发条太阳里那位目眩的新秩序者让你给有需要的人送一个包裹。

original: Deliver the Sequencer's care package
translation: 运送新秩序者的关怀包裹

original: London produces industrial quantities of orphans, which are stored in orphanages while awaiting export to a workworld.
translation: 伦敦大量产生孤儿，这些孤儿被寄养在孤儿院，等待被送到工作世界。

original: Upon opening your package, the orphans begin quietly and methodically distributing the food-parcels and medicine. At the governess' urging, they thank you.
translation: 打开你的包裹后，孤儿们开始安静而有条不紊地分发食品包裹和药品。在女教师的催促之下，他们向你表示感谢。

original: Sell the Sequencer's care package to a fence
translation: 把新秩序者的护理包裹卖给销赃者

original: You arrange to meet in a crooked little pub squatting on the edge of a slum.
translation: 你们安排在一个位于贫民窟边缘的破烂小酒馆见面。

original:
The landlady here is completely deaf, allowing her customers to conduct their shady business as loudly as they please.

When you open the Sequencer's parcel, the fence's cocky grin is replaced by a look of astonishment. He glances around the pub and hurriedly closes the crate back up.

"Yes, I think we can do business," he says, making a valiant attempt to sound casual.
translation:
这里的女房东完全聋了，这让她的顾客们能随心所欲地大声进行违法交易。

你把新秩序者的包裹打开时，销赃者脸上自大的笑容变成了惊讶的神色。他扫视了一眼酒吧，匆匆把箱子关上。

“行，我想我们能交易，”他说，并竭力装作漫不经心的样子。

original: Deliver the Sequencer's care package
translation: 运送新秩序者的关怀包裹

original: London produces industrial quantities of orphans, and they are stored in orphanages while awaiting export to a Workworld.
translation: 伦敦大量产生孤儿，他们被寄养在孤儿院，等待被送到工作世界。

original:
Upon opening your parcel, the orphans let loose a loud cheer. A forest of hands appears, grabbing at rusted revolvers and ornate flintlock pistols.

"Now, now, children," urges the governess, to the orphans' utter indifference. A second cheer goes up as they discover that the pistols are loaded.
translation:
打开你的包裹后，孤儿们大声欢呼起来。许多手伸出并抓着生锈的左轮手枪和华丽的燧发手枪。

“孩子们，安分点，安分点，”家庭教师对孤儿们完全漠不关心地催促道。当他们发现手枪已经上膛时，又响起了第二声欢呼。

original: Investigate Starling House
translation: 调查椋鸟府
