translation: 追踪阴沉的宫廷内侍

original: To find the Martyr-King's Cup, you must win a sword from one of your fellow questers. And you know where the Chamberlain is staying.
translation: 要找到殉道王圣杯，你必须从你的一个同行那里赢得一把剑。而你知道阴沉的宫廷内侍住在哪里。

original: Moonlit uplands
translation: 月光下的高地

original:
Following the Queen's directions, you find your way to the street where the Chamberlain is staying.

As you walk through rolling clouds of soot, the clamour and walls and noise fade away one by one. Then the smog clears. You remember (how could you have forgotten?) that you are a knight, riding your destrier up a narrow road on a barren, windswept hill. There are no stars tonight, but the moon seems to fill the sky.
translation:
遵照女王的指示，你找到了宫廷内侍所住的街道。

当你穿过滚滚的烟尘，喧嚣声、墙壁和噪音逐一消失。然后烟雾散去了。你记得（你怎么会忘记？）你是一名骑士，骑着你的战马在一条狭窄的道路上，攀登在荒凉、多风的山丘上。今晚没有星星，但月亮似乎填满了整个天空。

original: Ambition: Establish a spider-council here
translation: 野心：建立一个蜘蛛议会

original: Your sorrow-spider is cunning, and will be able to find its way down to the workworld. You release it and, sure enough, watch it scuttle silently after an overseer as he passes through the gates.
translation: 你的悲伤蜘蛛很狡猾，能够找到通往工作世界的路。你放出它，当然，看着它在一名监督员通过大门时默默地跟着进入。

original: A strand of the web
translation: 蛛网一缕

original:
Time moves more quickly on the workworld itself, so barely a day has passed for you when the spider reappears, its work already done.

In the wordless, signed language of its weaving legs it informs you of a forgotten factory, now clogged with webs, where the juvenile sorrow-spiders have learned to knit themselves together using an old Spinning Jenny.
translation:
工作世界本身时间过得更快，所以蜘蛛再次出现的时间对你来说不到一天，它的工作已经完成了。

用它编织腿的无言手语，它告诉你一个被遗忘的工厂，现在到处都是网，在那里，幼年的悲伤蜘蛛学会了用一台旧的珍妮纺纱机把自己编织在一起。

original: Join a tour of Brabazon Workworld
translation: 加入布拉巴宗工作世界之旅

original:
The guards are not corruptible. Starshine does not help them perform their daily toil, and keep others at theirs. You would most certainly not be allowed to join a tour in exchange for it.
[Once you join the tour, you will not be able to leave till the end.]
translation:
警卫是不会贪腐的。星光酒不会帮助他们完成日常工作，也不会让其他人留在自己的岗位上。你肯定不会被允许参加旅行以换取它。
[一旦你加入旅行，你将无法离开，直到结束。]

original: A way to pass the time
translation: 打发时间的一种方式

original:
The exchange is quick, furtive and entirely discreet. "We won't say nothing if you don't say nothing," the guard says. "Tour leaves presently. Don't be late."

The Overseer checks over the note given by the guards and sets aside some Brabazon hours to be woven for you. She hands the group over to the Tour Leader, who shepherds you all into a side room.
translation:
物品的交换迅速、隐秘且完全谨慎。“如果你什么都不说，我们什么都不会说，”警卫说。“旅游团马上就出发了。不要迟到。”

监督检查了警卫给你的纸条，并留出一些布拉巴宗时间给你编织。她把旅游团交给领队，领队把你们带到一个侧室。

original: Join a tour of Brabazon Workworld
translation: 加入布拉巴宗工作世界之旅

original:
The Overseer requires information. No one can be sentenced to the Workworld without there first being evidence of a crime.
[Once you join the tour, you will not be able to leave till the end.]
translation:
监督人需要信息。在没有犯罪证据的情况下，任何人都不能被判进入工作世界。
[一旦你加入旅行，你将无法离开，直到结束。]

original: Donation received
translation: 接受捐赠

original:
The Overseer listens intently to what you have to say. "Hmm. Useful, I think. We shall see what can be done with it."

She directs you to a group by the Tour Leader, who shepherds you all into a side room.
translation:
监督者聚精会神地听着你说的话。“嗯。我想很有用。我们看看能用它做些什么。”

她把你们带到领队的一个小组，领队把你们带进一个侧室。

original: Industrial Unrest!
translation: 工业动乱！

original: [qvd:134175(Revolution)]
translation: [qvd:134175(Revolution)]

original: Upbraid the Governor
translation: 斥责总督

original: The workers of Brabazon trusted him. They sacrificed their time for him, in the hope that he would save them. And now this.
translation: 布拉巴宗的工人信任他。他们为他牺牲了时间，希望他能救他们。现在就这。

original:
The Governor meets your gaze, but says nothing. A gasp alerts you to the presence of the bearded youth. How long has he been standing behind you? With a gesture, the Governor dismisses him. 

When the Governor speaks again, his voice is low. "If the furnaces die, so does Brabazon. The reality is: I can only shuffle a few workers off the workworld, but the rest would freeze." He smiles; bright, charming. "I can make things better, at least: I can give them hope."

He glances at the document on his desk. "I won't be leaving. I've no use for this. Take it. Please."
translation:
总督看到了你的目光，但什么也没说。一声喘息提醒你注意留胡子的年轻人的存在。他在你身后站了多久了？总督做了个手势，把他赶走了。

当总督再次发言时，他的声音很低。“如果熔炉死了，布拉巴宗也会死。现实是：我只能把几个工人从工作世界里赶走，但其他人都会冻僵。”他笑着说；明亮且迷人。“我可以让事情变得更好，至少：我可以给他们希望。”

他瞥了一眼桌子上的文件。“我不会走的。我用不到这个。请收下。”

original: Congratulate the Governor
translation: 祝贺总督

original: He has transitioned from leader to ruler, of sorts. He must be delighted.
translation: 在某种程度上，他已经从领导者转变为统治者。他一定很高兴。

original:
"I... I suppose..." The Governor stares at his desk. After several moments, he speaks again. "If the furnaces die, so does Brabazon. The reality is: I can only shuffle a few workers off the workworld, but the rest would freeze. There just isn't the time, or the ships." He smiles; bright, charming. "I can make things better, at least: I can give them hope."

He glances at the document on his desk. "I won't be leaving. I've no use for this. Take it."
translation:
“我……我想……”总督凝视着他的办公桌。过了一会儿，他又说话了。“如果熔炉死了，布拉巴宗也会死。现实是：我只能把几个工人从工作世界里拖出来，但其他人都会冻僵。只是没有时间，也没有船。”他笑着说；明亮且迷人。“我可以让事情变得更好，至少：我可以给他们希望。”

他瞥了一眼桌子上的文件。“我不会走的。我用不到这个。请收下。”

original: Investigate what's happening
translation: 调查正在发生的事情

original: [qvd:134175(Guide)]
translation: [qvd:134175(Guide)]

original: [qvd:134175(WhatsUp)]
translation: [qvd:134175(WhatsUp)]

original: Witness negotiations
translation: 见证谈判

original: In the front room, behind the desk, is [qvd:133994(LeaderName)]. He has not seen you. In front of him, with their backs to you are two men. Neither has removed their stovepipes.
translation: 在前厅的桌子后面，是[qvd:133994(LeaderName)]。他没见过你。在他面前，有两个人背对着你。他们俩都没有摘下烟斗。

original: "The Advisory Board was horrified to learn of conditions under the previous Governor. Genuinely shocking. We are convinced that you are the person to right the ship. After all, who knows it better than you?" The man takes out a sheet of paper and places it on the desk. You can't see what it says. The other stovepipe speaks. "There are some practicalities that might mean progress is slower than you or I would like. Production must be kept up, of course. After all, that's what puts food on the table. But I'm sure you can find efficiencies your predecessor couldn't. We leave it in your hands, Governor." Both stovepipes chuckle warmly. They shake the hand of the new Governor, and leave, giving you a small nod as they pass. The new Governor looks confounded. Whatever he expected, it was not this.
translation: “咨询委员会得知前任总督的情况后感到震惊。过于令人震惊。我们相信您就是能扭转乾坤的人。毕竟，还有谁能比您更了解这一切呢？” 那人拿出一张纸放在桌子上，但你看不到上面写了什么。 另一个高帽党人开始发言：“有些实际问题可能会导致进展比我们期望的要慢。当然，生产必须保持下去。毕竟，这是为了让我们有饭吃。但我相信您能发现前任总督无法实现的效率。我们把它交给你了，总督。” 两个高帽党人都热情地笑了起来。他们与新总督握手后离开，经过你时轻轻点了点头。 新总督看起来一脸困惑。无论他期待什么，都不是这个结果。

original: Ask the anxious Overseer what's going on
translation: 问问焦虑的监督者发生了什么事

original: He is signalling to locomotives, discouraging them from docking. Visitors that were already at the port are being encouraged, firmly, to leave.
translation: 他正向机车发出信号，阻止它们靠岸。目前已经在港口的游客被强烈要求离开。

original: Reassurances
translation: 安抚措施

original:
"Nothing to be concerned about. A small revolt, instigated by a fanatical group of revolutionaries. No doubt it will peter out soon, but while the situation is being resolved, we will be closing the port."

[Return to Brabazon Workworld in a week, when the unrest should be resolved.]
translation:
“无需担心。这是一场由狂热革命团体煽动的小叛乱。毫无疑问，它很快就会平息，但在局势得到解决之前，我们将关闭港口。”

[一周后返回布拉巴宗工作世界，届时骚乱应该已经平息。]

original: Ask after the Dismal Chamberlain
translation: 追问阴沉的宫廷内侍

original: What happened to him after your altercation in Brabazon?
translation: 在布拉巴宗和你发生争执之后，他怎么样了？

original: A head shake
translation: 摇了摇头

original: "Sorry. Can't help you. Not now. Not the time." The Anxious Overseer encourages you to leave, now. Just as a precaution, of course. [Return to Brabazon Workworld in a week, when the unrest should be resolved.]
translation: “对不起。我帮不了你。现在不行。现在不是时候。”焦急的监管者鼓励你离开，马上。当然，这只是出于预防的考虑。 [一周后返回布拉巴宗工作世界，届时骚乱应该已经平息。]

original: Track down the Dismal Chamberlain
translation: 追踪阴沉的宫廷内侍

original: To find the Martyr-King's Cup, you must win a sword from one of your fellow questers. And you know where the Chamberlain is staying.
translation: 要找到殉道王圣杯，你必须从你的一个同行那里赢得一把剑。而你知道阴沉的宫廷内侍住在哪里。

original: Advised to return another time
translation: 建议你下次再来

original: The Anxious Overseer shakes his head, not even listening to your questions. He encourages you to leave, now. Just as a precaution, of course. [Return to Brabazon Workworld in a week, when the unrest should be resolved.]
translation: 焦虑的监督者摇了摇头，甚至没有听你的问题。他鼓励你离开，马上。当然，这只是出于预防的考虑。 [一周后返回布拉巴宗工作世界，届时骚乱应该已经平息。]

original: The Last Day
translation: 最后一天

original: A horn blares. The factory doors creak open. Those Workworlders lucky enough to have reached the end of their service blink in the light of freedom. They were young when they first arrived. Now their skin is calloused and wrinkled; aged not only by hard labour, but the slow-burning light of the Clockwork Sun.
translation: 号角声响起。工厂的大门吱吱嘎嘎地打开了。那些足够幸运地结束服役的工人，在自由的光芒中眨着眼睛。他们初来乍到时还年轻。现在他们的皮肤已经布满老茧和皱纹；不仅是因为艰苦的劳动，还因为发条太阳的缓慢燃烧的光芒。

original: Help a Workworlder with their paperwork
translation: 帮助工作世界工人处理文件工作

original: They are due to be released, but Brabazon never makes it easy.
translation: 他们本该被释放，但布拉巴宗从不让事情变得简单。

original: According to Section 4B(2)...
translation: 根据第4B（2）条……

original: The Overseer is most displeased when you turn up with one of her workers, forms all correctly filed out and stamped. They are forced to release the prisoner on schedule. Your only reward is a smile from the prisoner, and a scowl from the Overseer. It is enough.
translation: 当你带着她的一名工人出现，所有表格都已正确填写并盖章时，监督者非常不高兴。他们被迫按时释放囚犯。你唯一的奖赏是囚犯的一个微笑和监督者的一个怒容。这就足够了。

original: Trapped by bureaucracy
translation: 被官僚主义困住

original: The official forms are labyrinthine, written in the smallest possible type for workers who can barely read. Unfortunately, you have no luck sorting through them. The hope of freedom in the worker's eye fades. They shuffle back through the gates.
translation: 官方表格错综复杂，以尽可能小的字体书写，工人们几乎无法阅读。不幸的是，你无法整理这些表格。工人眼中的自由希望逐渐消失。他们再次穿过大门。

original: Recruit crew from the Workworld
translation: 从工作世界招募列车员

original: Former workers, now old and exhausted. Brabazon does not pay for their journeys home.
translation: 前员工们现在年事已高，疲惫不堪。布拉巴宗不支付他们回家的路费。

original: Welcome aboard
translation: 欢迎上车

original: The now elderly crew shuffle aboard, almost relieved to be given orders. Their bones are brittle, but they will work hard. Working hard is all that they've known in their lifetimes under the lash.
translation: 现在这些年迈的列车员蹒跚着上了船，几乎如释重负地接到了命令。他们的骨头很脆弱，但他们会努力工作。在鞭子的抽打下，他们一生所知道的就是努力工作。

original: Recruit the Clay Conductor
translation: 招募粘土人列车主管

original:
A hulking Clay Man in a heavy coat stands on the platform. The Clay Men were an underclass in old London; very few of them came to the skies. This one holds an urn to his chest. 

"You're a captain; you can perform funeral rites," he says, nodding to the urn in his arms. "Then I want to travel." He pauses for a long moment, and then, as if feeling something more might be expected. "I could help out on your engine."
translation:
一个穿着厚外套的魁梧的粘土人站在站台上。粘土人是旧伦敦的下层人，他们中很少有人飞上天空。这个人把一个骨灰盒放在胸口。

“你是车长，你可以举行葬礼，”他指着怀里的骨灰盒说，“然后我想旅行。”他停顿了很长一段时间，然后，似乎想到了更多的东西。“我可以帮你修理机车。”

original: Recruit the Clay Conductor
translation: 招募粘土人列车主管

original:
Say a few words about death in the sky; skyfarers are accustomed to impromptu funerals.
[This will give you the Clay Conductor, a First Officer who will increase your Hearts by 6, and your Iron by 2.]
translation:
说几句关于天空中死亡的话。行天客习惯于即兴举行葬礼。
[这将使你获得粘土人列车主管，这位大副能使你的红心值增加6，钢铁值增加2。]

original: A sombre occasion
translation: 在一个悲痛的时刻

original:
You ask the Conductor where he would like to hold the ceremony. He looks about, confused, as though he hadn't expected the question. At last he comes to a conclusion. "Here will do," he says, indicating the crowded thoroughfare. 

You and a few of the more respectable of your crew gather for a brief funeral. Everyone has at least something in black. You offer the expected phrasings before pausing for the eulogy. 

The Clay Conductor shakes his head. "You do it," he grunts.
translation:
你问主管他想在哪里举行葬礼。他困惑地环顾四周，好像没想到会有这个问题似的。最后他得出结论。“就在这儿，”他指着拥挤的大街说。

你和一些比较斯文一点的列车员聚集在一个简短的葬礼上。每个人身上都至少带了一点黑色的东西。在停下来悼念之前，你要提供得体的措辞。

粘土人列车主管摇了摇头。“你来吧，”他咕哝着说。

original: Say a few words
translation: 说几句话

original: You're sure you can extemporise something.
translation: 你确信自己可以即兴创作一些东西。

original: You render up a bounty of platitudes, benign wishes to the beyond and maudlin remembrances of departed friends— The Conductor frowns, stonily, realising he needs to give you at least something to work with. "He could sing," he manages. You work a line about a 'man of clay with the voice of an angel' into the eulogy. The Conductor seems satisfied. "Where's your engine? I'm ready to assume my duties." The Conductor picks up the urn and heads off in the direction you point.
translation: 你发表了大量的陈词滥调，对远方的善意祝愿，对逝去的朋友的伤感回忆—— 粘土人列车主管皱着眉头，意识到他至少需要给你一点什么东西来帮你编造悼词。“他会唱歌，”他挤出了这句话。你在祭文中加了一句关于“一个有天使声音的粘土人”的话。粘土人列车主管似乎很满意。 “你的机车在哪里？我已经准备好承担我的职责了。”粘土人列车主管拿起骨灰盒，朝你指的方向走去。

original: Make the Clay Conductor speak
translation: 让粘土人列车主管说话

original: You don't even know who's in the urn.
translation: 你甚至都不知道骨灰盒里的人是谁。

original: There is a long silence. Your crew look at their feet, acutely aware of the awkwardness. The silence continues. Finally, the Clay Conductor speaks. "He was a Clay Man. He travelled on the Figaro." A pause. "He was a good singer." The Clay Conductor looks at you. "Where's your engine? I'm ready to assume my duties."
translation: 良久的沉默。你的列车员盯着他们的脚，敏锐地意识到了这种尴尬。沉默仍在继续。 最后，粘土人列车主管开了口，“他是一个粘土人。他乘费加罗号旅行。”停顿了一下，“他是个好歌手。” 粘土人列车主管看着你，“你的机车在哪里？我已经准备好承担我的职责了。”

original: An Opportunity: Glassworks in Brabazon
translation: 机遇：布拉巴宗新建了彩色玻璃工厂

original:
A new factory belches smoke in Brabazon. On the Governor's orders, workers have turned glassworkers, employing techniques learned from the Clockwork Sun's engineers. 

There have been accidents, but the higher wage means the workers might finally be able to pay off their debts. Despite the dangers, the production of glass only grows.
translation:
在布拉巴宗，一家新工厂正“喷云吐雾”。应总督之令，工人们师从发条太阳上的工程师，转职为玻璃厂工人，并将新技术应用到生产中。

虽然生产事故时有发生，但这份工作薪酬更高，让工人们终于看到了还清债务的渺茫希望。尽管危险重重，彩色玻璃的产量却只增不减。

original: Buy several panes of glass
translation: 购买几块彩色玻璃

original: Pay the value of the panes.
translation: 为彩色玻璃付费。

original: An accident
translation: 一个意外

original:
The overseer in charge of the glassworks is hollow-eyed and hulking. His fingers tremble as he takes your papers; his palms are clammy and he smudges his signature. 

He departs to the glassworks in haste, to fetch your purchase. You are not permitted to enter the factory. It is, you are told, unsafe.
translation:
玻璃厂的监督者身形高大，眼神空洞。接过你的文件时，他双手颤抖，掌心湿冷，签名都被他抹糊了。

他匆匆赶往玻璃厂去取你的货物。你不能进入厂房，因为有人告诉你，里面不太安全。

original: Donate Caddies of Tea
translation: 捐献几罐茶叶

original:
Brabazon has many needs. The throats of the overseers are often parched, for instance.
[You will gain 5 Panes of Stained Glass.]
translation:
布拉巴宗有许多需求。例如，监督员们的喉咙常常干渴难耐。
[你将获得5块彩色玻璃。]

original: An exchange of services
translation: 互通有无

original:
The overseer presiding over the glassworks gives a forced smile when you make your offer. His fingers tremble and his eyes are dark and sunken. Evidently, this is a man in dire need of tea.

Workers emerge from the glassworks (it is apparently unsafe for you to enter) bearing panes of glass. They carry these to your engine. One is reluctant to part with her pane; you find her hiding behind it in your hold. Before you can make any decisions, however, a troupe of enforcers arrives to haul her away.
translation:
你报价时，玻璃厂的监督者露出勉强的笑容。他双手发抖，眼眶深陷，眼圈发黑。很明显，这人急需来点茶叶放松一下。

工人们陆续走出玻璃厂（由于里面很不安全，你依然不能进入厂房），将一块块玻璃板搬上你的机车。有一名工人迟迟不肯交出她的玻璃板，你发现她躲在货舱中，藏在玻璃板后。不过，你还没来得及决定她的去留，一队执法者便赶到，将她强行拽走。

original: The Clockwork Sun
translation: 发条太阳

original:
Sunlight seeps like syrup through cracks in the stained-glass ceiling. The floor shudders in time with the churning machinery far beneath your feet.  The air has a tang of chemicals, bonfires and rain.

Pistons pump, cogs turn, and suit-swaddled figures tend to the enginery, bellowing over the shrieking metal.
translation:
阳光如糖浆一般自彩色玻璃天花板的裂隙中渗出。地板随着在你脚下深处搅动的机械而颤抖。空气中弥漫着化学物质，炉火和雨丝的刺鼻气味。

活塞抽泵，齿轮翻旋，被成套工作服所包裹的人们照管着机器，在嘶吼的金属中大声喊叫。

original: Head toward the sundial-shaped building
translation: 朝着日晷形状的建筑走去

original: "You'll be the Sequencer's new favourite project," one of the engineers tells you. "It'll keep him out of our hair for a while."
translation: “你会成为新秩序者最喜欢的新研究对象，”一位工程师告诉你，“这能让他暂时远离我们的视线。”

original: Azimuth
translation: 方位厅

original:
Azimuth is an enormous sundial without shadow, its roof topped by a golden shark-fin gnomon. There are still racks of yellowed pamphlets on the walls – it once served as a kiosk, selling tickets to sunspotters: the pilgrims and tourists that were expected to flock here. 

These days it is more like a temple. Frescoes on the curved walls depict the triumph of the new sun over the old.
translation:
方位厅是一个巨大的无影日晷，屋顶上有一个金色的鲨鱼鳍形日晷。墙上还挂满了泛黄的小册子，它曾经是一个亭子，向观日者出售门票：那些预计将涌向这里的朝圣者和游客。

如今，它更像是一座寺庙。弧形墙壁上的壁画描绘了新太阳对旧太阳的胜利。

original: Visit the Glasshouse
translation: 前往军事监狱

original: There's a dozen signs warning you to stay away, each more insistent than the last. The engineers shout, but they're too busy to stop you.
translation: 这里有十几个警告你不要靠近的标志，每一个的语气都比上一个更坚决。工程师们大喊大叫，但他们太忙了，无法阻止你。

original: The Glasshouse
translation: 军事监狱

original: An isolated section of the abandoned exhibition-halls has been repurposed to hold not treasures, but prisoners. Each wears a grey smock rather than a protective suit, leaving them utterly undefended from the ravages of sunlight. They sit slumped in unlocked cells, making no effort to escape. Where would they go?
translation: 废弃展览厅的一个单独的区域被重新利用起来，不是用来存放宝藏，而是用来关押囚犯。他们每个人都穿着灰色的罩袍，而不是防护服，完全无法抵御阳光的蹂躏。他们颓废地坐在没有上锁的牢房里，没有试图逃跑。他们将会去哪里？

original: Descend to the vaults beneath the surface
translation: 下降到地表下的拱顶

original: The vaults below are safer, protected by a dozen layers of stained glass.
translation: 下方由十几层彩色玻璃保护的拱顶要更安全。

original: The Terpsichore Vault
translation: 特耳西科瑞储藏室

original:
Beneath the machine-bristling surface you find a ring of nine vault-doors, each engraved with the name of a classical Muse. Eight are locked and barred, behind signs saying things like 'VACANT' or 'UNDER RENOVATION' or, in one case, 'UNFORTUNATE CHRONOLOGICAL DISCREPANCIES.'

The ninth, marked 'Terpsichore,' is the only door open to you. When you enter, your footsteps ring through dusty barracks and abandoned canteens. These are the engineers' quarters, but they are all on the surface, working. Except one.

The Broken Steward has been working on the Sun since before it first shone. She has been here far, far longer than any of the engineers above.
translation:
在机器轰鸣的表面下，你发现九扇金库门环形排列在墙上，每扇门都刻着一个古典缪斯的名字。其中八扇被锁住并堵死了，上面写着“空 置”或“正 在 装 修”，还有唯一的一扇上面写着“不 幸 的 时 间 顺 序 差 异”。

第九扇门上标着“特耳西科瑞”，是唯一对你开启的门。当你进入时，脚步声在尘土飞扬的营房和废弃的食堂里回荡。这些是工程师的宿舍，但他们都在地面上工作。除了一个人。

心力交瘁的总管在它第一次闪烁之前就在太阳上工作了。她在这里的时间比上面的任何工程师都要长得多得多。

original: The Steward's Sanctum
translation: 总管的圣地

original: Deep beneath the surface of the Sun, the Steward labours.
translation: 在太阳表面下的深处，总管正在辛勤工作。

original: Descend to the vaults beneath the surface
translation: 下降到地表下的拱顶

original: The vaults below are safer than the surface, protected by a dozen layers of stained glass.
translation: 下方由十几层彩色玻璃保护的拱顶比起表面要更安全。

original: The Terpsichore Vault
translation: 特耳西科瑞储藏室

original:
Beneath the machine-strewn surface you find a ring of nine vault-doors, each engraved with the name of a classical Muse. Eight are locked and barred, behind signs saying things like 'VACANT' or 'UNDER RENOVATION' or, in one case, 'UNFORTUNATE CHRONOLOGICAL DISCREPANCIES.'

The ninth, marked 'Terpsichore,' is the only door open to you. When you enter, your footsteps ring through dusty barracks and abandoned canteens. These are the engineers' quarters, but they are all on the surface, working. Except one.

You can hear her singing before you see her.
translation:
在机器破碎四散的表面下，你发现九扇金库门环形排列在墙上，每扇门都刻着一个古典缪斯的名字。其中八扇被锁住并堵死了，上面写着“空 置”或“正 在 装 修”，还有唯一的一扇上面写着“不 幸 的 时 间 顺 序 差 异”。

第九扇门上标着“特耳西科瑞”，是唯一对你开启的门。当你进入时，脚步声在尘土飞扬的营房和废弃的食堂里回荡。这些是工程师的宿舍，但他们都在地面上工作。除了一个人。

在看见她之前，你就能听到她的歌声。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
In response to your questions, the engineers shrug. The day dawns, the Sun brightens. The night comes, the Sun dims. What more is there to say?

Some of them seem so exhausted they can barely stand. They insist it's proximity to the Sun that affects their sleep.
translation:
作为对你的回应，工程师只是耸了耸肩。黎明来到，太阳亮起。夜幕垂落，太阳黯淡。他们还有什么可以说的?

他们中的一些看上去过于疲惫，以至几乎不能站立。他们坚称，是靠近太阳影响了他们的睡眠。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything.

They list a litany of recent faults: a broken cog, a snapped belt, unpredictable flares. More engineers swallowed by light or vitrified. And every morning, the Sun has been taking longer and longer to reach full incandescence.
translation:
工程师们聚到你身边。他们说，你得把这里发生的事告诉伦敦。叫他们派更多的工程师来。送来资源。送来援助。送点什么，什么都行。

他们细数着近期的一连串故障：齿轮损坏、皮带断裂、突然起火。更多的工程师被光吞噬或被玻璃化。而每天早上，太阳需要越来越长的时间才能达到完全白炽。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything. 

Without the expertise of the Steward, things are bleak. Engines burned out. Small, possibly-crucial, certainly-irreplaceable components warped beyond repair. A forgotten part of the Sun's deeper machinery has simply stopped moving, and no one is sure if it was something important.

Every night, a new defect. Every morning, the Sun takes longer to dawn.
translation:
工程师们聚到你身边。他们说，你得把这里发生的事告诉伦敦。叫他们派更多的工程师来。送来资源。送来援助。送点什么，什么都行。

没了总管的专业知识，形势变得严峻起来。引擎高负荷运转。小型的、可能至关重要的、绝对无法替换的部件已经变形到无法修理。太阳深层机器的一个被遗忘的部分干脆停止了运转，而且没有人知道它的状况是否紧要。

每个夜晚，都会出现一个新的问题。每天早上，太阳都需要花更长的时间来带来黎明。

original: Enquire after the lost sigils
translation: 问及丢失的符印

original: You're looking for sigils of the Correspondence. Do any of the engineers here know of any in the Clockwork Sun?
translation: 你正在寻找信符的符印。有工程师知道发条太阳这里的任何与之相关的事吗？

original: Directed elsewhere
translation: 指向别处

original: "Go speak to the Sequencer, in Azimuth," says an engineer. "If anyone knows, he will."
translation: “去和方位厅的新秩序者谈谈，”一个工程师说，“如果有人知道，那就是他了。”

original: Sabotage the sun for the Whisperwinds
translation: 为耳语之风破坏太阳

original: You made an oath to earn the clemency of the Storm that Speaks.
translation: 你发过誓要得到 言语之风暴神的宽恕。

original: The Clockwork Sun
translation: 发条太阳

original:
Sunlight seeps like syrup through cracks in the stained-glass ceiling. The floor shudders in time with the churning machinery far beneath your feet.  The air has a tang of chemicals, bonfires and rain.

Pistons pump, cogs turn, and suit-swaddled figures tend to the enginery, bellowing over the shrieking metal.
translation:
阳光如糖浆一般自彩色玻璃天花板的裂隙中渗出。地板随着在你脚下深处搅动的机械而颤抖。空气中弥漫着化学物质，炉火和雨丝的刺鼻气味。

活塞抽泵，齿轮翻旋，被成套工作服所包裹的人们照管着机器，在嘶吼的金属中大声喊叫。

original: Head toward Azimuth
translation: 前往方位厅

original: The engineers wave you onward, shouting something cheerfully derogatory about the Sequencer. It's mostly lost in the roar of pistons.
translation: 工程师们向你招手，欢快地喊着关于新秩序者的蔑称。那些话大多被活塞的轰鸣声淹没了。

original: Azimuth
translation: 方位厅

original:
Azimuth is an enormous sundial without shadow, its roof topped by a golden shark-fin gnomon. There are still racks of yellowed pamphlets on the walls – it once served as a kiosk, selling tickets to Sunspotter tourists. 

These days it is something more like a temple. Frescoes on the curved walls depict the triumph of the new sun over the old.
translation:
方位厅是一个巨大的无影日晷，屋顶上有一个金色的鲨鱼鳍形日晷。墙上还挂满了泛黄的小册子，它曾经是一个亭子，向观日的游客出售门票。

如今，它更像是一座寺庙。弧形墙壁上的壁画描绘了新太阳对旧太阳的胜利。

original: Visit the Glasshouse
translation: 前往军事监狱

original: There's a dozen signs warning you to stay away, each more insistent than the last. The engineers shout, but they're too busy to stop you.
translation: 这里有十几个警告你不要靠近的标志，每一个的语气都比上一个更坚决。工程师们大喊大叫，但他们太忙了，无法阻止你。

original: The Glasshouse
translation: 军事监狱

original: An isolated section of the abandoned exhibition-halls has been repurposed to hold not treasures, but prisoners. Each wears a grey smock rather than a protective suit, leaving them utterly undefended from the ravages of sunlight. They sit slumped in unlocked cells, making no effort to escape. Where would they go?
translation: 废弃展览厅的一个单独的区域被重新利用起来，不是用来存放宝藏，而是用来关押囚犯。他们每个人都穿着灰色的罩袍，而不是防护服，完全无法抵御阳光的蹂躏。他们颓废地坐在没有上锁的牢房里，没有试图逃跑。他们将会去哪里？

original: Descend to the Terpsichore Vault
translation: 下降到特耳西科瑞储藏室

original: The vaults below are safer, protected by a dozen layers of stained glass.
translation: 下方由十几层彩色玻璃保护的拱顶要更安全。

original: The Terpsichore Vault
translation: 特耳西科瑞储藏室

original:
Beneath the machine-bristling surface you find a ring of nine vault-doors, each engraved with the name of a classical Muse. Eight are locked and barred, behind signs saying things like 'VACANT' or 'UNDER RENOVATION' or, in one case, 'UNFORTUNATE CHRONOLOGICAL DISCREPANCIES.'

The ninth, marked 'Terpsichore,' is the only door open to you. When you enter, your footsteps ring through dusty barracks and abandoned canteens. These are the engineers' quarters, but they are all on the surface, working. Except one.

The Broken Steward has been working on the Sun since before it first shone. She has been here far, far longer than any of the engineers above.
translation:
在机器轰鸣的表面下，你发现九扇金库门环形排列在墙上，每扇门都刻着一个古典缪斯的名字。其中八扇被锁住并堵死了，上面写着“空 置”或“正 在 装 修”，还有唯一的一扇上面写着“不 幸 的 时 序 差 异”。

第九扇门上标着“特耳西科瑞”，是唯一对你开启的门。当你进入时，脚步声在尘土飞扬的营房和废弃的食堂里回荡。这些是工程师的宿舍，但他们都在地面上工作。除了一个人。

心力交瘁的总管在它第一次闪烁之前就在太阳上工作了。她在这里的时间比上面的任何工程师都要长得多得多。

original: The Steward's Sanctum
translation: 总管的圣地

original: Deep beneath the surface of the Sun, the Steward labours.
translation: 在太阳表面下的深处，总管正在辛勤工作。

original: Descend to the Terpsichore Vault
translation: 下降到特耳西科瑞储藏室

original: The vaults below are safer than the surface, protected by a dozen layers of stained glass.
translation: 下方由十几层彩色玻璃保护的拱顶比起表面要更安全。

original: The Terpsichore Vault
translation: 特耳西科瑞储藏室

original:
Beneath the machine-bristling surface you find a ring of nine vault-doors, each engraved with the name of a classical Muse. Eight are locked and barred, behind signs saying things like 'VACANT' or 'UNDER RENOVATION' or, in one case, 'UNFORTUNATE CHRONOLOGICAL DISCREPANCIES.'

The ninth, marked 'Terpsichore,' is the only door open to you. When you enter, your footsteps ring through dusty barracks and abandoned canteens. These are the engineers' quarters, but they are all on the surface, working. Except one.

You can hear her singing before you see her.
translation:
在机器破碎四散的表面下，你发现九扇金库门环形排列在墙上，每扇门都刻着一个古典缪斯的名字。其中八扇被锁住并堵死了，上面写着“空 置”或“正 在 装 修”，还有唯一的一扇上面写着“不 幸 的 时 间 顺 序 差 异”。

第九扇门上标着“特耳西科瑞”，是唯一对你开启的门。当你进入时，脚步声在尘土飞扬的营房和废弃的食堂里回荡。这些是工程师的宿舍，但他们都在地面上工作。除了一个人。

在看见她之前，你就能听到她的歌声。

original: Head toward Azimuth
translation: 前往方位厅

original: The engineers wave you onward, shouting something cheerfully derogatory about the Sequencer. It's mostly lost in the roar of pistons.
translation: 工程师们向你招手，欢快地喊着关于新秩序者的蔑称。那些话大多被活塞的轰鸣声淹没了。

original: Azimuth
translation: 方位厅

original:
Azimuth is an enormous sundial without shadow, its roof topped by a golden shark-fin gnomon. There are still racks of yellowed pamphlets on the walls – it once served as a kiosk, selling tickets to sunspotters: the pilgrims and tourists that were expected to flock here. 

These days it is something more like a temple. Frescoes on the curved walls depict the triumph of the new sun over the old.
translation:
方位厅是一个巨大的无影日晷，屋顶上安装着一个金色的鲨鱼鳍形晷针。此处的墙上仍挂满泛黄的小册子——它曾经是一个售票厅，向观日者出售门票：那些预期将涌向这里的朝圣者和游客。

如今，它更像是一座寺庙。弧形墙壁上的壁画描绘着新太阳对旧太阳的胜利。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
In response to your questions, the engineers shrug. The day dawns, the Sun brightens. The night comes, the Sun dims. What more is there to say?

Some of them seem so exhausted they can barely stand. They insist it's proximity to the Sun that affects their sleep.
translation:
作为对你问题的回应，工程师只是耸了耸肩。黎明来到，太阳亮起。夜幕垂落，太阳黯淡。他们还有什么可以说的？

他们中的一些看上去过于疲惫，以至几乎不能站立。他们坚称，是靠近太阳影响了他们的睡眠。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything.

They list a litany of recent faults: a broken cog, a snapped belt, unpredictable flares. More engineers swallowed by light or vitrified. And every morning, the Sun has been taking longer and longer to reach full incandescence.
translation:
工程师们聚到你身边。他们说，你得把这里发生的事告诉伦敦。叫他们派更多的工程师来。送来资源。送来援助。送点什么，什么都行。

他们细数着近期的一系列故障：齿轮损坏、皮带断裂、突然起火。更多的工程师被光吞噬或被玻璃化。而每个早上，太阳的光辉达到全盛所需的时间都变得越来越长。

original: Write a Port Report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: The Clockwork Sun is the pre-eminent symbol of the Empire's heavenly dominion. The newspapers in London call it enduring, everlasting, eternal.
translation: 发条太阳是帝国神圣统治的卓越象征。伦敦的报纸称它是久远、不朽、永恒的。

original: The heart of the Empire
translation: 帝国的心脏

original:
Engineers flock to you. You need to tell London what's happening up here, they say. Tell them to send more engineers. Send resources. Send help. Something, anything. 

Without the expertise of the Steward, things are bleak. Engines burned out. Small, possibly-crucial, certainly-irreplaceable components warped beyond repair. A forgotten part of the Sun's deeper machinery has simply stopped moving, and no one is sure if it was something important.

Every night, a new defect. Every morning, the Sun takes longer to dawn.
translation:
工程师们聚到你身边。他们说，你得把这里发生的事告诉伦敦。叫他们派更多的工程师来。送来资源。送来援助。送点什么，什么都行。

没了总管的专业知识，形势变得严峻起来。引擎高负荷运转。小型的、可能至关重要的、绝对无法替换的部件已经变形到无法修理。太阳深层机器的一个被遗忘的部分干脆停止了运转，而且没有人知道它的状况是否紧要。

每个夜晚，都会出现一个新的问题。每天早上，太阳都需要花更长的时间来带来黎明。

original: Find the Race Marshal
translation: 找到赛会主席

original: Lord Rochester is patrolling the upper chambers, humming cheerily to himself. He needs to confirm you've reached the Clockwork Sun.
translation: 罗切斯特勋爵正在上层大厅闲逛，欢快地哼着歌。他得确认你抵达了发条太阳。

original: Keeping up the pace
translation: 跟紧步伐

original: Lord Rochester beams as he sees you, ignoring the throngs of engineers attempting to manoeuvre him away from some of the more intricate machinery. "Capital! Knew you'd make it. I say, do you have any idea what this does?" A senior engineer hurries you away, along with the supplies Lord Rochester was holding for you, as an alarm begins to sound.
translation: 罗切斯特勋爵见到你时喜形于色，全然无视那群试图将他从一些复杂机器上移开的工程师们。“车长！我就知道能做到。我说，你知道这个是干什么的吗？” 警铃大作。一位高级工程师把你和罗切斯特勋爵为你准备的补给一起打发走了。

original: Nail philosophical Theses to the door of Azimuth
translation: 把哲学论文钉在方位厅的门上

original: Your actions are blasphemy to the Clockwork Sun itself. You better be quick, and ensure your suit is fastened tightly.
translation: 你的行为是对发条太阳本身的亵渎。最好动作快点，并确保你的工作服系得紧紧的。

original: Hammered home
translation: 一记重锤

original:
You hold the Theses to Azimuth's heavy oak door and hammer them in. Then you turn and walk hurriedly away – someone is sure to have heard you.

Sure enough, a forlorn figure in a yellow collar bursts from Azimuth and shouts something plaintive about the cost of door replacement. You flee, leaving the Dazzled Steward's anguished protestations far behind. You suspect he'll be even more upset when he reads the blasphemous Theses.
translation:
你拿着论文对准方位厅的厚重橡木门，然后把它们钉了上去。你随即转身匆匆离开——肯定有人听到了你的动静。

果不其然，一个身着黄领的惆怅的身影从方位厅冲出来，哀怨地喊着更换门要花的费用云云。你逃了出来，把目眩的总管痛苦的抗议声远远抛在后面。你猜当读到这些亵渎的论文时，他会更加难过。

original: Enquire after the lost sigils
translation: 问及丢失的符印

original: You're looking for sigils of the Correspondence. Do any of the engineers here know of any in the Clockwork Sun?
translation: 你正在寻找信符的符印。有工程师知道发条太阳这里的任何与之相关的事吗？

original: Directed elsewhere
translation: 指向别处

original: "Go speak to the Sequencer, in Azimuth," says an engineer. "If anyone knows, he will."
translation: “去和方位厅的新秩序者谈谈，”一个工程师说，“如果有人知道，那就是他了。”

original: Sabotage the sun for the Whisperwinds
translation: 为耳语之风破坏太阳

original: You made an oath to earn the clemency of the Storm that Speaks.
translation: 你发过誓要得到言语之风暴神的宽恕。

original: Shrieking alarms and jagged light
translation: 尖啸的警报声和锯齿状的光线

original:
You step from your train to find the floor rumbling. Machinery is crunching, lurching. A scream of tortured iron from below.

Some engineers are rushing back and forth, others stand in desperate huddles. One beelines to you as you disembark.

"Leave while you can," he shouts. "The Steward has gone mad! She's locked herself in some secret place below the Vaults! She's doing impossible things to the Sun!"

Flickering. Rumbling. The Sun dims, brightens, dims again.
translation:
你走下车，发现地板在隆隆作响。机器在嘎吱嘎吱地响着，摇摇晃晃。下方传来一声钢铁的惨叫。

一些工程师正在来回奔跑，另一些人则绝望地挤在一起。当你下船时，有一个人直奔你而来。

“趁你还能走的时候赶快离开，”他喊道，“总管疯了！她把自己锁在储藏室下面的某个秘密地点！她在对太阳做一些荒唐的事！”

时明时灭。隆隆作响。太阳变暗，变亮，然后再变暗。

original: Offer to help
translation: 提供帮助

original: The deeper engines drive the machinery on the surface. You must access the Steward's sanctum and stop her.
translation: 深处的引擎驱动着表面的机器。你必须进入总管的圣所并阻止她。

original: Time runs short
translation: 时间在流逝

original:
The Sun blazes. Leaderless engineers gather around you, shouting suggestions that are lost in the noise.

Then they go silent as the machinery falls still. The Sun, impossibly, brightens. Glass shatters above.
translation:
太阳熊熊燃烧。群龙无首的工程师们聚集在你周围，大声叫嚷着那些终会淹没在噪音里的建议。

而后，当机械停止不动时，他们也安静了下来。太阳，难以置信地，亮着。玻璃在上方支离破碎。

original: A Race against Unravelling Time
translation: 与解体的时间赛跑

original:
The Sun flares, dims, pulsates. Beams of light lance through the air. Your hazard-suit is already flaking. 

You need to reach the vault, before the Steward kills you all. But time is coming apart at the seams, and you don't have much of it left. 

[Time remaining before the Sun almost certainly explodes:] [qvd:134822(custodian_timer)]
translation:
太阳发光，变暗，搏动。光束刺穿空气。你的防护服已在不断剥落。

你需要在总管杀死你们所有人之前到达地下室。但时间正在不断流逝，而你已经没有多少时间了。

[距离太阳几乎确定的爆炸还有：][qvd:134822(custodian_timer)]

original: Disable the locks
translation: 打开门锁

original: She's sealed herself beneath an iron door as thick as the hull of a ship, but you're sure the locking mechanisms can be defeated somehow.
translation: 她把自己封在一扇像车体一样厚的铁门后面，但你确信可以用某种方法解开它的锁。

original: A satisfying click
translation: 令人满意的咔哒声

original:
The engineers scoff and insist it can't be done. It's rather satisfying to fetch your tools from the train, spend a few minutes tinkering at the foot of the door, and yank it open. Their faces are mingled horror and relief.

You hurry down the steps to confront the Steward. Deep in the bowels of the Sun, you find her working feverishly at a panel of levers and blinking buttons. The floor is heaped in complex tools. She doesn't even turn her head as you enter.
translation:
工程师们对此嗤之以鼻，坚称这不可能。但从火车上拿出你的工具，花几分钟时间在门脚处修理一番，然后把门一把拉开的体验，则让人感觉十分舒适。他们的脸上混合着惊恐和释然。

你匆匆走下台阶，与总管对峙。在太阳的腹中，你发现她在一个由杠杆和闪烁的按钮组成的面板上狂热地工作。地板上堆满了复杂的工具。当你走进房间时，她甚至都没有转头。

original: Time is running short
translation: 时间在流逝

original:
The engineers scoff and insist it can't be done. You fetch your tools from the train, kneel at the vault door, and are frustrated to find that they are correct.

They would have been better off had they been wrong, of course. An arc of light passes over your heads, and when it fades you see that one engineer's lips and nose have turned to glass. He turns blue, scrabbling frantically at his face, until a colleague chips his mouth open with a violent application of screwdriver.

[Time shifts. The clock-hand is somewhere different.]
translation:
工程师们对此嗤之以鼻，坚称这不可能。你从火车上拿出你的工具，跪在拱顶门前，沮丧地发现他们是正确的。

当然，如果他们错了，他们的下场会更好一点。一道弧光从你们头上掠过，当它消失时，你看到一位工程师的嘴唇和鼻子变成了玻璃。他脸色发青，疯狂地抓着自己的脸，直到一个同事用螺丝刀猛地砸开他的嘴。

[时间变换。指针指向的位置不同了。]

original: Take an unpleasant alternative route
translation: 走一条令人不快的替代路线

original: The engineers mention pipes through which toxic smoke and chemical waste are siphoned.
translation: 工程师们提到了用以排出有毒烟雾和化学废物的管道。

original: An unedifying success
translation: 一个并不令人满意的成功

original:
"Don't worry," the engineers assure you. "Your hazard-suit will protect you from the worst. And most of the chemicals won't kill you outright, probably, just shorten your lifespan a bit."

With a deep breath, you wriggle into the pipe and are carried away in a rush of vapour.

A short sickening while later, you are expelled somewhere deep within the Sun. After trudging in the dark for some time, you manage to find the Steward. She is working feverishly at a panel of levers and blinking buttons. The floor is heaped in complex tools. She doesn't even turn her head as you enter.
translation:
“别担心，”工程师们向你保证，“你的防护服会在最坏的情况下保护你。大多数化学物质都不会直接杀死你，大概吧，只是会缩短你一点寿命而已。”

你深吸一口气，扭动着钻进管道，并被一股蒸汽带走。

在一段短暂而令人恶心的时间之后，你被驱逐到太阳深处的某个地方。在黑暗中跋涉了一段时间后，你设法找到了总管。她正在疯狂地操作着面板上的控制杆和闪烁的按钮。地板上堆满了复杂的工具。当你进来时，她甚至没有转头。

original: Time is running short
translation: 时间在流逝

original:
The engineers were lying when they said your hazard-suit would protect you. You wriggle halfway into the pipe, and your skin immediately begins to blister. You tug frantically on the rope and your crew pull you back into fresh air.

Time continues to stammer. The machinery around you is rusting. A repair-crane sags and then collapses, burying one of your crew beneath a hundred tonnes of iron.

[Time shifts. The clock-hand is somewhere different.]
translation:
当工程师说你的防护服会保护你时，他们在撒谎。你在管道里蠕动了一半，皮肤就立即开始生起水泡。你疯狂地拽着绳子，你的列车员把你拉回了新鲜空气中。

时间继续时走时停。你周围的机器正在生锈。一台维修起重机掉下来，四分五裂，将你的一名船员埋在百吨重的铁块下。

[时间变化了。指针变得有点不一样了。]

original: Rip the door from its hinges
translation: 把门从铰链上扯下来

original: Find some strong cables. Tie the door to your train's undercarriage. And fly.
translation: 找些结实的缆线。把门绑在你的火车底板上。然后开动。

original: A triumph for brute force
translation: 蛮力得胜

original:
Your engine roars. A whistle shrieks. The cable goes taut, thinning. The vault door buckles, twists, and finally rips free of its hinges.

You hurry down the steps to confront the Steward. Deep within the Sun, you find her working feverishly at a panel of levers and blinking buttons. The floor is heaped in complex tools. She doesn't even turn her head as you enter.
translation:
你的机车在轰鸣。响起一声哨子般锐利的尖啸声。缆线绷紧，变细。拱顶的门弯曲、变形，最后从铰链上脱落。

你匆匆走下台阶，与总管对峙。在太阳的内部深处，你发现她在一个由杠杆和闪烁的按钮组成的面板上狂热地工作。地板上堆满了复杂的工具。当你走进房间时，她甚至都没有转头。

original: Time is running short
translation: 时间在流逝

original:
Your engine roars. A whistle shrieks. The cable is taut, thinning, thinning— And then, with hideous inevitability, it snaps. Your train goes flying and, naturally, crashes into a hundred-foot cog.

One of the engineers begins to scream. Her hair has turned into a thousand needle-shards of glass. Another is ageing before your eyes, jowls sagging, skin pruning. The Sun continues to flicker and spark.

[Time shifts. The clock-hand is somewhere different.]
translation:
你的机车在轰鸣。响起一声哨子般锐利的尖啸声。缆线绷紧，变细，变细——然后，它不可避免地绷断了。你的火车飞驰向前，自然而然地撞上了一个一百英尺高的齿轮。

一名工程师开始尖叫。她的头发变成了一千根针般的玻璃碎片。另一个在你眼前衰老、下巴下垂、皮肤脱落。太阳继续明灭闪烁。

[时间变换。指针指向的位置不同了。]

original: Blow a hole in the Sun
translation: 在太阳上炸出一个洞

original: You just happen to have some powerful explosives and an enormous drill handy. Why bother with the door?
translation: 你正好有一些强力炸药和一个巨大的钻头在手。为什么要为门的问题而烦恼呢？

original: An explosion that shakes the Sun
translation: 一场摇震太阳的爆炸

original: When the dust clears, you find the Steward staring up at you from a crater, her expression one of frank astonishment. She's surrounded by a forest of levers and blinking buttons. The floor is heaped in complex tools.
translation: 当灰尘散去时，你发现总管正站在一个弹坑上盯着你，她的表情是不加掩饰的惊愕。她被一片杠杆和闪烁的按钮所包围。地板上堆满了复杂的工具。

original: Time's up
translation: 时间到

original: And down. And backwards.
translation: 时间七零八落。

original: A flash of light
translation: 火光一闪

original:
The Sun brightens; brightens until your goggles crack. A few brief impressions are scorched into your mind: the thundering collapse of machinery, the engineers sprawled, aglow from every pore, the agony-twisted faces of your crew. 

And then the sun dims, duller than you've ever seen it. Dust clears. The scream of the engines falls to a rumble.

The vault-door finally swings open. Crew and engineers are scattered around you, wretched and blind and insensate. Alone, you descend.

Deep below, you find the Steward slumped motionless over a panel of levers and blinking buttons. The floor is heaped in complex tools.

"I give up," she says.
translation:
太阳变亮：亮到使你的护目镜破裂。一些简单的印象被烙在你的脑海中：机械雷鸣般倒塌，工程师们匍匐在地，每个毛孔都散发着光，你的列车员们因痛苦而扭曲的脸。

然后，太阳变暗了，比你见过的任何时候都要暗淡。灰尘散去。引擎的尖叫声降到了隆隆声。

拱顶的门终于打开了。列车员和工程师们散落在你周围，狼狈不堪，双目失明，毫无知觉。你独自一人走下了楼。

下面深处，你发现总管一动不动地瘫倒在一个由杠杆和闪烁的按钮组成的面板上。地板上堆满了复杂的工具。

“我放弃了，”她说。

original: Arrival at the Sun
translation: 抵至耀日

original:
An outpost on the roaring edge of the Sun, shielded from malevolent light by an eggshell of stained glass.

As you emerge from your train, suit-swaddled engineers gather, plainly astonished by your arrival. They bombard you with complex questions about how you dealt with dense sunlight and skewed chronosolar fields.

Once satisfied, they hand out protective suits to you and your crew. Yours is patched and torn, one boot missing. 

[You successfully reached the Clockwork Sun!]
translation:
一个位于太阳咆哮边缘的前哨站，通过上色玻璃的薄壳挡住恶毒的光线。

当你从火车上走出来时，穿着防护服的工程师们聚集而至，对你的到来感到诧异万分。他们用复杂的问题轰炸你，问你如何应对密集的阳光和歪曲的时空场。

直到问够了，他们才把防护服发给你和你的列车员。你的防护服打着补丁，破烂不堪，一只靴子不见了。

[你成功抵达了发条太阳！]

original: Shrug into your suit
translation: 穿上你的防护服

original: An engineer sprays you with a substance that smells like lemons gone wrong, and searches your pockets. A cursory effort at best. They seem distracted.
translation: 一个工程师给你喷洒了一种闻起来像坏掉柠檬的东西，然后粗略地搜查了一遍你的口袋。他们似乎心不在焉。

original: Scavenging with the Dawn Rats
translation: 与黎明之鼠们一起拾荒

original: A nervous face whispers to you from behind a bulkhead. "Help us. We were brought here to build the Clockwork Sun. Lots of abandoned storerooms. Help us raid them and take your fill. Safety in numbers. The Sun despises thieves, but its anger can't shine on all of us."
translation: 一张紧张的脸从舱壁后面对你低声说：“请帮帮我们。我们被带到这里来修建发条太阳。这里有很多废弃的储藏室。帮我们搜刮它们，你也可以拿一点。人越多越安全。太阳厌弃盗贼，但它的怒火不会照在我们所有人身上。”

original: Send crew to scavenge for fuel
translation: 派遣列车员去搜刮燃料

original: A risky endeavour, but perhaps worth it.
translation: 这是一次冒险，但也许值得一试。

original: A Pyrrhic victory
translation: 一次惨胜

original: Hours pass before your crew members return, rolling freshly unearthed barrels. The leader hands them to you with a carefully gloved hand.
translation: 几个小时过去，你的列车员们才回来，滚着刚出土的木桶。领头的用严密地戴着手套的手把它们递给你。

original: Shadows of the Sun
translation: 太阳之影

original: Not all of your crew returns. The survivors refuse to speak of what happened on their mission. They silently roll the stolen fuel into the cargo hold, flinching at shafts of light.
translation: 并非所有的列车员都得以返回。幸存者们拒绝谈论他们任务中发生的事情。他们默默地将偷来的燃料滚入货舱，逃离着光线的照耀。

original: A Pyrrhic victory
translation: 一次惨胜

original: Hours pass before your crew members return, rolling freshly unearthed barrels. The leader hands them to you with a carefully gloved hand.
translation: 几个小时过去，你的列车员们才回来，滚着刚出土的木桶。领头的用严密地戴着手套的手把它们递给你。

original: Send crew to scavenge for supplies
translation: 派遣列车员去搜刮补给

original: Food is scarce in this corner of the High Wilderness.
translation: 在天野的这一角，食物紧缺。

original: A souvenir of the Sun
translation: 太阳的纪念品

original: Hours pass before your crew members return, laden with dusty parcels. The leader now walks with a limp. The Dawn Rat is not with them.
translation: 几个小时过去，你的列车员们才带着满是灰尘的包裹回来。领头的如今走路一瘸一拐。黎明之鼠没有和他们在一起。

original: Wrath of the Sun
translation: 太阳之怒

original: Not all of your crew returns. The survivors refuse to speak of what happened on their mission. They silently carry the supplies into the cargo hold, piling them in the deepest shadows.
translation: 并非所有的列车员都得以返回。幸存者们拒绝谈论他们任务中发生的事情。他们默默地把补给搬进货舱，堆放在最深的阴影里。

original: A souvenir of the Sun
translation: 太阳的纪念品

original: Hours pass before your crew members return, laden with dusty parcels. The leader now walks with the aid of a stick. The Dawn Rat is not with them.
translation: 几个小时过去，你的列车员们才带着满是灰尘的包裹回来。领头的如今需要借助拐杖来走路。黎明之鼠没有和他们在一起。

original: London's Enclave
translation: 伦敦的辖地

original:
Her Majesty's Embassy dominates this little street, but the Eagle stands above the Lion and the Unicorn on the street-sign. 

London and the Khanate worked together to enter the High Wilderness; but their alliance since has been tenuous. It is preserved only by desperate diplomatic endeavour and a number of carefully preserved fictions regarding what the other is up to.
translation:
女王陛下的大使馆雄踞在这条小巷，但路标上雄鹰的徽记被安排在了金狮和独角兽的上方。

伦敦和汗国曾联手挺进天野，但他们的联盟从那时起就很脆弱。这段关系如今仅仅是通过殊死的外交努力和一些精心保留的关于对方目的的虚构说辞维持着。

original: Meet a New Street Line Passenger in a Mahjong parlour
translation: 在麻将馆里与一名新巷线的乘客见面

original: The Empyrean uses hours for labour in its war against the dark. Liberating indentured workers is a priority of the Fierce Philanthropist even on the other side of Heaven.
translation: 苍天上国利用时间对抗黑暗。即使远在天穹的另一端，刚毅的慈善家依旧将解放契约工人视为首要之务。

original: Flight from midnight
translation: 自午夜中驶出

original:
Lights of blue and green spill across the avenue, almost hiding a slim alleyway. A door, overlooked by most passers-by, opens to a descending staircase. Those who do see it, who enter, and who descend to the smoky parlours, are turned away by a set of muscular guards.

But when you show your ticket, you are welcomed with professional courtesy. Your passenger is an old soul who's just lost yet another game. "Ever so glad you're here," they say. You show them to your vessel; it's [qvd:133472(Port)] for them.
translation:
蓝色和绿色的灯光洒在大道上，几乎遮住了那条细长的巷子。在一扇被大多数路人视而不见的门的后面，藏着一个向下的楼梯。那些看到它，穿过它，向下来到那间烟雾缭绕的客厅的人，都会被一群肌肉发达的守卫赶走。

但当你出示你的票时，就会受到专业礼节的欢迎。你的乘客是一个刚刚又输掉一场比赛的老家伙。那人说：“很高兴你来了”。你把那人带到你的车上，终点是[qvd:133472(Port)]。

original: Investigate the clocks
translation: 调查时钟

original: [qvd:134402(EaglesIntro)]
translation: [qvd:134402(EaglesIntro)]

original: Introduce yourself at the Embassy
translation: 在大使馆自我介绍

original:
They might be glad to receive news from London. Few captains dare venture into Eleutheria.
[You can get a visa here, required to enter the Empyrean proper.]
translation:
他们可能很高兴收到来自伦敦的消息。很少有车长敢冒险进入厄琉忒里亚。
[你可以在这里获得签证，这是进入苍天上国所必需的。]

original: A brisk welcome
translation: 热烈欢迎

original:
The Embassy is a fine example of Georgian architecture. Inside, the elegance gives way to a pandemonium of desks, where bureaucrats minutely scrutinise their correspondence. Any mistake could trigger a summons to the Khan and the possible expulsion of the Embassy. Each is hunched with age, with hair as white as Lustrum's snow.

The Ambassador's Secretary is assigned to handle incoming captains. He reaches over a mountain range of papers with a visa. "Please don't make additional work for us. If you must visit the city, be polite."
translation:
大使馆堪称乔治时代建筑的典范。但在使馆内，这种雅致为一大片混乱的办公桌所替代。官僚们在此仔细检查他们的信件。任何错误都可能招致可汗的传唤，甚至导致他们被驱逐出大使馆。每个人都因岁月而驼背，头发像那伍载镇的雪一样白。

大使的秘书被指派处理新来的车长。他拿着签证翻过一大堆文件。“请不要为我们制造额外的工作。如果你必须到此做客，请有礼貌。”

original: Enjoy a respite at the Maiden and Unicorn
translation: 在少女与独角兽餐厅享受片刻休息

original: A tea-shop on the edge of the lane – as close to home as one can be in Eleutheria.
translation: 小巷边缘的一家茶店——厄琉忒里亚最接近家的地方。

original: Home comforts
translation: 家的温暖

original:
No matter how hard the decor tries, it can't mask the darkness visible from the window, nor soften the electric light of the Empyrean moon. Still, off-duty diplomats congregate around the triangle-cut sandwiches. They drink steeped tea with translators, attachés and runners.

The Maiden and Unicorn is also popular with citizens of the Empyrean. Some come to sample the latest London cuisine; others to do unofficial business with London's embassy. Others, like everyone else, just come to get away from the dark.
translation:
无论餐厅装饰的有多努力，它都无法掩盖透过窗户的可见黑暗，也无法柔化苍天上国月亮的电光。尽管如此，下班后的外交官们还是聚集在三角形切三明治周围。他们与翻译、随员和跑步者一起喝泡茶。

少女和独角兽也很受苍天上国市民的欢迎。有些人来品尝最新的伦敦美食；另一些人则与伦敦大使馆做非官方业务。还有些人，和任何来这的人一样，只是来躲避黑暗的。

original: Gather a port report
translation: 收集车站报告

original: The Eagle's Empyrean is a bastion of light in Eleutheria's dark.
translation: 雄鹰的苍天上国是厄琉忒里亚黑暗中的光明堡垒。

original:
Beyond the antique facades of the Lane of Lions and Unicorns, the Empyrean rises high in steel and blue light. The constraints of its location necessitate that the Empyrean builds upwards.

Careful porticoes give way to expansive temples and crowded markets. People live cheek by jowl. Light is precious, and easily lost. Power is conserved carefully; when times are bad whole districts go dark. It would be easy for hopelessness to seep in; the Khan occupies his people with festivals, celebrating his people's history of the old Khanate, and constant technological innovation. To be idle is to be afraid here. The Empyrean is busy at every hour.
translation:
在金狮独角兽小巷的古朴外观之外，苍天上国以钢铁和蓝光拔地而起。由于地理位置的限制，苍天上国的建筑必须向上发展。

精致的门廊让位于宽阔的庙宇和拥挤的市场。人们摩肩接踵地生活着。光线珍贵而容易消逝。电力被小心翼翼地保存着；在艰难时期，整个街区都会陷入黑暗。绝望情绪很容易滋生；可汗用他的节日来安抚人民，庆祝旧可汗国的历史，并推动不断的科技创新。在这里，无所事事就意味着恐惧。苍天上国每时每刻都繁忙不已。

original: Ask about the Transit Relay to the Reach
translation: 询问有关外野中继站的情况

original: Few diplomats would accept a posting here if they couldn't return to British territory. They know of a way back.
translation: 如果无法回到英国领土，很少有外交官愿意接受在这里任职。 他们知道有一条退路。

original: Rivalry
translation: 竞争

original:
The gentleman is immediately obliging. "We really should put a sign up. The [dir:28f06b55-44be-45f5-abdf-3137bcd41682]. Close by. Clockwise around the region from here. It's under Empyrean control, of course. In accordance with the treaty."

He smiles the broad smile of a practised liar. "We thought it would be a nice gesture. Let them think they control their borders, and all that." For all his confidence, he checked for Empyreans in earshot before saying that.
translation:
这位绅士立刻变得殷勤起来。“我们真应该立个牌子。[dir:28f06b55-44be-45f5-abdf-3137bcd41682]。就在这附近。顺时针绕这个地区转一圈。当然，这是在苍天上国控制之下。符合条约。”

他露出了一个惯于说谎的人那种宽厚的笑容。“我们觉得这是个不错的举动。让他们以为自己可以控制自己的边境，还有所有这一切。”尽管他信心满满，但在说这句话之前，他还是检查了一下附近是否有苍天上国的人。

original: Visit the Embassy
translation: 拜访大使馆

original: The Ambassador is always glad to receive guests. Suitably respectable ones, at least.
translation: 大使总是乐于接待客人，至少是乐于接待那些体面人。

original: Finish an unfinished story for the Gardener-Archivist
translation: 为保管故事的园丁完成未尽篇章

original: Instigate conflict. Answer questions. Tie loose threads. The Unflower can guide you.
translation: 挑起冲突，回答疑问，得到结局，未开之花会引导你。

original: A denouement
translation: 结局

original:
You read the petals of the Unflower. It blackens and wilts in your hands. It becomes apparent what you must do to bring the story to an end...

You storm into the London embassy and grab a frightened diplomat by the lapels. "He still loves you, Frederick!" you cry. "When you overheard him and Percy, they weren't lovers in earnest – they were only rehearsing for a play! Now go to him, and quick, because next week he is due to be married to the loathsome Margaret!"

You depart before Frederick has a chance to ask any questions.
translation:
你阅见了未开之花的花瓣。它在你手中变黑并枯萎。你逐渐明白，为了让故事落下帷幕，你必须做什么……

你冲进伦敦大使馆，抓住一个惊慌失措的外交官的翻领。“他仍然爱着你，弗雷德里克！”你喊道。“当你无意中听到他和珀西的对话时，他们并不是真正的恋人——他们只是在排练戏剧！现在快去找他，因为他下周就要和那个令人厌恶的玛格丽特结婚了！”

你在弗雷德里克有机会提出任何问题之前就离开了。

original: The Bespectacled Official
translation: 戴眼镜的事务官

original: He greets you at his customary table in the park, wearing a warm smile so genuine, it must be practised. "Ah, [qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]. Will you join me in playing my favourite game?" It is clear he is not speaking of mahjong, though the table is set and ready for a polite round.
translation: 他在公园里常坐的那张桌子旁迎接你，面带温暖的微笑，这表情如此真诚，一定是练过的。“啊，[qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]。你愿意陪我来一轮我最喜欢的游戏吗？”很明显，他说的不是麻将，虽然桌子已经摆好，可以礼貌地打上一圈。

original: Play a game of mahjong with the Official
translation: 与事务官打一局麻将

original: The air is warm, the tea is hot, the moon is burning bright. The unspoken business of spycraft can wait.
translation: 空气暖和，茶水温热，皎月灼灼明亮。暗流涌动的谍报业务可以再等等。

original: A quiet moment
translation: 平静时刻

original:
The Official offers you two teas – one more suited to the English palate, the other to that of Empyreans. "There's value in being comfortable with both sides," he says. 

"I spent some time in London myself, many years ago. A fine place. Fine people. Alas, family duties called, as did my current position serving the Rose-Without-Thorns. I do still like to keep up with the latest gossip, however. My generous Khan is known to value it as well."
translation:
事务官上了两杯茶，一杯是英式口味，另一杯是上国口味。“要能与两边都能和谐相处，那才叫好，”他说。

“许多年前，我自己在伦敦呆过一段时间。真是好地方，人也很好。唉，但是人要顾家，你看我现在这样，在无刺玫瑰当差。不过，我还是喜欢了解最新的传言。众所周知，我那慷慨的汗也很重视这些。”

original: Ask about the Khan's current interests
translation: 询问大汗目前的兴趣

original: On the off-chance you should be travelling in that direction...
translation: 万一你要把话题引向那边的话……

original: The House of Rods and Chains
translation: 链杆之屋

original:
"The House of Rods and Chains remains an uncomfortable mystery on our borders. It is a difficult place for our people to remain inconspicuous inside. Perhaps you could be my eyes." The Official carefully places a mahjong tile onto the board. "Your move."

[dir:b14c0b6b-839c-4311-bfd5-518edeea28ad].
translation:
“位于我国边境的链杆之屋仍然是一个令人不安的谜。我们这些人很难在里面保持不显眼。也许你可以成为我的眼睛，”事务官小心翼翼地把一张麻将牌放在牌桌上，“到你了。”

[dir:b14c0b6b-839c-4311-bfd5-518edeea28ad]。

original: Smuggle Ministry Permits into the Empyrean
translation: 将公德部的许可偷运进苍天上国

original:
"I do miss London sometimes," says the Official. "I wonder if you might provide me a souvenir."
[This will trade three Ministry-Stamped Permits for a Condemned Experiment.]
translation:
“我有时确实想念伦敦，”事务官说，“我想知道你能否为我提供一份纪念品。”
[用三张公德部盖章的许可证交换一个违背伦理的实验品。]

original: Paperwork
translation: 文书工作

original: The Official examines the paperwork closely. "If those are forged signatures, they're amongst the best I've seen. On an unrelated matter, perhaps this little trinket may be of use to you? Not our researchers' finest work. A little too willing to explode. Still, I believe you should be able to find a profitable use for it, ideally very far from here."
translation: 事务官仔细检查文件：“如果这些签名是伪造的，那它们算是我见过的最像的仿制品。打个岔，也许这件小玩意对你有用？这不是我们研究人员的最好作品。有点过于容易爆炸了。不过，我相信你应该能够找到它的有利可图的用途，最好是在离这里很远的地方。”

original: Smuggle Visions of the Heavens into the Empyrean
translation: 将天界风景偷运进苍天上国

original:
"Even the Eagle's eyes only see so far," the Official admits. "What wonders remain to be conquered?"
[This will trade three Visions of the Heavens for an Unlicensed Chart.]
translation:
“即使是雄鹰的视野也是有限的，”事务官承认，“还有哪些需要被征服的奇迹？”
[用三份天界风景交换一张未经许可的航图。]

original: A stealthy exchange
translation: 隐秘交换

original: The Official gives you the time, and the place. The electric moon casts amber shadows through the alley in the Lane of Lions and Unicorns. Your contact is late, and doesn't apologise for it. You provide glimpses of your travels through the High Wilderness and she repays you with intelligence straight from the Khan's vault. By mutual agreement, neither of you was here.
translation: 事务官把时间和地点给了你。电灯月亮在金狮独角兽巷的道路上投下琥珀色的阴影。你的联系人迟到了，而且并没有为此道歉。你提供了你天野旅行的一瞥，她用直接源自大汗金库的情报来作为回报。根据双方的协议，你们二人都不在这里。

original: Deliver intelligence on the House
translation: 提供有关链杆之屋的情报

original:
This should satisfy the Official's current need.
[Delivering Intelligence to the Official will raise your standing with the Eagle and lower it with the London Embassy.]
translation:
这应该可以满足事务官当下的需求。
[向事务官提供情报将提高你在鹰国的地位，并降低你在伦敦大使馆的地位。]

original: The drop-off
translation: 下落

original: A smile. A nod. An envelope passed from hand to hand under the table. A dropped mahjong tile draws your attention to a money pouch by your seat. You pick it up and play your next move. Careful as you are, it is unlikely that this exchange has gone unnoticed by observers from the London Embassy.
translation: 微笑。点头。信封在桌子下面从一只手递到另一只手。掉落的麻将牌把你的注意力吸引到座位旁的一个钱袋上。你拿起它，开始下一步行动。尽管你很小心，但伦敦大使馆的观察员不太可能忽视这些交流。

original: Deliver intelligence on Achlys
translation: 提供有关埃克吕斯的情报

original:
This should satisfy the Official's current need.
[Delivering Intelligence to the Official will raise your standing with the Eagle and lower it with the London Embassy.]
translation:
这应该可以满足事务官当下的需求。
[向事务官提供情报将提高你在鹰国的地位，并降低你在伦敦大使馆的地位。]

original: The drop-off
translation: 下落

original: A smile. A nod. An envelope passed from hand to hand under the table. A dropped mahjong tile draws your attention to a money pouch by your seat. You pick it up and play your next move. Careful as you are, it is unlikely that this exchange has gone unnoticed by observers from the London Embassy.
translation: 微笑。点头。信封在桌子下面从一只手递到另一只手。掉落的麻将牌把你的注意力吸引到座位旁的一个钱袋上。你拿起它，开始下一步行动。尽管你很小心，但伦敦大使馆的观察员不太可能忽视这些交流。

original: Ask about the Khan's current interests
translation: 询问大汗目前的兴趣

original: On the off-chance you should be travelling in that direction...
translation: 万一你要把话题引向那边的话……

original: Piranesi
translation: 皮拉内西

original: "There are many interesting people within Piranesi. Some of them may remain a little too interesting, if and when they emerge. A little advance warning would be valuable." He places a mahjong tile on the board. "Your move." [dir:06401842-00d7-463c-8d6b-6fdd41b2edae].
translation: “皮拉内西的里面有很多有趣的人。如果它们中的某些人出现在外面的话，也许事情就会变得过于有趣了。提前一点时间的警告会很有价值。”事务官把一张麻将牌放在牌桌上，“到你了。” [dir:06401842-00d7-463c-8d6b-6fdd41b2edae]。

original: Ask about the Khan's current interests
translation: 询问大汗目前的兴趣

original: On the off-chance you should be travelling in that direction...
translation: 万一你要把话题引向那边的话……

original: Achlys
translation: 埃克吕斯

original:
You take your turn while the Official considers the matter. "Have you heard talk of Midnight's Favour? It's a tea grown in Achlys. My interest in the beverage itself is purely personal – I hope to try it one day. But my professional concern is that where there is tea, there are Murgatroyds. Where there are Murgatroyds, there is the Game. I would like to know who the current players are."

[dir:9e91ea8e-3f0f-4a25-a400-2f451d91da81].
translation:
在官员思考这事时，你打着你的牌。“你可曾听说过午夜甄选？这是一种种植在埃克吕斯的茶。我对这种饮料本身的兴趣纯粹是个人的——我希望有天能品尝一下。但我的职业担忧是，哪里有茶，哪里就有穆加托德。哪里有穆加托德，哪里就有博弈。我想知道当前的玩家是谁。”

[dir:9e91ea8e-3f0f-4a25-a400-2f451d91da81]。

original: Ask about the Khan's current interests
translation: 询问大汗目前的兴趣

original: On the off-chance you should be travelling in that direction...
translation: 万一你要把话题引向那边的话……

original: Caduceus
translation: 商神宫

original:
The Official toys with a tile. "Have you ever wondered what the devils at Caduceus get up to? They do not discuss their business with outsiders. Ordinarily, that would be their prerogative. But this close to Empyrean territory, even good neighbours must regretfully become just a little inquisitive."

[dir:44773c30-e3dd-4ce4-a8bd-fec7b55bb463].
translation:
官员把玩着一张麻将牌。“你有没有想过商神宫的魔鬼到底在做什么？他们从不与外人讨论事务。按理说，这是他们的特权。但他们如此接近苍天上国的领土，即使是好邻居也难免会产生好奇。”

[dir:44773c30-e3dd-4ce4-a8bd-fec7b55bb463]。

original: Deliver intelligence on Piranesi
translation: 提供有关皮拉内西的情报

This should satisfy the Official's current need.

[向事务官提供情报将提高你在鹰国的地位，并降低你在伦敦大使馆的地位。]

translation: 下落

Careful as you are, it is unlikely that this exchange has gone unnoticed by observers from the London Embassy.
translation: 微笑。点头。信封在桌子下面从一只手递到另一只手。掉落的麻将牌把你的注意力吸引到座位旁的一个钱袋上。你拿起它，开始下一步行动。尽管你很小心，但伦敦大使馆的观察员不太可能忽视这些交流。

original: Exchange Plaques from Douser Engines for money
translation: 用熄光者机车的铭牌换钱

original: The Official will arrange the payment.
translation: 官员将安排付款。

original: Enemies of the State
translation: 国家的敌人

original: The Official's smile fades. "The Liberation of Night. Their ships take a special interest in our scouts and their lanterns. We return the favour. Let me show you my Khan's gratitude for your assistance."
translation: 戴眼镜的官员敛起笑容，说道：“黑夜解放组织啊，他们对我们的侦察机车和车上的灯笼格外感兴趣。我们汗国讲究礼尚往来。对于你的帮助，容我代可汗致谢。”

original: Donate Plaques from Douser Engines
translation: 献上熄光者机车的铭牌

original:
You have fought hard against those who would extinguish the light. The Official will appreciate that.
[This will lower Terror.]
translation:
你与那些想要熄灭光明的人进行了艰苦的战斗。官方将对此表示感谢。
[这将降低恐惧。 ]

original: Quiet gratitude
translation: 无声的感激

original: The Official passes you a hot cup of tea before sipping his own. He points to the bright moon and smiles proudly. "It's almost all that stands between us and the night. That intimidates some. Not me. I find it reassuring. Human invention can conquer the Wilderness, and the dark that floods across it. Human invention, and the bravery of those who'd fight against the revolutionaries who would betray us."
translation: 官员递给你一杯热茶，然后才开始品自己的茶。他指着明月，自豪地笑了。“这几乎是我们与黑夜之间的唯一屏障。它让一些人感到害怕。但不是我。我觉得它让人安心。人类的发明可以征服天野，以及充斥其间的黑暗。人类的发明，还有那些愿意与背叛我们的革命者斗争的人的勇气。”

original: Ambition: Acquire Empyrean Ingenuity
translation: 野心：获取苍天上国的智慧

original:
To open the Avid Horizon and flee the sky, the [qvd:139308(ID2)] needs access to Empyrean materials and records concerning the last time the gate was opened.

Either the Bespectacled Official or the London Embassy should be able to provide what you need. But do either of them trust you enough to share it?
translation:
为了打开渴求之地平线并逃离天空，[qvd:139308(ID2)]需要获取关于上次开启该门户时苍天上国所使用的材料和记录。

无论是戴眼镜的事务官还是伦敦大使馆，应该都能提供你所需要的东西。但他们中一个能足够信任你，愿意与你分享这些信息吗？

original: Call on a favour from the Bespectacled Official
translation: 向戴眼镜的事务官请求帮助。

original: You have proven your value to the Eagle Khan. Perhaps some strings could be pulled.
translation: 你已经证明了你对雄鹰汗的价值。也许可以拉一些关系。

original: Vital materials
translation: 重要材料

original:
It takes some convincing, but eventually several crates are delivered to your locomotive, containing redacted documents, incomprehensible machinery and even more incomprehensible blueprints.

"The Jochi Collection," an accompanying letter from the Official informs you. "This is all I can risk, but it includes accounts (appropriately edited) of the earliest attempts to open the gate." The letter makes it very clear that you are no longer warmly regarded by the Empyrean.

The [qvd:139308(ID2)] is satisfied. "This will have to do. It's enough to get started on, anyway. We'll have to establish a base of operations at the gate itself."
translation:
费了一些口舌，但最终有几个箱子被送到了你的机车上，里面装着经过编辑的文件、难以理解的机器和更难以理解的蓝图。

“术赤的收藏品”，事务官的一封附信上写道，“这是我所能冒的最大风险，但里面包括最早尝试打开大门的记录（不幸的是已经编辑过）。”这封信的其余部分非常清楚地表明，你不再受到苍天帝国的热烈欢迎。

[qvd:139308(ID2)]很满意。“这些都是必须的。无论如何，这已经足够让我们开始行动了。我们必须在大门那里建立一个行动基地。”

original: Call on your favours at the London Embassy
translation: 到伦敦大使馆寻求帮助

original: The embassy has come to rely on you. Perhaps enough that'll they'll give you what you want.
translation: 大使馆已经开始依赖你了。也许等到足够依赖时，他们会给你你想要的东西。

original: Vital materials
translation: 重要材料

original:
It takes some convincing, but eventually several crates are delivered to your locomotive, containing redacted documents, incomprehensible machinery and even more incomprehensible blueprints.

"The Jochi Collection," an accompanying letter from the Ambassador informs you. "Obtained by me at some cost. It includes accounts (unfortunately edited) of the earliest attempts to open the gate." The rest of the letter makes it very clear that you are no longer considered the apple of London's eye.

The [qvd:139308(ID2)] is satisfied. "This will have to do. It's enough to get started on, anyway. We'll have to establish a base of operations at the gate itself."
translation:
费了一些口舌，但最终有几个箱子被送到了你的机车上，里面装着经过编辑的文件、难以理解的机器和更难以理解的蓝图。

“术赤的收藏品”，大使的一封附信上写道，“我花了一些钱才拿到。里面包括最早尝试打开大门的记录（不幸的是已经编辑过）。”这封信的其余部分非常清楚地表明，你不再被当做伦敦的心腹。

[qvd:139308(ID2)]很满意。“这些都是必须的。无论如何，这已经足够让我们开始行动了。我们必须在大门那里建立一个行动基地。”

original: Ask how to win over one side or the other
translation: 询问如何赢得其中一方的支持

original: How can you prove yourself to them?
translation: 你该如何向他们证明自己？

original: Walking the line
translation: 走钢丝

original:
The London Embassy and the Rose-and-Thorns, the Empyreal security agency, are engaged in a covert war of information. Both require up-to-date intelligence on other ports in Eleutheria. If you can provide it, you can build a rapport with one side or the other.

[Seek out the London Embassy or Bespectacled Official here at the Empyrean, find out what ports they want intelligence on, and provide it.]
translation:
伦敦大使馆和苍天上国的安全机构——玫瑰与荆棘正在进行一场秘密的情报战争。两者都需要关于厄琉忒里亚其他港口的最新情报。如果你能提供，你可以与其中一方打好关系。

[向伦敦大使馆或苍天上国的戴眼镜的事务官咨询，了解他们想要的情报为何，然后提供给他们。]

original: Recruit a Felined Eccentric
translation: 招募猫咪怪人

original:
A woman sits at the station-side in oil-stained overalls. Three overfed, baleful cats lounge near her. 

"I'm looking for work," she says, climbing to her feet. The cats observe you with naked hostility.

"I'm afraid they're part of the package," she says, indicating them.

[Officers require a sign-on fee.]
translation:
一位女士穿着沾满油污的工作服坐在车站旁边。三只吃撑了的恶猫在她附近休息。 

“我在找工作，”她说着，爬起身来。这些猫以赤裸裸的敌意盯着你。

“恐怕它们是行李的一部分，”她指着它们说。

[招募车务官需要一笔签约费。]

original: Recruit her
translation: 招募她

original:
You always have room for a good engineer. Even one with cats.
[The Felined Eccentric is a Chief Engineer who increases Mirrors by 6, Hearts by 2, and Affiliation: Villainy by 1.]
translation:
你总归是需要一个好工程师的。即使她带着几只猫。
[猫咪怪人是一位能使你的镜子值增加6点，红心值增加2点，人脉：恶棍增加1点的轮机长。]

original: A new officer
translation: 一位新车务官

original:
As she climbs aboard, she pats your locomotive's boiler fondly. "Hello, my girl."

She makes her way towards her new cabin. The cats tangle around her feet, almost tripping her.
translation:
登上车时，她深情地拍了拍你机车的锅炉，“你好啊，我的女孩。”

她向她的新舱室走去。猫咪们在她的脚边打闹，几乎把她绊倒。

original: Hire on Crew
translation: 招募列车员

original:
Many potential workers lurk by the London Embassy. Their Empyrean visas have expired, but they've no way away from the port.

[You will only be able to do this once every 15 days.]
translation:
伦敦大使馆附近隐藏着许多未来的列车员。他们的苍天上国签证已经过期，但他们没有办法离开港口。

[每15天才能这么做一次。]

original: Hire a handful of crew
translation: 招募少量列车员

original:
You can take your pick from those stranded here.
[Recruit up to 3 or 4 Crew. Success lowers their cost.]
translation:
你可以从困在这里的人中间随意挑选。
[招募两至三名列车员。]

original: Eager workers
translation: 急切的工人

original: These few have been stuck at the Empyrean for weeks. They've become exceedingly tired of the weak tea offered by the Embassy 'to keep their spirits up', and will accept reduced wages if you'll just take them away.
translation: 这几个人已经在苍天上国滞留了数周。他们已经对大使馆提供的“保持精神振奋”的淡茶感到非常厌倦，如果你能把他们带走，低点工资他们也能接受。

original: Canny recruits
translation: 狡猾的新人

original: These crew members spent time in the Khan's market and have learned a great deal about haggling. They'll be paid their full value and not a sovereign less.
translation: 这些人在可汗的市场上呆了很长时间，学会了很多讨价还价的把戏。他们会得到全额报酬，一个金镑都不会少。

original: Go on a recruitment mission
translation: 开展招聘工作

original:
You are shorthanded. Engine morale and condition will falter if you don't recruit more crew.
[Recruit up to 4–8 Crew. Success lowers their cost.]
translation:
你正缺人手。如果不招募更多的列车员，机车的状态和士气都不会太好。
[招募 4 - 8 名列车员。判定成功会降低雇佣成本。]

original: New hands
translation: 新帮手

original: The groups gathered outside the embassy clamour to be taken on. Perhaps, they hope, you'll take them somewhere that doesn't rely on faltering electricity to fend off the dark.
translation: 聚集在大使馆外的人群吵着要上车。他们希望你没准能带他们去一个不靠不稳定的电力来抵御黑暗的地方。

original: A good showing
translation: 不错的表现

original: Not everyone stranded at Eagle's Empyrean is fit to crew your locomotive. But after a series of interviews you gather the best of those here: those with previous experience, the drive to survive, and the scars to prove it.
translation: 并非每个滞留在雄鹰之苍天上国的人都适合担任你的列车员。但经过一系列的面试，你雇佣了这里最优秀的人：那些有着丰富经验，生存动力，以及疤痕作为二者之证明的人。

original: An Opportunity: Bombazine at the Empyrean
translation: 机遇：苍天上国的邦巴辛布

original:
The Empyrean confiscates all Bombazine that enters its territory and prosecutes illegal carriers with vengeful zeal. It's a restricted item – vital for the maintenance of the Xanthous moon, but often used by agents of the Liberation to conceal their midnight work. 

Any storehouse would present too tempting a target for the Liberation's spies and smugglers. Instead, the Empyrean's government pays captains to transport the stuff far, far away. Any captain who undertakes such work must submit to an extensive check of their credentials..
translation:
苍天上国会没收所有进入其领土的邦巴辛布，并以报复性的热情起诉非法运输者。出于对朦黄之月维护工作中至关重要的一环，此物在这里受到限制，但夜之解放的特工经常用它来掩盖他们的午夜工作。

对解放组织的间谍和走私者来说，任何仓库都是一个太过诱人的目标。作为代替，苍天上国的政府付钱给车长，让他们把这东西运往很远很远的地方。任何从事这种工作的车长都必须接受对其证书的广泛检查。

original: Pay to have your credentials checked
translation: 付钱让人检查你的资格证书

original:
The bureaucracy is proudly Byzantine. A hefty bribe is required to expedite matters.

[You may gain four Rolls of Thirsty Bombazine.]
translation:
此处的官僚机构自豪地采用拜占庭式结构。为了加快办事速度，需要巨额的贿赂。

[你可能会获得四卷渴光的邦巴辛布。]

original: Precautionary measures
translation: 防范措施

original:
Despite their best efforts (or thanks to the unblemished nature of your character), the Empyrean's agents find not a shred of evidence against you. You are fit to transport Bombazine.

You are brought to a warehouse blazing with neon light. "Keeps the bombazine nice and heavy," you are told, as a crew of agents carry it to your engine. "Harder to steal."
translation:
尽管他们尽了最大努力（或由于你毫无瑕疵的性格），苍天上国的特工没有找到一丝对你不利的证据。你具有运输邦巴辛布的资质。

你被带到了一个闪烁着霓虹灯的仓库。“确保邦巴辛布的安全和重量，”当一队特工把它搬到你的机车上时，他们这么跟你说，“让人更难把它偷走。”

original: A spot check
translation: 抽查

original:
The agents detain you while they perform the requisite checks. The process will take a day and a night. They serve you too sweet tea but do nothing to shutter you from the neon glare of the lights. Your sleep is fitful.

The next morning you are considered to possess insufficient moral fortitude to transport bombazine. Furthermore, suspected contraband has been removed from your engine. They do, however, return half of your deposit.
translation:
特工们在进行必要的检查时扣留了你。这个过程将需要一天一夜。他们为你提供了太多的甜茶，但没有做任何事情来使你远离霓虹灯的刺眼光芒。你睡得断断续续。

第二天早上，你被认为没有足够的道德毅力来运输邦巴辛布。此外，可疑的违禁品已经从你的引擎中取了出来。然而，他们确实归还了你一半的押金。

original: Bypass the background check
translation: 绕过背景调查

original: If they check with their superiors, they'll surely agree that your character is more than suitable for transporting bombazine.
translation: 如果他们向上级核实，他们肯定会同意你的性格更适合运送邦巴辛布。

original: Swift apologies
translation: 迅速道歉

original:
The message is swiftly relayed. As soon as the warehouse officials discover you were telling the truth, there are an embarrassing number of apologies and promises that this will not happen again. You are assured that not only are you permitted to take the bombazine, but they will bring it straight to your engine. 

Later, you receive a curt note from the Bespectabled Official later, reminding you about the dignity of one's position and favours that are beneath a gentleperson to ask.
translation:
不久后便有消息来报。在仓库管理人员发现你说的是真话后，你就能听到数不清的足以使人脸红的道歉，并对不会再发生这种情况的承诺。你不仅可以放心地携带邦巴辛布，而且他们还会将其直接运到你的机车上。 

之后，你会收到尊贵官员的一封简短的便条，提醒你要注意一个人的地位的尊严和不符合绅士要求的恩惠。

original: The Parlour
translation: 会客厅

original:
The windows in the parlour are shuttered, the light stained with pale yellows, blushing pinks and bruised violets. 

Lit with the illusion of dawn – or perhaps, dusk – you see: a room cluttered with stiff-backed armchairs and decorative chaises, set against savagely floral wallpaper in shades of burgundy, violet and brunswick green. A portrait of the Empress, unsmiling, hangs in an ornate gilt frame. 

A few visitors mill about, casting speculative glances at the Exasperated Butler while they pretend to examine the decor.
translation:
客厅的窗户紧闭，光线被染成稀薄的黄色、羞涩的粉红色和青涩的紫罗兰色。

在黎明——或者黄昏——的幻景之中，映入你眼帘的是：房间里摆满了硬背扶手椅和装饰性躺椅，背景墙上贴着鲜艳的花卉壁纸，色调为酒红色、紫罗兰色和布伦瑞克绿。有一幅庄重严肃的皇后画像，挂在一个华丽的镀金框架里。

少数访客在附近徘徊，一边假装检查室内装饰，一边向暴躁的管家投去猜忌的目光。

original: Write a port report
translation: 撰写车站报告

original: Perdurance is a jewel in the Empire's crown; where its favourite sons and daughters are pampered, protected, and preserved.
translation: 琥珀宫是帝国王冠上的一颗明珠；帝国最受欢迎的儿女们在这里得到呵护、保护和维护。

original: Important matters
translation: 重要事项

original:
The visitors are puffed up with importance and embarrassingly eager to tell you how they obtained an invitation to the Half-Light Masque: some through patronage or long service, others through less salubrious means. 

All are desperate to spend a day in the company of the glittering inhabitants of Perdurance: the brightest stars in Albion's firmament. For here, the sons and daughters of Her Majesty's most important courtiers reside in eternal youth and sophistication.
translation:
来访者们自命不凡，迫不及待地想要告诉你他们是如何获得参加明暗假面舞会的邀请的：一些人通过赞助或长期服务获得邀请，而另一些人则通过不太光彩的手段。

所有人都渴望与琥珀宫光彩照人的居民共度一天：他们是阿尔比恩最耀眼的明星。因为在这里，女王陛下最重要朝臣的子女们永葆青春、举止优雅。

original: Talk to the Exasperated Butler
translation: 与暴躁的管家交谈

original: He appraises you with an officious disapproval that testifies to years of devoted training.
translation: 他以一种傲慢的不满态度评价你，证明了他多年来的潜心训练。

original: Hand your invitation to the Exasperated Butler
translation: 把你的邀请函交给暴躁的管家

original: And join the Half-Light Masque!
translation: 然后参加明暗假面舞会！

original: Through the Empress, straight on till Morning
translation: 穿过皇后，直至清晨

original:
The portrait of the Empress swings open and a succession of brightly-dressed debutantes, sour-faced chaperones and prim servants stumbles into the parlour. They barely have a moment to rest their feet and take a sip of tea before a panel of wallpaper slides open, the dark maw of a sharply curving passage just visible in the dawn light. 

The Exasperated Butler snatches the invitation from your hands. "Remember: your invitation only lasts one day." It is a warning, but sounds a little wistful. He propels you forward to join the Court in its procession.

You emerge, a little tender, into the Morning.
translation:
女王肖像画应声而开，盛装闺秀、面色阴沉的监护人与古板仆人接连跌撞而入客厅。众人还未及落座啜茶，墙纸暗格已悄然滑开——黎明微光中，一道急弯通道的幽暗入口若隐若现。

暴躁的管家夺过你手中请柬：“记住：你的邀请仅限今日。”虽是警告，却透出几分怅然。他将你推入宫廷队列之中。

你带着些许恍惚踏入晨光，恍若初生。

original: Stand for Parliament in Perdurance
translation: 在琥珀宫参加议会选举

original:
The debutantes wouldn't sully their perfect day by voting, of course. But perhaps some of Perdurance's servants and chaperones might be moved by democratic spirit.
[It costs 50 sovereigns to stand. It is refunded if you win.]
translation:
当然，闺秀们不会让她们完美的一天被投票所玷污。但也许琥珀宫的一些仆人和监护人会被民主精神所打动。
[参加选举需要花费50个金镑。如果你获胜，此费用会被退还。]

original: The election is called
translation: 开始选举

original: At least a few of the people bother going to the polls.
translation: 至少还有那么几个人愿意费心投票。

original: Minor setbacks
translation: 小小的挫折

original:
The polls are not in your favour. Your opponents appear to have the will of the people behind them. Fortunately, it is a long way from here to Parliament. You suspect that it will not be long before the winner tires of their new position and steps down.

[A new Election will be called here after a while, if you wish to try again]
translation:
你未赢得选举。你的对手显然更能吸引民意。好在，此地离浮空议会十万八千里，你推测，过不了多久，胜选者就会厌倦新职位，自愿下台。

[如果你想再次尝试，过段时间后，这里还会再次举行选举。]

original: Listen to the Will Of The People
translation: 听取民意

original: A delegation has been sent to petition you in your role as Minister.
translation: 一个代表团被派来向作为大臣的你请愿。

original: Endless problems, few solutions
translation: 麻烦无穷，办法甚少

original: You listen with appropriate amounts of care to each person who begs a moment of your time. The majority are local issues, not worth bringing up in Parliament. Occasionally, inspiration strikes for a new law. You promise with a practised politician's sincerity that even if there is nothing you can do, you will do it to the best of your ability. They seem mollified by that.
translation: 你以恰到好处的谨慎态度倾听每个请求占用你一点时间的人。大多都是本地的问题，不值得被带到议会那里。偶尔也会有新法案的灵感出现。你以政治家的诚意承诺，即使你无能为力，你也会尽你所能去做。他们似乎对此感到欣慰。

original: Endless problems, few solutions
translation: 麻烦无穷，办法甚少

original: You listen with appropriate amounts of care to each person who begs a moment of your time. Until the egg hits you in the face. The perpetrators run off giggling. You wipe away the dripping yolk. Someone should make a law against that sort of thing...
translation: 你以恰到好处的谨慎态度倾听每个请求占用你一点时间的人，直到鸡蛋打在你的脸上。肇事者傻笑着跑开了。你擦去滴落的蛋黄。应该有人制定一项法律，禁止这种事情发生……

original: Help the Incautious Driver hunt for the Verdant Fragment
translation: 帮助鲁莽的司机寻找青翠的碎片

original:
Their connection to its progenitor should assist.
[The more places you search, the easier your search will get. Failing here will not harm your quest.]
translation:
这个人与它祖先的联系应该会派上用场。
[你搜索的地方越多，就越容易找到。在这里失败不会让阻碍你的搜索。]

original: A taste on the wind
translation: 风的味道

original:
The Driver sniffs at the air for any hint of loose Verdant spores dragged in by passing travellers. "I can taste something. A fear. Not death, but the loss of something important. The Fragment doesn't want to return. It doesn't want to give up what it's become."

They close their eyes, focusing. "I can taste its design, as well. Its... host knew of a place called Hostrop Deep: a desolate corner of the sky. It meant to hide there. The Deep will be hard to find. When we're close, we'll need to use our scout."

The Deep [dir:15a02c74-f737-4094-b02b-01a35defe13e].
translation:
司机嗅着空气，搜寻着来往过客是否带有些许翠树孢子。“我能感觉到……恐惧的味道。不是惧怕死亡，而是怕失去某种重要的东西。离散孢子不愿回归母体，它不愿舍弃如今的模样。”

此人闭眼凝神，接着说道：“我还能了解它的打算。它的……母体知道一个名叫霍斯特罗普深渊的地方，那是天野中的一个荒凉角落。它打算藏在那里。深渊不好找寻，等我们接近时，得靠侦察兽来精确定位。”

深渊[dir:15a02c74-f737-4094-b02b-01a35defe13e]。

original: A failed attempt
translation: 失败

original: The Incautious Driver spends hours sniffing at the air in search of familiar spores, but to no avail. "We should try somewhere else," they reluctantly decide, shuffling with uncharacteristic glumness back towards the train.
translation: 一连几个小时，鲁莽的司机嗅着空气，寻找着熟悉的孢子，但徒劳无功。司机不情愿地建议道：“我们应该去别的地方试试，”阴沉着脸回到机车上，一反常态。

original: Ambition: Establish a spider-council here
translation: 野心：建立一个蜘蛛议会

original: You wait for the moment when Perdurance's glittering debutantes, having finished their perfect day, pass through the parlour to begin it anew. Excited visitors flock to see them. You release your sorrow-spider from its bag.
translation: 你静候着琥珀宫的闺秀们——当她们结束完美一日，容光焕发地穿过会客厅重启轮回的时刻。慕名者蜂拥而至。你从布袋中放出悲伤蜘蛛。

original: A strand of the web
translation: 蛛网一缕

original:
It scuttles under a voluminous skirt, and accompanies the debutantes into their day's festivities.

It is difficult to say how time passes in Perdurance. But when the debutantes emerge again from their Masque, you notice that one or two of them are wearing decorated eye patches.

The next time they emerge, it is several of them. The time after that, even more. Apparently it's quite the craze.
