original: There are endless numbers of them.
translation: 他们的数量无穷无尽。

original: Meet the Exacting Ombudsman
translation: 会见严苛的监察员

original: He gave you directions to a coffee-house.
translation: 他给你指引去咖啡馆的路。

original: The Exacting Ombudsman
translation: 严苛的监察员

original: The Ombudsman asked you to meet him at a coffee-house in Urd, where masked spirits silently contemplate empty cups and remember what coffee was like.
translation: 监察员让你在昔日城的一家咖啡馆见他，在那里，戴着面具的鬼魂默默地凝视着空杯子，回忆着咖啡的滋味。

original: Approach the Ombudsman's table
translation: 走近监察员的桌子

original: He's twitchy. He's abrupt. He's rude to the waitress. He clearly doesn't enjoy all this skulduggery.
translation: 他很焦躁。他很粗鲁。他对女侍者态度无理。他显然不喜欢这种阴谋诡计。

original: The Chorea Machabaeorum
translation: 死亡之舞

original:
"I interrogated the Jewelled Judge for hours and all I got out of her was a selection of inoffensive anecdotes." The Ombudsman shakes his head solemnly. "She's a tough nut to crack, that's for sure. But I have a plan.

"Every few months, the Graven go to a grand ball called the Chorea Machabaeorum. It's rare for outsiders to attend – and they know about my investigation, so there's no way I'll be invited. But if there's anywhere the Judge will let her guard down and speak freely, it's there. Report back as soon as you have discovered a clue."
translation:
“我审问了珠宝法官几个小时，从她那里得到的只是一些无害的轶事。”监察员严肃地摇头。她是个难对付的家伙，这是肯定的。但我有一个计划。

“每隔几个月，墓族就会去参加一个名为死亡之舞的盛大舞会。很少有外人参加——他们知道我的调查，所以我不可能被邀请。但如果有什么地方法官会放松警惕，畅所欲言，那就是那里。一旦你发现线索，就立即报告。”

original: Tell the Exacting Ombudsman the truth
translation: 告诉严苛的监察员事实

original: The Watcher is dead, his judgements counterfeit.
translation: 守望者已死，它的判决是伪造的。

original: The truth is out
translation: 真相大白

original:
"I knew it!" declares the Ombudsman, leaping to his feet. "Rest assured, my vindication only somewhat dampens my outrage! I am going to travel at once to the Forge of Souls to present my findings."

He pulls from his robes a flawless diamond, the size of a horse's heart. "Here. It's just a transparent rock containing no souls at all, but I believe it has some kind of symbolic value where you come from? Hopefully it's enough to recompense you for your time."
translation:
“我就知道！”监察员跳起来说，“请放心，我的辩护只是在一定程度上平息了我的愤怒！我将立即前往铸炉，展示我的发现。”

他从长袍中取出一颗完美无瑕的钻石，大小如马的心脏。“给。这只是一块透明的石头，根本没有灵魂，但我相信它在你的家乡有某种象征价值？希望它足以补偿你的时间。”

original: Lie to the Exacting Ombudsman
translation: 对严苛的监察员说谎

original: The Graven are still hearing the Watcher in their polished ivory heads, same as always.
translation: 墓族仍然像往常一样，在他们抛光的象牙头里听到守望者的声音。

original: An oddly disappointed Ombudsman
translation: 一个奇怪的失望的监察员

original: "Oh," says the Ombudsman, standing and collecting his things. "Good. That's a good thing. After all, it would be dreadful if I had actually been on the brink of uncovering a vast and terrifying conspiracy. I suppose I'll return to the Forge of Souls and present our findings."
translation: “哦，”监察员站着收拾东西说。“很好。这是一件好事。毕竟，如果我真的处于揭露一个巨大而可怕的阴谋的边缘，那将是可怕的。我想我会回到灵魂铸炉，展示我们的发现。”

original: Lure the Ombudsman to his demise at the bottom of the Well
translation: 诱使监察员在井底丧命

original: The Watcher's spirit lingers down there, you lie, but in a much-reduced state. It could perish any minute.
translation: 你撒谎说，守望者的灵魂在那下面徘徊，但处于一种非常虚弱的状态。它随时可能消亡。

original: A hero's mission
translation: 英雄的使命

original: "Then I must rescue the poor soul at once! Meet me at Wellmouth!" The Ombudsman leaps to his feet and rushes from the coffee-house.
translation: “那我必须马上营救这个可怜的灵魂！在井口见我！”监察员跳起来，从咖啡馆冲了出去。

original: Ask the Ombudsman how you can obtain an invitation
translation: 询问监察员你如何才能获取邀请

original: The Chorea Machabaeorum is usually off-limits to all except the Graven, but the Ombudsman has an idea. He leans in conspiratorially.
translation: 通常，死亡之舞禁止所有墓族以外的人进入，但监察员有一个想法。他阴险地靠了过来。

original: The Ombudsman's plan
translation: 监察员的计划

original:
"I happen to know that the Carious Official has received an invitation to the Machabaeorum, but he doesn't plan to attend," says the Ombudsman.

"I expect he'll be happy to give it to you. In order to get him to meet you, though, your Status must be Invisible or Antedeceased... So I suppose that's impossible." He sighs. "In which case you'll need to flatter the Judge with a gift of gemstones and hope she sees fit to invite you."
translation:
“我碰巧知道龋齿官员已经收到了前往死亡之舞的邀请，但他并不打算参加，”监察员说。

“我想他会很乐意把它给你的。但是，为了让他见你，你的身份必须是无形灵或者质亡灵……所以我想这是不可能的。”他叹了口气。“在这种情况下，你需要用宝石作为礼物来奉承法官，并希望她认为邀请你合适。”

original: Leave the coffee-house
translation: 离开咖啡馆

original: You leave the Ombudsman brooding over his empty cup.
translation: 你留下监察员对着他的空杯子沉思。

original: Death's Doorstop
translation: 死亡之门的门栓

original:
An austere, ugly little town has sprung up around the station, built and inhabited by spirits too afraid to pass beyond the Door.

It has no official name, because officially it should not exist, but some of the Blue Kingdom bureaucrats sneeringly call it Death's Doorstop.

Beyond it, the Endless Furrows. An endless expanse of churned black mud.
translation:
车站周围已经建起了一个朴素、简陋的小镇，它是由那些不敢通过死亡之门的灵体建造和居住的。

它没有正式的名字，因为按照官方的说法来说它不应该存在，但一些蓝色王国的官员讥讽地称它为死亡之门的门栓。

再往前是无尽的沟壑——一望无际的翻涌着的黑色泥浆。

original: Wander the streets of the officially-nameless town
translation: 漫步在这个没有官方名称的小镇的街道上

original: A town of spirits too cowardly to pass on. There are few such specimens – only the most committed kind of cowardice can survive death.
translation: 这是一座鬼魂之城，懦弱得无法传承。很少有这样的标本——只有最坚定的懦弱才能逃过死亡。

original: Make your way to the Endless Furrows
translation: 前往无尽沟壑

original: Careful. The mud can devour a boot whole.
translation: 小心点。这些泥浆可以吞没整只靴子。

original: Treacherous ground
translation: 诡谲的土地

original:
As you make your way to the Furrows, the mud seems softer, more yielding than usual. First you sink to your ankles, then to your knees. You find yourself wading, torso-deep, and finally come to a stop with the cold mud reaching your chin.

A heavy boot falls inches from your nose. You crane your neck to meet the empty gaze of a porcelain mask. A Yoked spirit, as tall as a stone column.

 "The Arbiter of Fates will see you now," booms a voice from the clay urn on his back, in a tone that brooks no argument. An arm plunges into the mud and hauls you free.
translation:
当你向无尽沟壑前进时，泥土似乎比平常更柔软，更易屈服。你先是陷到脚踝，然后是膝盖。你发现自己正在趟水，泥水淹到了你的躯干，最后在你下巴处停了下来，冰冷刺骨。

一只沉重的靴子离你的鼻子只有几英寸远。你伸长脖子，迎接一副瓷制面具空洞的凝视。那是一个与石柱一样高的缚链灵。

“命运仲裁者现在要见你，”他背上泥罐里传来一个不容置疑的声音。一条手臂猛地插入泥中，把你拖了出来。

original: Make your way to the Endless Furrows
translation: 前往无尽沟壑

original: Careful. The mud can devour a boot whole.
translation: 小心点。这些泥浆可以吞没整只靴子。

original: Make your way to the Endless Furrows
translation: 前往无尽沟壑

original: Careful. The mud can devour a boot whole.
translation: 小心点。这些泥浆可以吞没整只靴子。

original: Meet with the Mesmeric Orator
translation: 与煽惑人心的演说家会面

original: A stocky spirit is waiting, buckling under the weight of a golden urn as tall as he is. This is the Daughter's chosen ambassador.
translation: 一个健壮的鬼魂正等着，背负着一个与他一样高的金瓮。这是太阳之女选中的大使。

original: The Mesmeric Orator
translation: 煽惑人心的演说家

original:
Some of the Yoked spirits speak through the voices of the departed, which they carry in jars or other containers. You've never seen an urn quite so large, though.

"Greetings, [qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]." A voice echoes from the urn. A voice that is honey poured over thunder. You could huddle around it for warmth. "I understand we are to be partners in the Blue Kingdom's first diplomatic enterprise."

"Well, what are we waiting for?" asks the Mesmeric Orator, chuckling the warmest, kindest chuckle that has ever issued from a pot. He marches aboard your engine. "We are to establish the embassy at a place called Hybras."
translation:
一些缚链灵通过离世者的声音说话，他们把这些声音装在罐子或其他容器里。不过你从来没有见过这么大的骨灰盒。

“你好，[qvd:131182(SpeechFormal)]。”一个声音从骨灰盒里回荡出来。这个声音是在雷声中浇灌的蜂蜜。你可以蜷缩在它周围取暖。“我知道我们将成为蓝色王国第一个外交企业的合作伙伴。”

“好吧，我们还在等什么？”煽惑人心的演说家问道，他咯咯地笑着，这是有史以来罐里发出的最温暖、最友善的笑声。他在你的机车上走来走去：“我们要在一个叫海波拉的地方建立大使馆。”

original: The Court of Mayflies
translation: 蜉蝣法庭

original: This Court is little bigger than a dressing room. The spirits that come here pass through quickly, and many of them belong to small creatures. But they are brightly dressed and fast-moving, giving the impression of a midge's wedding.
translation: 这个法庭不比一个更衣室大多少。来到这里的鬼魂很快就会出来，其中有许多鬼魂属于小型生物。但它们衣着鲜艳，行动迅速，让人感觉像是在参加蠓虫的婚礼。

original: Undergo the Removal of your Clear Soul Flaw
translation: 清除你灵魂的澄明缺陷

original:
The spirits of the Court of Mayflies offer you this gift: a keener sense of mortality.
[This will remove your Flaw: Clear at the permanent cost of 1 Hearts.]
translation:
蜉蝣法庭的鬼魂给了你这份礼物：一种更敏锐的死亡感。
[这将以1点红心的永久成本消除你的缺陷：澄明。]

original: They tell you their truth in small words
translation: 他们用简短的话语告诉你真相

original:
Life is short. Death is all.

We do the best things first.

There is time for nothing else.

They let you feel time as it passes for them. They are born like a drunkard falling out of a window. They live their whole span in screaming toward the ground.

When you recover your senses, those who spoke to you are already gone. They have completed their wait and passed before you into the Kingdom.
translation:
人生苦短，死亡是唯一归宿。  

我们总是先做最好的事情。  

没有时间去做其他。  

他们让你感受到时间的流逝，如同醉酒者从窗户坠落。他们的一生都在尖叫着向地面坠落。  

当你恢复神智时，那些与你交谈的人已经离去。他们已经完成了等待，先于你进入天国。

original: Rental Dispute: Seek a ruling on the shortness of days
translation: 一场租约纠纷：寻求对天数过短的裁决

original: The Court of Mayflies is entitled to determine that a contract has too short a time limit.
translation: 蜉蝣法庭有权判定合同的时限过短。

original: Precedent!
translation: 先例！

original:
Three days for a contract of lease? Not reasonable! Precedent states this cannot be correct! Therefore the lease must have another meaning!

The official of the court embellishes your copy of the lease with roughly fifty small red stamps, then shouts for you to make way for the next applicant.

[Take your paperwork to the Pansekritis to have it converted from word into action.]
translation:
三天的租赁合同？不合理！有先例表明这不可能是正确的！因此租约肯定有另一种含义！

法院的官员在你的租约副本上盖了大约五十个小红章，然后大声叫你为下一个申请人让路。

[把你的文件带到潘塞克里蒂斯前，让它把文字转化为行动。]

original: Quickly, quickly!
translation: 快，快！

original: You are here? Go to the window! State your case! Why are you slow? State faster! No! Too slowly! Pay the fine for untimely delay! Next!
translation: 你应该在这里吗？到窗口去！说明你的情况！你为什么这么慢？说快点！不！太慢了！你要为你不合时宜的延误支付罚款！下一个！

original: Claim the Status of Ephemera
translation: 宣称浮生灵的地位

original: Perhaps you were Antedeceased when you arrived here, but life is so short! Produce a witness to your death, and be recognised as Ephemera.
translation: 也许你到这里时已经是质亡灵了，但生命是短暂的！见证你的死亡，然后被承认为浮生灵。

original: Your companion
translation: 你的同伴

original:
Your Litigator is required to recount your death, from personal experience. They describe an incident with the escaped spirit of a bull elephant, a lack of nerve, a heart attack. Two Court officials in a row go on break before the description is complete.

The third attendant does stamp you Ephemera, however. The mark is applied to your lower lip and it is the iridescent green-black of a beetle's carapace.
translation:
你的诉讼代表需要根据你的亲身经历来复述你的死亡过程。它描述了一起与一头逃跑的公象鬼魂相关的事件，一场精神崩溃，一次心脏病发作。两名法庭官员在描述完成前便接连休庭了。

然而，第三名侍从确实在你的身上盖上了浮生灵的印记。这个印记被印在了你的下唇上，呈现出甲虫甲壳般的虹彩绿黑色。

original: Lurk near the Court of Mayflies
translation: 潜伏在蜉蝣法庭附近

original: You may learn what rituals are offered here.
translation: 你可能会了解到这里提供什么仪式。

original: An overlap of purposes
translation: 交叠的欲求

original:
The Court of Mayflies serves those who have had exceptionally brief lives, either by nature or by circumstance. It also hears appeals concerning matters where something has been cut off too soon, or where short measure has been granted. Souls with the Clear flaw can be remedied, though at significant cost.

[Only those with a Status other than Invisible may enter here. The Market of Litigators in the Toll-Tower can offer instruction in changing Status in the Blue Kingdom.]
translation:
蜉蝣法庭为那些因自然或环境原因而拥有特别短暂生命的物种服务。它也审理关于某些东西被过早截止，或者关于某地被授予的东西分量不足的上诉。有澄明缺陷的灵魂可以在这里得到治疗，尽管要付出巨大的代价。

[只有那些拥有无形灵以外的地位的人才能进入这里。渡灵塔中的诉讼代表市场可以提供关于改变蓝色王国地位的指引。]

original: The Court of Oaks
translation: 橡树法庭

original:
The vaulted ceiling is distant as a cloud-forest canopy. The spirits, too, are mostly vegetative: an unyielding bronzewood; a Welsh yew; some species with scales for bark. 

The officials and attendants of the court are masked, Yoked shades in muddy overalls.

Even this court honours the Pansekritis, highest official of the House of Days. Its name is worked into the soil, expressed in the exact proportions of sand and clay and loam.
translation:
拱形天花板就像云林冠层一样遥远。这里的鬼魂也大多是植物：不屈不挠的青铜木；威尔士紫杉；一些树皮带鳞的树种。

法庭的官员和侍从都戴着面具，穿着泥泞的工作服，就像缚链灵。

就连这个法庭也尊崇着潘塞克里蒂斯，时光之屋的最高官员。他的名字被刻印在泥土里，以沙、粘土和壤土的确切比例表现出来。

original: Undergo the removal of your Flickering soul flaw
translation: 去除你灵魂的闪烁缺陷

original:
The spirits of the Court of Oaks offer you a gift of heartwood and permanence.
[This will remove your Flaw: Flickering at the permanent cost of 1 Veils.]
translation:
橡树法庭的鬼魂们赠予你一份心材与永恒的礼物。
[这将以1点面纱的永久成本消除你的缺陷：闪烁。]

original: Slow self-becoming
translation: 缓慢的自我成长

original:
You are offered an explanation so unhurried that it is difficult to follow. Is there an argument here? What could anyone make of this story, in which volumes are devoted to the layering of leaves in a single autumn?

But from the crown of the narrative, look back, and see. There were circumstances. There was wind, snow, and wildfire, years whose austerity became a tight ring inside the body. 

There were also springs of sunward reaching, of sending roots into the available crevices. 

This process – you on the world, the world on you – has made you true. What is inevitable is always true.
translation:
你得到的解释太过从容不迫，以至于很难跟上。这里有论点吗？谁能从这个故事中得出什么结论呢？这个故事用大量的篇幅来描写秋天树叶的层层堆积。

但请从叙述的顶端回望，看看。当时是有一些情况的。有风、雪和野火，那些年的严酷在身体里形成了紧绷的环。

但也有阳光照耀的春天，有根扎进可用缝隙的春天。

这个过程——你与世界，世界与你——让你变得真实。不可避免的事情总是真实的。

original: A Rental Dispute: Wait for a ruling on an overlong contract
translation: 租赁纠纷：等待对过长合同的裁决

original: You will need a tremendous persistence and a suitable bribe.
translation: 你需要极大的耐心和适当的贿赂。

original: Granted, eventually
translation: 准许，终于

original:
The attendant asks about the Ambassador, Albion, your opinion of Devils and your reasons for siding with them against your own kind. 

She inks your tongue and takes its imprint. She tests your spittle with drops that turn it a vigorous puce, "to check for spite."

Then she writes out her own notes in handwriting like the trace of a vine. She adduces five precedents which have bearing on this case. On the lease itself, she places a symbol which means 'the tree that dies upright in the forest, but does not fall until a snow comes.'
translation:
侍者询问了大使、阿尔比恩，你对魔鬼的看法，以及你站在他们这边与你同类为敌的原因。

她用墨水涂在你的舌头上，并取下了它的印迹。她用几滴试剂测试了你的唾液，使其变成了鲜艳的紫色，“以检查是否有恶意”。

然后，她以如藤蔓般蜿蜒的笔迹写下了自己的笔记。她引用了五个与本案有关的先例。在租约本身上，她放置了一个符号，意思是“森林中直立而死的树，直到雪来时才倒下”。

original: Is this even a line?
translation: 这是在排队吗？

original:
You get into what you think must be the queue. It doesn't move.

You stand. Then you sit. Then you lie down. Nothing moves.

The spirit of a fungal colony occupies a space next to you. It smells like dirt and dark permanence. It doesn't go anywhere either.

You haven't eaten since you got here. There are no changes of light to help you guess how long that has been. It feels like days. It feels like weeks.

In the end the need to stretch your legs becomes overwhelming.
translation:
你进入了你认为应该是排队中的队伍。它一动不动。

你站着。然后你坐着。然后你躺着。没动。

真菌群落的鬼魂占据了你旁边的一个空间。它闻起来像泥土和永恒黑暗。它也不会去任何地方。

你到这儿以后就没吃过东西。没有光线的变化可以帮助你猜测这已经持续了多久。感觉像是几天。感觉又像是几个星期。

最后，伸展双腿的渴望变得势不可挡。

original: A Rental Dispute: Hurry a ruling on an overlong contract
translation: 一场租约纠纷：匆忙裁决一份过长的合同

original: Spend a barrel of hours to get a hearing sooner.
translation: 花一桶时间争取早日举行听证会。

original: Granted, in a slightly cheating manner
translation: 当然，以一种带有轻微欺骗的方式

original:
The attendant asks about the Ambassador, Albion, your opinion of Devils and your reasons for siding with them against your own kind. 

She inks your tongue and takes its imprint. She tests your spittle with drops that turn it a vigorous puce, "to check for spite."

Then she writes out her own notes in handwriting like the trace of a vine. She adduces five precedents which have bearing on this case. On the lease itself, she places a symbol which means 'the tree that dies upright in the forest, but does not fall until a snow comes.'
translation:
侍者询问了大使、阿尔比恩，你对魔鬼的看法，以及你站在他们这边与你同类为敌的原因。

她用墨水涂在你的舌头上，并取下了它的印迹。她用几滴试剂测试了你的唾液，使其变成了鲜艳的紫色，“以检查是否有恶意”。

然后，她以如藤蔓般蜿蜒的笔迹写下了自己的笔记。她引用了五个与本案有关的先例。在租约本身上，她放置了一个符号，意思是“森林中直立而死的树，直到雪来时才倒下”。

original: Claim the Status of Ephemera
translation: 宣称浮生灵的地位

original: You have been Yoked long enough. The Court of Oaks might rule you to be free.
translation: 你变成缚链灵这么久。橡树法庭可能会裁定你重获自由。

original: Languid investigation
translation: 慵懒的调查

original:
First there is the wait to reach the attendant's window. Then, when at last you do, it is in no hurry to collect your information. From courtesy, it asks you first about your birth and family, and then about your travels, and next about your state of health. Several hours pass before it even opens an inquiry about your status...

So you talk and talk until your breath is exhausted, but it is enough, in the end. You're marked Ephemera rather than Yoked, and now you may move about as the Ephemera do.
translation:
首先得等着轮到你的窗口。然后，终于轮到你的时候，对方却并不急于收集你的信息。出于礼貌，它会先问你的出生和家庭情况，然后问你的旅行情况，接着问你的健康状况。几个小时过去后，它才询问你的身份...

所以你一直说一直说，直到精疲力尽，但最终还是够了。你被标记为浮生灵而非缚链灵，现在你可以像浮生灵一样四处走动了。

original: Observe the Court of Oaks
translation: 观察橡树法庭

original: One may watch, with or without entering the court itself.
translation: 可以观看，是否进入法庭是自愿的。

original: Endurance
translation: 忍耐

original:
The Court of Oaks serves creatures with very long lives, those with a great deal of patience, and those bringing suit because a contract or term of service overran its natural bounds. Souls with the Flickering flaw can be remedied, though at significant cost. 

Those with the Yoked status can be returned to Ephemera status on recognition that they have been too long in service.
translation:
橡树法庭为寿命极长的生物、极具耐心的生物以及因合同或服务期限超出自然范围而提起诉讼的生物服务。带有闪烁缺陷的灵魂可以得到补救，但代价高昂。

对于服务时间过长的缚链灵，在确认其身份后，可以将其恢复到浮生灵的状态。

original: The Court of Apes
translation: 猿猴法庭

original:
This is where you belong. 

A man in military trousers reads a newspaper. A masked gorilla holds a sheaf of documents written on banana leaf. 

On the wall is a sign that says, "Everything in its place." When you read it a second time, it says, "The Queue Forms to the Right."

This is where you belong.
translation:
你属于这里。

一个穿着军裤的男人正在读报纸。一只戴着面具的大猩猩拿着写在香蕉叶上的文件。

墙上有一个牌子，上面写着：“物归原处。”再看一遍，就变成了“排队请向右。”

你属于这里。

original: A Rental Dispute: Begin renegotiating the Embassy's lease
translation: 租赁纠纷：重新谈判大使馆的租赁合同

original: Take a number. Wait on a cushion until the number is called.
translation: 取个号。坐在垫子上等待，直到被叫到号码。

original: You are number 2047
translation: 你是第2047号

original:
You sit. You lose feeling in your legs. Sometimes, you see another Ape rise from its place. It shakes hands with the Ape to its left and the Ape to its right: grave courtesy from gorilla to chimp, from chimp to woman, from woman to gibbon.

At last, Ape 2047 may approach the window. You perform your handshakes.

The attendant holds the lease close to the eyeholes of its mask. Finally its voice-jar speaks. "Clarifications on existing contracts go to the Court of Mules. You will need a Testament of the Feather to be heard there." 

It hands the lease back and summons Ape 2048.
translation:
你坐着。你的腿失去了知觉。有时，你看到另一只猿猴从它的位置上站起来。它与左边的和右边的猿猴握手：一种从大猩猩到黑猩猩，从黑猩猩到雌性猿猴，从雌性猿猴到长臂猿的严肃握手礼节。

最后，2047号猿猴可以前往服务窗口。你也做了握手礼。

侍者将租约紧贴在它面具的眼睛孔上。终于，它的声音罐子发出声音。“关于现有合同的阐明，请到骡子法庭。你需要一份羽之证明才能在那里受到接见。”

它把租约递了回给你，并叫来第2048号猿猴。

original: A Rental Dispute: Begin renegotiating the Embassy's lease
translation: 租赁纠纷：重新谈判大使馆的租赁合同

original: Take a number. Wait on a cushion until the number is called.
translation: 取个号。坐在垫子上等待，直到被叫到号码。

original: You are number 2047
translation: 你是第2047号

original:
You sit. You lose feeling in your legs. Sometimes, you see another Ape rise from its place. It shakes hands with the Ape to its left and the Ape to its right: a grave courtesy from gorilla to chimp, from chimp to woman, from woman to gibbon.

At last, Ape 2047 may approach the window. 

But no sooner do you get there than the attendant clicks angrily. "No boons, favours, requests or solicitations are honoured from persons with a Clear soul!" it snaps, as though you ought to know this already. "Go to the Mayflies first!"

[A visit to the Court of Mayflies will allow you to lift your Clear Soul flaw.]
translation:
你坐着。你的腿失去了知觉。有时，你看到另一只猿猴从它的位置上站起来。它与左边的和右边的猿猴握手：一种从大猩猩到黑猩猩，从黑猩猩到雌性猿猴，从雌性猿猴到长臂猿的严肃握手礼节。

最后，2047号猿猴可以前往服务窗口。

但你一到窗口，侍者就生气地哇啦哇啦向你说话。“不受理有澄明灵魂缺陷的人任何的福利、恩惠、请求或索取！”侍者突然停下来，好像你早就应该已经知道这一点。“先去蜉蝣那里！”

[拜访蜉蝣法庭，可以解除你的澄明灵魂缺陷。]

original: Undergo the removal of your Lightless soul flaw
translation: 消除你灵魂的无光缺陷

original:
The spirits of the Court of Apes offer you this gift: their appetite.
[This will remove your Flaw: Lightless at the permanent cost of 1 Mirrors.]
translation:
猿猴法庭的鬼魂赐予你一份礼物：他们的渴求。
[这将以1点镜子的永久成本消除你的缺陷：无光 。]

original: These are the desires that they display to you
translation: 这些是他们向你展示的欲望

original:
To have a taste of blood on the teeth. To smile like a killer. To fill the lungs completely.

To uncover the mechanism that drives the birth of stars. To fling faeces into the cogs. To rejoice in the equations of rotation, and also in the squishy stink.

To have kin, and to be chief among them.

To mark the world deeply.

One by one the others in the Court of Apes offer you these ambitions, and then they go to the window and meet with the creature that presides. 

Every one bows to its edict. Every one passes silently from the Court.
translation:
让牙齿间留有血腥的味道。来露出杀手般的微笑。让肺部充盈。

去揭开恒星诞生的奥秘。将粪便抛入齿轮中。沉浸在旋转的方程式中，也沉醉在粘稠的臭气中。

拥有亲人，并成为他们之中的首领。

在世界上留下深刻的印记。

在猿猴法庭上，其他人逐一向你展示这些野心，然后他们走到窗边，与那里的主宰者会面。

每个人都对它的命令俯首帖耳。每个人都默默地从法庭中离开。

original: Achieve a Testament of the Feather
translation: 获得羽之证明

original:
A matter of convincing the attendants of this Court that your case deserves to be heard by another.
[A Testament of the Feather can be used to gain access to various officials elsewhere in the Blue Kingdom.]
translation:
要说服这个法院的侍者，你的案件应该由另一个人审理。
[羽之证明可以用来获得与蓝色王国其他地方的各种官员会见的机会。]

original: A grant of Favour
translation: 一种恩赐

original:
You tell a story that moves the attendant to tears. You invoke the influence of your benefactor. You embellish certain points, and gloss over others.

It is enough. "I have a friend in another Court. You will only need to bring a message from me..." says the attendant, proud of his generosity. All the trouble of your case will land on someone else.

The attendant inscribes the Testament of the Feather in clay and bakes it with the glare of his will. When you pick it up, it feels like a brick that has been left in the sun.
translation:
你讲了一个让侍者感动得落泪的故事。你提及了你恩人的影响力。你美化某些事件并掩盖其他事情。

“这就够了。我有个朋友在另一个法庭。你只需要替我带个口信……”侍者说道，并为自己的慷慨感到自豪。你案子里的所有麻烦都会落到另一个人的身上。

侍者用把羽之证明刻在一块陶板上，并用它的意志强烈地烧硬它。当你把它捡起来的时候，感觉就像捡起一块被太阳晒过许久的砖块。

original: Unconvinced
translation: 不为所动

original: Perhaps, suggests the Court, you are meddling in things that you ought to leave alone. Nuisance suits are not regarded kindly in the Blue Kingdom.
translation: 法庭提示，也许你正在插手那些你不该干涉的事情。滋扰性质的诉讼在蓝色王国不受欢迎。

original: Lurk near the Court of Apes
translation: 潜伏在猿猴法庭附近

original: You may wish to observe its protocols.
translation: 你也许想要观察它的流程。

original: Those going in
translation: 那些要进去的

original:
This Court attends to apes and monkeys, to humans, and to certain orders that appear similar to humans. It issues Testaments of the Feather, when the attendants think another Court should listen to someone's rightful claim. And they say that Lightless souls can be cured here, though at a significant price.

As you watch, a Yoked Shade carries in a basket of figs.
translation:
这个法庭负责处理猿猴、人类和某些看起来与人类相似的特定种族的诉求。当服务人员认为另一个法庭应该听取某人的合法诉求时，它就会给予羽之证明。他们说，无光的灵魂可以在这里得到治愈，尽管要付出很大的代价。

当你观察的时候，一个缚链灵遗魂带着一篮无花果进去了。

original: The Court of Mules
translation: 骡子法庭

original: Smaller and more dimly lit than the other courts, this place is for applicants who wish to appeal or clarify a previous decision. The spirit of a pear sapling is next in line, followed by a liger in a striped mask, and a pair of women holding hands.
translation: 这个地方比其他法庭更小，光线更暗，是为希望上诉或弄清先前裁决的申请人准备的。一棵梨树幼苗的鬼魂排在队列最前头，接着是一只戴着条纹面具的老虎，以及一对手拉着手的女人。

original: Contest the interpretation of the Embassy lease
translation: 对使馆租约的解释提出异议

original: To be seen in the Court of Mules, one must either belong to the Court by nature, or be sent by another functionary.
translation: 要想在骡子法庭得到接见，一个人必须要么天生上属于骡子法庭，要么由另一官方人员派遣而来。

original: Solid attention
translation: 全神贯注

original:
You must surrender your Testament of the Feather in order to be given a place in line. Then you must wash your body with a sponge dipped in vinegar-water.

After this, the masked attendant kneels beside you on a square of bleached linen. She takes careful and copious notes. She does say, with a sigh, that you can never tell with contracts drawn up by Devils.

Finally she asks: should the Ambassador of Albion hold the Toll-Tower, though it belonged to the Devils for millennia? Though she has already stretched her time with imported hours? Though she has no respect for bounds?
translation:
你必须交出你的羽之证明才能在排队的队伍中得到一个位置。然后你必须用蘸了醋水的海绵清洗你的身体。

随后，戴着面具的侍者跪在你身旁一块褪色的亚麻布上。她仔细地记了大量笔记。她叹了口气说，你永远不知道魔鬼如何解释由他们拟订的合同。

最后，她问道：尽管渡灵塔千年来一直属于魔鬼，但阿尔比恩应该在其中拥有它的位置吗？尽管大使已经用进口的时间延长了她所在的时间？尽管她不尊重蓝色王国规则与理念？

original: Yes, she has made great progress
translation: 是的，她已经取得了很大的进展

original:
She needs just a little more time.
[This choice will commit you to act against the Devils and for the Ambassador.]
translation:
她还需要一点点时间。
[这个选择将使你做出反对魔鬼和支持大使的行动。]

original: "Very well," says the attendant. "The Mayflies control precedent that pertains to unfairly short contracts, rents, and leases of life. Ask them to rule."
translation: “很好，”侍者说。“蜉蝣法庭控制着不公平的短期合同、租金和生命出租有关的判例。请让他们裁决吧。”

original: When it's put that way, no
translation: 这么说的话，不行

original:
Albion has no rightful claim.
[This choice will commit you to act against the Ambassador.]
translation:
阿尔比恩的诉求并不正当。
[这个选择将使你决定反对大使。]

original: "Then we are pursuing an eviction," says the attendant. "The Court of Oaks controls precedent around unreasonable delays and matters of endurance. Ask them to rule."
translation: “那么，我们就需要进行驱逐，”侍者说，“橡树法庭控制着不合理的拖延和积压事务的判例。请让他们裁决吧。”

original: Seek a removal of your Curdled Soul flaw
translation: 寻求治疗，以消除你的灵魂凝结缺陷

original:
The spirits of the Court of Mules offer you insight.
[This will remove your Flaw: Curdled at the permanent cost of 1 Iron.]
translation:
骡子法庭的鬼魂给你提供了洞察力。
[这将以永久失去1点钢铁值为代价消除你的缺陷：凝结 。]

original: An antidote
translation: 解药

original:
The memories are vivid, varied, distracting. In many cases they are disturbing, even frightening: marriages of defiance, unsuitable love affairs, children born to imprisoned mothers. A duckling adopted by a sympathetic poodle. The synthetic growth of a Rubbery Appendage. A thousand thousand rejections of status and social striving, in exchange for a moment's true connection, no matter how unlikely that connection might seem.

The Blue Kingdom swallows fame, fortunes, titles and estates as though they had never been. But it cannot digest these events. They persist, sapphires caught in the crop of a basilisk.
translation:
记忆是鲜活的、多姿的、纷扰的。在许多情况下，它们是令人不安的，甚至是可怕的：违抗的婚姻，不合适的恋情，被囚禁的母亲所生的孩子。一只小鸭子被一只有同情心的狮子狗收养。橡皮筋的合成生长。一千次对地位和社会努力的拒绝，换来了片刻的真正联系，无论这种联系看起来多么不可能。

蓝色王国吞下了名声、财富、头衔和遗产，就像它们从未出现过一样。但它无法消化这些事件。它们持续存在，就像蓝宝石被巴斯里斯克的庄稼夹住一样。

original: Study the signs outside the Court of Mules
translation: 研究骡子法庭外的标志

original: You can listen for rumours about the cases being heard within.
translation: 你可以听一听里面正在审理的案件。

original: Several purposes
translation: 万千意图

original: The Court of Mules attends to spirits that inherit more than one category; to exceptionally stubborn and determined spirits; and to appeals on rulings that have already been given. The queue moves slowly.
translation: 骡子法庭负责处理承袭了多个物种的鬼魂；异常固执和坚定的鬼魂；以及对已经作出的裁决提出的上诉。队列缓慢移动。

original: Subcontract your Litigator to another applicant
translation: 将你的诉讼代表外租给另一个申请人

original:
A masked shark would pay for the assistance of your Litigator. You will also need to wait while its case is made.
[This will exchange a Barrel of Unseasoned Hours for 100 Sovereigns.]
translation:
一条戴面具的鲨鱼会为你诉讼代表的帮助买单。你还将需要等待直到它的案件受到审理。
[这将用一桶未加工的时间换取100金镑。]

original: Some grumbling
translation: 一些埋怨

original:
[qvd:138076(Name)][qvd:138077(Name)][qvd:138078(Name)] is mildly annoyed by the extra work, and the shark's concerns are not easy to understand. 

You wait to one side, while [qvd:138076(name)][qvd:138077(name)][qvd:138078(name)] pulls three of the shark's teeth and conveys them to the attendant of the Court. Further ceremonies are conducted in an oversized bathtub, wheeled in by three Yoked spirits for the purpose.

After considerable splashing, the shark passes onward to the Court of Whales, and you receive your payment.
translation:
[qvd:138076(Name)][qvd:138077(Name)][qvd:138078(Name)]对额外的工作有些恼火，而且鲨鱼的担忧并不容易理解。

你在一旁等候，而[qvd:138076(name)][qvd:138077(name)][qvd:138078(name)]拔出三颗鲨鱼牙并将它们传给法庭的侍者。在由三个缚链灵特地推来的硕大浴缸中，执行了进一步的仪式。

在好一阵水花四溅后，鲨鱼前往鲸鱼法庭，而你收到了你的报酬。

original: The Antechamber of the Pansekritis
translation: 潘塞克里蒂斯的前厅

original:
One may see the Pansekritis at any time. He appears as a sigil of flame at the heart of the House of Days. The same sigil is reflected in the polished stone. It is written at the head of the page, every page, in every appointment book of the House. It is spoken as greeting and parting by the servants of the House. 

To be noticed by the Pansekritis, however, requires effort and prior arrangement.
translation:
人们随时都能看到潘塞克里蒂斯。他以燃烧着火焰的符印的形式出现在时光之屋的中心。同样的符印也映现在抛光的石头上。它被写在书页的开头，书籍的每一页，在每个法院的任命文件上。它被时光之屋的仆人们作为问候和离别的话语。

然而，要想得到潘塞克里蒂斯的注意，需要一些努力和安排。

original: Claim your right to an audience
translation: 要求获得觐见的权利

original: This will bring you before the Pansekritis, following the established protocols. Your liver will be required as a deposit. You will get it back later.
translation: 按照既定程序，这将把你带到潘塞克里蒂斯面前。你的肝脏需要作为抵押品。你稍后会把它取回来的。

original: Others have vouched for you
translation: 别人为你做了担保

original:
Place the Testaments of the Feather here, on the back of a heron. Then, expose your belly to the nails of a masked jackal. 

The wound is not fatal while you are in the House of Days. But you are committed now. Fail to come back this way and you will be, for a brief time, very sorry.

The jackal packs the vacancy with linen and bitter herbs. Your liver goes into a jar which is stamped with your name in the House of Days, and the jar stored on a shelf with twelve of thirteen other jars of various sizes. Several are very dusty.
translation:
把羽之证明放在苍鹭的背上。然后把你的肚子暴露给覆面豺狼的爪子。

在时光之屋里，这个伤口不会致命。但你现在已经下定决心了，如果你没有按这条路回来，你将会在短时间内感到非常后悔。

豺狼用亚麻布和苦药草填充了空缺。你的肝脏被放进了一个罐子里，这个罐子刻上了你的名字，并被存放在时光之屋里一个架子上，与其他十二个或十三个不同大小的罐子放在一起。其中几个罐子上积满了灰尘。

original: Walk boldly into the Presence
translation: 直接闯入

original:
This is dangerous. It avoids certain liturgies and rituals. Following protocols would be safer.
[Failing here will strip you of your Status in the Blue Kingdom.]
translation:
这很危险。此举规避了所需的典仪和程式。遵循规程会更安全。
[若在这里失败，你在蓝色王国的地位会被剥夺。]

original: Between the glance of one guard and the next
translation: 在两名看守的注视之下

original: You go with courage. It is the only way. Admit doubt that you belong, and you will not belong.
translation: 你带着勇气前行。这是唯一的办法。供认你对于自身地位的怀疑，你便会失去任何地位。

original: Cast out
translation: 扫地出门

original:
Some courts rely on guards. The Pansekritis needs none. You have not been granted an audience. Therefore, you have no place claiming the attention of the Pansekritis. When you receive it anyway, for a fraction of an instant, you see yourself as the Pansekritis sees you:

Impertinent. Intruding. Insignificant. It has concerns you cannot imagine. Business like yours is for the servants of servants.

Then your presence, your highly unsuitable presence, is... negated. You are slapped backwards, outside the House, status stripped away, Invisible again. The experience doesn't physically harm you, but you cannot forget the sight of your own smallness.

[You are once more Invisible to those of the Blue Kingdom.]
translation:
有些法庭依靠卫兵护卫，而潘塞克里蒂斯却无需如此。你并未获准觐见。因此，你无权奢求潘塞克里蒂斯的关注。但当它的目光真的投向你时，就在那片刻之间，你看到了自己在潘塞克里蒂斯眼中的模样：

无礼。冒昧。微不足道。它的所思所虑你无可想象。像你这样的琐事，只配由仆人的仆人处置。

然后，你这存在，你这个极度不合适的存在，就被……抹煞了。你被一把扇退到时光之屋的外面，地位尽失，并再次堕为无形灵。这个经历并没有对你造成实质性的伤害，但你无法忘记自己那渺小的样子。

[你再一次成为蓝色王国的无形灵。]

original: Listen to rumours about the Pansekritis
translation: 听听关于潘塞克里蒂斯的传言

original: Each time you hear the name, it conveys new meanings to you.
translation: 每次你听到这个名字，它都会向你传达新的含义。

original: Echo on echo
translation: 回声交叠

original:
The Pansekritis is a Logos, a word that was spoken by the Westernmost King, and has echoed ever since. Depending on your translator, the Pansekritis’ meaning may be rendered as any of these phrases:

Eternal dominion

Everything in its place

No drop-in meetings permitted

The sigil is painted in nectar on the ceiling of the Court of Hummingbirds for the better understanding of the winged spirits; in the Court of Whales, it is expressed in bass song; in the Court of Bloodhounds, it is translated – almost accurately – as a scent of vetiver and sandalwood.
translation:
潘塞克里蒂斯是一个圣言，一个由蓝宝石之王说出的词语，并一直回响至今。根据为你翻译它的人的说法，潘塞克里蒂斯的意思可能被翻译成这些短语中的任何一句。

永恒统治

万物各居其位

不允许随意会面

蜂鸟法庭的天花板上用花蜜画出了这个符印，以便让带有翅膀的鬼魂更好地理解信符的含义；在鲸鱼法庭，它们用低声调的歌声表达潘塞克里蒂斯的含义；在猎犬法庭，它几乎被准确地翻译成香根草和檀香木的香味。

original: Return to the Presence of the Pansekritis
translation: 回到潘塞克里蒂斯的面前

original: Now that you have been once, it is easier to claim a second visit.
translation: 既然你已经去过一次，那么再去一次就更容易了。

original: Familiar scents
translation: 熟悉的气味

original:
Your liver is removed, its place is packed with herbs and white linen and an astringent powder. The jackal in attendance nods as it does its work. You do not flinch, which makes the operation faster.

Now it is over, and you are free to enter.
translation:
你的肝脏被取走了，取而代之的是草药、白麻布和止血粉。在一旁的胡狼一边工作一边点头。你并没有退缩，这使得手术进行得更快。

现在手术结束了，你可以自由进入。

original: Have your Litigator argue your right to enter
translation: 让你的诉讼代表论证你的进入权利

original: Your Litigator can help you gain access to the Pansekritis at a reduced cost, and with your liver.
translation: 你的诉讼代表可以帮助你以较低的成本和抵押你的肝脏来获得会见潘塞克里蒂斯的机会。

original: Others have vouched for you
translation: 别人为你做了担保

original: [qvd:138076(pansekritis_entry)][qvd:138077(pansekritis_entry)][qvd:138078(pansekritis_entry)]
translation: [qvd:138076(pansekritis_entry)][qvd:138077(pansekritis_entry)][qvd:138078(pansekritis_entry)]

original: The Porch of the House of Days
translation: 时光之屋的门厅

original:
The House of Days is a palace so large that it is hard to see both ends of the facade. The staircase up is many storeys tall and ballrooms wide.

There is only one door. Spirits go in briskly, but those who come out are slower, not always sure where to go next.

A masked Rubbery spirit sits on the steps, holding an application tablet smeared in yellowish fluid: Application Denied, No Right of Appeal.
translation:
时光之屋是一座宫殿，其规模宏大，难以一眼看清全貌。楼梯高耸入云，大厅宽阔无垠。

宫殿只有一扇门。鬼魂们匆匆而入，但出来的人却步履缓慢，往往不知接下来该往何处去。

一位戴着面具的软体人鬼魂坐在台阶上，手中拿着一张涂满黄色液体的申请表：“申请被拒，无权上诉”。

original: Attempt the doorway
translation: 试着走到门口

original: The door is guarded by two wheels of light, living and resplendent. They are not quite too bright to look at.
translation: 这扇门由两个明亮、生动且辉煌的轮子守护着。它们看起来并不刺眼。

original: Unwelcome!
translation: 不受欢迎！

original:
One of the Wheels circles you. You have no shadow, illuminated like this. The fact strikes you as obscurely shameful. 

"You are Invisible," says the Wheel, though the language it uses is a single word, which is its own name, and which you comprehend without translation. "You must present yourself to the proper authorities and be given a Status in the Blue Kingdom."

A masked chimpanzee passes you, snickering. It has been marked with a seal that declares it Ephemera.

[Speak with the Secretary at the Embassy of Albion in the Toll-Tower to learn how you may change your status.]
translation:
一个发光的轮状物围着你转动。在光轮的照耀下，你没有影子。这个事实让你感到费解的羞耻。

“你是无形灵，”光轮说，尽管它所用的语言是一个独词——这是它自己的名字，而且你不需要翻译就能理解。“你必须向合适的官方机构介绍自己，并在蓝色王国获得一个地位。”

一只戴着面具的黑猩猩从你身边经过，窃笑着。它身上有一个图章，宣布它是浮生灵。

[在渡灵塔与阿尔比恩大使馆的秘书交谈，了解如何改变你的地位。]

original: Lurk near the Entrance
translation: 潜伏在入口处附近

original: Perhaps someone will tell you what lies inside.
translation: 也许有人会告诉你里面有什么。

original: Rumours gathered
translation: 收集传言

original:
Once upon a time, the House of Days was only one court, with the Pansekritis inside. They built new Courts each time a new need was found.

Now, several floors of the House of Days are too low-ceilinged for a human to enter, and others are scaled for giants. Two sections of the House are underwater, and one burns without respite, catering to the spirits of those born in volcanoes.

These surface differences do not signify. Every court is essentially alike: a place to wait, a place to fill forms, a collection of weighing and measuring devices, a window with a secretary.
translation:
曾几何时，时光之屋只有一个法庭，其中的法官便是潘塞克里蒂斯。每当发现新的需求时，他们都会建造新的法院。

现在，时光之屋有几层矮到人类无法进入，另外几层则高到让能巨人使用。房子的两部分一部分淹没在水下，另一部分燃烧在火中，为了那些在火山中出生的人的鬼魂。

这些表面差异并不意味着什么。每个法庭基本上都是一样的：一个等待的地方，一个填写表格的地方，一堆称重和测量设备，一个有秘书的窗口。

original: Mingle in the crowds approaching the staircase
translation: 混在接近楼梯的人群中

original: There are creatures and spirits without number.
translation: 有无数生物和鬼魂。

original: Attempt the doorway
translation: 试着走到门口

original: You have the Status to enter, but you have not been to the House of Days before, and there are rituals to perform.
translation: 你的身份可以进入，但你以前没有去过时光之屋，还有一些仪式要进行。

original: Acknowledged
translation: 受到认可

original:
You must be clean in purpose and in body, and to this end, you are washed with vinegar and scrubbed with salt. Then you are given three poems in honour of the Sapphir'd King, which you must read aloud, in chorus with the others entering the House just now.

"Not as bad as my Litigator made me think," remarks a cheerful shade beside you. But that is before the Ceremony of Inhalation. You are tested with the odour of the rotting dead, and you only just escape being most improperly ill.

After all this, the attendants direct you towards the Court of Apes.
translation:
你必须身心纯洁，为此，你得用醋洗身，用盐擦身。然后，你会得到三首颂扬蓝宝石之王的诗，你必须和刚才刚进入大厅的其他人一起大声朗读。

“没有我的诉讼代表让我以为的那么糟糕，”你旁边一个欢快的遗魂说道。但这仅仅是吸入之仪式前的一个步骤。你经受着腐尸气味的考验，竭尽全力不让自己由于恶心而失态。

经过这一切后，侍从们指引你前往猿猴法庭。

original: Return within
translation: 返回内部

original: You have been to the House of Days once before, and may reenter now.
translation: 你以前去过一次时光之屋，现在可以重新进入。

original: An Opportunity: Caged Catches at the House of Days
translation: 机遇：时光之屋的笼中猎获

original:
Occasionally, great-souled beasts find their way to the Blue Kingdom. Most are quickly pacified and made to comply with the laws of the Sapphir'd King and begin their progress towards Death's Door. 

Some resist, however. It is to the Blue Kingdom's bureaucratic embarrassment that there is no law prohibiting bestial Antedeceased. To resolve this the animals are permitted to return to the High Wilderness, provided that they can find someone to take them.

A hunched spirit keeps the Court of Primordials, ensuring they depart in cages, and that someone takes away the wretched things.
translation:
偶尔，会有巨魂野兽来到蓝色王国。它们大多数很快就会被安抚下来，并遵守蓝宝石之王的法律，开始向死亡之门进发。

然而，也有一些野兽会不断抵抗。让蓝色王国的官僚们感到尴尬的是，并没有法律禁止质亡灵地位的野兽不能在蓝色王国停留。为了解决这个问题，野兽们被允许回到天野，只要它们能找到人带他们离开。

一个驼背的鬼魂主持着原始法庭，确保野兽们呆在笼子里，并确保会有人带走这些可恶的东西。

original: Employ your litigator to lower the price
translation: 让你的诉讼代表来讲价

original:
[qvd:138077(Catch)][qvd:138076(Catch)][qvd:138078(Catch)]

[You will gain five Caged Catches.]
translation:
[qvd:138077(Catch)][qvd:138076(Catch)][qvd:138078(Catch)]

[你将获得五个笼中猎获。]

original: Helping hands
translation: 援助之手

original:
The presiding spirit listens wearily, before waving you through to the Court of the Primordials.

Spirits help you gather the animals deemed worthiest of passage; that is, the greatest nuisances. The rituals of purification: the washing with the vinegar, the dipping in salt, the rubbing of the flanks with honey, are left to you. Your litigator does assist.
translation:
在疲倦地听你陈词之后，主持的鬼魂便挥手示意你前往原始法庭。

鬼魂会帮你集中那些被认为最值得离开的动物，也就是最麻烦的那些。清洗的仪式：用醋清洗、盐水浸泡、用蜂蜜擦拭侧腹，这些都交由你来完成。你的诉讼代表也会协助你。

original: Pay for the Caged Catches with British coin
translation: 用英国钱币购买笼中猎获

original:
The new currency of Heaven isn't universal to the Blue Kingdom. They may not consider it legal tender.

[You will gain between 3 and 5 Caged Catches.]
translation:
在天野流通的货币对蓝色王国来说并不是广泛使用的。他们可能不认为这是法定货币。

[你将获得3到5只笼中猎获]

original: A bargain struck
translation: 达成交易

original:
The presiding spirit is unsure about accepting your foreign sovereigns but does appreciate the quantity and hue. After several minutes of prodding, your price is accepted.

You are brought to the Court of Primordials, which is a stinking menagerie of caged beasts. After performing a ritual cleansing of the beasts with vinegar, you are permitted to leave with five.
translation:
主持鬼魂对接受你的外国货币有所疑虑，但对数量和色调很欣赏。经过几分钟的催促后，你的报价被接受了。

你被带到了原始法庭，那是一个散发着恶臭的野兽动物园。在用醋对野兽进行了一场仪式性的清洁之后，你被允许带走五只。

original: Come away
translation: 走吧

original:
The presiding spirit in its porcelain mask, peers at your sovereigns in confusion. At last, having determined they are neither edible nor a threat, it accepts them, and permits you to remove three of the beasts from the Court of Primordials. 

The beasts are eager to be away and submit to the ritual purifying with vinegar and wine with only moderate growling. You take the opportunity to shove them into their cages while they're still docile.
translation:
瓷质面具后的主持鬼魂疑惑地凝视着你的金镑。最后，在确认它们既不可食用也不构成威胁后，它接受了它们，并允许你从原始法庭中带走三只野兽。

野兽们渴望离开，在醋和酒的仪式净化过程中只是发出了轻微的咆哮声。你趁机在它们温顺时将它们推入笼子。

original: Wellmouth
translation: 井口

original:
Howling winds erupt from the frozen abyss, rattling roofs and chasing snow over mist-shrouded streets. 

[qvd:138775(wellmouth_desc)]

[qvd:138480(wellmouth_desc)]
translation:
咆哮的寒风从冰封的深渊中喷涌而出，吹得屋顶嘎嘎作响，在薄雾笼罩的街道上追逐积雪。

[qvd:138775(wellmouth_desc)]

[qvd:138480(wellmouth_desc)]

original: Speak to the Widows
translation: 与寡妇们说话

original: These cadaverous figures are known as the Widows at the Well. [qvd:138480(speak_widows)]
translation: 这些形容枯槁的人被称为“井边寡妇”。[qvd:138480(speak_widows)]

original: Whispers among the Widows
translation: 寡妇间的私语

original: You've attracted a half-circle of veiled observers by now. They respond to your questions with whispers and hiss among themselves.[qvd:138480(speak_widows2)] "You're in the wrong place," says one of them finally, stepping a little too close. She points to where the lights of Urd twinkle on the other side of the well. "The Stone-Faced Court is there." "Grandmother will know you're here by now," says another of the Widows. "If you intend to stay, you must meet with her. Else, fly away at once."
translation: 现在你已经吸引了半圈蒙着面纱的观察者。她们用窃窃私语和嘶嘶声回应你的问题。[qvd:138480(speak_widows2)] “你来错地方了，”其中一人最后说道，她的走得太近了一点。她指着井的另一边，昔日城的灯火不断闪烁的地方，“石面法庭在那里。” “祖母现在知道你在这里了，”另一个寡妇说，“如果你打算留下来，你必须和她见面。否则，就马上飞走。”

original: Seek out the Matronly Relict's approval
translation: 寻求威严的遗族的批准

original: She squats in a black cottage at the village's heart. Its walls bulge and pulsate oddly. [qvd:138480(relict_approval)]
translation: 她蹲坐在村子中心的一间黑色小屋里。它的墙壁隆起，奇怪地搏动着。[qvd:138480(relict_approval)

original: The Matronly Relict
translation: 威严的遗族

original:
[qvd:138480(relict_approval3)]

She shuffles aside and gestures silently to an armchair beside a roaring fire. You ignore the insistent skitter-scratching coming from inside the walls, and you enter her parlour.
translation:
[qvd:138480(relict_approval3)]

她走到一旁，默默指向熊熊燃烧的火炉边的一把扶手椅。你忽略从墙内传来的持续不断的刮擦声，然后走进她的客厅。

original: Meet the Exacting Ombudsman
translation: 会见严苛的监察员

original: He has rope, and hooks, and an ice-axe. He is preparing to climb into the Well. [qvd:138480(ombudsman_doom)]
translation: 他有绳子、钩子和冰镐。他正在准备爬进井里。[qvd:138480(ombudsman_doom)]

original: A bold descent
translation: 大胆的下降

original:
"This will be a doddle," says the Ombudsman brightly as he drops over the edge. "I'll pop down, find what's wrong with the Watcher, then come back up and we can work out how to fix it!"

You watch as he descends. When you pull the rope back up, much later, the very end has been chewed off. [qvd:138480(ombudsman_doom2)]
translation:
“这简直是轻而易举，”调查员边说边越过边缘。“我会下去看看守望者出了什么问题，然后回来，我们可以一起想办法解决它！”

你看着他下降。当你很久之后才把绳子拉回来时，发现绳子末端被咬断了。 [qvd:138480(ombudsman_doom2)]

original: Visit the Matronly Relict
translation: 拜访威严的遗族

original: [qvd:138480(visit_relict)]
translation: [qvd:138480(visit_relict)]

original: Watch the Widows inter one of the Failed Dead
translation: 观看寡妇们处理一个失败的不死者

original: A steady supply of immortals and quasi-immortals trickles from the Stone-Faced Court. [qvd:138480(failed_dead)]
translation: 石面法庭源源不断地送来永生者和准永生者。[qvd:138480(failed_dead)]

original: The end of an immortal
translation: 一个永生者的终结

original: The Failed Dead is a cadaverous figure in a three-piece suit, his skin tattooed with phrases in Sanskrit. The Widows are dragging him to the edge of the Well atop a rickety cart. Though shackled in heavy iron, he thrashes and writhes like a snake on hot coals. "I can give you power!" he shouts, voice carrying even above the wind. The Widows' wagon nears the edge. "Wealth! Secrets! Feasts, favours! I've lived a thousand years, I am owed debts by gods! What do you want?" The Widows titter beneath their veils and tip him unceremoniously into the abyss. [qvd:138480(failed_dead2)]
translation: 这位失败的不死者是一位穿着三件套西装的枯槁身影，他的皮肤上纹刻着梵文短语。寡妇们正用一辆摇摇晃晃的小车将他拖到井边。尽管他被沉重的铁链束缚着，却仍像热炭上的蛇一样扭动挣扎。 “我能给你们力量！”他大声喊道，声音甚至盖过了风声。寡妇们的小车离井边越来越近。“财富！秘密！盛宴，恩惠！我活了一千年，众神都欠我人情！你们想要什么？” 寡妇们在面纱下窃笑，毫不客气地将他推进了深渊。[qvd:138480(failed_dead2)]

original: Ask about changing your Status
translation: 询问如何改变你的身份

original: [qvd:138480(status_change)]
translation: [qvd:138480(status_change)]

original: Wellmouth's Library
translation: 井口的图书馆

original: One of the Widows seems to fulfil the role of Wellmouth's archivist. She huddles alone in a library at the edge of the village, surrounded by crammed shelves, her floor obscured by a layer of damp-mangled books. When you ask her about changing your status, she scrabbles through the tome-heap and retrieves, with triumph, a mouldy journal. She flips to the relevant page. [qvd:138480(status_change2)] "Centuries past, we employed something called a Spider-Sweeper," she says. "It was a role assigned to a Yoked spirit, back when Grandmother tolerated their presence. Perhaps ask her about it?"
translation: 其中一位寡妇似乎扮演着井口档案员的角色。她独自蜷缩在村庄边缘的图书馆里，四周是拥挤的书架，地板上散落着一层因潮湿而损坏的书籍。 当你向她询问如何改变你的身份时，她手忙脚乱地在书堆中翻找，最终得意地找到了一本发霉的日记。她翻到相关页面。[qvd:138480(status_change2)] “几个世纪前，我们用过一种叫做蜘蛛清扫工的东西，”她说。“那是一个缚链灵，那时祖母还容忍他们的存在。也许你可以问问她？”

original: Fulfil your duties as the Spider-Sweeper
translation: 履行你作为蜘蛛清扫工的职责

original:
[qvd:138480(spider_sweeper)]
[This will change your status to Yoked, making you a lowly servant of the Blue Kingdom bureaucracy.]
translation:
[qvd:138480(spider_sweeper)]
[这将使你的地位变为缚链灵，使你成为蓝色王国官僚机构的低级仆人。]

original: The Spider-Sweeper's Duty
translation: 蜘蛛清扫工的职责

original:
The White Well's edges are a plunging tangle of clumped sorrow-spiders, thankfully frozen. Under your boots they crumble. With every step of your descent, shards of spider fall into the abyss.

You come across one of the Failed Dead, limbs outstretched, fingertips wormed into ice-cracks. He dabbled in immortality, and ended up here for his trouble. 

You swing toward him, broomstick jabbing and prodding, ignoring his yelps. He slips and falls into the abyss with a final screech. An undignified end for one who fought so hard not to end.

For the rest of the day you dislodge more Failed Dead, in much the same fashion. One whispers a confession in your ear before he plunges; another desperately summarises her life. Snatching for immortality, even now.
translation:
白井的边缘是一片杂乱无章的蜘蛛网，上面结满了悲伤蜘蛛，幸好它们都被冻住了。它们在你的靴底下破碎。每当你走一步，蜘蛛的碎片就会掉入深渊。

你遇到了一个失败的不死者，四肢伸开，指尖挤进了冰缝中。他曾涉足永生之术，却因此落得如此下场。

你朝他挥动扫帚，刺戳着，无视他的尖叫声。他滑倒并伴随着最后一声尖叫掉入了深渊。对于一个如此努力不愿终结的人来说，这是一个不体面的结局。

在接下来的日子里，你以同样的方式又驱赶了更多失败的不死者。其中一个在坠落前在你耳边低声忏悔；另一个则绝望地概述了她的一生。即使在现在，他们仍在拼命追求永生。

original: The Spider-Sweeper's Duty
translation: 蜘蛛清扫工的职责

original:
The White Well's edges are a plunging tangle of clumped sorrow-spiders, thankfully frozen. Under your boots they crumble. With every step of your descent, shards of spider fall into the abyss. 

The Failed Dead cling to the well like spiders in a bathtub. They've fought long and hard to avoid death, and they keep fighting even now. [qvd:138480(spider_sweeper2)]

He grabs your arm and sinks his teeth so deep he strikes bone. You kick him away and both the immortal and your broomstick fall, spinning endlessly.
translation:
白井的边缘是一团团悲伤蜘蛛交织而成的混乱景象，幸好它们都被冻住了。它们在你的靴底下破碎。每当你走一步，蜘蛛的碎片就会掉入深渊。

失败的不死者像浴缸里的蜘蛛一样紧贴着井口。他们长久以来都在艰难地抵抗死亡，即使现在他们仍在继续战斗。[qvd:138480(spider_sweeper2)]

他抓住你的手臂，牙齿咬得那么深，几乎要咬到骨头。你把他踢开，然后这个不死者和你的扫帚一起不停地旋转着坠落。

original: Fulfil your duties as the Spider-Sweeper
translation: 履行你作为蜘蛛清扫工的职责

original:
[qvd:138480(spider_sweeper)]
[You are already Yoked.]
translation:
[qvd:138480(spider_sweeper)]
[你已被缚。]

original: The Spider-Sweeper's Duty
translation: 蜘蛛清扫工的职责
